title: Tokka-Bench: Evaluating Tokenizers Across 100 Natural and 20 Programming Languages
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/bgub/tokka-bench. Interactive dashboard: https://tokka-bench.streamlit.app/
summary: Large language models rely on subword tokenizers whose quality varies across languages, yet no standardized multi-metric framework exists for broad comparative evaluation. We introduce Tokka-Bench, an open-source framework that evaluates tokenizers on five complementary metrics -- bytes per token, unique token coverage, subword fertility, word-split rate, and vocabulary composition -- across 100 natural languages (30+ scripts) and 20 programming languages, using language-aware segmentation adapted to each writing system. Comparing seven BPE tokenizers (GPT-2, GPT-4, gpt-oss, Llama 3.1, Gemma 3, Qwen3, and Kimi K2) within individual languages, we find that vocabulary allocation strategy matters more than raw vocabulary size, and that programming-language efficiency has converged among recent tokenizers despite divergent natural-language profiles. The framework, data, and interactive dashboard are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Tokka-Bench，一个开源框架，用于在100种自然语言和20种编程语言上，通过五个互补指标评估分词器质量，并比较了七种BPE分词器。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型依赖子词分词器，但其质量因语言而异，目前缺乏标准化的多指标框架进行广泛比较评估。
AI.method: Tokka-Bench框架使用字节每token、唯一token覆盖率、子词生育率、词拆分率和词汇组成五个指标，针对每种书写系统进行语言感知分词，在100种自然语言（30+种文字）和20种编程语言上评估七种BPE分词器（GPT-2、GPT-4、gpt-oss、Llama 3.1、Gemma 3、Qwen3和Kimi K2）。
AI.result: 词汇分配策略比原始词汇量大小更重要；近期分词器在编程语言效率上已趋同，尽管自然语言特征存在差异。
AI.conclusion: Tokka-Bench框架、数据和交互式仪表板已公开可用，为分词器比较提供了标准化多指标评估工具。

title: Quantifying Grid-Forming Requirements for System Strength: How Much and Where?
comment: 25th Wind & Solar Integration Workshop, Porto, Portugal, 29 September - 02 October 2026
summary: As power systems transition toward inverter-based resource (IBR)-dominated grids, Grid-ForMing (GFM) IBRs are increasingly expected to provide the voltage-source characteristics required to maintain adequate system strength. However, how many GFM IBRs are required, and where they should be located in the grid, remains unclear. This paper investigates the impact of the number and location of GFM IBRs on small-signal system strength. The Jacobian Voltage Stiffness Metric (JVSM), which quantifies the voltage-magnitude and voltage-phase stiffness from frequency-domain Jacobian characteristics, is used as a system-strength measure. The analysis demonstrates that increasing the number of GFM IBRs generally improves system strength; however, configurations with the same number of GFM IBRs can exhibit significantly different bus-wise system-strength characteristics depending on their locations. Thus, this paper provides a quantitative basis for specifying GFM requirements in terms of the resulting system strength, rather than solely in terms of penetration level or the number of GFM IBRs. Case studies on a modified IEEE 39-bus system demonstrate how JVSM can be used to quantify and compare the system-strength impact of different numbers and locations of GFM IBRs, with the resulting strength assessments validated against small-signal oscillatory stability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究GFM IBR的数量和位置对小信号系统强度的影响，提出以JVSM量化系统强度，并说明相同数量但不同位置会导致显著不同的母线级强度。
AI.motivation: 在IBR主导电网中，GFM IBR被期望提供维持系统强度所需的电压源特性，但需要多少台以及部署在哪里仍不明确。
AI.method: 采用Jacobian Voltage Stiffness Metric (JVSM)，从频域雅可比特性量化电压幅值和电压相位刚度，并在修改后的IEEE 39节点系统中比较不同数量和位置的GFM IBR。
AI.result: 增加GFM IBR数量通常提升系统强度；但相同数量下，不同位置会带来显著不同的母线级系统强度特性。JVSM评估结果通过小信号振荡稳定性得到验证。
AI.conclusion: GFM需求应基于其带来的系统强度进行量化规定，而不能仅以渗透率或GFM IBR数量为依据。

title: Abdominal Ultrasound Simulation from Semantic Labels using Paired Label-to-Physics-Based Image Translation
summary:
Purpose: Current abdominal ultrasound (US) simulation methods often require CT-based anatomical references for ray-casting, limiting deformation and pathology variability. We propose a learning-based pipeline trained to predict physics-based images derived from CT scans from semantic labels, enabling controlled simulations without patient-specific CT volumes at inference time.
  Methods: We introduce a two-stage pipeline that maps anatomical segmentations to realistic US images through a simplified US image. Stage~I synthesizes this image from semantic labels using models trained on CT-based ray-casting outputs. Stage~II refines it into a realistic US scan using anatomically guided unpaired translation. Deformations and pathologies are generated by editing anatomical maps.
  Results: We evaluated Pix2Pix and the Semantic Diffusion Model (SDM) in Stage~I, followed by segmentation-guided CycleGAN (SG-CycleGAN) refinement in Stage~II. SDM significantly outperformed Pix2Pix in morphological metrics, including MAE (19.85 vs. 21.65), SSIM (0.28 vs. 0.24), and mIoU (0.43 vs. 0.29), whereas Pix2Pix yielded better perceptual point estimates (LPIPS: 0.17 vs. 0.19; FID: 0.32 vs. 0.37; KID: 0.25 vs. 0.48).
  Conclusion: Training paired generative models with physics-based supervision enables approximation of CT-derived ray-casting outputs at inference time directly from semantic labels. Although the pipeline does not require patient-specific CT volumes at inference time, CT-derived segmentations and ray-casting simulations remain necessary to train Stage~I. Once trained, the framework enables controllable healthy and pathological simulations through semantic-map modification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段学习框架，无需推理时使用患者CT即可从语义标签生成逼真腹部超声图像，并支持通过编辑解剖图实现形变与病理模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有腹部超声模拟多依赖CT解剖参考进行光线投射，限制了解剖形变和病理变异性，因此希望训练模型从语义标签预测物理仿真图像，从而在推理阶段摆脱患者特异性CT体数据。
AI.method: 提出两阶段流程：第一阶段用基于CT光线投射输出训练的模型，从语义标签合成简化超声图像；第二阶段采用解剖引导的非配对图像翻译，将其细化为真实超声。通过编辑解剖图生成形变和病理。评估了Pix2Pix与语义扩散模型SDM，以及分割引导CycleGAN细化。
AI.result: 第一阶段中，SDM在形态学指标上显著优于Pix2Pix，如MAE 19.85 vs. 21.65、SSIM 0.28 vs. 0.24、mIoU 0.43 vs. 0.29；Pix2Pix在感知指标上更好，如LPIPS 0.17 vs. 0.19、FID 0.32 vs. 0.37、KID 0.25 vs. 0.48。
AI.conclusion: 用物理仿真监督训练配对生成模型，可在推理时仅从语义标签近似CT光线投射输出。虽然推理无需患者CT，但训练第一阶段仍需CT来源分割和光线投射模拟。训练完成后，可通过修改语义图实现可控的健康与病理超声模拟。

title: Pre-training, Reasoning, Benchmarking: X-ray Report Generation on CheXpert Plus Dataset
summary: X-ray image-based Radiology Report Generation (RRG) constitutes a critical research direction within medical artificial intelligence, with great potential to alleviate clinicians' diagnostic workload and shorten patient waiting periods. Despite substantial advances over recent years, the field faces evident bottlenecks stemming from insufficient standardized benchmarks and inadequate domain adaptation of generic large models. Notably, the newly released CheXpert Plus dataset is provided without accompanying baseline implementations and evaluation results, which impedes standardized training, quantitative evaluation and fair comparison among follow-up algorithms. To mitigate this limitation, we establish a comprehensive benchmark encompassing prevailing X-ray report generation models and Large Language Models on CheXpert Plus. This benchmark delivers a reliable comparative foundation for upcoming methods and enables researchers to rapidly identify state-of-the-art approaches within this domain. Beyond benchmark construction, we rethink X-ray RRG under the paradigm of large models and propose a novel framework termed MambaXray-PRB. Our framework improves report generation performance and enhances model interpretability via multi-stage large-model pre-training and multi-modal Chain-of-Thought reasoning. The pipeline consists of three successive phases: self-supervised auto-regressive modeling, X-ray-report contrastive learning, and post-training optimization for reasoning and report generation. Extensive experiments on IU X-ray, MIMIC-CXR, and CheXpert Plus datasets validate the effectiveness of MambaXray-PRB for radiology report generation. The source code of this paper is available on https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis

AI.tldr: 该论文针对X射线放射报告生成缺乏标准化基准和通用大模型领域适应不足的问题，在CheXpert Plus上构建综合基准，并提出MambaXray-PRB框架，在IU X-ray、MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: X射线报告生成可减轻临床诊断负担，但存在标准化基准不足和通用大模型领域适应不足等瓶颈。尤其CheXpert Plus数据集未提供基线实现与评估结果，阻碍了标准化训练、定量评估和公平比较。
AI.method: 在CheXpert Plus上建立涵盖主流X射线报告生成模型和大型语言模型的综合基准；提出MambaXray-PRB框架，采用多阶段大模型预训练和多模态思维链推理，包括自监督自回归建模、X射线-报告对比学习、面向推理与报告生成的后训练优化三个阶段。
AI.result: 该基准为后续方法提供可靠比较基础，帮助快速识别领域内最先进方法；在IU X-ray、MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus数据集上的大量实验验证了MambaXray-PRB在放射报告生成中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MambaXray-PRB能提升报告生成性能并增强模型可解释性；所构建基准有助于推动X射线报告生成领域的标准化评估与公平比较，论文源代码已开源。

title: Adaptive Workflow Intelligence: A Cognitive Architecture for Context-Driven Enterprise Automation
comment: 12 pages, simulation-based evaluation of adaptive workflow agents
summary: Enterprise systems increasingly rely on automated workflows, yet many AI-driven solutions remain brittle under non-stationary conditions, evolving policies, and delayed operational feedback. While reinforcement learning and large language model (LLM) agents offer partial adaptability, they do not by themselves provide persistent reflection mechanisms or straightforward integration with policy-constrained enterprise operations. This paper introduces Adaptive Workflow Intelligence (AWI), a cognitive architecture for context-driven enterprise agents organized around a four-layer Perception-Cognition-Action-Reflection (PCAR) loop. AWI treats reflection as a mechanism for continuous policy refinement and combines hybrid reasoning with reflective memory and feedback-driven adaptation to support decision making under environmental drift and operational constraints. We evaluate AWI in a simulated enterprise decision workflow characterized by delayed outcomes and a controlled regime shift. In a drift-and-delay stress test, guardrail-constrained adaptive approaches recover more rapidly than static automation while maintaining policy compliance. Within this setting, AWI's reflective components modestly reduce behavioral oscillation and feedback variance, illustrating the stability-agility trade-off introduced by reflective policy adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自适应工作流智能AWI，一种面向企业智能体的认知架构，基于感知-认知-行动-反思四层循环，通过反思机制进行持续策略优化，以应对环境漂移与运营约束下的决策问题。
AI.motivation: 企业自动化工作流在非平稳条件、政策演变和延迟反馈下表现脆弱；强化学习和LLM智能体虽有一定适应性，但缺乏持续反思机制，也难以直接融入受政策约束的企业运营。
AI.method: 提出AWI认知架构，围绕感知-认知-行动-反思循环组织企业智能体；将反思作为持续策略精炼机制，结合混合推理、反思记忆和反馈驱动适应；在具有延迟结果和受控制度转变的模拟企业决策工作流中评估。
AI.result: 在漂移与延迟压力测试中，受护栏约束的自适应方法比静态自动化恢复更快，同时保持政策合规；AWI的反思组件适度减少了行为震荡和反馈方差。
AI.conclusion: 结果体现了反思式策略适应带来的稳定性与敏捷性权衡，说明AWI可在环境漂移和运营约束下支持企业决策。

title: Geometry-Aware Diffusion Approximate Posterior Sampling for Sparse-View and Limited-Angle CT
summary:
Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation dose and acquisition time and may mitigate motion artifacts. However, angular undersampling provides insufficient information to determine the image uniquely and stably. Limited-angle CT, arising from restricted angular coverage, produces strongly directional information loss associated with the missing angular range. In both settings, image directions may be strongly observed, weakly constrained, or unobservable, leading to severe ill-posedness and reconstruction ambiguity. Existing diffusion-based approaches incorporate measurement information through likelihood guidance, data-consistency operations, or range-null-space corrections. However, they do not generally use the continuously varying measurement sensitivity of the acquisition to jointly shape both reconstruction updates and stochastic exploration.
  We propose a geometry-aware diffusion-guided stochastic reconstruction framework for sparse-view and limited-angle CT. Its central component is a regularized noise-weighted pullback metric constructed from the CT forward operator and measurement-noise covariance. This metric continuously adapts both the measurement-aware update and stochastic exploration according to directional measurement sensitivity, suppressing changes along strongly constrained directions while permitting greater exploration along weakly constrained and unobservable directions. We complement this geometry-aware update with a regularized data-consistency correction and approximately null-space-restricted stochastic perturbations, implemented matrix-free using forward and backprojection operations together with conjugate-gradient solves. Experiments on sparse-view, noisy, and limited-angle CT demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality, strong measurement consistency, and spatially resolved empirical uncertainty estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种几何感知的扩散引导随机重建框架，用于稀疏视角和有限角度CT；通过由CT前向算子与测量噪声协方差构造的正则化噪声加权拉回度量，按方向测量敏感度自适应调整重建更新与随机探索。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角CT可降低辐射剂量和采集时间，但角度欠采样导致病态性；有限角度CT存在方向性信息缺失，使图像方向可能强观测、弱约束或不可观测，造成严重不适定和重建模糊。现有扩散方法虽引入测量信息，但通常未利用随空间变化的测量敏感度来共同塑造重建更新和随机探索。
AI.method: 提出几何感知扩散引导随机重建框架。核心是构建正则化噪声加权拉回度量，基于CT前向算子和测量噪声协方差，连续自适应测量感知更新与随机探索：抑制强约束方向变化，允许弱约束和不可观测方向更大探索。辅以正则化数据一致性校正和近似零空间限制的随机扰动，并用前向/反投影与共轭梯度求解实现无矩阵计算。
AI.result: 在稀疏视角、含噪和有限角度CT实验中，该方法展现出有竞争力的重建质量、较强的测量一致性，以及空间分辨的经验不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知的扩散引导随机重建能够有效处理稀疏视角和有限角度CT中的不适定性，兼顾重建质量、数据一致性与不确定性量化。

title: Hybrid++: The Bridge between PDE Models and Deep Learning for Gamma Noise Removal
summary: Multiplicative gamma noise is one of the dominant noise factors in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and medical ultrasound images. They are dependent on pixel level noises due to which they are highly varying across the image and harder to handle as compared to additive noise. The denoising methods to address this noise currently include classical partial differential equation (PDE) methods which are good for interpretation but lack the restoration ability as compared to the state-of-the-art models while deep convolutional networks like DnCNN achieve high performance but at the cost of transparency due to which practitioners are skeptical to use them in high-risk critical fields like medicine. This paper presents Hybrid++, a novel trainable nonlinear reaction-diffusion architecture that addresses both the concerns - staying interpretable while offering performance close to huge black-box models. It combines a fully learnable PDE initialization with a 3-stage reaction-diffusion network having 64-channel multiscale filter banks, 4-layer Squeeze-and-Excitation attention-based influence functions and a 64-dimensional noise level embedding. It uses a two-phase training strategy, stage-wise optimization followed by joint end-to-end refinement which enables co-adaptation of all learnable parameters. On the FoE benchmark, Hybrid++ substantially improves over classical PDE, BM3D and the original TNRD baselines. In the severe-noise setting L=1, it comes within 0.23 dB PSNR of a separately trained DnCNN while using only about 8% of its parameters. We therefore position Hybrid++ not as a universal state-of-the-art image restoration backbone, but as a compact, physically structured reaction-diffusion model for multiplicative gamma noise.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 Hybrid++，一种可训练非线性反应扩散架构，用于 SAR 和医学超声图像中的乘性伽马噪声去噪，在保持可解释性的同时获得接近大型黑箱模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 乘性伽马噪声是 SAR 与医学超声图像的主要噪声之一，具有像素相关、空间变化大、较加性噪声更难处理的特点。现有方法中，经典 PDE 可解释但复原能力不足；DnCNN 等深度卷积网络性能高但透明度低，使医学等高风险领域的从业者对其使用存疑。
AI.method: Hybrid++ 将完全可学习的 PDE 初始化与 3 阶段反应扩散网络结合，包含 64 通道多尺度滤波器组、4 层 Squeeze-and-Excitation 注意力影响函数和 64 维噪声水平嵌入。训练采用两阶段策略：先分阶段优化，再联合端到端微调，使所有可学习参数协同适应。
AI.result: 在 FoE 基准上，Hybrid++ 显著优于经典 PDE、BM3D 和原始 TNRD 基线。在严重噪声设置 L=1 下，其 PSNR 与单独训练的 DnCNN 相差仅 0.23 dB，而参数量约为 DnCNN 的 8%。
AI.conclusion: 作者将 Hybrid++ 定位为面向乘性伽马噪声的紧凑、物理结构化的反应扩散模型，而非通用 SOTA 图像复原主干。

title: A Review Of Robotic World Models For Dynamic Environments Based On Factor And Scene Graphs
summary: Models based on graphs have emerged in robotics as a powerful foundation for internal world representations, where factor and scene graphs are among the most prominent model types found in the related literature and in successful robotic solutions. Initially, many of these models were assuming static environments as a simplification. Herein, factor graphs mainly provide uncertainty-aware geometric estimations while scene graphs enable a structured semantic abstraction. However, real-world robotic environments are often dynamic, posing severe challenges for purely static world representations. Therefore, this review presents a comprehensive view on how dynamic aspects of real-world environments can be addressed in such graph-based world models. We organize our assessments around three main aspects: (I) suitable representations, (II) pipelines to construct and update the representations, and (III) their exploitation for downstream tasks. We review approaches that are either based on factor or scene graphs, but put special emphasis on novel approaches that combine both types to form hybrid models. We mainly analyze how different types of dynamics can be modeled herein, and categorize common architectural patterns. Finally, emerging trends and open challenges are identified, including uncertainty propagation from learned perception through the representation layers, the observability of dynamic-entity motion and scale under minimal sensing, scalable lifelong maintenance, and the lack of datasets and evaluation protocols that ground world-model quality in downstream task performance under dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该综述回顾了机器人领域中基于图的世界模型（因子图与场景图）如何应对真实环境的动态性，涵盖表示、构建更新流程及下游任务应用，并重点关注混合模型、常见架构模式、趋势与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人环境通常是动态的，而早期因子图和场景图等图基世界模型多假设静态环境，这给纯静态表示带来严重挑战，因此需要系统梳理动态环境下的图基世界模型。
AI.method: 围绕三方面组织评估：(I) 适合的动态表示；(II) 构建与更新表示的流程；(III) 下游任务利用。综述因子图、场景图及两者结合形成的混合模型，分析可建模的动态类型，归类常见架构模式。
AI.result: 总结了动态图基世界模型在表示、构建更新与下游利用方面的方法；强调混合模型的潜力；归纳常见架构模式；识别新兴趋势与开放挑战，包括从学习感知到表示层的不确定性传播、最小感知下动态实体运动与尺度的可观测性、可扩展终身维护、以及缺乏将世界模型质量与动态下游任务性能关联的数据集和评估协议。
AI.conclusion: 图基世界模型需从静态假设转向动态建模；因子图与场景图混合是重要方向；未来需解决不确定性传播、可观测性、终身维护和评测基准等开放问题，以推动动态环境下机器人世界模型发展。

title: Deep Learning for Longitudinal Medical Imaging: A Scoping Review
summary: Longitudinal medical imaging analysis is a cornerstone of modern medical practice and patient care. Deep learning applied to longitudinal imaging offers wide potential to enhance diagnosis and track disease progression by capturing spatial changes over time. With major advances in single-timepoint deep learning for imaging, there has been growing interest in longitudinal image analysis, given its increased clinical relevance, though technical challenges remain. Several recent innovations may lead to a new era of multi-timepoint image evaluation, yet the scientific landscape, recent progress, and areas of need remain under-characterized. To address this gap, we conducted a scoping review of deep learning methodologies applied to longitudinal medical imaging, yielding 102 studies published between 2018 and 2025. Neurological disorders (48%) and ophthalmic conditions (12%) were the most common clinical applications, with MRI serving as the predominant imaging modality (67%). Sequential feature modeling approaches combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with temporal models (LSTM/RNN) were the most frequent methodology (40%), followed by direct feature aggregation across timepoints (23%). Most studies targeted classification tasks (56%), while external validation was performed in only 24% of studies. Our findings highlight that deep learning-based longitudinal imaging analysis remains a promising field, though newer temporal architectures and larger datasets may improve success and clinical adoption of these tools.

AI.tldr: 本文对2018-2025年间应用深度学习于纵向医学影像的102项研究进行了范围综述，发现神经疾病（48%）和眼科疾病（12%）最常见，MRI为主要模态（67%），CNN+LSTM/RNN序列建模（40%）是最常用方法，多数为分类任务（56%），仅24%进行外部验证。
AI.motivation: 纵向医学影像分析对诊断和追踪疾病进展至关重要，深度学习在此领域潜力巨大但技术挑战仍存，且科学图景、近期进展和需求尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 对2018年至2025年发表的深度学习应用于纵向医学影像的研究进行范围综述，共纳入102项研究。
AI.result: 神经疾病（48%）和眼科疾病（12%）为主要临床应用，MRI为主要影像模态（67%）。方法上，CNN与时间模型（LSTM/RNN）结合的序列特征建模最常见（40%），其次是跨时间点直接特征聚合（23%）。多数研究针对分类任务（56%），仅24%进行了外部验证。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度学习的纵向影像分析是一个有前景的领域，但更新的时间架构和更大的数据集可能有助于提高这些工具的成功率和临床采用。

title: STRIDE: Spatial-Temporal Representation for Interval-conditioned Disease Evolution in Longitudinal Glioblastoma MRI
summary: Glioblastoma (GBM), an aggressive primary brain tumor, is routinely monitored with longitudinal MRI after treatment. Distinguishing stable disease (SD), pseudoprogression (PsP), and true progression (TP) remains challenging because these states can show overlapping MRI appearances despite different temporal trajectories. Existing longitudinal methods still face challenges in modeling scan-specific spatial variability, variable follow-up intervals, and complementary information from the observed follow-up state and its longitudinal change. We propose STRIDE, a framework for spatial-temporal representation of interval-conditioned disease evolution that takes paired post-treatment MRI scans and their inter-scan interval as input and predicts SD, PsP, or TP. The lesion-prior-guided spatial representation combines SoftGate and an Adaptive-window Hierarchical Transformer (AWHT) to emphasize lesion-related regions while preserving surrounding context. The time-conditioned latent transition uses pair-level context and the actual inter-scan interval to estimate interval-dependent representation changes between visits. The observed--transition fusion integrates the transition-estimated follow-up representation with the directly observed follow-up representation to jointly characterize the follow-up state and its longitudinal change. BraTS2024 is used to develop and evaluate the lesion-prior generator, while longitudinal pretraining on LUMIERE supports transfer before downstream adaptation to Burdenko. On the Burdenko three-class task, STRIDE achieves a macro ROC--AUC of 0.816 and a macro F1-score of 0.796. These results support its potential for more reliable longitudinal post-treatment GBM state assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIDE框架，利用配对MRI和扫描间隔预测胶质母细胞瘤治疗后状态（稳定、假性进展、真进展），在Burdenko数据集上取得macro ROC-AUC 0.816和macro F1 0.796。
AI.motivation: 胶质母细胞瘤治疗后纵向MRI监测中，稳定疾病、假性进展和真进展的MRI表现重叠，现有方法难以建模扫描间空间变异、可变随访间隔，以及观测随访状态与其纵向变化的互补信息。
AI.method: STRIDE包含三部分：病灶先验引导的空间表示（SoftGate与自适应窗口层次Transformer）突出病灶区域并保留上下文；时间条件潜在转移利用配对上下文和实际扫描间隔估计间隔依赖的表示变化；观测-转移融合整合转移估计与直接观测的随访表示。使用BraTS2024训练病灶先验生成器，LUMIERE纵向预训练，Burdenko下游微调。
AI.result: 在Burdenko三分类任务上，macro ROC-AUC为0.816，macro F1为0.796。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明STRIDE有潜力实现更可靠的胶质母细胞瘤治疗后纵向状态评估。

title: The internal model principle in reservoir computing
comment: Submitted to the American Control Conference (ACC) 2027
summary: The paper studies learning in reservoir computing systems through the lens of the internal model principle. The key idea is to model training signals as outputs of an exogenous signal generator, thus connecting reservoir computing to output regulation, observer theory, and frequency-domain interpolation. For linear signal generators, we characterize the steady-state response of a linear reservoir through invariant subspaces, establishing connections with Luenberger observers and classical frequency-domain interpolation. For nonlinear signal generators, we obtain analogous results using invariant manifolds, connecting synchronization to Kazantzis-Kravaris/Luenberger observers and readout training to nonlinear moment matching. Case studies illustrate how our perspective explains possible instability of trained predictors and informs reservoir design.

AI.tldr: 本文从内模原理视角研究储备池计算中的学习问题，将训练信号建模为外源信号发生器的输出，从而把储备池计算与输出调节、观测器理论和频域插值联系起来。
AI.motivation: 旨在为储备池计算的学习过程提供控制理论解释，理解训练预测器可能出现的不稳定性，并指导储备池设计。
AI.method: 将训练信号视为外源信号发生器输出；对线性信号发生器，通过不变子空间刻画线性储备池稳态响应，并联系Luenberger观测器和经典频域插值；对非线性信号发生器，利用不变流形得到类似结果，联系同步与Kazantzis-Kravaris/Luenberger观测器，并将读出训练联系到非线性矩匹配。
AI.result: 建立了储备池计算与输出调节、观测器理论及频域/矩匹配之间的理论联系，并通过案例说明该视角可解释训练预测器的潜在不稳定性，为储备池设计提供信息。
AI.conclusion: 内模原理为储备池计算学习提供了统一视角，能够解释稳定性问题并指导系统设计。

title: Accelerating Floating-Point Satisfiability Solving via Gradient Normalization
summary:
Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solvers are foundational to software verification, program analysis, and compiler testing, particularly over the theory of Quantifier-Free Floating-Point (QF_FP). While recent optimization-based SMT solvers have successfully applied gradient descent to continuous relaxations of logical formulas, they are fundamentally bottlenecked by gradient domination, a phenomenon where a small subset of difficult clauses hijacks the optimization trajectory, preventing the solver from satisfying the broader formula and trapping it in local minima.
  To overcome this, we present GradSAT, a novel framework that bridges optimization-based SMT solving with Multi-Task Learning (MTL). GradSAT reformulates the constraint satisfaction process by treating each SMT clause as an independent MTL task. By applying dynamic gradient normalization (GradNorm), GradSAT actively balances the gradient magnitudes across all clauses at runtime, systematically penalizing dominant gradients and accelerating lagging clauses to ensure uniform convergence. GradSAT implements this through a highly optimized, two-stage hybrid pipeline. First, a GPU-accelerated PyTorch backend leveraging symbolic compilation and operator fusion navigates the continuous relaxation to a high-quality basin. Second, the candidate assignment is handed off to a bit-precise local search engine to rapidly resolve the exact, rigorous assignment. By stabilizing the continuous search dynamics, GradSAT mitigates the brittleness of prior gradient-based solvers and provides a robust, highly parallelizable architecture for complex constraint solving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GradSAT，一个将优化型 SMT 求解与多任务学习（MTL）相结合的新框架，用于缓解 QF_FP 公式求解中的梯度支配问题，并通过 GPU 连续搜索与位精确局部搜索的两阶段流程实现高效求解。
AI.motivation: SMT 求解器对软件验证、程序分析和编译器测试至关重要，尤其是 QF_FP 理论。现有基于优化的 SMT 求解器虽将梯度下降用于逻辑公式的连续松弛，但受梯度支配瓶颈限制：少数困难子句会主导优化轨迹，使求解器难以满足整体公式并陷入局部最优。
AI.method: GradSAT 将每个 SMT 子句视为独立的 MTL 任务，利用动态梯度归一化（GradNorm）在运行时平衡各子句的梯度幅度，惩罚主导梯度并加速滞后子句。其实现采用两阶段混合流水线：第一阶段使用 GPU 加速的 PyTorch 后端，结合符号编译与算子融合，在连续松弛中寻找高质量区域；第二阶段将候选赋值交给位精确局部搜索引擎，快速求解出精确、严格的赋值。
AI.result: GradSAT 通过稳定连续搜索动态，缓解了先前基于梯度的求解器的脆弱性，并提供了面向复杂约束求解的鲁棒、高度可并行化架构；其核心效果是减轻梯度支配，促进各子句均匀收敛。
AI.conclusion: GradSAT 将优化型 SMT 求解与多任务学习相桥接，通过动态梯度归一化和两阶段混合求解流程，有效应对梯度支配问题，为复杂约束求解提供了一种更稳定且可扩展的方案。

title: SAFE: Unified Slip and Fracture Detection with Low-Cost Acoustic Sensing in Robotic Grasping
summary: Manipulating fragile objects remains challenging as robots must understand the state of what they grasp, such as slip or fracture, to respond appropriately, especially when material properties are unknown. In this paper, we present SAFE: a low-cost, general-purpose sensing approach that detects both slip and fracture in real time using two passive polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) acoustic sensors and motor proprioception, without relying on vision or prior material knowledge. The sensors are mounted on a compliant Fin Ray gripper, and a unified HistGradientBoosting classifier reports the state (normal, slip, or fracture) from a 79-dimensional feature vector. Under leave-one-grasp-out cross-validation, SAFE achieves an Alert-F1 of 0.884 with near-zero slip-fracture confusion, and ablations confirm that acoustic sensing is indispensable. An adaptive grasp controller built on this detection layer runs at 104 Hz on a Jetson Orin Nano, achieving 91.3% success across 46 closed-loop robot trials spanning diverse object categories, while each fixed-force strategy drops to 0% on object conditions that mismatch its preset. It further reaches 82.4% success on novel objects unseen during training, demonstrating robust, failure-aware grasp control without object-specific calibration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAFE，一种低成本、通用型实时感知方法，利用两个被动PVDF声学传感器和电机本体感知，在不依赖视觉或先验材料知识的情况下检测滑动与破裂，并结合自适应抓取控制器实现稳定抓取。
AI.motivation: 机器人抓取易碎物体时，需要理解抓取状态（如滑动或破裂）并做出适当响应，尤其是在材料属性未知的情况下，传统方法依赖视觉或先验材料知识，存在局限。
AI.method: 在柔性Fin Ray夹爪上安装两个被动PVDF声学传感器，结合电机本体感知；构建79维特征向量，使用统一的HistGradientBoosting分类器实时判别正常、滑动或破裂状态；采用留一抓取交叉验证和消融实验，并设计自适应抓取控制器在Jetson Orin Nano上以104 Hz运行。
AI.result: 留一抓取交叉验证下，SAFE达到Alert-F1为0.884，滑动与破裂混淆接近零，消融实验证实声学感知不可或缺；闭环机器人试验中46次抓取成功率为91.3%，固定力策略在不匹配条件下成功率降至0%；对训练中未见的新物体成功率仍达82.4%。
AI.conclusion: SAFE能够在不进行物体特定校准的情况下，实现稳健且具备故障感知能力的抓取控制，验证了低成本声学与本体感知结合在实时滑动/破裂检测中的有效性。

title: Child ASR Adaptation with Adult Retention: An Empirical Study
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often underperform for children and non-native speakers, while adapting adult ASR models to child speech can cause adult-speech forgetting. We study child ASR adaptation with adult retention across Arabic and English. We compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, and post-hoc weight-space merging across encoder--decoder, encoder--CTC, and AudioLLM-based ASR systems. Experiments use Arabic native and non-native child speech, English MyST child speech, and adult benchmarks from MGB-2 and LibriSpeech test-clean. We evaluate recognition quality with WER and quantify the adaptation--retention trade-off using Retention Index, Child Adaptation Gain, and Adaptation Recovery. Results show that child adaptation is necessary, especially for non-native Arabic and English child speech, but direct adaptation often reduces adult ASR performance. Bilingual adaptation is more stable than language-specific adaptation. Weight-space merging often improves the trade-off, especially for encoder--CTC, Whisper, and AudioLLM-based ASR, with LERP favoring adult retention and TIES recovering stronger child gains. For the encoder--decoder model, direct bilingual fine-tuning remains strongest in raw WER.\footnote{Code, and models are available at https://github.com/qcri/Child-ASR-Adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该研究面向阿拉伯语和英语儿童语音ASR适配，在提升儿童识别效果的同时保持成人语音性能，比较了全微调、LoRA和事后权重空间合并，并覆盖编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC和AudioLLM等ASR系统。
AI.motivation: ASR系统对儿童和非母语说话人通常表现较差，而将成人ASR模型适配到儿童语音时又容易导致成人语音性能遗忘，因此需要在儿童适配与成人保持之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 使用阿拉伯语母语和非母语儿童语音、英语MyST儿童语音，以及MGB-2和LibriSpeech test-clean成人基准，比较full fine-tuning、LoRA和post-hoc weight-space merging；评估编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC和AudioLLM-based ASR，并用WER、Retention Index、Child Adaptation Gain和Adaptation Recovery衡量适配-保持权衡。
AI.result: 儿童适配是必要的，尤其对非母语阿拉伯语和英语儿童语音；但直接适配常降低成人ASR性能。双语适配比单语适配更稳定。权重空间合并通常能改善权衡，尤其对编码器-CTC、Whisper和AudioLLM系统；LERP更利于成人保持，TIES能恢复更强的儿童增益。对编码器-解码器模型，直接双语微调在原始WER上仍最强。
AI.conclusion: 儿童ASR适配需要同时关注成人语音保持；双语适配和权重空间合并是缓解适配-保持冲突的有效方向，不同架构和合并方法在儿童增益与成人保持之间存在不同侧重。

title: Autonomous Driving Research Requires a Community-Driven Data Paradigm
summary: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress, with recent AI advances enabling commercial deployments that are reshaping urban mobility. Yet the field remains far from its universal social promise: autonomous systems that can operate robustly anywhere, anytime, for anyone. We posit that this gap is not merely a modeling problem, but a problem of the prevailing data paradigm. Current research relies heavily on a few benchmark datasets with limited spatial and scenario coverage, even though the community has collectively produced over 600 autonomous driving datasets across nearly 50 countries. However, this abundance has not translated into broad research impact: most datasets remain significantly underused due to fragmentation, limited visibility, incompatible protocols, and benchmark incentives that concentrate attention on a few dominant datasets. We therefore argue that autonomous driving research requires a collaborative, community-driven data paradigm. Such a paradigm would improve the discovery, reuse, integration, and evaluation of diverse datasets; make underexplored data easier and more rewarding to study; and lower the barrier for new contributors. We outline its key principles, illustrate an early realization, and call for collaboration across academia and industry to transform fragmented datasets into shared community infrastructure for anytime-anywhere autonomy.

AI.tldr: 论文指出自动驾驶尚未实现随时随地稳健运行，根本障碍在于当前依赖少数基准数据集的数据范式；尽管社区已积累600多个数据集，却因碎片化、可见性低、协议不兼容和基准激励集中而未被充分利用。作者倡导建立协作式、社区驱动的数据范式，并呼吁产学研合作将碎片化数据转化为共享基础设施。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶虽已取得进展并开始商业部署，但距离“随时随地服务任何人”的普遍社会愿景仍很遥远。作者认为这一差距不仅是建模问题，更是数据范式问题：现有研究过度依赖少数空间和场景覆盖有限的基准数据集，大量已发布数据集未能转化为广泛研究影响。
AI.method: 本文属于立场/愿景型研究，而非提出具体算法或实验。作者论证当前数据范式的局限，提出社区驱动、协作式的数据范式，概述其关键原则，展示一个早期实现案例，并呼吁学术界与工业界合作。
AI.result: 论文的主要“结果”是诊断性观察与倡议：社区已在近50个国家产生超过600个自动驾驶数据集，但多数因碎片化、可见性不足、协议不兼容以及基准激励集中而严重未被充分利用；因此需要新的协作数据范式来改善数据发现、复用、集成与评估。
AI.conclusion: 要实现 anytime-anywhere autonomy，必须将分散的数据集转变为共享的社区基础设施。这需要建立社区驱动的数据生态，降低新贡献者门槛，使未被充分探索的数据更易用且更有研究回报，并推动跨学界与业界的协作。

title: On-Device Super-Resolution Imaging for a Low-Cost SPAD Array on a 640-KB-SRAM Microcontroller
summary: This work presents a super-resolution (SR) deep-learning (DL) architecture to simultaneously upscale low-resolution (LR) depth and intensity images acquired by a consumer-grade VL53L9CX time-of-flight (ToF) sensor, a compact single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) ranging device, while targeting deployment on a resource-constrained microcontroller (MCU) with only 640 KB SRAM and 2 MB Flash. The VL53L9CX provides 54 $\times$ 42 depth and intensity measurements. The proposed framework performs $\times$4 spatial SR to reconstruct 216 $\times$ 168 depth and intensity images simultaneously. The network employs separate reconstruction branches for intensity and high-resolution (HR) depth. We train the network with efficient loss functions and investigate the performance by testing multiple compact, hardware-oriented backbones, including Spatially Adaptive Feature Modulation (SAFM), Swift Parameter-Free Attention Network (SPAN), and Residual Local Feature Network (RLFN). We evaluate the network on both synthetic and real measurements, with particular attention to constrained activation and memory storage. We export the selected network to ONNX, quantize it to INT8, generate C inference code for an STM32H563ZI Arm Cortex-M33 MCU, and integrate it with our simplified sensor's firmware. This work is the first to demonstrate a compact DL SR model on a low-cost bare-metal MCU for a consumer-grade LR SPAD sensor, integrated with customized MCU firmware to enable on-device SR inference.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种超分辨率深度学习架构，可同时提升消费级VL53L9CX ToF/SPAD传感器获取的低分辨率深度和强度图像，并部署在仅有640 KB SRAM和2 MB Flash的MCU上。
AI.motivation: 消费级ToF/SPAD传感器分辨率低，而边缘MCU资源严重受限，因此需要一种紧凑、硬件友好的深度学习方法，在单芯片上同时增强低分辨率深度与强度图像。
AI.method: 网络采用强度与高分辨率深度两个独立重建分支，将54×42输入进行×4空间超分至216×168；使用高效损失函数，并评估SAFM、SPAN、RLFN等紧凑骨干。在合成与真实数据上测试，关注激活与内存限制。最后导出ONNX、INT8量化、生成STM32H563ZI Arm Cortex-M33的C推理代码，并集成到定制传感器固件中。
AI.result: 实现了面向低成本裸机MCU的紧凑DL超分模型，可对消费级低分辨率SPAD传感器进行端侧超分推理，并完成与定制MCU固件的集成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是首个在低成本裸机MCU上为消费级低分辨率SPAD传感器演示紧凑深度学习超分模型并实现片上推理的研究，证明了资源受限边缘设备上进行ToF深度与强度图像增强的可行性。

title: Route-Verify-Vote: Procedure-Conditioned Self-Consistency for Mixed-Domain Reasoning
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, and 8 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at CCL26-Eval
summary:
Compositional generalization remains challenging when language models must combine familiar reasoning operations in unfamiliar ways. The Scenario-Based Commonsense Reasoning Evaluation (SCoRE) 2026 tests this ability on three mixed domains absent from training and requires models to identify the complete set of correct options for each question.
  We introduce Route-Verify-Vote (RVV), a framework for procedure-conditioned self-consistency that uses language models without parameter updates. Route uses the provided domain label to select a reasoning procedure that guides the model in representing and applying the relevant constraints. Verify prompts the model to assess each option against those constraints. Vote aggregates complete answer sets and allocates additional samples to questions with a small vote-count margin between the two most frequent sets. Samples for each question follow the same domain-specific procedure.
  On the official test set, voting over 16 sampled answer sets per question achieves an exact-set accuracy of 74.6%. Adaptive RVV reaches 77.3%, and combining models on selected domain routes raises accuracy to 79.4%. The final system ranked second among participating systems. These results support domain-specific reasoning procedures and answer-set disagreement as useful tools for allocating inference-time computation in mixed-domain reasoning.

AI.tldr: 针对语言模型在新颖方式下组合熟悉推理操作的挑战，SCoRE 2026 在三个训练中未见的混合领域测试模型识别完整正确选项集的能力。本文提出 Route-Verify-Vote (RVV) 框架，无需参数更新，在官方测试集上取得最高 79.4% 的精确集合准确率，最终排名第二。
AI.motivation: 组合泛化仍是语言模型的难点，尤其当其需要以不熟悉的方式组合熟悉的推理操作时。SCoRE 2026 基准专门测试这一能力，要求模型在混合领域问题中找出完整的正确答案集合。
AI.method: 提出 Route-Verify-Vote (RVV) 框架，实现过程条件化的自一致性，且不更新模型参数。Route 利用给定领域标签选择推理过程，引导模型表示并应用相关约束；Verify 提示模型依据这些约束评估每个选项；Vote 聚合完整答案集，并对两个最常见答案集票数差距较小的问题分配额外采样。每个问题的采样均遵循相同的领域特定过程。
AI.result: 在官方测试集上，每题采样 16 个答案集进行投票达到 74.6% 的精确集合准确率；自适应 RVV 达到 77.3%；在选定的领域路径上组合多个模型将准确率提升至 79.4%。最终系统在参赛系统中排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定推理过程和答案集分歧可作为在混合领域推理中分配推理时计算的有效工具，支持了 RVV 框架的设计思路。

title: Context-Aware Adaptive Pesticide Spraying for Agricultural Robots under Changing Weather and Terrain Using Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted for publication in Computers and Electronics in Agriculture
summary: Precision pesticide spraying is essential for optimizing application efficiency and ensuring uniform chemical distribution. Spraying performance is influenced by multiple factors, including environmental conditions such as temperature and wind speed, pesticide type, and the robot's capability to accurately perceive crops and target spray locations. Existing approaches predominantly emphasize crop detection and rely on predefined spraying parameters, whereas human operators dynamically adjust their spraying strategies by considering environmental conditions, region-specific crop characteristics, and the type of pesticide being applied. In this study, we propose a context-aware adaptive spraying framework based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which enables robots to leverage spatial reasoning and integrate information from multiple sources, including crop type, pesticide type, and weather data, to make adaptive and optimized spraying decisions. Subsequently, a trajectory-tracking controller based on Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is employed to ensure precise navigation and accurate spraying at crop locations. The comparative results demonstrate that the proposed method improves accuracy by at least 30% in detecting crop rows. In addition, the experimental evaluations conducted in two environments further demonstrate the robot's ability to flexibly adjust spraying volume and travel speed, while reducing pesticide drift.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的上下文感知自适应喷洒框架，融合作物、农药和天气等多源信息进行空间推理，并结合MPPI控制器实现精准导航与喷洒；作物行检测精度至少提升30%，且能灵活调整喷洒量和速度并减少农药漂移。
AI.motivation: 精准喷洒受温度、风速、农药类型及机器人感知能力等多因素影响。现有方法多侧重作物检测并依赖预设喷洒参数，而人工操作员会依据环境、区域作物特征和农药类型动态调整策略，因此需要更智能的自适应喷洒方法。
AI.method: 提出基于VLM的上下文感知自适应喷洒框架，利用空间推理整合作物类型、农药类型和天气数据以优化喷洒决策；随后采用基于模型预测路径积分（MPPI）的轨迹跟踪控制器，确保精准导航并在作物位置准确喷洒。
AI.result: 对比结果表明，所提方法在作物行检测中准确率至少提高30%；在两种环境中的实验进一步表明，机器人能够灵活调整喷洒量和行进速度，同时减少农药漂移。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够实现自适应、优化的喷洒决策与精准执行，提升作物行检测精度和喷洒灵活性，并降低农药漂移，优于依赖预设参数的现有方法。

title: PanoPed: Beyond Bounding Boxes for Sim-to-Real Panoramic Pedestrian Tracking
summary: Full-sphere panoramic cameras let fixed monitoring systems and mobile robots track people in every direction, but a planar bounding box does not fully describe where a person is on the sphere. We introduce PanoPed, a sim-to-real benchmark for pedestrian tracking on the full sphere. PanoPed-S contains 108,000 frames from fixed, quadruped-mounted, and drone-mounted cameras, with synchronized masks, depth, camera poses, and 3D pedestrian states. PanoPed-R adds 28,002 real frames from fixed cameras, 16,247 of them densely annotated. We find that an ERP rectangle cannot uniquely determine the spherical center and angular extent of the visible person, while the detector's visual query still carries information about them. Inspired by the sextant's use of angular measurements to locate objects, we propose Sextant, a plug-and-play angular localization head with only about 0.035M parameters. It reuses a frozen detector, keeps track identities unchanged, and needs no extra image encoder. Sextant gives the best result in our PanoPed-S test comparison, raising the strongest baseline, MOTIP, from 47.30 to 49.49 HOTA, with gains on all eight test sequences. Without fine-tuning on real data, the same synthetic-trained heads improve MOTIP and HAT by 0.96-1.14 HOTA on real video, and both seeds improve every real sequence. HAT+Sextant scores best among the compared systems that add no localization image encoder.

AI.tldr: 论文提出全球面行人跟踪基准 PanoPed 与即插即用的角度定位头 Sextant，利用探测器视觉查询中的角度信息恢复行人在球面上的位置。
AI.motivation: 全向全景相机让固定监控与移动机器人可进行全方向行人跟踪，但平面边界框无法完整描述行人在球面上的位置；ERP 矩形也不能唯一确定可见行人的球面中心和角范围，而检测器的视觉查询仍包含相关信息。
AI.method: 构建 sim-to-real 基准 PanoPed：PanoPed-S 含 108,000 帧固定、四足、无人机视图，带同步掩码、深度、相机位姿和 3D 行人状态；PanoPed-R 增加 28,002 真实帧，其中 16,247 帧密集标注。受六分仪角度测量定位启发，提出 Sextant：约 0.035M 参数的即插即用角度定位头，复用冻结检测器，保持身份不变，无需额外图像编码器。
AI.result: 在 PanoPed-S 测试对比中 Sextant 最佳，将最强基线 MOTIP 从 47.30 HOTA 提升至 49.49，八个测试序列全部提升。合成数据训练的同一头部无需真实数据微调，即可在真实视频上将 MOTIP 和 HAT 提升 0.96-1.14 HOTA，且两个种子均在每个真实序列上提升。HAT+Sextant 在不增加定位图像编码器的对比系统中得分最佳。
AI.conclusion: ERP 矩形对球面行人定位存在歧义，而角度定位头可有效利用检测器查询信息，提升全球面行人跟踪性能，并展现出良好的仿真到真实迁移能力。

title: When Forgetting Looks Like Improvement: Metric Masking in Streaming Diarizer Adaptation and the Price of Rehearsal
summary: Small-data adaptation can improve speech detection while degrading speaker attribution. We study this discrepancy in a released streaming diarizer adapted on 7.5 h of two-party conversation and evaluated across six corpora. Adaptation substantially improves in-domain diarization performance and transfers to an independent corpus. However, this improvement is not consistent across evaluation scenarios as the additional confusion is mainly associated with impaired temporal identity consistency rather than speaker-count errors. A local-remapping diagnostic reveals different patterns of identity degradation across corpora, indicating that adaptation may alter how streaming models maintain speaker assignments over time. Rehearsal reduces the observed degradation but reduces the cross-domain transfer performance. These results highlight the need to jointly evaluate detection accuracy, identity consistency, and retention behavior when adapting streaming diarization systems.

AI.tldr: 小数据适应可提升语音检测但会损害说话人归属。本文研究这一矛盾现象，通过在一个流式说话人日志系统上适应7.5小时双人对话并在六个语料库上评估，发现适应主要损害时间身份一致性，且排练虽减少退化但降低跨域迁移。
AI.motivation: 小数据适应在提升语音检测的同时会损害说话人归属，这一矛盾现象促使作者研究其成因，特别是在流式说话人日志系统中。
AI.method: 对一个已发布的流式说话人日志系统在7.5小时双人对话数据上进行适应，并在六个语料库上评估；采用局部重映射诊断分析身份退化模式；并测试排练策略的影响。
AI.result: 适应显著提升域内日志性能并可迁移至独立语料，但改进不一致；额外混淆主要与时间身份一致性受损有关，而非说话人计数错误。局部重映射诊断显示不同语料库的身份退化模式不同。排练减少退化但降低跨域迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: 在适应流式说话人日志系统时，需联合评估检测准确率、身份一致性和保留行为。

title: Electric Racing Kart with BLDC Drive, LiFePO4 Battery System, Traction Control and Regenerative Braking
comment: German title: Elektro-Rennkart mit BLDC-Antrieb, LiFePO4-Batteriesystem, Antischlupfregelung und Rekuperation. Diploma thesis, HTL Braunau, Austria, 2016. Third, revised English edition, 2026, revised and translated by Johannes Stockhammer. 69 pages, 36 figures, 15 tables
summary: This diploma thesis documents the conversion of a petrol-powered go-kart into a battery-electric kart with a 10 kW BLDC drive, a LiFePO$_4$ traction battery with battery management system, a slip-based traction control and regenerative braking. The traction control estimates the slip of the driven rear axle from three Hall-effect wheel-speed sensors as $λ= (v_R - v_F)/v_R$ and reduces the torque command of the throttle pedal when the axle slips. It runs on a 32-bit ARM Cortex-M3 microcontroller (SAM3X8E) in the signal path between pedal and motor controller, with galvanic isolation and an emergency stop. Regenerative braking uses the generator mode of the motor controller in three stages: motor brake on throttle release, light braking via a steering-wheel button, and blended braking with the hydraulic brake. Drivetrain calculations show that the kart is traction-limited. At rated torque, the drive force at standstill exceeds the transmissible traction force by a factor of 1.7 to 2.0, up to approx. 27 to 43 km/h. Traction control is therefore a functional requirement of the drivetrain. The calculated top speed is approx. 65 km/h. Regenerative braking reaches approx. 0.45 g and could cover up to about 30 % of the energy demand on a winding track. With 80 % of the nominal battery energy, approx. 44 min of driving at 50 % motor load result, so the target of one hour is missed. The initial charging measurement quantifies the flat LiFePO$_4$ voltage plateau at 0.7 to 1.8 mV per percent state of charge, which makes voltage-based state-of-charge estimation unreliable. Cold cells showed a voltage sag under load that triggered the low-voltage alarm. Validation of the control functions by instrumented driving tests is the main open point.

AI.tldr: 本论文记录了将汽油卡丁车改装为电池电动卡丁车的过程，包括10 kW无刷直流驱动、LiFePO4电池及BMS、基于滑移的牵引力控制和再生制动。牵引力控制通过轮速传感器估计后轴滑移并降低扭矩指令。驱动系统计算表明卡丁车受牵引力限制，需牵引力控制。最高速度约65 km/h，再生制动可达0.45g，可覆盖约30%能量需求，但续航约44分钟未达1小时目标。LiFePO4电压平台平坦导致SOC估计不可靠。控制功能验证是主要待完成工作。
AI.motivation: 将汽油卡丁车转换为电动卡丁车，并解决牵引力限制、能量回收和电池管理等问题，可能出于环保、性能或研究目的。
AI.method: 改装为10 kW BLDC驱动，LiFePO4电池与BMS，基于滑移的牵引力控制（λ = (v_R - v_F)/v_R），使用32位ARM Cortex-M3微控制器，电气隔离和紧急停止。再生制动三阶段：松油门电机制动、按钮轻度制动、与液压制动混合。进行驱动系统计算和充电测量。
AI.result: 驱动系统受牵引力限制，额定扭矩下驱动力超过可传递牵引力1.7-2.0倍，最高速度约65 km/h。再生制动达0.45g，可覆盖约30%能量需求。80%电池能量下以50%电机负载行驶约44分钟，未达1小时目标。LiFePO4电压平台平坦（0.7-1.8 mV/% SOC），电压法SOC估计不可靠。冷电池负载下电压下降触发低压报警。
AI.conclusion: 牵引力控制是功能需求。再生制动有效但续航不足。SOC估计需其他方法。控制功能验证（仪器化驾驶测试）是主要待完成工作。

title: Diagnosing Diversity Collapse and Validating Mask-Conditioned Diffusion for Labeled Microtubule Microscopy
summary: Mask-conditioned diffusion models have become standard for generating labeled training data in biomedical imaging. But the tools used to evaluate them were built for a different problem. Standard metrics like FID and KID score images through ImageNet-trained features. Those features do not transfer to microscopy, leaving the metrics poorly calibrated for specialized domains. Even with a domain-appropriate feature space, a single blended number can still hide a real failure: a model can produce visually plausible images that still transfer poorly to downstream tasks. We identify a specific failure mode: Late in training, realism keeps improving while texture diversity collapses. The model settles onto a fixed color palette, converging to a high-similarity, low-diversity state that standard metrics do not penalize. Therefore, we propose a diversity-aware diagnostic in a domain-validated feature space. It combines a realism axis based on inter-similarity to real images with a diversity axis based on intra-similarity among generated samples. This diagnostic selects a checkpoint that domain experts cannot reliably distinguish from real recordings in a forced-choice study. It also yields useful downstream segmentation: a segmenter trained only on synthetically labeled data reaches a median skeletonised IoU comparable to one trained on real data, at lower cross-fold variance, and clearly ahead of the best available public alternative in this domain, a parametric renderer. We also reproduce a data-efficient hyperparameter-transfer experiment from prior work, tuning several foundation segmenters on a small labeled subset and evaluating on real images: transfer is stronger with our data. We release DiffuMT on HuggingFace, including the triplet dataset, code to reproduce the downstream-utility validation, and a standalone diagnostic tool for evaluating mask-conditioned diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出生物医学图像生成中常用的FID/KID等指标不适合显微图像，并提出一种基于领域验证特征空间的多样性感知诊断方法，以捕捉扩散模型后期真实感上升但纹理多样性崩塌的问题，同时验证了生成数据在下游分割和迁移学习中的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有的掩码条件扩散模型评估工具主要面向ImageNet等自然图像，使用的FID/KID特征无法迁移到显微图像等专业领域，导致指标校准不佳；且单一混合分数可能掩盖真实失败模式，例如生成图像看似合理但下游迁移效果差。
AI.method: 作者识别出一种失败模式：训练后期图像真实感持续提升，但纹理多样性崩塌，模型收敛到固定色彩和高相似度、低多样性状态。为此，他们提出在领域验证特征空间中的多样性感知诊断，将评估分为两个轴：基于生成样本与真实图像之间相似度的真实感轴，以及基于生成样本内部相似度的多样性轴。
AI.result: 该诊断方法选出的检查点在强制选择实验中难以被领域专家与真实记录区分；仅用合成标注数据训练的分割器，其骨架化IoU中位数与真实数据训练相当，且跨折方差更低，并明显优于该领域现有最佳公开替代方案——参数化渲染器。作者还复现了数据高效超参数迁移实验，发现在小规模标注子集上微调多个基础分割器并在真实图像上评估时，使用其生成数据可获得更强迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，面向领域验证特征空间的多样性感知诊断能更好评估掩码条件扩散模型，并筛选出兼具真实感、多样性和下游实用性的生成数据。作者发布了DiffuMT（HuggingFace）、三元组数据集、下游效用验证代码以及独立诊断工具。

title: MoR-MLLM: Mixture of Recursions for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities across vision and language tasks. However, their massive computational and memory demands hinder real-world deployment. While recent efforts reduce costs by employing lightweight language backbones, existing paradigms remain computation-dense due to their static sparsity and depth allocation, which cannot adapt to the semantic complexity of each token. To this end, we propose MoR-MLLM, a computation-sparse MLLM based on the recent Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) framework. MoR-MLLM introduces adaptive per-token recursion, allowing the model to dynamically adjust its recursive depth and allocate more computation to visually or linguistically challenging tokens while skipping redundant operations for simpler ones. To stabilize the training of recursive sparsity in multimodal settings, we further design a three-stage MoR-Tuning strategy and an entropy-regularized loss to encourage diverse routing distributions. Extensive experiments show that compared with recent advanced tiny MLLMs, our proposed MoR-MLLM can greatly reduce the training memory and computation complexity while retaining high performance on various vision-language tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoR-MLLM，一种基于 Mixture-of-Recursions 的计算稀疏多模态大语言模型，通过自适应逐 token 递归深度分配，在降低训练内存和计算复杂度的同时保持多视觉语言任务高性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型计算与内存需求大，难以实际部署；轻量语言骨干虽降低成本，但静态稀疏和深度分配无法适应每个 token 的语义复杂度。
AI.method: 基于 Mixture-of-Recursions 框架实现逐 token 自适应递归，动态调整递归深度，对视觉或语言上更难的 token 分配更多计算，对简单 token 跳过冗余操作；设计三阶段 MoR-Tuning 策略和熵正则化损失，以稳定多模态递归稀疏训练并促进多样化路由分布。
AI.result: 与近期先进 tiny MLLM 相比，MoR-MLLM 大幅降低训练内存和计算复杂度，并在多种视觉语言任务上保持高性能。
AI.conclusion: MoR-MLLM 通过自适应逐 token 递归稀疏，为多模态大模型提供了一种更高效的计算分配方案，兼顾效率与多模态任务性能。

title: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills' Downstream Utility
summary: Agent Skills package procedural guidance and resources for reuse, but a relevant Skill does not necessarily improve task performance. Existing studies characterize Skill content and evaluate downstream performance, yet provide limited explanations of how utility depends on content, execution configuration, and multi-Skill organization. We conduct an empirical study on 87 SkillsBench tasks, defining downstream utility as the pass-rate difference from No-Skill on the same tasks under the same model--harness configuration. We compare the same Skills across nine configurations, then examine alternative published Skills and organizations of fixed Skill sets under three selected configurations. We retrieve marketplace candidates from a curated corpus of 37,596 Skills. LLM-assisted analysis of content, execution traces, and final artifacts, followed by author review, relates provided support to actual use and task outcomes. The same Skills help some configurations and hurt others on 36.78\% of tasks, with trajectories showing that recommended procedures can become an execution burden. Relevance rankings overlook more useful candidates. Within the evaluated candidate sets, reranking by support for required operations raises first-choice pass rates by 4.35--5.80 percentage points across the three configurations. We derive 17 authoring practices linking executable procedures to recovery, preservation of task requirements, and checks on final artifacts. Stage Plan and Dependency DAG outperform use order alone, with DAG's additional benefits concentrated in tasks supplied with five or six Skills. These findings guide developers to assess usable operation support, allow procedure adaptation while preserving task requirements, and make artifact dependencies explicit when organizing Skills.

AI.tldr: 本文对87个SkillsBench任务进行实证研究，将Skill的下游效用定义为相同模型-执行框架配置下相对无Skill的通过率差异，揭示同一Skill在不同配置下可能帮助或损害任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多刻画Skill内容并评估下游性能，但较少解释Skill效用如何取决于内容、执行配置以及多Skill组织方式。
AI.method: 在87个SkillsBench任务上，比较同一Skill在9种配置下的表现，并在3种选定配置下考察替代Skill和固定Skill集的不同组织方式；从37,596个Skill的精选语料中检索市场候选；结合LLM辅助分析与作者复核，分析Skill内容、执行轨迹和最终产物。
AI.result: 同一Skill在36.78%的任务上对部分配置有益、对另一些有害，推荐流程可能成为执行负担；相关性排序会忽略更有用的候选；按所需操作支持度重排序使三种配置的首选通过率提升4.35–5.80个百分点；总结出17条编写实践；Stage Plan和Dependency DAG优于仅按使用顺序组织，且DAG的额外收益集中在提供5或6个Skill的任务中。
AI.conclusion: 开发者应评估Skill是否提供可用的操作支持，允许流程适配但保留任务要求，并在组织多个Skill时显式表达产物依赖。

title: Taming an End-to-End Autonomous Driving Policy for Urban Navigation of Quadruped Robots
comment: Accepted to IROS 2026 Workshop on AI Meets Autonomy
summary: We present Go2-DrivoR, a goal-conditioned adaptation of the end-to-end autonomous driving trajectory planning framework DrivoR for urban navigation with quadrupedal robots. By conditioning trajectory generation on a local-frame subgoal through a goal token and adapting the vehicle-centric scoring formulation, the method extends DrivoR to short-horizon goal-conditioned local planning without redesigning its core decoders. Specifically, we redefine drivable-area compliance for sidewalk-oriented navigation and reformulate the original ego progress term as goal-conditioned ego progress. Trained exclusively on TartanGround simulation data, Go2-DrivoR improves waypoint-conditioned planning performance on unseen simulation environments and transfers zero-shot to open-loop real-world trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出Go2-DrivoR，将端到端自动驾驶轨迹规划框架DrivoR适配为四足机器人城市导航的目标条件局部规划器。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人需要在城市环境中进行目标导向的局部导航，但现有DrivoR面向车辆，需在不重构核心解码器的情况下扩展至四足机器人人行道场景。
AI.method: 通过目标token将轨迹生成条件化于局部坐标系子目标，调整车辆中心评分公式；重新定义人行道可行驶区域合规性，并将自我进度项改为目标条件自我进度；仅在TartanGround仿真数据上训练。
AI.result: 在未见仿真环境中提升了路点条件规划性能，并零样本迁移至真实世界开环轨迹预测。
AI.conclusion: 无需重新设计核心解码器即可将DrivoR扩展为短时域目标条件局部规划，并展现出仿真到现实的迁移能力。

title: Local Reproduction Numbers for Analysis and Optimal Mitigation of Epidemic Processes
summary: In this paper, we propose a unifying framework to analyze layered networked epidemic processes where the population, represented either as a networked SIS or SIR model, is coupled with an infrastructure network. We propose novel local metrics that enable the analysis of the epidemic spreading locally (node-level) and the prediction of the network-wide spreading under some sufficient conditions. Inspired by the bilayer nature of our model, we partition the layered network between intra- and inter-layer interactions. We identify conditions at the layer level which allow the characterization of the network-level basic reproduction number in terms of the physical structure of the layered network. Then, we leverage the local metrics to propose an optimization framework for epidemic mitigation based on a fundamental notion: the network-wide spreading can be quantified by the aggregation of the local (node-level) epidemic burden. We provide guarantees that the local metric-based optimization can be solved as a geometric program. We illustrate our theoretical results via numerical examples and evaluate the performance of the local metrics and the optimization framework they enable versus other existing epidemic mitigation approaches based on network-level metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于分析人口网络（SIS或SIR模型）与基础设施网络耦合形成的分层网络流行病过程。
AI.motivation: 现有流行病缓解方法多基于网络级指标，缺乏对分层耦合网络中节点级局部传播的分析，因此需要统一框架来刻画局部与全局传播关系并支持优化。
AI.method: 提出新的局部指标，将分层网络划分为层内与层间交互，给出层级别条件以用物理结构表征网络级基本再生数；并基于局部疫情负担聚合，构建可求解为几何规划的疫情缓解优化框架。
AI.result: 在充分条件下，局部指标可分析节点级传播并预测网络级传播；层级别条件可刻画基本再生数；局部指标优化可保证转为几何规划，数值实验验证了其性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于局部指标的框架能有效分析和缓解分层网络中的流行病传播，相比基于网络级指标的现有方法具有更好的性能表现。

title: AI Data Centers Meet Electrical Grids: A Review of Power Challenges and Coordinated Solutions
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) workloads are creating large, power-electronic loads whose effects on power systems depend on location, temporal variability, controllability, and interactions with other loads and resources. Annual electricity consumption alone cannot capture these effects. This review examines how AI data centers affect power systems stability, renewable-energy integration, and low-carbon planning by tracing the power-delivery chain from accelerators and workloads through rack converters, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), storage, and microgrids to the transmission point of interconnection. Reported oscillatory events and multi-gigawatt load transfers highlight how facility responses can amplify disturbances, while programmable workloads and controllable power converters offer opportunities for demand flexibility. Challenges and mitigation strategies are organized across device, rack, facility, and power systems levels, spanning millisecond-to-year timescales. A bandwidth-matching framework relates disturbances to the response capabilities of mitigation resources. The review distinguishes computational energy efficiency from power systems and sustainability outcomes: lower energy consumption per token does not necessarily reduce peak demand, electrical disturbances, or carbon emissions. It examines how coordinated workload scheduling, grid-interactive UPS systems, storage, high-voltage DC distribution, and flexible interconnection can support reliability, efficiency, and decarbonization. Key research needs include dynamic load models, high-bandwidth telemetry, carbon-and grid-aware scheduling, and mechanisms for valuing flexible computational demand.

AI.tldr: 该综述探讨AI数据中心作为大型电力电子负载如何影响电力系统稳定性、可再生能源整合与低碳规划，并沿功率交付链从加速器与工作负载到输电网接入点进行分析，提出跨设备、机架、设施和系统层面的挑战与缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 仅用年用电量无法刻画AI负载对电力系统的影响，因为其影响取决于位置、时间变化、可控性以及与其他负载和资源的交互；因此需要理解AI数据中心对稳定性、新能源消纳和低碳规划的深层影响。
AI.method: 综述方法：沿功率交付链追踪（加速器与工作负载、机架变换器、UPS、储能、微电网至并网点），组织设备、机架、设施和电力系统多层级及毫秒至年时间尺度的挑战与缓解措施，并提出带宽匹配框架关联扰动与缓解资源响应能力。
AI.result: 报告了振荡事件和数吉瓦级负荷转移，说明设施响应可能放大扰动；同时可编程工作负载和可控功率变换器提供需求灵活性。研究区分计算能效与电力系统及可持续性结果：每token能耗降低不一定减少峰值需求、电气扰动或碳排放。协调工作负载调度、电网交互UPS、储能、高压直流配电和灵活互联可支持可靠性、效率和脱碳。
AI.conclusion: 关键研究需求包括动态负荷模型、高带宽遥测、碳与电网感知调度，以及为灵活计算需求定价的机制。需要跨时间尺度和多层级协调，才能让AI数据中心在电力系统中实现可靠、高效和低碳运行。

title: Autonomous Droplet Navigation via Model-Based Reinforcement Learning: Zero-Shot Transfer and Emergent Dynamics
comment: Accepted for presentation at the Robotics & Automation in Self-Driving Laboratories 2026 Workshop, IROS 2026. https://sites.tufts.edu/selfdrivinglabs-iros2026/
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are transforming chemical and materials discovery through closed-loop automation, yet automated infrastructure for physical manipulation of soft, deformable matter remains beyond current robotic platforms. A critical instance is autonomous droplet transport on an open surface, where contact-angle hysteresis, capillary pinning, and surface heterogeneity produce partially observable dynamics that pose significant challenges for classical model-based controllers. We introduce the first robotic platform for closed-loop autonomous liquid droplet navigation on an open, unconfined surface using model-based reinforcement learning. A two-axis tilting board coated with a thin silicone oil film drives the droplet, while an overhead camera provides real-time feedback. A learned policy was trained on just 50 to 150 physical episodes depending on geometric complexity, without simulation or analytical models. Beyond performance alone, the platform demonstrates three capabilities of interest to the SDL community: it robustly transfers zero-shot to unseen geometries; it autonomously discovers an oscillatory depinning strategy to free the droplet when it sticks; and it completes its full training pipeline in under 90 minutes. These results extend reinforcement-learning manipulation from rigid microrobots to deformable soft-matter systems for next-generation SDLs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于开放无约束表面上液滴闭环自主导航的机器人平台，采用基于模型的强化学习，无需仿真或解析模型，仅用少量物理实验即可训练完成。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室（SDLs）正通过闭环自动化变革化学与材料发现，但针对柔软、可变形物质的自动化物理操作基础设施仍超出当前机器人平台能力。开放表面上液滴自主运输面临接触角滞后、毛细钉扎和表面不均匀性导致的部分可观测动力学难题，传统基于模型的控制器难以应对。
AI.method: 构建了一个双轴倾斜板平台，表面涂有薄硅油膜以驱动液滴，并通过顶置相机提供实时反馈。使用基于模型的强化学习训练策略，训练仅需50至150个物理回合（取决于几何复杂度），不依赖仿真或解析模型。
AI.result: 平台能够零样本迁移到未见过的几何形状；当液滴卡住时，可自主发现振荡脱钉策略使其脱离；完整训练流程可在90分钟内完成。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将强化学习操作从刚性微机器人扩展到可变形软物质系统，为下一代自驱动实验室提供了新能力。

title: Emo-Jev: Probabilistic Reasoning for Emotion Classification with Jev
summary: Jev offers an alternative interface for language understanding: given an input and predefined questions, it returns probabilistic decisions rather than free-form responses. Whether this interface can support effective reasoning for text classification against leading LLMs remains an open questions. We introduce Emo-Jev, a training-free framework with two complementary implementations. Emo-Jev-D decomposes classification into task-specific atomic judgments and composes their probabilities into a final prediction. Emo-Jev-SC constructs multiple judgment paths from complementary perspectives and aggregates their predictions into a consensus decision. We evaluate Emo-Jev on eight datasets spanning sentiment analysis, emotion recognition, sarcasm detection and humor detection, comparing against direct Jev classification and five SoTA LLMs under input/output and chain-of-thought reasoning. Standard Jev achieves 62.93\% average macro-F1 versus 67.28\% for the strongest LLM baseline, with lower observed latency and generally lower cost.

AI.tldr: 论文研究Jev这种基于预定义问题返回概率决策的接口能否有效支持文本分类推理，并提出免训练的Emo-Jev框架，包含分解式Emo-Jev-D和共识式Emo-Jev-SC两种实现。
AI.motivation: Jev提供了一种不同于自由文本生成的语言理解接口，但其在文本分类推理上能否匹敌或超越领先LLM仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架Emo-Jev。Emo-Jev-D将分类分解为任务特定的原子判断，并将其概率组合为最终预测；Emo-Jev-SC从互补视角构造多条判断路径，并聚合预测形成共识决策。在8个数据集上评估，涵盖情感分析、情绪识别、讽刺检测和幽默检测，并与直接Jev分类及五种SoTA LLM在输入/输出和思维链推理设置下比较。
AI.result: 标准Jev平均macro-F1为62.93%，而最强LLM基线为67.28%；Jev具有更低的观测延迟和通常更低的成本。摘要未明确给出Emo-Jev两种实现的具体性能结果。
AI.conclusion: Jev接口在延迟和成本方面具有优势，但在文本分类推理准确率上仍落后于最强LLM基线；Emo-Jev通过分解判断与多路径共识聚合来尝试提升免训练分类效果，但其最终收益仍有待摘要之外的实验验证。

title: CoDR: Training-Free Confidence-Drift Remasking for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) decode by repeatedly committing tokens to masked positions, but these commitments are usually irreversible. A token chosen under sparse, partial context is kept fixed, even when later context no longer supports it. Existing samplers mainly decide when to commit a token, but rarely check whether an already committed token should still be kept, allowing early mistakes to propagate. We trace this issue to confidence drift, where the model's confidence in a committed token drops from its sparse commit-time context to the denser context available later. Based on this signal, we propose CoDR (Confidence Drift Remasking), a training-free and sampler-agnostic refinement pass. CoDR estimates drift for all committed positions in only k forward passes via k-partition probing, then remasks and regenerates only the tokens the model no longer endorses. Across two backbones, four reasoning and coding tasks, and three base samplers, CoDR improves average accuracy across all evaluated model-sampler configurations and improves most individual task settings with modest overhead. Controlled experiments show that the gains come from targeted confidence-drift remasking rather than extra compute alone, and that CoDR uses far fewer forward passes than prior remasking methods. Code is available at https://github.com/YueWu0301/CoDR.

AI.tldr: 本文针对掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）中已提交 token 不可逆、早期错误会传播的问题，提出无需训练且与采样器无关的置信漂移重掩码方法 CoDR，通过检测已提交 token 的置信度漂移来重掩码并重新生成不再被模型支持的 token。
AI.motivation: MDLM 在稀疏、部分上下文中提交 token 后通常不可逆，即使后续更密集的上下文不再支持该 token 也会保留，导致早期错误传播。现有采样器主要决定何时提交 token，很少检查已提交 token 是否仍应保留。作者将此问题归因于置信漂移：已提交 token 的模型置信度从其稀疏提交时上下文到后续更密集上下文会下降。
AI.method: 提出 CoDR（Confidence Drift Remasking），一种无需训练、采样器无关的细化过程。它通过 k 分区探测在仅 k 次前向传播中估计所有已提交位置的置信漂移，然后仅对模型不再认可的 token 进行重掩码和重新生成。
AI.result: 在两个骨干模型、四个推理与编码任务、三种基础采样器上，CoDR 提升了所有评估的模型-采样器组合的平均准确率，并在大多数单个任务设置中取得提升，且开销适中。控制实验表明增益来自有针对性的置信漂移重掩码，而非单纯增加计算量；与先前重掩码方法相比，CoDR 使用的前向传播次数少得多。
AI.conclusion: CoDR 能有效缓解 MDLM 中因不可逆提交和置信漂移导致的早期错误传播问题，在多种模型、任务和采样器上稳定提升性能，且训练免费、采样器无关、计算开销较低，代码已开源。

title: How Could AI Eliminate Humanity? A Failure-Mode Analysis of Civilizational Risk
summary: This article develops a failure-mode framework for analyzing how advanced artificial intelligence could contribute to human extinction, irreversible civilizational collapse, or permanent human disempowerment. The central thesis is that catastrophic AI risk does not require consciousness, hostility, or an explicit intention to harm humanity. Instead, risk may arise through several distinct but interacting pathways, including autonomous misalignment, harmful human use, organizational failure, and competitive deployment. The severity of these pathways depends on factors such as capability, autonomy, external access, persistence, institutional safeguards, and the preservation of recovery capacity. The analysis is deliberately non-operational: it identifies causal conditions, empirically tractable intermediate quantities, and defensive research questions rather than procedures for causing harm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个失效模式框架，用于分析先进人工智能如何可能导致人类灭绝、不可逆文明崩溃或永久性人类失权。核心观点是，灾难性AI风险并不需要AI具备意识、敌意或伤害人类的明确意图。
AI.motivation: 现有关于先进AI灾难性风险的讨论可能过度依赖意识、敌意或明确伤害意图等假设，因此需要更系统地识别风险产生的多种因果路径及其相互作用。
AI.method: 构建非操作性的失效模式分析框架，识别因果条件、可实证的中间变量和防御性研究问题，而非提供造成伤害的具体程序。
AI.result: 提出若干相互作用的灾难风险路径，包括自主性失准、人类有害使用、组织失败和竞争性部署；风险严重性取决于能力、自主性、外部访问、持续性、制度保障和恢复能力保护等因素。
AI.conclusion: 灾难性AI风险不必然要求意识、敌意或明确意图；应重点关注能力、自主性、外部访问、持续性、制度保障和恢复能力等可干预因素，并推进防御性研究。

title: VCR-Bench: A Modular Open-Source Benchmark for Video Classification Robustness
comment: 6 pages,1 figure, accepted at ACM MM 2026
summary: Robustness of image classification has several benchmarks, but their video counterparts are absent. In video classification temporal dimension introduces additional degrees of freedom for adversarial attacks, defenses, and preprocessing. Temporal sampling, perturbation budgets, and metric aggregation also interact in ways with no direct analogue in the image setting. Therefore, robustness for video classifiers is studied across scattered, incompatible implementations, making reported numbers hard to reproduce and analyze. We introduce VCR-Bench, a modular open-source benchmark framework that standardizes video loading, wrappers for classifiers, adversarial attacks and defenses, perceptual metrics, configuration presets, and result logging. VCR-Bench currently integrates 30 video classification models, 14 adversarial attacks, and 10 defense wrappers under a common evaluation protocol. We evaluate representative video classifiers, attacks, and defenses on Kinetics-400 subset, reporting clean accuracy, attack success rate, perceptual quality, runtime, and memory usage. VCR-Bench is released with documented installation, reproducible run presets, component-extension interfaces, and scripts for reproducing the reported results at https://github.com/msu-video-group/vcr-bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 VCR-Bench，一个模块化开源视频分类鲁棒性基准框架，统一视频加载、模型/攻击/防御封装、感知指标、配置预设与结果日志，集成30个视频分类模型、14种对抗攻击和10种防御，并在Kinetics-400子集上评估。
AI.motivation: 图像分类鲁棒性已有多个基准，但视频分类缺乏对应基准；视频的时间维度带来额外自由度，时序采样、扰动预算和指标聚合相互影响，现有实现分散且不兼容，导致结果难以复现和分析。
AI.method: 构建模块化开源基准框架，标准化视频加载、分类器包装、对抗攻击与防御、感知指标、配置预设和结果日志；采用统一评估协议，集成30个视频分类模型、14种对抗攻击和10种防御包装器；在Kinetics-400子集上评估代表性模型、攻击和防御。
AI.result: VCR-Bench 集成了30个视频分类模型、14种对抗攻击和10种防御包装器；在Kinetics-400子集上报告了干净准确率、攻击成功率、感知质量、运行时间和内存使用，并提供安装文档、可复现运行预设、组件扩展接口和复现脚本。
AI.conclusion: VCR-Bench 为视频分类鲁棒性研究提供了标准化、可复现、可扩展的基准平台，有助于公平比较不同模型、攻击和防御方法，并推动后续研究。

title: Localized Thermal Management of Induction-Heated Microrobots for Hyperthermia Applications
summary: Induction-heated microrobots face a fundamental thermal management challenge: the alternating magnetic fields required for localized hyperthermia simultaneously generate parasitic ohmic heating within the actuation coils. Conventional cooling approaches can fail because conductive cooling structures placed near the coil can couple to the time-varying field, generating additional electromagnetic losses. This paper addresses this architectural limitation by evaluating two liquid-cooling frameworks designed to isolate the electromagnetic workspace: an indirect configuration utilizing an external copper water block, and a direct architecture routing coolant internally through a hollow helical coil. Evaluated over a 100~s window with multi-point thermocouple telemetry, the indirect water-block configuration failed due to secondary inductive coupling with the block itself, acting as an unintended susceptor that drove the block temperature to an extreme peak of 805$^{\circ}$C. In contrast, the direct internal cooling architecture successfully extracted ohmic losses at the source, sustaining a localized ablation tip temperature of 63.4$^{\circ}$C while strictly restricting surrounding fluid and boundary surfaces below defined thresholds of 33.9$^{\circ}$C and 37.6$^{\circ}$C, respectively. These results establish coil-level fluidic integration as a key design principle for thermally isolated microrobot actuation and provide a hardware foundation for future spatially controlled hyperthermia.

AI.tldr: 本文针对感应加热微型机器人中驱动线圈寄生欧姆发热的难题，评估了两种液冷架构：外部铜水块间接冷却和空心螺旋线圈内部直接冷却。结果表明，间接冷却会因二次感应耦合而失效，直接内部冷却能有效带走线圈损耗并实现局部热疗温控。
AI.motivation: 感应加热微型机器人需要交变磁场实现局部热疗，但该磁场会同时在驱动线圈中产生寄生欧姆热。传统冷却结构若靠近线圈，可能与时变磁场耦合产生额外电磁损耗，因此需要一种能隔离电磁工作区的热管理方案。
AI.method: 设计并对比两种液冷框架：一是使用外部铜水块的间接冷却配置；二是将冷却液直接通入空心螺旋线圈内部的直接冷却架构。在100秒窗口内使用多点热电偶遥测进行热性能评估。
AI.result: 间接水块配置因水块本身与磁场发生二次感应耦合，成为非预期感受器，温度峰值高达805°C，冷却失败。直接内部冷却架构能够从源头带走欧姆损耗，使局部消融尖端温度维持在63.4°C，同时将周围流体和边界表面温度分别限制在33.9°C和37.6°C以下。
AI.conclusion: 线圈级流体集成是热隔离微型机器人驱动设计的关键原则，并为未来空间可控热疗提供了硬件基础。

title: Leveraging LLM-Generated Explanations for Detecting Emotionally Rewritten Fake News
summary: The spread of fake news may cause severe social consequences. Existing fake news detection methods mainly focus on stylistic variations or incorporate external information such as explanations. However, news articles are often rewritten under different emotional backgrounds while preserving their underlying factual claims, which may affect the robustness of detection models. In this work, we investigate fake news detec- tion under fact-preserving emotional variations. To study this problem, we construct emotion-rewritten test sets and generate explanations from the original news articles as stable background knowledge. We then propose a Gated Cross Attention (GCA) framework that adaptively integrates emotionally rewritten news with the corresponding explanations, enabling the model to focus on informative explanation content while reducing potential mismatches caused by emotional reframing. Experiments on PolitiFact, GossipCop, and LUN demonstrate that the proposed method achieves notable improvements under multiple emotional conditions on PolitiFact and LUN, while maintaining competitive performance on GossipCop. We further analyze the effects of explanation guidance and gating mechanisms under different emotional conditions. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Flulike/fakenews gca .

AI.tldr: 本文研究在保持事实内容不变的情感改写场景下的假新闻检测，构建情感改写测试集并利用原新闻生成解释作为稳定背景知识，提出门控交叉注意力（GCA）框架融合情感改写新闻与解释，以提升检测鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 假新闻传播危害严重，而现有检测方法多关注风格变化或引入外部信息，但新闻常在不同情感背景下被改写而事实主张不变，这会削弱检测模型鲁棒性。因此需要研究事实保持型情感变化下的假新闻检测。
AI.method: 构建情感改写测试集；从原始新闻生成解释作为稳定背景知识；提出GCA框架，通过门控交叉注意力自适应融合情感改写新闻与对应解释，使模型关注有用解释内容并减少情感重构导致的错配。
AI.result: 在PolitiFact、GossipCop和LUN数据集上实验表明，该方法在PolitiFact和LUN的多种情感条件下取得显著提升，在GossipCop上保持有竞争力表现；并进一步分析了不同情感条件下解释引导和门控机制的作用。
AI.conclusion: GCA框架能有效利用稳定解释知识并借助门控机制缓解情感改写带来的负面影响，从而提升假新闻检测在事实保持型情感变化下的鲁棒性。

title: SPW-Nav: A Streaming Panoramic World Model for Language-Guided Navigation
summary: Language-guided panoramic video generation benefits various downstream applications, such as interactive 3D scene exploration, virtual reality experiences, and embodied agent training. Existing panoramic generators follow predefined trajectories, and interactive world models act through low-level actions in perspective views. We propose SPW-Nav, a streaming panoramic world model that understands movement instructions and streams one minute of 2K 360-degree video in real time from a single panorama. SPW-Nav interprets each instruction in the previously generated panorama as camera motion. Spherical rotation decoupling applies rotation exactly on the sphere, pose-aligned conditioning keeps translation inputs bounded over long streams, and a multi-term memory with a few-step generator continues the scene as instructions change. We also build SPW-NavSet, panoramic videos with camera trajectories and verified instructions. Driven by language, SPW-Nav outperforms prior panoramic generators in camera-following accuracy and video quality, and supports on-the-fly instruction switching.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SPW-Nav，一种语言引导的流式全景世界模型，能够从单张全景图实时生成一分钟 2K 360 度视频，并支持根据运动指令动态切换相机轨迹。
AI.motivation: 语言引导的全景视频生成可用于交互式 3D 场景探索、虚拟现实和具身智能体训练。现有全景生成器通常遵循预定义轨迹，而交互式世界模型多在透视视角下依赖低层动作，缺乏对语言运动指令和长时全景生成的支持。
AI.method: SPW-Nav 将每条指令解释为上一帧全景中的相机运动；采用球面旋转解耦在球面上精确应用旋转，使用姿态对齐条件约束长流中的平移输入，并结合多术语记忆与少步生成器在指令变化时延续场景。同时构建 SPW-NavSet 数据集，包含带相机轨迹和验证指令的全景视频。
AI.result: 在语言驱动下，SPW-Nav 在相机跟随准确度和视频质量上优于先前全景生成器，并支持实时指令切换。
AI.conclusion: SPW-Nav 证明了语言引导的流式全景世界模型可实现实时、长时、可交互的 360 度视频生成，为沉浸式场景探索与具身应用提供了新途径。

title: Sequential Probabilistic Uncertainty Estimation for Parallel Multi-Agent Reasoning Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have attracted growing attention for improving reasoning through interaction among multiple agents. In this work, we focus on parallel multi-agent reasoning systems, where several agents solve the same problem over multiple rounds and aggregate their outputs into a final answer. Despite their strong reasoning performance, uncertainty estimation for such systems remains underexplored: the reliability of a MAS depends not only on individual generations, but also on how agents interact and evolve across rounds. We propose SAUCE (Sequential Agent Uncertainty through Consensus Evolution), a lightweight, training-free uncertainty estimator that formulates MAS uncertainty as sequential inference over a latent system-level belief. SAUCE aggregates round-level agreement and generation-uncertainty signals through a filtering-style update. Across five backbones, five benchmarks, and two MAS protocols, SAUCE improves misclassification detection, selective prediction, and calibration over a broad set of uncertainty estimation baselines, including standard log-likelihood-based methods and MAS-specific estimators.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SAUCE，一种轻量、免训练的不确定性估计器，用于并行多智能体推理系统，通过共识演化对系统级信念进行序贯推断。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统虽能通过多智能体交互提升推理能力，但其不确定性估计仍未被充分探索；系统可靠性不仅取决于单个智能体的生成，还取决于智能体在多轮交互中的演化与聚合方式。
AI.method: SAUCE 将多智能体系统的不确定性建模为对潜在系统级信念的序贯推断，并通过滤波式更新聚合轮级一致性与生成不确定性信号。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型、五个基准和两种多智能体协议上，SAUCE 在误分类检测、选择性预测和校准方面优于多种不确定性估计基线，包括标准对数似然方法和多智能体系统专用估计器。
AI.conclusion: SAUCE 是一种轻量、免训练且有效的多智能体推理系统不确定性估计方法，能够提升系统可靠性评估相关任务的表现。

title: CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks
summary: Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIRRA（持续指令协调机器人智能体），一种结合LLM语义推理与规则约束结构集成的双层框架，用于在执行中协调新指令；同时发布CHIRP基准，并在Unitree G1人形机器人上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 家庭机器人在执行任务时需接收新指令。现有方法常重新生成或大幅修改剩余任务序列，导致计划模糊、逻辑不一致和冗余执行。因此需要持续协调新指令与正在执行的任务。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为持续指令协调；CIRRA先用LLM语义推理将新指令 grounding 到可执行技能，解决欠指定动作和位置；再保留正在执行的子任务序列作为执行主干，把新子任务插入位置匹配段生成候选，仅评估修改段以识别依赖和冲突，选择逻辑最一致的局部集成，并复用共享子任务。还提出CHIRP文本基准，含120个episode、8个家庭环境和6类日常活动。
AI.result: 在CHIRP上，CIRRA达到74.2%决策一致率，超最强重规划基线30个百分点；每个正确融合决策都产生正确放置且无冲突的调度。在Unitree G1人形机器人上，CIRRA每次试验都能在正确时刻中断正在执行的技能，并在所有指标上显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: CIRRA通过结构保持的持续指令协调，能减少计划模糊、逻辑不一致和冗余执行，并在文本基准与人形机器人实验中验证了其有效性和优越性。

title: Trajectory Planning without Trajectory Data: A Manifold-Guided Approach
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code can be found in https://github.com/SilongYong/Ariadne/
summary: A common way for trajectory planning is to leverage generative models trained on large collections of expert trajectories. At inference time, the model generates executable trajectories by conditioning on task goal constraints. However, trajectory-based methods rely on costly supervision, scale poorly with sequence length, and often generalize poorly to unseen constraints such as novel start-goal pairs. We propose an alternative to learn the underlying state-space manifold and use the geometry of the manifold for trajectory planning. This approach requires only state observations and enables generalization to unseen constraints by con- structing trajectories on the learned manifold of the state space. Experiments on Maze2D and robotic motion-planning benchmarks show that Ariadne constructs feasible paths from state-only supervision and generalizes to unseen start-goal combinations. On high-dimensional dual-arm planning, it remains competitive with trajectory-supervised and classical planners, while requiring no trajectory data for training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ariadne，仅用状态观测学习状态空间流形，并利用流形几何进行轨迹规划，避免依赖专家轨迹监督，且能泛化到未见起止点约束。
AI.motivation: 现有基于生成模型的轨迹规划依赖大量专家轨迹，监督成本高、随序列长度扩展差，且常难以泛化到新约束（如新的起止点对）。
AI.method: 学习状态空间的底层流形，仅需状态观测；在学到的流形上构造轨迹，并利用其几何进行轨迹规划。
AI.result: 在 Maze2D 和机器人运动规划基准上，Ariadne 能从仅状态监督生成可行路径，并泛化到未见起止点组合；在高维双臂规划中，与轨迹监督方法和经典规划器相比仍有竞争力，且训练无需轨迹数据。
AI.conclusion: 学习状态空间流形并利用其几何进行规划，是替代轨迹生成方法的有效途径，可降低监督需求并提升对未见约束的泛化能力。

title: Mission-critical spectrum sharing with decentralized Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of IEEE CCNC 2027
summary: Motivated by emerging mission-critical applications and an increasingly congested spectrum, we develop a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) model for dynamic spectrum access. The model enables secondary users to learn effective transmission strategies across shared frequency bands while minimizing collisions with high-priority primary users and among themselves. We design the agent-level learners following a Markov potential game approach, connecting independent local updates to system-level improvement. We instantiate this design using lightweight linear actor-critic learners suitable for resource-constrained edge devices, rather than computationally intensive centralized or deep multi-agent architectures. Across spectrum environments with different incumbent activities, the learned policies adapt their transmission policy and waiting behavior to preserve throughput while greatly reducing transmission collisions relative to random and forecast-aware heuristic baselines. The results establish the value of decentralized MARL and shows up to 96.8% reduction in overall collisions.
