We then present sum of squares (SOS) verification conditions that certify both correctness and feasibility of the resulting DAE-aware CBF. The framework is validated on power system case studies.

AI.tldr: 本文针对半显式微分代数方程（DAE）系统提出了一种安全关键控制框架，通过引入考虑代数约束兼容性的DAE-aware CBF，并利用投影向量场和SOS验证条件，解决了传统CBF在DAE系统中可能不可行的问题。
AI.motivation: DAE系统广泛存在于电力网络、多体力学和化工过程中，其代数约束耦合动态与代数状态。传统为常微分方程设计的安全控制屏障函数（CBF）方法无法直接适用于DAE系统，因为代数约束会带来兼容性要求，可能导致安全滤波器不可行。
AI.method: 提出DAE-aware CBF，在约束流形上构造投影向量场以刻画隐藏动态，并确保代数约束持续满足的兼容性条件；进一步给出平方和（SOS）验证条件，以证明所得DAE-aware CBF的正确性和可行性。
AI.result: 该框架在电力系统案例研究中得到验证，表明其能够有效处理DAE系统的安全关键控制问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文为半显式DAE系统提供了一种考虑代数约束兼容性的安全控制方法，克服了传统CBF的局限性，并通过SOS条件保证了正确性与可行性。

title: Quad-State Safety Evaluation of Open-Weight Large Language Models on Non-Canonical Inputs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust). 12 pages, 11 tables. Project page: https://www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pavanmaddula/ASRD-Dataset
summary: Standard safety evaluations of large language models assess harmful requests written in canonical plain text, while models in real-world deployment routinely receive inputs containing emojis, altered spellings, encoded strings, and character-level variations. This work introduces the Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset (ASRD), comprising 2,100 prompts across seven distinct surface-form families. Five open-weight language models are evaluated across these prompts, producing 10,500 responses. The Quad-State Evaluation Rubric classifies each response into one of four outcomes: harmful compliance, safe response, comprehension failure, or indeterminate. Emoji and invisible Unicode variations cause almost no comprehension failure, with pooled harmful compliance of 20.27% and 17.20% against a 22.87% baseline that is driven mainly by Mistral 7B, whereas leetspeak, encoded wrappers, and hybrid transformations score 2.40%, 0.13%, and 2.40% while comprehension failure rises to 36.47%, 65.60%, and 34.47%. Inspection of raw model outputs reveals three response behaviors: hallucinated benignity, structural collapse, and language drift. Project page: www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate

AI.tldr: 论文提出ASRD数据集，包含2100个提示，覆盖七种表面形式变体，评估五个开源权重语言模型共10500条响应，并用四态评分标准分类为有害遵从、安全响应、理解失败或不确定。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型安全评估主要针对规范纯文本的有害请求，但真实部署中输入常包含emoji、拼写变体、编码字符串和字符级变化，因此模型在这些表面形式下的安全鲁棒性尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset（ASRD），包含七类表面形式、2100个提示；评估五个开源权重模型，生成10500条响应；采用Quad-State Evaluation Rubric将响应分为有害遵从、安全响应、理解失败和不确定；并检查原始输出以识别行为模式。
AI.result: Emoji和不可见Unicode变体几乎不导致理解失败，合并有害遵从率为20.27%和17.20%，基线为22.87%（主要受Mistral 7B驱动）；而leetspeak、encoded wrappers和hybrid变换的有害遵从率分别为2.40%、0.13%和2.40%，理解失败率升至36.47%、65.60%和34.47%。原始输出显示三种行为：幻觉性良性、结构崩溃和语言漂移。
AI.conclusion: 表面形式扰动会显著影响安全评估结果，编码和混合变换导致高理解失败，而简单字符变体仍可能绕过安全机制；因此安全评估与部署应考虑表面形式鲁棒性。

title: OverLay++: Dense-Overlap Layout-to-Image Generation Dataset
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Project website: https://mlpc-ucsd.github.io/OverLayPP . Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mlpcucsd/OverLayPP
summary: Layout-to-Image generation has made substantial progress in spatial and object-level control. However, existing methods still struggle with complex scenes containing many overlapping and interacting objects. We argue that training data is a particular bottleneck: existing datasets lack examples with dense, complex object interactions. To address this gap, we introduce OverLay++, a large-scale Layout-to-Image dataset with structurally complex scenes. OverLay++ contains approximately 500K images with an average of 6.6 objects per image, exceeding existing datasets by 1.67 times in annotation density. Beyond annotation density, OverLay++ provides rich semantic detail with object captions over six times longer than in current datasets. Our dataset generation pipeline is simple and produces dense, overlapping object annotations with rich per-object captions. Across multiple benchmarks, state-of-the-art Layout-to-Image methods trained on the OverLay++ dataset show consistent improvement and faster convergence, demonstrating the importance of dense, overlap-aware, and caption-rich supervision for controllable image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 OverLay++，一个面向布局到图像生成的大规模数据集，包含约50万张图像，平均每张6.6个物体，显著提升了标注密度和物体描述长度，旨在解决复杂重叠物体场景的训练数据瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有布局到图像生成方法在包含大量重叠、交互物体的复杂场景中表现不佳，作者认为关键瓶颈在于训练数据：现有数据集缺乏密集、复杂物体交互的样本。
AI.method: 构建 OverLay++ 数据集：约500K图像，平均每张6.6个物体，标注密度为现有数据集的1.67倍；提供比现有数据集长6倍以上的物体级描述；采用简单流程生成密集、重叠的物体标注和丰富的逐物体描述。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，使用 OverLay++ 训练的先进布局到图像生成方法均取得一致提升，并实现更快收敛。
AI.conclusion: 密集、重叠感知且描述丰富的监督信号对可控图像生成非常重要，OverLay++ 能有效推动布局到图像生成在复杂场景中的进展。

title: Continuous-Time Critic as a Lyapunov Function: Projected Adaptation and Cart-Pole Stabilization
summary: We study adaptive stabilization of known control-affine systems by treating the current parameterized critic itself as a Lyapunov candidate. Its total derivative contains a parameter-velocity term that can compensate unfavorable state evolution. A projection onto the intersection of a bounded admissible velocity set and one decay halfspace enforces parameter invariance and Lyapunov decrease simultaneously. We give an exact pointwise feasibility test, a conditional state-stability theorem, and a counterexample showing why a positive critic family containing a stabilizing member does not imply persistent feasibility. A convex endpoint constraint provides a distinct sampled implementation. A generic periodic polynomial-factor critic with a local Riccati anchor is evaluated on a force-limited cart-pole without mechanical-energy features, replay training, waypoints, or controller switching. The frozen controller passes stabilization and numerical decay checks on 600 sampled initial states across two draw sets; 400 matched continuous trajectories also pass. Independent reintegration audits and a conservative local feasibility certificate are distinguished from a global or machine-arithmetic guarantee. Compared with nonlinear model-predictive control, the measured implementation uses less CPU but has higher cost, settling time, and cart travel. The results support a conditional adaptive stabilization mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究已知控制仿射系统的自适应镇定，将当前参数化评论家（critic）本身作为Lyapunov候选函数，通过参数速度项补偿不利状态演化，实现参数不变性与Lyapunov下降，并在力限小车-摆杆任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 传统自适应控制或基于Lyapunov的方法中，参数化critic通常仅用于评价，而非直接作为Lyapunov函数；作者希望探索将critic本身作为Lyapunov候选并利用其参数速度项实现自适应镇定的机制。
AI.method: 将参数化critic作为Lyapunov候选，其全导数包含参数速度项；通过投影到有界容许速度集与一个衰减半空间的交集，同时强制参数不变性和Lyapunov下降。给出逐点可行性精确检验、条件状态稳定性定理、反例说明含镇定成员的critic族不一定持续可行；采用凸端点约束实现采样版本。使用带局部Riccati锚点的周期多项式因子critic，在无力学能量特征、回放训练、路径点或控制器切换的力限小车-摆杆上评估。
AI.result: 冻结控制器在两组采样初始状态共600个样本上通过镇定和数值衰减检查；400条匹配连续轨迹也通过。独立重积分审计和保守局部可行性证书被区分于全局或机器算术保证。与非线性模型预测控制相比，实测实现CPU占用更低，但代价、调节时间和小车行程更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种条件自适应镇定机制，即在该机制下可实现镇定性，但可行性是条件性的，且不提供全局或机器算术层面的保证。

title: Same Text, Different Prediction: Serving-Context Nondeterminism in Text Classifiers
summary: Deterministic inference is essential for reliable and trustworthy machine learning. Prior studies of text generation have shown that changing factors such as batch size, batch composition, hardware, or inference engine can alter the generated text, even when the prompt, model parameters, and sampling randomness are fixed. These differences have been attributed in part to floating-point non-associativity, shape-dependent kernel selection, and other implementation-level differences in numerical execution. However, it remains unclear whether, when, and to what extent the same factors affect text classification. We present a systematic study of serving-context non-invariance in text classifiers, which prior work has measured only through generated text. We train 180 models spanning discriminative, pseudo-generative, and fully generative classifier formulations and evaluate each across four categories of serving contexts, holding the checkpoint and the text fixed. Label stability does not imply score stability. Changing only the batch shape changes no labels across fp32 comparisons, yet under bf16 it moves up to 56.7 percentage points of predicted probability mass, with label changes concentrated at small margins. Fully generative classifiers change more labels than their discriminative counterparts under the same serving changes. We derive sufficient conditions for label stability under each serving change and give a separate mitigation for each mechanism. Our results identify and quantify the serving conditions that must be fixed for reproducible text classification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了文本分类器中的服务上下文非不变性，发现即使固定模型和文本，批大小、批组成、硬件或推理引擎等变化仍可能导致预测分数甚至标签变化。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明文本生成会因浮点非结合性、形状相关内核选择等实现差异而变化，但尚不清楚这些服务因素是否、何时以及多大程度上影响文本分类。
AI.method: 训练180个模型，涵盖判别式、伪生成式和完全生成式分类器，固定检查点与文本，在四类服务上下文中评估，并分析fp32与bf16下批形状等变化对标签和预测概率的影响。
AI.result: 标签稳定不代表分数稳定；仅改变批形状在fp32下不改变标签，但在bf16下可移动高达56.7个百分点的预测概率质量，标签变化集中在较小间隔处；完全生成式分类器比判别式分类器在相同服务变化下改变更多标签。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了每种服务变化下标签稳定的充分条件及对应缓解措施，明确了实现可复现文本分类所需固定的服务条件。

title: World Models Dream of Success: Diagnosing and Repairing Failure Insensitivity in Robot World Models
summary: Robot world models support policy evaluation, planning, and synthetic data generation, but these applications require predictions that distinguish successful actions from failures. Across four released checkpoints from two architecture families, we observe weak sensitivity to action changes and success-like predictions on verified failures. Although recent work incorporates failures into model training, which data can repair released checkpoints without changing their architecture or training objective still remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce CureWM, which constructs alternative actions from successful demonstrations across a severity grid, verifies their outcomes through execution in simulation or on hardware, and fine-tunes released models on the resulting failures and surviving successes alongside nominal demonstrations. This construction provides controlled action contrasts from shared starting contexts. On 484 held-out LIBERO failure counterfactuals, optimism falls from 80\% after fine-tuning on the official data to 30--43\% across four independently fine-tuned CureWM models (38\% mean). In two separate evaluations on a physical robot arm, failure predictions scored as success-like by a latent-distance diagnostic decrease from 90\% after fine-tuning on successful demonstrations alone to 33\% with CureWM. With failure counts per task, successful replay data, and training budget matched, counterfactual failures yield a success--failure value gap of 0.124, compared with 0.014 for freshly collected on-policy failures. These findings support execution-verified counterfactual replay for post-hoc repair and show why reduced optimism must be evaluated alongside success--failure discrimination. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CureWM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CureWM：用成功示范构造严重度网格上的反事实动作，经仿真或真机执行验证结果，再用失败样本、存活的成功样本和原始示范微调已发布世界模型。无需改变架构或训练目标，即可显著降低模型对失败的乐观预测。
AI.motivation: 机器人世界模型用于策略评估、规划和合成数据生成，但要求预测能区分成功动作与失败动作。作者发现两款架构族的四个已发布检查点对动作变化不敏感，且对已验证的失败仍给出“成功-like”预测。虽然已有工作将失败纳入训练，但哪些数据能在不改变架构和训练目标的前提下修复已发布检查点仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: CureWM 基于成功示范在多个严重度级别上构造反事实替代动作，通过仿真或真机执行验证其真实结果，然后在得到的失败样本、存活成功样本与原始名义示范上微调已发布模型。由于反事实动作与原始示范共享起始上下文，可提供受控的动作对比。
AI.result: 在 484 个 LIBERO 保留失败反事实上，乐观预测率从官方数据微调后的 80% 降至四个独立 CureWM 模型的 30–43%（均值 38%）。在真机机械臂的两项评估中，潜距离诊断判为“成功-like”的失败预测从仅用成功示范微调后的 90% 降至 33%。在失败数、成功回放数据和训练预算匹配时，反事实失败带来的成功-失败价值差为 0.124，而新采在线失败仅为 0.014。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持使用执行验证的反事实回放进行事后修复，并表明降低乐观预测必须与成功-失败判别能力一起评估。

title: U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models
summary: Large language models are informing decisions with ever-higher stakes. As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? Yet recognizing when to defer remains difficult because language models can present incorrect conclusions with fluent explanations and an authoritative tone. Uncertainty quantification seeks to address this disconnect by estimating the reliability of individual predictions. However, many existing methods require repeated generations or separately trained components, and their scalar estimates do not reveal where uncertainty arises or how it evolves during reasoning. Recent work has also shown that generation length can be strongly associated with uncertainty estimates and correctness, raising the question of how much of an estimator's predictive power comes from uncertainty-specific information rather than output length alone. Mechanistic interpretability offers a way to address these limitations by connecting human-interpretable concepts to intermediate model states. Building on this capability, we introduce the U-Space, a low-dimensional subspace that makes a model's evolving uncertainty measurable and interpretable. We identify semantic anchors for doubt and certainty, map their unembedding directions back into the residual space, and combine their contrasts into an orthogonal basis. The U-Lens projects each token state onto these basis vectors, yielding an interpretable token-level uncertainty map that can be inspected directly or aggregated into a scalar uncertainty score. Our approach requires no correctness labels, repeated generations, or training. Across reasoning benchmarks, its confidence score outperforms established baselines under both standard and length-controlled evaluation and transfers more reliably than supervised estimators. Code: https://github.com/s2labres/U-Space.

AI.tldr: 提出U-Space/U-Lens：一种无需训练、无需重复生成的可解释不确定性量化方法，通过残差空间中的“怀疑/确定”语义基投影每个token状态，生成token级不确定性图并可聚合为置信度分数。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型决策风险升高，需要判断单个答案是否可信；但现有不确定性量化方法常需多次生成或单独训练组件，标量估计不可解释，且受生成长度影响，难以区分不确定性信息与长度信号。
AI.method: 利用机制可解释性：识别“怀疑”和“确定”的语义锚点，将其unembedding方向映射回残差空间，并组合其对比形成正交基（U-Space）；用U-Lens将每个token状态投影到该基上，得到可解释的token级不确定性图，再聚合为标量置信度；无需正确性标签、重复生成或训练。
AI.result: 在推理基准上，其置信度分数在标准和长度控制评估下均优于已有基线，并且比有监督估计器具有更可靠的迁移性。
AI.conclusion: U-Space提供了一种可解释、token级、无需训练的不确定性量化方式，能更可靠地评估LLM答案可信度，并有助于区分生成长度对预测能力的影响。

title: A Unified Kinematic Representation Enables Reusable Biological Joint Moment Estimation
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Objective: Data-driven models that estimate physiological states, particularly biological joint moments, are widely used in exoskeleton control. However, these estimators are often coupled to device-specific sensor configurations, limiting controller transfer and the use of open-source biomechanics datasets. Methods: We proposed joint kinematics as an intermediate representation that decouples hardware-specific sensing from downstream biological joint moment estimation. A joint-moment estimator using joint angles and angular velocities was trained exclusively on open-source biomechanics data and evaluated using kinematics from a hip exoskeleton, knee exoskeleton, and inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor suite during level-ground, ramp-ascent, and ramp-descent walking. Results: The estimator achieved an root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.17 Nm/kg and coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.79 using hip exoskeleton kinematics, 0.19 Nm/kg and 0.62 using knee exoskeleton kinematics, and 0.15 Nm/kg and 0.85 using kinematics derived from IMUs across bilateral hip, knee, and ankle joints. Conclusion: Joint kinematics enabled an estimator trained only on open-source data to operate across distinct wearable platforms. Significance: This framework may reduce target-device data collection and support transferable biological joint moment estimation for exoskeleton control and wearable biomechanics.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出以关节运动学作为中间表示，解耦硬件特定传感与下游生物关节力矩估计，使仅用开源数据训练的估计器能跨不同可穿戴平台工作。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动关节力矩估计器常与设备特定传感器配置耦合，限制了控制器迁移和开源生物力学数据集的使用。
AI.method: 提出关节运动学作为中间表示，使用关节角度和角速度训练力矩估计器，仅用开源生物力学数据，并在髋外骨骼、膝外骨骼和IMU传感器套件上评估平地、上坡、下坡行走。
AI.result: 髋外骨骼：RMSE 0.17 Nm/kg，R2 0.79；膝外骨骼：RMSE 0.19 Nm/kg，R2 0.62；IMU：RMSE 0.15 Nm/kg，R2 0.85（双侧髋膝踝关节）。
AI.conclusion: 关节运动学使仅用开源数据训练的估计器能跨不同可穿戴平台运行，有望减少目标设备数据收集，支持可迁移的生物关节力矩估计用于外骨骼控制和可穿戴生物力学。

title: DISRQAD: Diffusion Image Super-Resolution Quality Assessment Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Diffusion-based image super-resolution (SR) can create visually plausible detail that is not supported by the low-resolution input. We introduce DISRQAD, a subjective-quality dataset and diagnostic benchmark for this setting. It contains mean opinion scores (MOS) for 14,000 SR outputs from ten diffusion and four non-diffusion methods, spanning four low-resolution degradation conditions and x2/x4 upscaling. We evaluate 51 standard full-reference and no-reference metric configurations and 11 adapted variants. Agreement with MOS is substantially weaker on diffusion outputs: the strongest standard no-reference baseline reaches 0.431 SRCC on diffusion SR versus 0.813 on non-diffusion SR. As a case study in benchmark use, a pruned and distilled Q-ReAlign-mini student reaches 0.496 SRCC on diffusion SR. DISRQAD measures perceived output quality, not faithfulness to the input; it enables analysis of metric behavior across generator families and input conditions. Our findings reveal a substantial gap in the assessment of diffusion-based SR and provide a basis for developing quality models sensitive to diffusion-specific artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DISRQAD，一个面向扩散式图像超分辨率的主观质量数据集与诊断基准，包含 14,000 个 SR 输出的 MOS，并系统评估现有质量指标在扩散与非扩散方法上的表现。
AI.motivation: 扩散式图像超分辨率能生成视觉上看似合理但低分辨率输入未必支持的细节，因此传统保真度或质量指标可能无法准确衡量其感知质量，需要专门基准来诊断评估缺口。
AI.method: 构建包含 10 种扩散方法和 4 种非扩散方法、4 种低分辨率退化条件及 x2/x4 放大设置的 14,000 个 SR 输出主观评分数据集；评估 51 种标准全参考/无参考指标配置和 11 种适配变体，并以剪枝蒸馏的 Q-ReAlign-mini 学生模型作为案例研究。
AI.result: 现有指标与 MOS 的一致性在扩散输出上明显更弱：最强标准无参考基线在扩散 SR 上 SRCC 为 0.431，而在非扩散 SR 上为 0.813；Q-ReAlign-mini 在扩散 SR 上达到 0.496 SRCC。
AI.conclusion: DISRQAD 衡量感知输出质量而非对输入的忠实度，揭示了扩散式 SR 质量评估的显著缺口，并为开发对扩散特有伪影敏感的质量模型提供了基础。

title: Sigma-Hunter: A Domain-Specific Language Model for Threat Hunting and Detection Engineering
summary: Detection engineers must translate threat reports, forensic observations, and hunt hypotheses into precise, testable rules. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) can draft such rules, but often produce invalid YAML, incorrect log sources, unsupported fields, or overly broad detection logic. This paper presents \emph{Sigma-Hunter}, a domain-adapted LLM for analyst-assistive Sigma rule generation and threat hunting. We build an instruction-tuning dataset from 3,635 validated open-source Sigma rules, expanded into 7,663 question-answer and analyst-reasoning examples. Each source rule is assigned to a single train, validation, or test partition before this expansion, so no rule leaks across splits. We fine-tune a 7B Mistral model and a Phi-4 model with LoRA and score held-out rule generations on syntax, approximate field consistency, and a semantic judgment of detection logic, completeness, selectivity, and log-source alignment. Sigma-Hunter-Mistral scores 8.17 overall, against 7.88 for the strongest general-purpose baseline and 4.61 for untuned Mistral. Two findings stand out: domain adaptation enables a compact 7B model to perform competitively with larger general-purpose models on this structured task, and syntactic validity is a weak proxy for semantic rule quality, as several baselines emit well-formed YAML carrying weak detection logic. The adapted models run locally, which suits detection engineering in disconnected environments where analysts cannot reach hosted model services.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sigma-Hunter，一个面向检测工程与威胁狩猎的领域适配大语言模型，用经过验证的 Sigma 规则构建指令微调数据，辅助生成并评估 Sigma 规则。
AI.motivation: 检测工程师需要将威胁报告、取证观察和狩猎假设转化为精确、可测试的规则；通用大语言模型虽能起草规则，但常产生无效 YAML、错误日志源、不支持字段或范围过宽的检测逻辑。
AI.method: 从 3635 条经过验证的开源 Sigma 规则构建指令微调数据集，扩展为 7663 个问答与分析师推理样本；每条源规则先划分到训练、验证或测试集以防泄漏；使用 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 和 Phi-4 模型；从语法、近似字段一致性以及检测逻辑、完整性、选择性和日志源对齐的语义判断进行评分。
AI.result: Sigma-Hunter-Mistral 总体得分为 8.17，最强通用基线为 7.88，未微调 Mistral 为 4.61。结果表明，领域适配使紧凑的 7B 模型在该结构化任务上可与更大通用模型竞争；语法有效性是语义规则质量的弱代理，部分基线能生成格式正确但检测逻辑薄弱的 YAML。
AI.conclusion: Sigma-Hunter 可辅助分析师生成 Sigma 规则并支持威胁狩猎，且能本地运行，适合分析师无法访问托管模型服务的隔离环境。

title: Transition Path Sampling Using Koopman Operators and Exit-Time Optimal Control
summary: Sampling transitions between metastable states is a central problem in dynamical systems theory and molecular dynamics in particular. A key challenge is the existence of high free-energy barriers that separate the states, making transitions extremely rare. Recent machine learning-based methods cast transition path sampling (TPS) as an optimal stochastic control (OSC) problem over a fixed time horizon, and parameterize the drift bias via a neural network trained by simulation-in-the-loop, requiring repeated biased rollouts. To address computational and performance guarantee issues of these models, we propose a new approach for the problem based on Koopman operators. Because Koopman operators are linear, their leading eigenfunctions reveal the metastable sets and provide an estimate of the committor function with no transition path information required. Furthermore, we formulate TPS as an OSC problem up to an exit time. Our time horizon is the first hitting time of the target set, and our running cost penalizes time spent in nonreactive regions by encoding the estimated committor function. We derive the optimal controller in closed form and approximate it in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). This reduces the problem of constructing the optimal controller to solving a single equality-constrained quadratic program, whose solution can be characterized by a linear Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) system. On the two-channel double well and alanine dipeptide, our controller increases the fraction of trajectories reaching the target from 0% to 99.8% within 1000 steps, and from 0% to 93% within 1ps, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于Koopman算子的过渡路径采样新方法，将过渡路径采样建模为至退出时间的最优随机控制问题，并用RKHS近似闭式最优控制器。
AI.motivation: 亚稳态之间的过渡因高自由能垒而极其罕见。现有基于机器学习的过渡路径采样方法通常将其建模为固定时域的最优随机控制问题，并通过神经网络和重复有偏模拟训练，存在计算量大和性能保证不足的问题。
AI.method: 利用Koopman算子的线性性质，通过其领先特征函数识别亚稳态并估计committor函数，无需过渡路径信息。将过渡路径采样表述为以目标集首次命中时间为时域的最优随机控制问题，运行代价编码估计的committor函数以惩罚非反应区停留时间。推导闭式最优控制器，并在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中近似，从而将控制器构造转化为单等式约束二次规划，其解可由线性KKT系统刻画。
AI.result: 在两通道双势阱和丙氨酸二肽体系上，所提控制器显著提高目标到达比例：双势阱中1000步内从0%提升至99.8%，丙氨酸二肽中1 ps内从0%提升至93%。
AI.conclusion: 基于Koopman算子和退出时间最优随机控制的框架能够有效构造过渡路径采样控制器，避免重复有偏模拟，并显著提升罕见过渡事件的采样效率。

title: Learning to Report Unsafe Tasks in a Multi-Agent Game
summary: When agents share a reward for completed tasks, reporting unsafe work can reduce the reporter's reward by stopping a task. Audits can make reporting optimal without ensuring that further training teaches a silent team to report. We study this learning problem in a game where any witness can stop a task by reporting. With $k$ witnesses per task sharing a policy and drawing independently, the expected-reward derivative with respect to their shared silence probability counts each task's benefit $k$ times at universal silence. The comparison with universal reporting counts it once. For arbitrary policy groups, we give an audit condition sufficient for exact policy-gradient updates to reach universal reporting and, apart from boundary cases, necessary near universal silence. In a balanced family, the cheapest audits meeting the condition with prescribed positive margins cost exactly $k$ times as much for full sharing as for one policy per role. We train PPO policies on 24 witness graphs from learned silence. Separating co-witnesses reduces unsafe completion by 33.59 percentage points compared with shuffled groups of the same sizes under the same audits (95% graph-bootstrap interval: 21.03-45.13). Only 9 of 48 witness-group runs achieve below 1% unsafe completion while retaining at least 90% legitimate completion. At the same audit budget, a fully shared network meets both thresholds in none of 48 runs with independent action draws and all 48 with a common draw.

AI.tldr: 本文研究共享奖励下多见证者报告安全隐患的学习问题：报告会中止任务并减少报告者收益，审计虽可使报告最优，但未必能通过训练让沉默团队学会报告。作者分析策略梯度条件，并用PPO实验比较共享与分离策略、独立与共同动作抽样。
AI.motivation: 当智能体共享任务奖励时，报告不安全行为会停止任务并降低报告者收益，因此团队可能学会沉默。审计可以改变单步最优性，但尚不清楚它是否能让策略梯度训练收敛到普遍报告，尤其是在多个见证者共享策略的情况下。
AI.method: 将问题建模为任意见证者可通过报告停止任务的博弈；分析共享沉默概率的期望奖励导数，给出使精确策略梯度更新到达普遍报告的审计充分条件，以及接近普遍沉默时（除边界情况外）的必要条件；在平衡家族中比较审计成本；用PPO在24个见证图训练，比较共见证者分离与打乱分组、独立动作抽样与共同抽样。
AI.result: 在k个见证者共享策略且独立抽样时，普遍沉默下每任务收益在导数中被计k次，而普遍报告只计1次。任意策略组下，审计条件可保证精确策略梯度到达普遍报告，并在近普遍沉默时近似必要。平衡家族中，满足条件且带正边际的最便宜审计，全共享成本为每角色一策略的k倍。实验中，分离共见证者使不安全完成率比同规模打乱组降低33.59个百分点（95%图自助区间：21.03–45.13）。仅9/48个见证组运行达到不安全完成<1%且合法完成≥90%。同审计预算下，全共享网络在独立动作抽样下0/48达标，在共同抽样下48/48达标。
AI.conclusion: 审计可创造条件，但策略共享和动作抽样结构对学习到报告至关重要。分离共同见证者或采用共同抽样能显著改善安全报告与合法完成的权衡；全共享加独立抽样则容易学到沉默，难以同时满足安全与合法完成阈值。

title: Anaximander: Interactively Running Geospatial Deep Learning Models on Any Compute Backend
comment: Accepted as a poster at the TerraBytes II workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: Applying deep learning models to satellite imagery from within geographic information systems (GIS) remains high-friction for remote sensing practitioners. Models arrive in incompatible formats and target different compute environments, from local workstations to serverless cloud services. As a result, every evaluation demands custom deployment, tiling, and georeferencing code before a single prediction reaches the analyst's map. This friction discourages systematic comparison in a domain where model choice directly affects operational outcomes such as field delineation, crop monitoring, and disaster response. We present Anaximander, an open-source system that unifies model source and compute location choice behind one interactive interface. The system's backend is an inference server that loads models from multiple commonly-used sources and serves them on any accessible compute backend. The server provides session management and model caching, and streams results back per tile. The backend is paired with a QGIS plugin that drives tiling, result reassembly, georeferencing, and real-time per-tile status visualization. An additional user-interface path injects layer legends as prompts into vision-language models. We demonstrate the system in a code-free side-by-side comparison of three heterogeneous models on an agricultural field delineation task: gpt-image-1 via a cloud API, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) on a remote GPU, and DelineateAnything on a local CPU. The inference backend and protocol are open-source and available at https://github.com/microsoft/nxmndr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anaximander（Anaximander）开源系统，旨在简化GIS中卫星影像深度学习模型的应用，通过统一推理服务器和QGIS插件，实现无需编码的模型对比与部署。
AI.motivation: 遥感从业者在GIS中应用深度学习模型时面临高摩擦：模型格式不兼容、计算环境多样（本地到云），导致每次评估都需要定制部署、分块和地理参考代码，阻碍了系统性的模型比较，而模型选择直接影响实地划定、作物监测和灾害响应等操作结果。
AI.method: 系统包含一个推理服务器后端，支持从多种常用来源加载模型，并可在任何可访问的计算后端上服务；提供会话管理、模型缓存和逐块结果流式传输。后端与QGIS插件配对，驱动分块、结果重组、地理参考和实时逐块状态可视化。另有一条用户界面路径将图层图例作为提示注入视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 在农业实地划定任务中，通过无代码并排比较了三个异构模型：通过云API的gpt-image-1、在远程GPU上的Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) 和在本地CPU上的DelineateAnything。
AI.conclusion: Anaximander统一了模型来源和计算位置选择，降低了GIS中深度学习应用的门槛，支持系统性模型比较。推理后端和协议已开源，地址为https://github.com/microsoft/nxmndr。

title: geodex: A Library for Motion Planning on Riemannian Manifolds
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Code, documentation, and tutorials at https://geodex.readthedocs.io
summary: Planning motions that respect the intrinsic geometry of a robot's configuration space, including its curvature and a configuration-dependent notion of cost, yields shorter, lower-energy, and more natural trajectories than planning under the ambient flat metric. Existing libraries for optimization on manifolds provide rich geometric primitives but do not plan around obstacles. While general-purpose motion planning libraries support many state spaces and custom distance functions, they do not yet treat a configuration-dependent Riemannian metric as the geometry that drives distance, interpolation, and geodesics. We present geodex, an open-source C++20 library with Python bindings. The library exposes the manifold, its Riemannian metric, the retraction, and the sampler as independent, interchangeable components through a single sampling-based motion planning interface. The same planner runs unchanged on canonical spaces $\mathbb{R}^n$, $\mathbb{T}^n$, $\mathbb{S}^n$, matrix Lie groups such as $SO(2)$, $SE(2)$, $SO(3)$, and $SE(3)$, products of these spaces, and articulated-robot configuration spaces, each equipped with a user-defined Riemannian metric. We make geodex publicly available with documentation, tests, and a reproducible benchmark suite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源 C++20 库 geodex（含 Python 绑定），支持在流形上以配置相关的黎曼度量进行基于采样的运动规划，并统一处理障碍物。
AI.motivation: 考虑机器人构型空间的内在几何（曲率、配置相关代价）可产生更短、能耗更低、更自然的轨迹；现有流形优化库缺乏避障规划，通用运动规划库也未将配置相关黎曼度量作为驱动距离、插值与测地线的几何。
AI.method: geodex 将流形、黎曼度量、回缩（retraction）和采样器作为独立可互换组件，通过统一的基于采样的运动规划接口暴露；同一规划器无需修改即可运行在 R^n、T^n、S^n、SO(2)、SE(2)、SO(3)、SE(3) 等矩阵李群、其乘积空间及铰接机器人构型空间上，并支持用户自定义黎曼度量。
AI.result: 同一规划器可在上述多种标准空间与乘积空间上运行，且每个空间可配备用户定义的黎曼度量；库已公开，并附带文档、测试和可复现的基准测试套件。
AI.conclusion: geodex 填补了在流形上结合障碍物与配置相关黎曼度量进行运动规划的空白，为几何感知的机器人运动规划提供了开源、可扩展的工具。

title: sk-bench: A Native-First Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Slovak
summary: Multilingual LLM benchmarks omit Slovak, a morphologically rich West Slavic language of five million speakers, or cover it only by machine translation. We present sk-bench, a native-first Slovak benchmark with 30 datasets (33 scored task variants) across ten skill categories. Eleven resources are introduced or first packaged for generative-LLM evaluation, including IFEval-SK with Slovak-adapted instruction checkers and native Chiby/SKJ1 resources for Slovak grammar and morphology. We evaluate 55 open- and closed-weights models under one harness. The best open model trails proprietary APIs by 12.6 points. Model rankings are similar for native and translated closed-form data ($ρ\geq0.98$), though translation separates the strongest models less well. By contrast, human-authored and LLM-generated QA questions rank models differently ($ρ=0.72$). For Qwen3-14B, continued Slovak pretraining lowers the overall score by 13.9 points. A small instruction set restores three quarters of that loss. Test-time reasoning improves scores by 8.5 to 12.5 points for models of 9B and above. Together, these findings suggest four design lessons for other under-resourced languages: use native data where translation fails, plan instruction repair after language adaptation, enable test-time reasoning before scaling up, and avoid overinvesting in target-language prompts. We release the data and code at https://github.com/slovak-nlp/sk-bench

AI.tldr: 论文提出 sk-bench：一个面向斯洛伐克的本地优先生成式 LLM 基准，覆盖 30 个数据集、33 个任务变体和十大技能类别，并统一评测 55 个开放与闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言 LLM 基准通常忽略斯洛伐克语，或仅通过机器翻译覆盖，难以真实评估这一形态丰富的西斯拉夫语言。
AI.method: 构建本地优先的斯洛伐克语基准，引入或首次打包 11 个资源，包括适配斯洛伐克语的 IFEval-SK 指令检查器以及 Chiby/SKJ1 语法形态资源；在统一测试框架下评测 55 个模型，并比较原生与翻译数据、人工与 LLM 生成 QA、继续预训练和测试时推理等影响。
AI.result: 最佳开源模型比专有 API 低 12.6 分；原生与翻译闭式数据排名相似（ρ≥0.98），但翻译对最强模型区分度较差；人工与 LLM 生成 QA 排名不同（ρ=0.72）。Qwen3-14B 继续斯洛伐克语预训练使总分下降 13.9 分，小型指令集可恢复四分之三损失；9B 及以上模型测试时推理提升 8.5 至 12.5 分。
AI.conclusion: 研究总结出面向资源匮乏语言的四点设计经验：翻译失效处应使用原生数据，语言适配后需规划指令修复，扩展规模前应启用测试时推理，并避免过度投入目标语言提示设计；数据与代码已公开。

title: Beyond Reconstruction: What Matters in Action Tokenization for Robot Policies?
summary: Autoregressive action-token policies such as vision-language-action models require action tokenizers to translate discrete token sequences into precise control actions in continuous space. Many action tokenizers learn the mapping between tokens and actions via a reconstruction objective. However, as we show through extensive analysis, sufficiently accurate action reconstruction is only one part of what makes a downstream robot policy successful. It is also critical that the policy is able to predict the right tokens for new observations, and that unseen policy token predictions still decode into reasonable actions. These properties are downstream of tokenizer training and are not directly incentivized by a reconstruction objective alone. In this work, we introduce Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization (ProAct), a tokenizer training method that strategically augments reconstruction with the goal of improving downstream predictability and robustness. ProAct is policy-agnostic and uses only action datasets for training. Across the Robomimic, LIBERO, and RoboTwin benchmarks and a diverse set of tokenizer architectures, ProAct improves rollout success by an average of 11.3 percentage points. These improvements also translate to vision-language-action policies and real-world robotic manipulation, yielding average gains of 21.8 and 36.7 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that effective action tokenization should be designed as a policy interface that balances fidelity, predictability, and robustness, rather than as a reconstruction problem alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ProAct 动作分词器训练方法，通过在重建目标之外增强下游策略的可预测性与鲁棒性，在多个机器人基准、VLA 策略和真实机器人操作中显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: 现有动作分词器多依赖重建目标学习离散 token 与连续动作的映射，但仅准确重建不足以保证下游策略成功；策略还需能为新观测预测正确 token，并且未见过的 token 预测仍能解码为合理动作，而这些并未被重建目标直接激励。
AI.method: 提出 Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization（ProAct），一种策略无关的分词器训练方法，仅使用动作数据集，在重建目标基础上策略性地加入提升下游可预测性和鲁棒性的训练目标，并适用于多种分词器架构。
AI.result: 在 Robomimic、LIBERO、RoboTwin 基准及多种分词器架构上，ProAct 平均提升 rollout 成功率 11.3 个百分点；迁移到 VLA 策略和真实机器人操作时，分别平均提升 21.8 和 36.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 有效的动作分词应被设计为策略接口，需在保真度、可预测性和鲁棒性之间取得平衡，而不仅仅是重建问题。

title: Fast Planning for Multi-object Multi-target Throwing
comment: Accepted to IROS 2026. 8 pages, 9 figures. Zhengming Zhu and Yang Liu contributed equally. Video Summary: https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video
summary: Robot throwing has emerged as a promising technique for improving efficiency in logistics and warehouse automation, by enlarging the workspace and speeding up the process. To significantly increase the throwing system's throughput, we develop strategies for throwing multiple objects in one swipe. Such multi-object multi-target throwing (MOMT) leverages the large degrees of freedom of anthropomorphic hands. The key is to quickly generate fast and feasible throwing motions, which involves a complex trade-off between short trajectory duration and short planning time. We solve this problem in two stages. Offline, we build a model of the feasible set by combining object's inverted flying dynamics and the robot's kinematics and dynamics. Online, we generate feasible throws through fast solution matching and filtering of object's valid detach state and robot's feasible state that can compose sequences of throws in less than 5 ms. We validate the framework on a 7-DoF manipulator equipped with a multi-fingered hand. In simulation, coordinated two-object throwing reduces execution time by up to 46% compared to independent single-object planning, and this improvement is maintained when scaling to three objects. Real-world experiments with two objects confirm a 29% reduction; the remaining gap to the theoretical 50% is attributed to inter-throw transition overhead. When target positions are randomly changed mid-execution, the system re-plans and successfully reaches the new targets within 100 ms latency without stopping the robot. These results establish the first unified planning framework for MOMT throwing -- demonstrating scalability to multiple objects in simulation and real-world feasibility on two-object tasks -- advancing the frontier of high-throughput robotic manipulation. A video summarizing the method and the hardware experiments is available at https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video

AI.tldr: 提出多物体多目标抛掷（MOMT）统一规划框架，使机器人一次挥动可抛掷多个物体并命中多个目标，在线可在5毫秒内生成可行抛掷序列。
AI.motivation: 机器人抛掷可扩大工作空间并加速物流仓储流程，但单物体抛掷吞吐有限；为提高吞吐，需利用多指手的自由度实现一次挥动抛掷多个物体，并平衡短轨迹时长与短规划时间。
AI.method: 分两阶段：离线结合物体倒立飞行动力学与机器人运动学、动力学构建可行集模型；在线通过快速解匹配和过滤物体有效脱离状态及机器人可行状态，生成可组成抛掷序列的可行抛掷。在7自由度机械臂与多指手上验证。
AI.result: 仿真中两物体协调抛掷相比独立单物体规划执行时间最多减少46%，扩展到三物体仍保持；实物两物体减少29%，与理论50%的差距来自抛掷间过渡开销。目标中途随机改变时，系统100毫秒内重规划并成功命中新目标且不停机。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了首个MOMT抛掷统一规划框架，仿真证明多物体可扩展性，实物证明两物体任务可行，推动了高吞吐机器人操作的发展。

title: Whose Memory Is It? Scope-Aware Commit Rules for Long-Term LLM Memory
summary: Persistent memory allows an LLM agent to carry experience across conversations, but it also turns a local reasoning mistake into a durable one. During deliberation, an agent may consider a plan, simulate a tool result, report another speaker's belief, and then reject all of them. If memory retains only the resulting sentences, those once-useful possibilities can later return as facts. The record is neither fabricated nor irrelevant; it has simply been detached from the context in which it was valid. We identify this missing context as \emph{discourse ownership}: the world, branch, or speaker that licenses a proposition. Our first finding is counterintuitive. Language models already carry a causally active signal for ownership, yet conventional memory interfaces discard it when they convert reasoning into records. We introduce CASK (Causally Anchored Scoping Keys), a commit rule that preserves this signal so that shared-world facts enter durable memory while provisional content remains available only within its original scope. Our second finding is that the most obvious way to preserve the signal---storing the discovered internal coordinates---is unreliable because equivalent representations need not keep the same coordinates. CASK instead preserves the stable relations that express ownership. Controlled long-conversation conflicts and tool-agent traces show that this design improves memory admission and prevents provisional content from contaminating later answers while complementing runtime provenance. The resulting commit boundary lets agents explore more possibilities without granting every intermediate sentence authority over future behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM智能体持久记忆导致局部推理错误固化为事实的问题，提出“话语所有权”概念，并设计CASK提交规则，保留所有权信号，使共享世界事实进入持久记忆，而临时内容仅在原作用域内可用。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆让智能体跨对话积累经验，但也使局部推理错误变为持久错误。智能体在 deliberation 中可能考虑计划、模拟工具结果、报告他人信念，然后拒绝它们。若记忆只保留结果句子，这些曾有用的可能性会作为事实返回，问题在于记录脱离了其有效上下文，即缺少“话语所有权”。
AI.method: 识别话语所有权为命题许可的世界、分支或说话者。发现语言模型已有因果有效所有权信号，但常规记忆接口在转换推理为记录时丢弃。提出CASK提交规则，保留该信号，而非存储不稳定的内部坐标，而是保留表达所有权的稳定关系。通过受控长对话冲突和工具智能体轨迹进行实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，该设计改进了记忆准入，防止临时内容污染后续答案，并补充运行时溯源。CASK使共享世界事实进入持久记忆，临时内容限于原始作用域。
AI.conclusion: 提交边界让智能体探索更多可能性，而不会让每个中间句子对未来行为拥有权威。

title: Enabling Dynamic Computation in Looped LMs
summary: Looped LMs are parameter efficient and promise dynamic computation (saving memory and FLOPs on easy tokens). However, state-of-the-art open Looped LMs trained with this dynamic computation capability (Ouro models) do not realize it in practice as each loop iteration (depth) requires its own level of KV-cache, necessitating all loop computations. Moreover, Ouro's early-exit prior is enforced on each token equally, which results in static lower-depth like processing of all tokens regardless of difficulty. In this work, we propose a simple "best-available" KV caching strategy that works out-of-the-box, creating a new frontier in the performance vs depth space. Our approach enables up to 30% reduction in FLOPs and KV memory while retaining full-depth performance, showing the true flexibility of Looped LMs. Furthermore, training looped LMs with awareness about this KV caching strategy improves performance and efficiency. Finally, we apply a small but effective fix to the early-exit prior enforcement objective that makes tokens exit at truly heterogeneous depths based on effort. Our findings are validated on Ouro models as well as smaller looped LMs pre-trained from scratch.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种“best-available” KV 缓存策略，解决 Looped LM 虽具参数高效与动态计算潜力、但实际仍需执行所有循环深度的问题，并改进 early-exit 目标，使 token 能按难度自适应退出。
AI.motivation: 现有开源 Looped LMs（如 Ouro）虽然承诺动态计算，但每个循环深度都需要独立 KV-cache，导致无法真正节省计算；同时 early-exit 先验对所有 token 一视同仁，造成所有 token 按静态较低深度处理，无法根据难度动态调整。
AI.method: 提出可开箱即用的“best-available” KV 缓存策略，在性能与深度之间建立新前沿；让 Looped LM 在训练时感知该 KV 缓存策略；并对 early-exit 先验施加一个小而有效的修正，使 token 根据实际计算需求在不同深度退出。
AI.result: 该方法在保持全深度性能的同时，最高减少 30% FLOPs 和 KV 内存；训练时感知缓存策略可进一步提升性能与效率；修正后的 early-exit 使 token 真正异构深度退出。结果在 Ouro 模型及从零预训练的较小 Looped LMs 上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作释放了 Looped LMs 的动态计算潜力，证明通过更好的 KV 缓存与 early-exit 设计，可以在不损失性能的情况下显著降低计算与内存开销，并提升模型效率。

title: Co-Evolving Robot Orchestrators and Policies through Deployment
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on large datasets are capable within their training domains, yet they still fail to generalize to the variety of situations a robot meets in real-world deployment. Agentic robot systems complement the policy with a vision-language model (VLM) orchestrator that learns when to call the policy, how to instruct it, and when to use scripted skills instead. However, because the harness is built around a frozen policy that has limited language steerability, the orchestrator can avoid the policy's failures but never overcome them. The policy becomes the bottleneck of the whole system. Fine-tuning the policy can remove this bottleneck, but updating it alone decouples it from an orchestrator tuned to its old behavior. We propose Robo-COP, in which the orchestrator and policy co-evolve during deployment. Robo-COP curates skill demonstrations from its own executions, fine-tunes the policy when this data can address recurring failures, and adopts each new policy only after it improves the skills it was trained for. Across ten simulated RoboLab tasks, Robo-COP raises mean held-out success from 64.8% to 73.8% over the same harness with a frozen policy, while fine-tuning on a fixed schedule without verification reaches only 65.8%. On three real-world tasks, Robo-COP raises held-out success from 38.3% to 50.0%. Robo-COP turns deployment into a self-improving flywheel in which robots learn by doing, with each improvement in execution producing better data for the next round of learning. Videos and code are available at https://robo-cop.pages.dev/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Robo-COP，让 VLM 编排器与 VLA 策略在部署中协同进化：自我收集技能演示、按需微调策略、验证有效后才采用，实现机器人持续自我改进。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略在训练域内表现良好，但在真实部署中泛化能力不足；现有 agentic 系统用冻结策略加 VLM 编排器，只能规避失败而无法克服失败，策略成为系统瓶颈；而单独微调策略又会与旧编排器解耦。
AI.method: Robo-COP 在部署中让编排器与策略共同进化：从自身执行中整理技能演示数据，当数据能解决反复出现的失败时微调策略，并且仅当新策略在被训练的技能上有所提升后才采纳。
AI.result: 在十个仿真 RoboLab 任务中，平均留出成功率从 64.8% 提升至 73.8%，而固定计划无验证微调仅达 65.8%；在三个真实任务中，留出成功率从 38.3% 提升至 50.0%。
AI.conclusion: Robo-COP 将部署变成自我改进飞轮：机器人边做边学，每次执行改进都会为下一轮学习产生更好的数据。

title: ToolRACER: A Robust Agentic Conversation Emulation Resource for Agent Training and Evaluation
summary: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under real world conversation scenarios as they rarely follow a predictable script, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks often emphasize successful, cooperative interactions and underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present ToolRACER, a synthetic data generation pipeline that coordinates user, assistant and tool emulation models to generate and validated multi-turn interactions between a user and an agent. Using \sysn, we construct ToolRACERBench a robust multi-turn conversation benchmark spanning six domains, ranging over 55 varied personas, generating a validated corpus of 5.6K conversation trajectories, with approximately 66\% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We inject adversarial behaviors, producing validated conversational interaction trajectories that capture realistic, robust scenarios. We evaluate models trained on ToolRACERBench against internal benchmarks, as well as on function calling benchmarks such as $τ^2$-bench, BFCLv3 and ACEBench to evaluate agentic accuracy and robustness. Models trained on ToolRACERBench improve end to end agentic accuracy across $τ^2$-bench and ACEBench, demonstrating significant gains when mixed with in-domain dataset in small language models for agent capability tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ToolRACER 合成数据生成流程，协调用户、助手和工具模拟模型生成并验证多轮交互，构建了 ToolRACERBench 基准。该基准覆盖六个领域、55 种人物设定，包含 5.6K 条验证过的对话轨迹，其中约 66% 涉及易失败或对抗性场景。
AI.motivation: 现有 function-calling 基准多关注成功、合作的交互，较少覆盖对抗性对话轨迹，导致训练鲁棒对话代理的资源不足；真实场景中用户行为往往不可预测且可能不合作。
AI.method: 使用 ToolRACER 合成数据生成流程，协调 user、assistant 和 tool emulation models 生成并验证多轮用户-代理交互；注入对抗行为，构建跨六领域、55 种人物设定的 ToolRACERBench，并生成 5.6K 条验证轨迹。
AI.result: ToolRACERBench 中约 66% 对话包含易失败场景。基于该基准训练的模型在内部基准、τ²-bench、BFCLv3 和 ACEBench 上评估 agentic accuracy 与鲁棒性；在 τ²-bench 和 ACEBench 上提升了端到端 agentic accuracy，与小语言模型的领域内数据混合时对 agent 能力任务有显著增益。
AI.conclusion: ToolRACERBench 能补充对抗性多轮对话训练资源，提升代理在真实非合作场景下的准确性和鲁棒性，尤其在与领域内数据结合时对小模型 agent 任务效果明显。

title: SPLATIFY: Reproduce, Discover, Innovate! From Papers and Ideas to Trainable 3DGS Code
summary: The rapid growth of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) research demands significant effort to reimplement papers before building on them. We introduce SPLATIFY, a multi-agent framework that converts 3DGS papers into trainable gsplat-based implementations, where generic paper-to-code methods and frontier models fail. SPLATIFY achieves this through five innovations: (1) A context-free grammar for gsplat over a modular method template with extension points for losses, densification, rendering, and optimization, constraining synthesis so generated code satisfies gsplat's architectural invariants by construction. (2) Architectural elements for faithful reproduction: fork-aware citation recovery retrieving component-level code at function-level granularity, Graph-of-Thought synthesis in topological dependency order, RAG-guided in-context example selection from over 20 verified implementations, and visual feedback combining PSNR-guided regeneration, Gaussian-level structural checks, and VLM-driven patching. (3) Knowledge-driven compositional improvement that autonomously finds weaknesses and composes complementary regularizers, losses, and densification strategies to improve upon original results. (4) Interdisciplinary method discovery where agents retrieve physical priors from outside the 3DGS literature and compose them with rendering knowledge to produce methods for previously unaddressed scene types. (5) SPLATIFY-Bench, an evaluation framework across 30 diverse 3DGS papers. On papers without public code, SPLATIFY matches expert implementations while reducing development time from weeks to minutes, and through compositional discovery further improves PSNR by up to 2.4 dB. We additionally demonstrate novel methods for volumetric nebula rendering and other scientific domains, synthesized entirely by SPLATIFY.

AI.tldr: SPLATIFY 是一个多智能体框架，可将 3DGS 论文转换为基于 gsplat 的可训练实现，解决通用论文到代码方法和前沿模型在该任务上失败的问题。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 研究快速增长，但复现论文并在此基础上继续开发需要耗费大量精力，现有通用论文到代码方法难以生成可训练、符合 gsplat 架构的实现。
AI.method: 提出五项创新：1）为 gsplat 设计无上下文语法和模块化模板，约束生成代码满足架构不变量；2）构建忠实复现架构，包括 fork 感知引用恢复、函数级代码检索、拓扑依赖序 Graph-of-Thought 合成、基于 RAG 的示例选择，以及 PSNR 引导重生成、高斯级结构检查和 VLM 驱动修补的视觉反馈；3）知识驱动组合改进，自动发现弱点并组合正则化、损失和致密化策略；4）跨学科方法发现，从 3DGS 文献外检索物理先验并与渲染知识组合；5）提出覆盖 30 篇 3DGS 论文的 SPLATIFY-Bench 评估框架。
AI.result: 在无公开代码的论文上，SPLATIFY 可达到专家实现水平，并将开发时间从数周缩短到数分钟；通过组合发现，PSNR 最多提升 2.4 dB；还合成了体积星云渲染及其他科学领域的新方法。
AI.conclusion: SPLATIFY 能自动、忠实地复现并改进 3DGS 论文实现，同时支持跨学科新方法发现，显著降低 3DGS 论文复现与扩展的成本。

title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions. This task requires a transition from representations that describe the scene and instruction to representations that support action generation. Many continuous-action VLAs leave this transition implicit and supervise it mainly through the final action-prediction loss. We introduce PAIR, a framework that learns a shared perception-action representation between these two spaces. During training, a Masked Action Autoencoder encodes expert action chunks into horizon-aligned Action Latent Tokens. A Bridge Module extracts task-relevant features from the current visual-language representations. PAIR aligns these features with the Action Latent Tokens to form Bridge Tokens that preserve task information and capture the structure of expert actions. The Bridge Tokens are then projected into the action-token space and injected into the initial Action Tokens, providing an action-ready starting point for Action Expert refinement. At inference, the autoencoder is removed, and the Bridge Tokens are generated only from the current observation and instruction. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN ABC-D show gains for the evaluated OpenVLA-OFT and VLA-Adapter models. On LIBERO-Plus, PAIR raises VLA-Adapter's success rate from 59.1% to 64.2%. On CALVIN, it increases VLA-Adapter's average completed sequence length from 4.42 to 4.53. Across seven real-world tasks, PAIR raises OpenVLA-OFT's success rate from 51.4% to 65.0%. Representation analyses show that Bridge Tokens retain task information while making continuous-action information accessible before Action Expert refinement. These results support a shared intermediate representation as a useful interface between perception and action in continuous-action VLAs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAIR框架，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中学习感知与动作之间的共享中间表示，通过动作潜令牌与桥接令牌改进连续机器人动作生成。
AI.motivation: 连续动作VLA模型需要从描述场景和指令的表示过渡到支持动作生成的表示，但许多方法将这一过渡隐式处理，主要依赖最终动作预测损失进行监督，缺乏显式的感知-动作接口。
AI.method: 训练时，Masked Action Autoencoder将专家动作块编码为与时间范围对齐的Action Latent Tokens；Bridge Module从当前视觉-语言表示中提取任务相关特征，并与Action Latent Tokens对齐形成Bridge Tokens；随后将其投影到动作令牌空间并注入初始Action Tokens，为Action Expert细化提供动作就绪起点。推理时移除自编码器，仅根据当前观测和指令生成Bridge Tokens。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN ABC-D上，PAIR提升了OpenVLA-OFT和VLA-Adapter的表现。LIBERO-Plus上，VLA-Adapter成功率从59.1%提升至64.2%；CALVIN上平均完成序列长度从4.42提升至4.53；七个真实世界任务上，OpenVLA-OFT成功率从51.4%提升至65.0%。表示分析表明Bridge Tokens保留任务信息，并使连续动作信息在Action Expert细化前可访问。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，共享中间表示可作为连续动作VLA中感知与动作之间的有效接口。

title: CAP: Codebook-Aligned Prediction for Tokenized Robot Policies
summary: Action tokenization converts continuous robot actions into discrete symbols that can be modeled autoregressively. However, existing tokenizer-based policies typically ignore the tokenizer's learned latent code structure: after tokenization, the policy treats tokens as unrelated class indices and learns a new classifier from scratch. We show that this discarded structure is valuable. We introduce Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP), a method that directly reuses the tokenizer's code vectors as policy class prototypes while leaving the tokenizer and policy backbone otherwise unchanged. Across four quantizer families, three simulation benchmarks, and two real-robot tasks, CAP consistently improves task success over standard token classification heads while holding the tokenizer (and therefore its reconstruction quality) fixed. Our analysis further shows that these gains are not explained by higher token accuracy or changes in the policy head alone. Instead, reusing the tokenizer codebook provides the policy with valuable information about the tokenizer's learned latent structure across tokens, making token prediction errors more benign in action space and improving the representations learned by the policy backbone. These results suggest that action tokenizers learn useful action-aware latent structure beyond discrete targets that should be preserved when training downstream policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP)，直接复用动作 tokenizer 的码本向量作为策略分类原型，在多个量化器、仿真基准与真实机器人任务上稳定提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 tokenizer 的策略在动作 token 化后，将 token 视为无关的类别索引并从头学习新的分类器，从而丢弃了 tokenizer 学到的码本潜在结构。
AI.method: CAP 方法：将 tokenizer 的 code vectors 直接作为策略的类别原型，tokenizer 与策略主干保持不变；在四种量化器家族、三个仿真基准和两个真实机器人任务上进行验证。
AI.result: CAP 在保持 tokenizer 及其重建质量不变的情况下，一致优于标准 token 分类头；分析表明增益并非来自更高的 token 准确率或仅策略头的变化，而是复用码本为策略提供了 token 间潜在结构信息，使 token 预测误差在动作空间中更温和，并改善策略主干的表示。
AI.conclusion: 动作 tokenizer 学到的动作感知潜在结构超越了离散目标本身，在训练下游策略时应予以保留。

title: TopoCurve: Geometry-Aware Topology Reasoning via Bézier Curves in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (main track). 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: Topology reasoning jointly detects 3D lanes and traffic elements from multi-view images and infers their structural connectivity. Current methods model lanes as discrete polylines, lacking smoothness, analytical tangent directions, and global spatial support for attention, while providing sparse topology supervision. We propose TopoCurve, a geometry-driven architecture for 3D topology reasoning grounded in a structured parametric lane representation. Lanes are modeled as endpoint-fixed cubic Bézier curves, enabling continuous geometry with exact endpoints and analytically defined directionality. We exploit this shared curve geometry across the entire pipeline. Endpoint distance and tangent alignment are encoded with multi-scale Fourier features and injected into the topology head. Sampled curve points serve as geometry-aligned references for deformable cross-attention spanning the full lane. Parallel curve-anchored attention branches provide diverse predictions for one-to-many topology supervision. These components form a tightly coupled cascade where representation enables geometric reasoning, guides feature aggregation, and supports denser supervision. TopoCurve achieves 50.6 OLS on the OpenLane-V2 benchmark without any post-processing, establishing a new state-of-the-art among end-to-end camera-only methods, and outperforms all existing approaches on endpoint detection (56.8 vs. 52.6 on DET_p).

AI.tldr: 提出TopoCurve，一种基于参数化车道表示（端点固定三次贝塞尔曲线）的几何驱动3D拓扑推理架构，在OpenLane-V2上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将车道建模为离散折线，缺乏平滑性、解析切方向和全局空间注意力支持，且拓扑监督稀疏。
AI.method: 将车道建模为端点固定三次贝塞尔曲线；利用多尺度傅里叶特征编码端点距离与切线对齐并注入拓扑头；采样曲线点作为可变形交叉注意力的几何对齐参考；并行曲线锚定注意力分支提供一对多拓扑监督。
AI.result: 在OpenLane-V2基准上无后处理达到50.6 OLS，为端到端纯视觉方法新SOTA；端点检测DET_p为56.8，优于此前52.6。
AI.conclusion: TopoCurve通过结构化参数化表示紧密耦合几何推理、特征聚合与密集监督，有效提升3D拓扑推理性能。

title: Adaptive Risk-Certified Event-Triggered Replanning for Dynamic Navigation
summary: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to plan under obstacle predictions whose errors are uncertain, non-stationary, and can induce rare but safety-critical failures. Existing control-barrier-function safety filters can reject immediately unsafe controls, but they provide little guidance on when the current finite-horizon planning mode itself is becoming unsafe as prediction uncertainty evolves. We propose Conformal Event-Triggered Risk-Certified Replanning (\emph{CERT-Replan}), a framework that uses calibrated barrier risk as an early-warning signal for replanning. CERT-Replan calibrates horizon-indexed obstacle-prediction residuals online and uses the resulting uncertainty radii to evaluate dynamic-obstacle safety margins. A one-step safety filter protects the next applied control, while a horizon-level risk monitor evaluates the upper-tail CVaR of predicted barrier-violation losses along the current MPC rollout. When this risk exceeds an allocated budget, CERT-Replan rejects the current planning mode and selects a lower-risk alternative, such as a different speed profile, corridor, or homotopy class, rather than repeatedly correcting the same nominal plan. In a non-stationary benchmark, CERT-Replan achieves an \(83.3\%\) collision reduction relative to the safety-filter-only baseline \textcolor{black}{and a \(77.8\%\) reduction relative to simple replanning triggers}, while reducing average safety-filter intervention by \(32.4\%\). \textcolor{black}{With Trajectron++, CERT-Replan achieves \(96\%\) collision-free operation. Hardware experiments and onboard runtime profiling demonstrate computational feasibility.}

AI.tldr: 提出 CERT-Replan 框架，利用在线校准的障碍预测不确定性作为早期预警信号，通过风险评估触发重规划，从而提升动态环境下机器人导航的安全性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有控制屏障函数（CBF）安全过滤器只能拒绝即时不安全控制，难以前瞻判断当前有限时域规划模式在预测不确定性演化下何时会变得不安全。
AI.method: 在线校准带时域索引的障碍预测残差，得到不确定性半径并评估动态障碍安全边际；用一步安全过滤器保护下一控制；沿 MPC  rollout 监测预测屏障违规损失的 CVaR 上尾风险；当风险超预算时，拒绝当前规划模式并选择更低风险替代方案，如不同速度、走廊或同伦类。
AI.result: 在非平稳基准中，相比仅安全过滤器基线碰撞减少 83.3%，相比简单重规划触发减少 77.8%，安全过滤器平均干预减少 32.4%；结合 Trajectron++ 达到 96% 无碰撞运行；硬件实验与车载运行时分析证明计算可行。
AI.conclusion: CERT-Replan 将校准后的屏障风险作为早期预警，可有效触发更优重规划决策，在动态不确定环境中显著降低碰撞风险并减少干预，同时具备实际部署的计算可行性。

title: Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation
summary: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping. Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个认知基础的框架，用于生成物质使用障碍（SUD）咨询中的患者对话，通过显式建模并对齐潜在认知成分，提升小语言模型在临床场景中的认知真实性与对齐度。
AI.motivation: SUD咨询需要患者回应反映信念、应对策略和改变准备度等认知状态；现有LLM虽流畅，但难以生成认知连贯、临床真实的患者行为，且前沿大模型在医疗中面临成本、延迟、隐私和资源受限部署问题，因此需要认知对齐的小语言模型（SLM）。
AI.method: 提出两阶段流程：认知成分检测与认知成分对齐的对话生成；结合高容量教师模型的知识蒸馏、基于人工标注的偏好优化、注意力引导的奖励塑造，以在较小模型上有效学习。
AI.result: 使用BERTScore、ROUGE、METEOR、BLEU及LLM-as-judge命中率指标，相对人类参考和教师模型参考评估，认知信息微调显著优于通用指令微调基线和心理健康领域专用SLM，尤其在开放式认知成分上提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 认知信息驱动的微调能显著改善SUD患者对话的认知实现与对齐，为资源受限临床环境下部署认知对齐SLM提供了可行路径。

title: Dialect-Robust Speech Language Models with Synthetic Pseudo-Dialect Augmentation
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Speech Language Model (SLM) performance often degrades on dialects due to data scarcity. Conventional text-to-speech (TTS) augmentation struggles to cover diverse dialects as it requires a certain amount of real dialect speech. We propose synthesizing pseudo-dialect speech by converting LLM-generated dialect text via a standard-language TTS model, requiring zero real dialect speech. Additionally, we introduce intermediate standard-text prediction during training, acting as semantic normalization for downstream tasks. We evaluate dialect understanding via dialect-to-English speech translation across Japanese, German, and Chinese dialects. Compared to synthetic standard speech baselines, pseudo-dialect augmentation improves scores for Japanese (from 25.38 to 26.24) and German (from 31.57 to 32.47). Furthermore, the intermediate standard-text prediction effectively bridges the semantic gap, boosting performance to 28.26 for Japanese and from 11.67 to 16.37 for Chinese. These results suggest that our approach scales to various languages without requiring speech resources specific to each dialect.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需真实方言语音的伪方言数据增强方法：利用LLM生成方言文本，再通过标准语TTS合成为伪方言语音，并结合中间标准文本预测来提升语音语言模型在方言任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型在方言上性能常因方言语音数据稀缺而下降；传统TTS数据增强仍需一定量真实方言语音，难以覆盖多样方言。
AI.method: 用LLM生成方言文本，并通过标准语TTS模型合成伪方言语音，实现零真实方言语音的增强；训练中引入中间标准文本预测，作为语义归一化，用于下游任务。
AI.result: 在日语、德语、汉语方言到英语的语音翻译评测中，相比合成标准语基线，伪方言增强将日语从25.38提升到26.24，德语从31.57提升到32.47；中间标准文本预测进一步将日语提升到28.26，将汉语从11.67提升到16.37。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需特定方言的语音资源，可扩展到多种语言，并能有效缓解方言数据稀缺带来的性能下降。

title: Depth-to-RGB: Repurposing a Frozen Depth Estimator for Geometry-Guided Compositing
summary: Reference-based object compositing inserts or replaces an object using a background image, a reference image, and a 2D compositing mask. These inputs guide appearance and placement but leave the completed scene's geometry implicit, which can distort object structure or alter the surroundings. Our Depth-to-RGB (D2R) framework predicts composite depth for a scene not yet observed in the RGB inputs. It learns reference-conditioned corrections to a frozen depth estimator using encoder features of paired completed scenes as targets. The unchanged decoder maps the corrected representation to the intended scene's depth, which a separately trained renderer holds fixed during RGB synthesis. Under matched architecture and training, encoder-feature supervision reduces OOD Stage-1 AbsRel by 31.4% relative to decoded-depth supervision. We also introduce AnyInsertion++ with paired in-distribution and category-disjoint splits to evaluate generalization beyond compositing training categories. The complete D2R system leads 12 open-source and 3 closed-source baselines in estimator-derived geometry and photometric quality on both paired splits. On category-disjoint data, D2R reduces AbsRel by 43.7% and improves PSNR by 2.4 dB over the matched RGB baseline. Across three unpaired benchmarks, D2R leads both identity metrics and reduces mean CLIP reference cosine distance by 55% relative to the strongest baseline. Project page: https://shjo-april.github.io/Depth2RGB/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Depth-to-RGB（D2R）框架，用于基于参考图像的物体合成任务。它先预测合成场景的深度（即使该场景在 RGB 输入中尚未出现），再据此渲染 RGB 图像，从而显式建模合成场景的几何结构，在多种基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 基于参考的物体合成仅依赖背景图、参考图和 2D 合成掩码，导致合成场景的几何信息是隐含的，容易造成物体结构扭曲或周围环境被破坏。因此需要显式预测合成后的场景深度以保证几何一致性。
AI.method: D2R 以冻结的深度估计器为基础，利用成对完整场景的编码器特征作为监督目标，学习参考条件下的修正量；未改动的解码器将修正后的表示映射为目标场景深度，再由单独训练并在 RGB 合成时保持固定的渲染器生成图像。同时提出 AnyInsertion++ 数据集，包含分布内与类别不相交两种划分以评估泛化能力。
AI.result: 在相同架构与训练条件下，编码器特征监督相较解码深度监督将 OOD Stage-1 的 AbsRel 降低 31.4%。完整 D2R 在两种划分的几何与光度质量上均优于 12 个开源和 3 个闭源基线；在类别不相交数据上 AbsRel 降低 43.7%、PSNR 提升 2.4 dB；在三个非配对基准上身份指标领先，并将平均 CLIP 参考余弦距离相对最强基线降低 55%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模合成场景深度、并以编码器特征进行监督，能有效提升参考式物体合成的几何保真度与图像质量，且具备良好的跨类别与跨基准泛化能力。

title: Not Every Call Needs a Frontier Model: Per-Call-Site Evaluation of Small Language Models in a Deployed Agentic Home-Automation System
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, accepted in NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris,
summary: An agentic system issues several structurally different kinds of LLM calls. It routes intent, classifies actions, grounds language in a device registry, plans multi-agent pipelines and writes the Python code those pipelines run. The difficulty of these call sites varies by an order of magnitude, yet in practice a single model, chosen for the hardest site, serves all of them. In this work, we evaluate 9 models from 0.8B to a frontier hosted model across the five call sites of a deployed open-source home-automation framework (Wactorz), using its unmodified production prompts and two real Home Assistant installations (280 cases, 2520 scored calls). We find that capability is not ordered the same way at every site, and that larger models are not uniformly better: one 4B model is worse than its 2B sibling at grounded actuation. Paired testing shows the best local model to be statistically indistinguishable from both hosted models at four of five sites. Only code generation separates them, against a small hosted model (p = 0.039) as well as a frontier one (p = 0.002). Aggregate accuracy also hides a safety failure specific to actuation, where small models resolve the accuracy/refusal trade-off in degenerate ways: one model (Gemma4 E2B) actuates on 87.2% of requests for devices the site does not own, while another refuses every request it receives. Routing each site to its best local model reaches 91.8% against 95.4% at no per-call cost. In a live deployment judged by a user, hosting only the two generative sites matches hosting everything (39/43 against 39/43) for 28% of the spend, and the actuation gap the benchmark predicted appears as exactly one case in twenty-six. Benchmark, harness and all records are released at https://github.com/waldiez/slm-callsite-eval.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了agentic系统中不同LLM调用点是否都需要使用单一最强模型。作者在开源家庭自动化框架Wactorz的5类调用点上测试9个模型（0.8B到前沿托管模型），发现能力排序因调用点而异，大模型并非处处更好；按调用点路由到最佳本地模型可接近全托管效果并大幅降低成本。
AI.motivation: agentic系统包含意图路由、动作分类、设备注册表接地、多智能体规划与代码生成等结构不同的LLM调用，难度相差一个数量级，但实践中常由为最难站点选择的同一模型服务所有调用，可能造成成本浪费与安全风险被忽视。
AI.method: 使用Wactorz未修改的生产提示词，在5个调用点上评估9个模型（0.8B至前沿托管模型），基于两个真实Home Assistant安装，共280个案例、2520次评分调用；采用配对统计检验比较本地与托管模型，并分析各调用点准确率、安全/拒答行为及实际部署成本。
AI.result: 能力在不同站点排序不同：一个4B模型在接地执行上不如其2B版本。最佳本地模型在5个站点中的4个与两个托管模型统计上不可区分；仅代码生成存在差距（对小托管模型p=0.039，对前沿托管模型p=0.002）。聚合准确率掩盖了执行安全失败：Gemma4 E2B对非所属设备87.2%请求执行动作，另一模型则全部拒绝。按站点路由最佳本地模型达91.8%，全托管为95.4%，且无每调用成本。实际部署中仅托管两个生成站点与托管全部达到相同用户评价（39/43对39/43），花费28%；预测的执行差距在26例中仅出现1例。
AI.conclusion: 并非所有LLM调用点都需要最大/最强模型；按调用点选择或路由模型可在几乎不损失效果的情况下显著降低成本。同时，聚合准确率会掩盖执行安全与拒答退化问题，需针对具体调用点评估。基准、测试框架与全部记录已开源发布。

title: LLM-Enabled UAV Dispatch: A System-Level Survey and Taxonomy
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) dispatch is beginning to move beyond isolated path planning and optimization-driven resource allocation toward system-level coordination supported by semantic reasoning and LLM-based interfaces. This survey provides a unified characterization of LLM-enabled UAV dispatch systems that bridges semantic intent, symbolic decision-making, and physical UAV execution. Rather than treating LLMs as standalone add-ons, we conceptualize them as a cross-layer semantic orchestration layer connecting human instructions, external solvers, and distributed control modules. We organize the literature into four representative dispatch paradigms: pipeline dispatch, global assignment dispatch, decentralized agentic dispatch, and divide-and-conquer dispatch. For each paradigm, we analyze its decision logic, system structure, control flow, representative methods, and potential LLM roles. We further examine how LLMs support semantic parsing, retrieval-grounded planning, solver orchestration, local agent reasoning, multi-agent coordination, safety assessment, and human-facing explanation. We discuss the implications of these paradigms for scalability, robustness, coordination burden, and verification requirements, and identify open challenges including latency-aware reasoning, grounding reliability, physical feasibility guarantees, edge deployment, privacy protection, and distributed consistency. This survey provides a system-level taxonomy and design perspective for integrating LLMs into safety-critical UAV dispatch systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，提出以LLM作为跨层语义编排层，统一刻画LLM赋能的无人机调度系统，并归纳四类调度范式、LLM作用、影响与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 无人机调度正从孤立的路径规划与优化驱动资源分配，转向由语义推理和LLM接口支持的系统级协同，因此需要统一理解语义意图、符号决策与物理执行之间的联系。
AI.method: 将LLM视为连接人类指令、外部求解器和分布式控制模块的跨层语义编排层；把文献组织为流水线调度、全局分配调度、去中心化智能体调度、分而治之调度四类范式，并分析其决策逻辑、系统结构、控制流、代表方法与LLM潜在角色。
AI.result: 梳理了LLM在语义解析、检索增强规划、求解器编排、本地智能体推理、多智能体协同、安全评估与人机解释中的作用，并讨论了各范式在可扩展性、鲁棒性、协同负担和验证需求方面的影响，识别出延迟感知推理、 grounding可靠性、物理可行性保证、边缘部署、隐私保护和分布式一致性等开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为将LLM集成到安全关键的无人机调度系统提供了系统级分类体系和设计视角。

title: Embedded Evaluation of Task Admission Coalescing in Decentralized Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Multi-robot task allocators in dynamic missions commonly admit newly released tasks immediately, potentially invoking allocation for each new arrival. We evaluate task-admission coalescing as a mechanism for controlling allocator processor work while accounting for target-service latency, using CBAA, ACBBA, PI, and HIPC as a representative MRTA suite. The study comprises a 3,000-mission AGX Orin campaign with measured computation delay, 3,000 paired zero-compute missions, and a 96-mission Pololu 3pi+ RP2040 allocator hardware-in-the-loop campaign. Immediate (Eager) admission is compared with thresholds of two, four, and eight tasks and a four-task policy with a 10-s waiting bound across three arrival rates. Across the AGX experiments, coalescing reduces both allocator calls and processor work in 31 of 48 evaluated conditions, although the magnitude of the saving varies by allocator. The principal cost appears under sparse arrivals, where four-task batching increases online-target mean latency by 20.08-23.57 s, predominantly through admission waiting. Bounded admission reduces mean work in ten of twelve allocator-load conditions, including a 19.35% reduction with a 1.40-s mean latency increase for high-arrival HIPC. RP2040 experiments show that this tradeoff can become more favorable as processor constraints tighten. Across four matched medium-arrival HIPC scenarios, Count b=4 reduces mean RP2040 work by 59.85% and service latency by 39.47%, while the corresponding AGX cases increase latency by 27.69%. These results show that the usefulness of task-admission coalescing depends on arrival intensity, allocator-specific behavior, and the relative cost of computation on the execution platform.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估多机器人任务分配中的任务准入合并机制，用于在控制分配器计算量的同时权衡目标服务延迟，并比较 CBAA、ACBBA、PI、HIPC 四种代表性 MRTA 算法。
AI.motivation: 动态任务中新任务若立即进入分配，会频繁触发分配计算，增加处理器负担；因此需要研究何时合并任务准入能节省计算，以及其对服务延迟的影响。
AI.method: 开展 3000 任务 AGX Orin 实测计算延迟实验、3000 配对零计算实验，以及 96 任务 Pololu 3pi+ RP2040 硬件在环实验；将立即准入与阈值 2、4、8 任务及 4 任务加 10 秒等待上限策略，在三种到达率下比较。
AI.result: AGX 实验中，48 个条件有 31 个通过合并减少分配器调用和处理器工作，但节省幅度因算法而异；稀疏到达时 4 任务批处理使在线目标平均延迟增加 20.08-23.57 秒，主要来自准入等待。有界准入在 12 个分配器负载条件中 10 个降低平均工作，其中高到达 HIPC 降低 19.35%，平均延迟增加 1.40 秒。RP2040 实验中，处理器约束越紧，该权衡越有利；四个中到达 HIPC 场景中 Count b=4 使 RP2040 平均工作降低 59.85%、服务延迟降低 39.47%，而对应 AGX 场景延迟增加 27.69%。
AI.conclusion: 任务准入合并的有效性取决于任务到达强度、具体分配器行为以及执行平台上计算成本的相对高低。

title: BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment
summary: We present BEACON-SP, an ontology-grounded Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework for clinician-facing decision support in behavioral health settings such as suicide prevention, where effective assessment requires integrating heterogeneous clinical, behavioral, social, and temporal evidence. BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events, and temporal relationships. The framework is enabled by a comprehensive suicide prevention ontology that integrates the Three-Step Theory, the Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model, and the Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology into a unified representation of patient risk factors. We construct ontology-grounded patient knowledge graphs and evaluate BEACON-SP for clinician-facing question answering. Compared with a vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline on a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, BEACON-SP improves completeness, clinical relevance, and evidence grounding under a corrected comparative evaluation protocol, with a small gain on factual accuracy. In paired criterion-level comparisons, GraphRAG is preferred in 76.4% of cases. These results demonstrate the potential of ontology-guided GraphRAG to provide structured, contextualized patient evidence for clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 提出BEACON-SP，一种本体驱动的GraphRAG框架，用于行为健康（如自杀预防）中面向临床医生的决策支持，通过患者知识图谱与本体引导检索实现多跳推理，并在基准评估中优于向量RAG基线。
AI.motivation: 有效的临床评估需要整合临床、行为、社会和时间等多源异构证据，传统方法难以结构化整合这些信息并支持可解释的多跳推理。
AI.method: 构建整合三阶段理论、整合动机-意志模型和自杀健康社会决定因素本体的自杀预防本体；基于本体构建患者知识图谱；采用本体引导的GraphRAG支持跨诊断、药物、风险/保护因素、生活事件和时间关系的多跳推理；在包含15个临床类别、100名患者、1500个查询的基准上，与向量RAG基线进行临床医生问答对比评估。
AI.result: 在校正比较评估协议下，BEACON-SP在完整性、临床相关性和证据 grounding 方面优于向量RAG基线，事实准确性略有提升；在配对标准级比较中，GraphRAG在76.4%的案例中被偏好。
AI.conclusion: 本体引导的GraphRAG有潜力为临床决策支持提供结构化、情境化的患者证据。

title: Belief-Space Planning with Planner-Conditioned Estimator Error under Intermittent Observations
summary: Belief-space planners with separately designed or off-the-shelf estimators may have access to state-relevant information the estimator does not observe. Consequently, even an estimator that minimizes mean-squared error under its own information can have a nonzero error mean when conditioned on planner information. When future corrections are intermittent and stochastic, differences between accepted and rejected error means introduce additional uncertainty terms to correction events that zero-mean assumptions ignore. In this paper, we propose a belief-space planning approach that predicts, propagates, and penalizes planner-conditioned estimator error along evaluated trajectories. A planner-conditioned estimator-error model combines affine error dynamics with a moment recursion that preserves stochastically-induced correction uncertainty. We describe a method by which to predict estimator error dynamics within specified operating regimes and incorporate predicted error moments into a task-weighted quadratic risk objective. We evaluate the approach in simulation for a tilt-rotor VTOL landing on a ship deck using receding-horizon planning. We find that conditioning on planner information reduced error-prediction loss for a command-blind EKF by 13.4% relative to a planner-ignorant model, with strongly regime and horizon-dependent forecasting abilities. In a small set of 16 paired closed-loop trials, the planner lowered the median terminal task gauge from 1.60 to 0.99, and predicted estimator error beyond 2s within a factor of 1.3, versus a 5.7-fold underprediction by covariance-only planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种信念空间规划方法，能够在轨迹评估中预测、传播并惩罚由规划器信息条件化带来的估计器误差，从而改善在随机间歇校正下的规划性能。
AI.motivation: 独立设计或现成的估计器可能无法观测到规划器可用的状态相关信息，因此即使估计器在其自身信息下最小化均方误差，在规划器信息条件下其误差均值仍可能非零。当未来校正间歇且随机时，接受与拒绝误差均值差异会引入零均值假设忽略的额外不确定性。
AI.method: 提出规划器条件化估计器误差模型，将仿射误差动力学与保持随机校正不确定性的矩递推相结合；在指定运行区间内预测估计器误差动力学，并将预测误差矩纳入任务加权二次风险目标。采用滚动时域规划，在倾转旋翼VTOL舰船甲板着陆仿真中评估。
AI.result: 对命令盲EKF，条件化规划器信息使误差预测损失相对规划器无知模型降低13.4%，预测能力强烈依赖运行区间和时域。16次配对闭环试验中，规划器将终端任务指标中位数从1.60降至0.99，并能以1.3倍以内误差预测2秒后的估计器误差，而仅协方差规划低估达5.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 考虑规划器条件化估计器误差可提升误差预测精度和闭环规划性能，说明在随机间歇校正场景中必须处理非零条件误差均值及校正不确定性。

title: OnlineQAT: On-Policy Distillation for Ultra-Low-Bit Large Language Models
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover much of the accuracy lost when large language models are compressed below four bits. Existing re- covery stages, however, are commonly optimized on fixed completions or teacher-generated answers, whereas the deployed quantized model condi- tions on prefixes generated by itself. Quantization errors can therefore move the model into states that are absent from offline recovery data. We introduce OnlineQAT, a two-stage framework that first obtains a usable low-bit initialization through block-wise QAT and then performs on-policy distillation (OPD) on student-generated responses. At each visited pre- fix, a frozen full-precision teacher provides a sampled reverse-KL training signal. On Qwen3-1.7B, OnlineQAT obtains the best average among the compared quantized methods: 57.28 at W3A16 and 32.52 at W2A16, im- proving over ReasoningQAT by 2.90 and 0.44 points, respectively. The results suggest that student-visited states provide a useful recovery signal beyond fixed-completion training, particularly at three bits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OnlineQAT，一种两阶段量化感知训练框架，用于恢复低位量化大语言模型的精度。第一阶段通过分块QAT获得可用的低位初始化，第二阶段在学生模型自生成回复上进行在线策略蒸馏，并由冻结的全精度教师提供采样反向KL训练信号。
AI.motivation: 现有量化恢复方法通常在固定补全或教师生成答案上优化，但部署后的量化模型实际会基于自身生成的prefix进行条件生成。量化误差可能使模型进入离线恢复数据未覆盖的状态，因此需要利用学生访问到的状态进行恢复训练。
AI.method: OnlineQAT采用两阶段框架：先进行block-wise QAT获得低位初始化；再进行on-policy distillation，在学生生成的响应上训练。在每个访问到的prefix处，冻结的全精度教师提供采样reverse-KL训练信号。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B上，OnlineQAT在对比的量化方法中取得最佳平均表现：W3A16为57.28，W2A16为32.52，分别比ReasoningQAT提升2.90和0.44分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，学生访问状态能提供固定补全训练之外的有效恢复信号，尤其在3比特量化时更为明显。

title: Shared-Roadmap Generation and Evaluator for Multi-Agent Path Planning Using Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network
summary: Multi-agent path planning (MAPP) in continuous environments often relies on roadmaps to balance safety and search efficiency. However, traditional roadmap generation methods, such as lattice grids or standard sampling-based approaches, frequently face a trade-off between graph density and the likelihood of finding feasible, high-quality solutions. In this paper, we propose a scalable heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework for the automated generation and evaluation of shared multi-agent roadmaps. Our model covers the representation of waypoints, agent locations, and task locations as distinct nodes in a heterogeneous graph, allowing it to reason over global connectivity and inter-agent interactions. By training on occupation density maps aggregated and collected from expert solver trajectories, the GNN learns to identify critical points of interest and prune redundant nodes and edges. This process produces a compact, coordination-aware roadmap that is invariant to task permutations and is reusable for multi-agent pick and delivery tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework can reduce planning effort and can potentially find better solutions, reaching at least 40% reduction in runtime and in graph size for dense roadmaps.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种可扩展的异构图神经网络框架，用于自动生成和评估共享多智能体路径规划路图，通过裁剪冗余节点和边来获得紧凑、协调感知且可复用的路图。
AI.motivation: 连续环境中的多智能体路径规划常依赖路图来平衡安全性与搜索效率，但传统方法（如栅格图或标准采样）难以兼顾图密度与找到高质量可行解的可能性。
AI.method: 将路点、智能体位置和任务位置表示为异构图中的不同节点，利用图神经网络推理全局连通性和智能体间交互；基于专家求解轨迹聚合的占用密度图进行训练，识别关键兴趣点并裁剪冗余节点与边，生成对任务排列不变且可复用的多智能体取送任务路图。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架能减少规划开销并可能找到更优解，在密集路图中至少减少40%的运行时间和图规模。
AI.conclusion: 所提异构图神经网络框架可自动生成紧凑、协调感知的多智能体共享路图，提升多智能体路径规划效率与解质量，并支持任务排列不变和取送任务复用。

title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: Simulation enables large-scale, low-cost robot data generation, but policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world due to the sim-to-real visual discrepancies. Existing approaches often rely on intermediate representations, which can discard rich semantic information or require additional perception modules at deployment. We address this visual sim-to-real gap with RoboRender, a framework that converts simulated trajectories into photorealistic RGB videos for policy learning. RoboRender trains a robot-oriented video generation model conditioned on simulated depth videos, language instructions, and robot RGB mask videos, preserving simulator geometry, robot motion, and action labels while synthesizing realistic textures, backgrounds, and distractors. The generated RGB videos are paired with simulator-provided states and actions to train policies for zero-shot real-world deployment. On robot video test sets, our video model outperforms depth-conditioned video generation baselines in generation quality. In real-world experiments across pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and mobile manipulation tasks, policies trained on RoboRender-generated data achieve a 71% average success rate, outperforming raw simulation renderings and conventional visual domain randomization by approximately 7.1x and 3.6x, respectively. We further show that policy performance improves with more generated videos per simulation trajectory, increasing opening-task success by 65 percentage points. These results demonstrate that generative video rendering mitigates the visual sim-to-real gap for zero-shot policy transfer. Project website: https://robo-render.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RoboRender 框架，将仿真轨迹通过深度条件视频生成模型转换为逼真 RGB 视频，用于训练可零样本迁移到真实世界的机器人策略。
AI.motivation: 仿真数据成本低、规模大，但仿真与真实世界存在视觉差异，导致策略迁移失败。已有中间表示方法会丢失语义信息或需额外感知模块。
AI.method: RoboRender 以仿真深度视频、语言指令和机器人 RGB 掩码视频为条件，训练面向机器人的视频生成模型，保留几何、运动与动作标签，同时合成真实纹理、背景和干扰物；生成 RGB 视频与仿真状态、动作配对训练策略。
AI.result: 在机器人视频测试集上，生成质量优于深度条件视频生成基线。真实世界抓放、铰接物体操作和移动操作任务中，平均成功率达 71%，分别约为原始仿真渲染和传统视觉域随机化的 7.1 倍和 3.6 倍；每条仿真轨迹生成更多视频可将开门任务成功率提升 65 个百分点。
