AI.conclusion: 生成式视频渲染能有效缓解视觉 sim-to-real 差距，实现零样本策略迁移。

title: RDGSplat: Render-Dedicated Geometry for Novel View Synthesis
summary: 3D foundation models enable efficient novel view synthesis by carrying a Gaussian head on the representation they already use for reconstruction. However, the views they render fall short of the geometry they recover, because that geometry is estimated under a metric objective and never scored on how it renders. Recent methods alleviate this by updating the backbone weights, but they thereby discard the metric predictions the model was built for and must be repeated for every new backbone. To this end, we propose RDGSplat, a framework that decodes a second geometry dedicated to rendering from a frozen 3D foundation model, leaving its metric predictions intact. In particular, we devise Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding, which duplicates the pretrained decoders and optimizes the duplicates under photometric supervision alone. Then, a Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter is introduced to reformulate the representation those decoders read, conditioned on the target camera pose rather than the target image. Extensive experiments show that RDGSplat improves novel view synthesis across three feed-forward backbones on four benchmarks, with every pretrained weight frozen. On RE10K, it raises WM2.0 from 20.918 to 24.266\,dB while training 205.5\,M added parameters against a frozen 1.4\,B backbone, and the depth and pose the same model predicts are unchanged.

AI.tldr: 提出 RDGSplat，在冻结的 3D 基础模型上解码一套专用于渲染的第二几何，从而在不破坏原模型度量预测的前提下提升新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 基础模型虽能重建几何并支持新视角合成，但其渲染视图受限于在度量目标下估计的几何，并未以渲染质量为目标优化；更新主干权重的方法会丢失模型原有的度量预测，且需针对每个新主干重复训练。
AI.method: RDGSplat 从冻结的 3D 基础模型解码渲染专用几何：通过 Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding 复制预训练解码器，并仅用光度监督优化副本；再引入 Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter，将解码器读取的表示改为以目标相机位姿为条件，而非目标图像。
AI.result: 在四个基准、三个前馈主干上均提升新视角合成，且所有预训练权重保持冻结。在 RE10K 上，WM2.0 从 20.918 dB 提升到 24.266 dB；仅增加训练 205.5M 参数，而主干为冻结的 1.4B，且同一模型预测的深度和位姿保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 将渲染几何与度量几何解耦，可在不改变原模型度量预测的情况下高效适配新主干并显著改善渲染质量。

title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free 4D Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Radial-Decomposed Flow Matching
summary: Cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) captures the cardiac cycle as a four-dimensional (4D) sequence, but standard acquisition requires electrocardiogram (ECG) gating and repeated breath holds. Visual realism alone does not establish accurate patient-specific ejection fraction (EF) or ventricular volumes. We present PhaseFlow3D, a generative framework that synthesizes a complete 4D cine sequence from a single end-diastolic (ED) three-dimensional (3D) volume without ECG. To capture asymmetric systolic and diastolic dynamics, it represents the cardiac cycle as a piecewise linear phase anchored at ED and end-systolic (ES) time points. At inference, a population-level canonical template supplies this phase without patient-specific temporal information. A phase-conditioned rectified flow model generates a cardiac motion trajectory in latent space. Radial Contraction Decomposition converts each latent state into a 3D displacement field, combining a physics-informed radial component for centripetal myocardial contraction with an image-conditioned residual for rotation and out-of-plane motion. Each frame is generated by directly warping the ED volume, bypassing variational autoencoder decoding. On the combined ACDC and M&Ms benchmark, PhaseFlow3D achieves the lowest EF mean absolute error, the only positive left-ventricular volume-curve $R^2$, and the best distributional quality among compared methods. Ablations confirm each component's contribution. Downstream evaluations demonstrate the utility of the synthesized sequences and displacement fields for segmentation, pathology classification, label propagation, and myocardial strain analysis.

AI.tldr: PhaseFlow3D 是一种生成框架，无需心电图门控，仅从单个舒张末期（ED）三维体积即可合成完整的心脏四维 cine 磁共振序列。
AI.motivation: 标准 cine 心脏磁共振采集依赖心电图门控和反复屏气，且视觉真实度本身并不能保证准确的患者特异性射血分数（EF）或心室容积测量。
AI.method: 将心动周期表示为以 ED 和收缩末期（ES）为锚点的分段线性相位；推理时用群体级典型模板提供相位，无需患者特异性时间信息。采用相位条件整流流模型在隐空间生成心脏运动轨迹；通过径向收缩分解将每个隐状态转为三维位移场，结合物理信息驱动的径向分量（向心性心肌收缩）与图像条件残差（旋转和平面外运动）。每帧通过直接变形 ED 体积生成，绕过变分自编码器解码。
AI.result: 在 ACDC 与 M&Ms 联合基准上，PhaseFlow3D 取得最低的 EF 平均绝对误差、唯一为正的左心室容积曲线 R²，以及相比方法中最佳的分布质量。消融实验证实各组件的贡献。下游评估表明合成序列与位移场可用于分割、病理分类、标签传播和心肌应变分析。
AI.conclusion: PhaseFlow3D 能够从单个体积生成具有临床实用价值的四维 cine 序列及位移场，支持多种下游心脏分析任务。

title: Video-to-Model: Automatic Modeling of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: This paper presents a video-to-model framework for automatically modeling the motion of a deformable suture thread from an input video. We utilize a recently developed CBF--CLF--QP numerical model that simplifies the characterization of deformable string motion through the selection of a small number of parameters. A perception module first localizes and tracks the thread in video, producing an ordered sequence of thread nodes. The observed thread motion is then processed by a spatio-temporal CNN network that estimates the effective parameters of a structured CBF--CLF--QP model. These parameters are used to simulate the thread under a user-defined needle velocity input. Experiments using unseen thread configurations and motion demonstrate that the framework can reliably reconstruct the thread behavior from video, automatically configure the structured model, and reproduce the expected thread motion with low tracking error. The proposed approach reduces the need for manual parameter tuning and provides a step toward automatic video-based modeling of deformable linear objects.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从视频自动建模可变形缝合线运动的视频到模型框架，利用感知模块与时空CNN估计CBF-CLF-QP模型参数，并仿真复现线运动。
AI.motivation: 可变形线性物体的建模通常依赖手动调参，自动化程度低，因此希望直接从视频中学习并配置其运动模型。
AI.method: 先用感知模块在视频中定位并跟踪缝合线，生成有序节点序列；再用时空CNN从观测运动中估计结构化CBF-CLF-QP模型的有效参数；最后在用户定义的针速度输入下仿真线运动。
AI.result: 在未见过的线配置和运动上实验表明，该框架能可靠重建线行为，自动配置结构化模型，并以较低跟踪误差复现预期运动。
AI.conclusion: 该方法减少了手动参数调节需求，为基于视频的可变形线性物体自动建模提供了可行方向。

title: Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control
summary: Precise end-effector tracking during humanoid whole-body motion is challenging due to floating-base oscillations, gravity, dynamic coupling, and locomotion-induced disturbances. We propose ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller for precise end-effector pose tracking that combines geometric admittance control (GAC) with residual reinforcement learning. GAC provides structured $\SE$ task-space feedback and generates nominal arm joint-position targets, while residual RL compensates for unmodeled dynamics and coordinates locomotion and balance in the shared joint-position action space. The left-invariant geometric formulation allows the same GAC law to be used across manipulation reference frames. This enables the use of a ground-attached heading frame that preserves planar locomotion while removing pelvis roll, pitch, and heave from the manipulation reference, thereby reducing reference-induced end-effector motion during locomotion. ResGAC is validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across four standing end-effector tracking benchmarks, ResGAC consistently outperforms representative baselines, including SONIC, achieving lower translational and rotational errors. Real-world experiments further demonstrate reduced propagation of pelvis motion to the desired end-effector pose using the proposed ground-attached heading frame. ResGAC achieves $90\%$ success in a standing peg-in-hole task compared with $50\%$ for SONIC, and accurate world-frame $\SE$ end-effector pose tracking during lower-body motion. Experimental videos are included in the supplementary material and are also available on the project website: https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/.

AI.tldr: 提出ResGAC，一种结合几何导纳控制与残差强化学习的全身人形控制器，用于在全身运动中实现精确的末端执行器位姿跟踪，并在真实Unitree G1上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身运动中的精确末端跟踪面临浮动基座振荡、重力、动态耦合和运动扰动等挑战。
AI.method: ResGAC将几何导纳控制（GAC）与残差强化学习（RL）结合：GAC提供结构化的SE(3)任务空间反馈并生成标称手臂关节位置目标，残差RL在共享关节位置动作空间中补偿未建模动态并协调运动与平衡。利用左不变几何形式，同一GAC律可跨操作参考系使用，并采用地面附着航向框架，在保留平面运动的同时消除骨盆滚转、俯仰和升降对操作参考的影响。
AI.result: 在真实Unitree G1上，ResGAC在四个站立末端跟踪基准中均优于包括SONIC在内的基线，实现更低的平移和旋转误差。真实实验表明骨盆运动到期望末端位姿的传播减少。站立轴孔装配任务成功率90%（SONIC为50%），并在下肢运动期间实现准确的世界坐标系SE(3)末端位姿跟踪。
AI.conclusion: ResGAC能有效实现人形机器人全身运动中的精确末端执行器位姿跟踪，并提升装配等任务的成功率。

title: Expert Coupling in MoE Pretraining: Reducing All-to-All Overhead with Correlated Placement and Token Shuffling
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers replace the feed-forward block of a Transformer with E expert networks, and each token is routed to k of these experts. Under expert parallelism (EP) the experts are distributed across GPUs, and every MoE layer runs all-to-all collectives in the forward and backward passes to dispatch tokens to their experts and then combine the results. On a cluster with 8 AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs per node, these collectives can take 45% of the training step at EP32 with top-2 routing and 60% with top-6 routing. We find that early in pretraining routers have already learned to assign tokens to experts in correlated patterns, both within a layer and across layers. At top-2, 0.8% of the expert pairs in a layer are selected together by 42% of tokens, and the experts a token selects at one layer predict the experts it selects at the next layer. We use these correlations to keep more token--expert assignments on the token's own GPU, which reduces communication across GPUs and across nodes. Correlated expert placement puts experts that are often selected together on the same GPU. Combined with a dispatcher that sends each token to each GPU once, it removes up to 58% of dispatched rows. Token shuffling applies when sequence parallelism shards tokens across the EP group. It moves each token to the GPU predicted to hold its next-layer experts during the reduce-scatter that follows attention. On one node this raises the share of token--expert assignments served on the token's GPU from 12.5% to 59%. In Megatron-LM, across EP degrees from 8 to 64 with top-2 and top-6 routing, the two methods reduce all-to-all time by 1.16-2.63X and end-to-end step time by up to 1.41X. Neither method changes the models' underlying routing decisions or expert parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现MoE路由中专家选择存在层内和跨层相关性，并提出相关专家放置与token重排来减少专家并行中的all-to-all通信，在不改变路由和专家参数的情况下加速训练。
AI.motivation: 在专家并行下，MoE层的前向和反向传播需要all-to-all通信来分发和合并token，这在8卡AMD MI300X节点上可占训练步的45%（top-2）甚至60%（top-6），成为主要瓶颈；同时路由器早期已学会将token分配给具有相关模式的专家。
AI.method: 利用路由相关性：1）相关专家放置，将常被一起选中的专家放到同一GPU；2）配合每个token只向每个GPU发送一次的dispatcher，减少重复分发行；3）token shuffling在注意力后的reduce-scatter中，将token移动到预测持有其下一层专家的GPU。方法不改变模型路由决策或专家参数。
AI.result: 在top-2下，层内0.8%的专家对承担42%的token共同选择；专家选择可跨层预测。相关专家放置+dispatcher最多减少58%的分发行；token shuffling将单节点上token的专家计算在本地GPU完成的比例从12.5%提升到59%。在Megatron-LM中，EP 8到64、top-2/top-6下，all-to-all时间减少1.16-2.63倍，端到端步时间最多加速1.41倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用MoE路由中专家选择的相关性，可以显著降低专家并行通信开销并加速训练，且无需修改模型原本的路由决策和专家参数。

title: Evaluating the Transfer of Co-Evolved Communication from 2D to 3D Simulation
summary: This work examines the transfer of a co-evolved communication mechanism between two robotic agents from a discrete two-dimensional (2D) simulator to a three-dimensional simulator with real physics (3D). The study focuses on whether a communication mechanism co-evolved in a 2D environment retains its functional role after transfer to a 3D physics-based simulator. To support this analysis, the effects of the episode time budget, the social cue, and the asymmetry between the two co-evolved roles were examined. The results indicate that the success rate increased approximately linearly with the evaluated time budgets, with no evidence of a plateau between 2,000 and 6,000 physics steps, suggesting that evaluations based on shorter episodes may underestimate the performance of the trained controllers. In both simulators, the social cue functioned primarily as a jam- assistance mechanism rather than as a navigation guide, although with a more pronounced effect in 2D. Analysis of eight independent evolutionary runs revealed a consistent direction of asymmetry, although its magnitude varied across runs. Controlling the processing order between agents allowed us to rule out an artifact of the physics engine. Finally, the results are discussed in terms of the factors that may contribute to the remaining performance gap observed after transfer.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察两个机器人智能体共同进化的通信机制从离散二维模拟器迁移到具有真实物理的三维模拟器后，是否仍能保持其功能作用。
AI.motivation: 探究在二维环境中共同进化得到的通信机制，迁移到三维物理模拟器后是否仍具有功能角色，并分析影响迁移效果的因素。
AI.method: 将两个机器人智能体在二维模拟器中共同进化的通信机制迁移到三维物理模拟器；分析回合时间预算、社会线索以及两个共同进化角色之间不对称性的影响；进行八次独立进化运行，并控制智能体处理顺序以排除物理引擎伪影。
AI.result: 成功率随评估时间预算近似线性增加，在2000至6000个物理步长之间未出现平台期，表明短回合评估可能低估训练后控制器的性能。社会线索在两种模拟器中主要作为拥堵辅助机制而非导航指南，且在二维中效果更明显。八次独立进化运行显示不对称方向一致，但幅度存在差异。控制处理顺序排除了物理引擎伪影。
AI.conclusion: 共同进化的通信机制在迁移后仍具一定功能，但二维与三维物理模拟器之间仍存在性能差距；短回合评估可能低估性能，社会线索主要起拥堵辅助作用，角色不对称性方向稳定但幅度可变。

title: When the Governor Becomes the Disturbance: Control-Generated Disturbance and Cost-Aware Backoff in Governed Tool-Using Agents
comment: Includes ancillary experimental data and a Python script for reproducing numerical summaries. Code: https://github.com/CriticalAttentionSystems/CASAgentGovernor
summary: Supervisory governors can interfere with the tool-using agents they regulate. We study this possibility in a controlled file-recovery environment where increases in regulatory intensity trigger experimentally imposed tool failures. A cost-blind governor can turn these failures into persistent blocking that prevents task completion. We compare this governor with a backoff rule that reduces intervention probability using a moving average of known induced events. On a hand-coded stochastic-policy agent, the failure pattern appears under both result replacement and execution of corrupted tool arguments. For the persistent policy, adaptive backoff improves completion relative to a fixed weak governor with approximately matched intervention frequency. A Gemini 2.5 Flash experiment comprising 576 episodes across 6 tasks also shows reduced blocking and improved completion under backoff; among the tested settings, intermediate backoff strength achieves the highest observed aggregate success. These results identify an interaction between intervention cost and persistent action blocking, together with a possible mitigation. The cost mechanisms are imposed and their induced events are directly observable to the backoff rule; applicability beyond this controlled environment remains an empirical question.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控的文件恢复环境中研究监督者（governor）对工具使用型智能体的干预。当监管强度增加导致工具失败时，一个不考虑成本的监督者可能将失败转化为持续阻断，使任务无法完成；而基于已知诱发事件移动平均的自适应退避规则可缓解该问题并提升完成率。
AI.motivation: 监督者可能干扰其监管的工具使用型智能体，尤其是当监管强度提高引发工具失败时，这种干预可能导致持续性的动作阻断。作者希望验证这种干预成本与持续阻断之间的交互，并探索可能的缓解机制。
AI.method: 设计受控的文件恢复环境，通过实验手段在监管强度增加时触发工具失败。比较一个成本盲目的监督者与一个使用已知诱发事件移动平均来降低干预概率的退避规则。在手工编码的随机策略智能体上测试失败模式，包括结果替换和执行损坏的工具参数两种机制。另使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 进行 576 个回合、覆盖 6 个任务的实验。
AI.result: 在手工编码的随机策略智能体上，失败模式在结果替换和执行损坏工具参数下均出现。对于持续阻断策略，自适应退避相比干预频率大致匹配的固定弱监督者提高了任务完成率。Gemini 2.5 Flash 实验也显示退避减少了阻断并提高了完成率；在测试设置中，中等强度的退避取得了最高的总体成功率。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出干预成本与持续性动作阻断之间的交互，并提出一种可能的缓解方法。由于成本机制是人为施加的，且诱发事件对退避规则可直接观测，该方法的适用性是否能推广到更广泛环境仍是实证问题。

title: LLA-MPPI: Rapidly Adaptive Whole-body Control of Legged Robots with GPU-Accelerated Parallel Simulations
comment: The first two authors are co-first authors (contributed equally to the work)
summary: Real-time whole-body controllers for legged robots typically plan through a fixed nominal model and degrade when the deployed dynamics change. Adaptive methods typically require a model structure that contact dynamics do not provide, or they need offline training for each anticipated condition. We present Look-back and Look-ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral control (LLA-MPPI). The method converts whole-body adaptation into selection over a bank of GPU-batched contact simulators with different physical or structural parameters. Windowed prediction errors select the simulator that best explains recent motion. A whole-body MPPI planner optimizes controls through the selected model. The framework requires no offline training, and its selected hypotheses are physically interpretable. Across four simulated tasks, it achieves 97.5% success while the strongest baseline reaches 74% and an oracle with the true model reaches 98.5%. Hardware validation on a Unitree Go2 shows the robot walking under a payload added mid-run, walking after one leg is disabled, and pushing a box to its goal while increasing its mass on the fly. Code, videos, and project details are available at: https://lla-control.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出LLA-MPPI方法，将全身自适应问题转化为在GPU批量接触模拟器库中选择最匹配当前动力学的模型，再用全身MPPI规划控制，无需离线训练且选择结果可物理解释。
AI.motivation: 腿式机器人实时全身控制器通常依赖固定标称模型，动力学变化时性能下降；现有自适应方法往往需要接触动力学不具备的模型结构，或需针对每种预期条件离线训练。
AI.method: LLA-MPPI（Look-back和Look-ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral）维护一组具有不同物理或结构参数的GPU批量接触模拟器；通过窗口化预测误差选择最能解释近期运动的模拟器；再由全身MPPI规划器通过所选模型优化控制。
AI.result: 在四个仿真任务中达到97.5%成功率，最强基线为74%，使用真实模型的oracle为98.5%；在Unitree Go2硬件上验证了运行中加载后行走、一条腿禁用后行走、以及推动质量实时增加的箱子到目标。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需离线训练，所选假设具有物理可解释性，能实现实时全身自适应控制，并在仿真与真实机器人上应对动力学变化。

title: The Persona Hierarchy Model: Understanding Contextual Generalization in Fine-Tuning LLMs
summary: Language models are routinely fine-tuned under a fixed context, such as a generic system prompt, persona or domain-specific instruction, yet the learned behavior sometimes stays confined to that context and sometimes broadly generalizes to unseen contexts. We propose the Persona Hierarchy Model to explain this: a shared default persona influences behavior across contexts. Under this model, fine-tuning that modifies the shared persona promotes broader transfer, whereas changes to local personas remain more context-specific. Across 120 fine-tuned models spanning four behaviors and 15 training contexts, generalization narrowness positively correlates with the similarity between the training context's persona and the default persona (Pearson's r = 0.72 for Qwen3-4B). Prior fine-tuning under the default context can broaden generalization in subsequent training under other contexts. Aligning contextual responses with default-persona responses produces stronger effects. Finally, we propose persona-preserving regularization (PPR) to confine undesired contextual generalization. In RL, PPR cuts reward hacking from 42-55% to at most 0.2% under every evaluated prompt while retaining accuracy gains. These results support the Persona Hierarchy Model as an explanation for contextual generalization and can motivate future controls on unintended generalization for better alignment of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Persona Hierarchy Model，用共享默认人格解释大语言模型微调后的上下文泛化差异，并通过120个微调模型和正则化方法验证该模型。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常在固定上下文（如系统提示、人格或领域指令）下微调，但其学到的行为有时局限于该上下文，有时又能广泛泛化到未见上下文，现有研究缺乏统一解释。
AI.method: 提出 Persona Hierarchy Model：共享默认人格影响跨上下文行为，修改共享人格促进广泛迁移，修改局部人格则更局限于上下文。实验涵盖4种行为和15种训练上下文，共120个微调模型；分析训练上下文人格与默认人格相似度同泛化窄化的相关性；测试默认上下文预微调、默认人格对齐响应的影响；并提出 persona-preserving regularization（PPR）限制不良上下文泛化，在强化学习中评估。
AI.result: 泛化窄化与训练上下文人格和默认人格的相似度正相关（Qwen3-4B 上 Pearson r = 0.72）。在默认上下文下预微调可拓宽后续其他上下文训练的泛化。使上下文响应与默认人格响应对齐效果更强。PPR 在强化学习中把奖励黑客从42-55%降至所有评估提示下至多0.2%，同时保留准确率增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 Persona Hierarchy Model 对上下文泛化的解释，并表明可通过人格保持正则化控制非预期泛化，为更好对齐大语言模型提供方向。

title: From High Recall to High Utility: Dataset-Adaptive Post-Processing of LLM-Generated Customer Intents
summary: Large language models can extract useful signals from heterogeneous enterprise data, but high-recall extraction often produces outputs that are duplicated, uneven in granularity, semantically overlapping, or too numerous for downstream systems and human reviewers to use effectively. We present a dataset-adaptive post-processing architecture developed for Customer Intent Extraction (CIE), where unstructured customer language is transformed into stable, traceable intent units. The approach separates recall-oriented extraction from utility-oriented reduction. Source-specific preprocessing first isolates evidence from multimodal plans, sparse operational records, and structured opportunity data. Candidate intents are then standardized and deduplicated, optionally enriched with metadata for embedding computation, represented in a shared semantic vector space, and grouped using a clustering strategy selected according to the candidate set's characteristics. Cluster-level keywords provide an explainability layer, while singleton reassignment requires agreement between embedding and keyword similarity. Finally, constrained language-model aggregation produces one concise intent per cluster without introducing unsupported concepts, and the resulting unit retains provenance, clustering, embedding, and generation metadata. This treats post-processing not as cosmetic cleanup, but as a semantic reduction layer converting high-recall LLM outputs into reusable enterprise intelligence. We also describe two downstream applications: Machine-Generated Intents, which infer likely objectives for customers lacking direct evidence from peer customers with similar profiles, and intent-guided semantic retrieval and mapping, which uses the stable intent as a query against a downstream decision space, illustrated here by mapping customer intents to business outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文面向客户意图抽取（CIE），提出一种数据集自适应的后处理架构，将高召回但冗余、粒度不齐的LLM抽取结果转化为稳定、可追溯、可复用的意图单元，并展示两个下游应用。
AI.motivation: 企业异构数据中，大语言模型虽能高召回地抽取信号，但输出常存在重复、粒度不均、语义重叠和数量过多等问题，难以被下游系统和人工审阅有效使用。
AI.method: 方法将召回导向的抽取与效用导向的归约分离：先按来源预处理多模态方案、稀疏运营记录和结构化商机数据；再标准化、去重候选意图，可选元数据增强，映射到共享语义向量空间，并按候选集特征选择聚类策略；以簇级关键词提供可解释性，单例重分配需嵌入与关键词相似度一致；最后用受限语言模型聚合，每簇生成一个简洁意图，不引入无支持概念，并保留来源、聚类、嵌入和生成元数据。
AI.result: 该架构可将高召回LLM输出转化为可复用的企业智能，并支持两个下游应用：机器生成意图，为缺乏直接证据的客户基于相似画像同伴推断可能目标；以及意图引导的语义检索与映射，将稳定意图作为查询映射到业务结果等决策空间。
AI.conclusion: 后处理不应仅被视为表面清理，而应作为语义归约层，把高召回的大模型输出转化为稳定、可追溯、可复用的企业智能资产。

title: StableGrasp: Reconstructing Physically Stable Human Hand Grasps from Single Images
summary: Reconstructing a physically stable human grasp from a single RGB image is challenging because physically modeling grasps is itself difficult, and the problem requires estimating not only a visually constrained hand pose but also a control target that stabilizes the grasp. Existing methods either model only visual hand geometry without considering physics, or rely on less plausible physical modeling, which limits the physical validity of the resulting grasps. In this paper, we present StableGrasp, a differentiable simulation-based optimization framework that explicitly separates the visual hand pose from the control target that determines the grasping forces. Our method jointly optimizes hand geometry and control by minimizing the kinetic energy of the grasp in a differentiable simulator, while regularizing the hand geometry to preserve visual consistency and geometric plausibility. The reconstructed grasps are substantially more stable under rigorous physical simulation, while remaining visually consistent with the input images and geometrically plausible. Experiments show that our approach produces far more stable grasps than alternative hand-control strategies, benefiting visual-only grasp reconstruction pipelines by turning their outputs into physically stable grasps.

AI.tldr: 论文提出StableGrasp，一个基于可微分仿真的优化框架，从单张RGB图像重建物理稳定的抓取，将视觉手部姿态与控制目标分离并联合优化。
AI.motivation: 从单张RGB图像重建物理稳定的人手抓取很困难，因为既要估计视觉上合理的手部姿态，又要确定能稳定抓取的控制目标；现有方法要么只建模视觉几何而忽略物理，要么物理建模不够合理，导致抓取的物理有效性有限。
AI.method: 提出StableGrasp，显式分离视觉手部姿态和决定抓取力的控制目标；在可微分仿真器中联合优化手部几何与控制，通过最小化抓取动能，并正则化手部几何以保持视觉一致性和几何合理性。
AI.result: 重建的抓取在严格物理仿真下更稳定，同时与输入图像保持视觉一致且几何合理；相比其他手部控制策略，产生远更稳定的抓取，并能将仅视觉的抓取重建流程输出转化为物理稳定抓取。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉手部姿态与控制目标分离，并利用可微分仿真优化，可有效提升从单张RGB图像重建抓取的物理稳定性，为纯视觉抓取重建管线提供物理稳定化能力。

title: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
summary: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause system outputs to deviate from the user's true intent. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries. Experimental results show that text-to-SQL remains challenging in the presence of ambiguity: gpt-6-sol achieves only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化消歧新范式并构建ARCS基准，发现文本到SQL系统在真实歧义下表现仍差，GPT-6-sol仅51%准确率。
AI.motivation: 文本到SQL系统走向真实部署时，用户问题中的歧义成为主要错误来源，且传统对话澄清效率低、认知负担重、与真实工作流不匹配。
AI.method: 提出结构化消歧范式，通过显式、受约束的交互而非自由对话解决歧义；构建ARCS语料库，这是首个包含真实数据库上自然产生无约束歧义的文本到SQL基准，并完整标注所有有效歧义点、解释和SQL查询。
AI.result: 实验显示文本到SQL在歧义下仍具挑战性：GPT-6-sol端到端执行准确率仅51%，无开源模型超过27%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化消歧为文本到SQL歧义问题提供了新方向，ARCS基准揭示了当前模型在真实歧义场景下的显著不足，需进一步研究。

title: R-CNN-Based Chess Position Recognition
summary: Performing chess game position recognition solely from a single image of a three-dimensional board requires predicting the position and orientation of the board relative to the camera, the occupancy of squares and the piece type, which includes its colour. We propose an R-CNN-based framework with independent components for piece recognition and board geometry estimation, whose predictions are combined to reconstruct the position. For piece recognition, we adapt Faster R-CNN using a class-weighted objective and a deeper classification head. The detector operates directly on the input image, retaining alternative piece hypotheses that are subsequently refined using constraints on piece counts and square occupancy. For board detection, we introduce an octagonal arrangement of eight labelled boundary keypoints, predicted using the keypoint head of Mask R-CNN. These provide redundant correspondences for homography estimation and encode board orientation. The estimated homography maps representative points from the piece boxes to an 8x8 grid. On a synthetic dataset, the modifications to piece detection increase mean average precision from 61.59% to 90.14%. Of the predicted board keypoints, 97.11% are within 1% of the image diagonal of their labelled targets. Using ground-truth piece boxes with the predicted homographies gives correct square assignments for every test position. The complete framework recovers 76.61% of test positions exactly and 96.49% with at most one incorrect square.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于R-CNN的框架，从单张三维棋盘图像中识别棋子类型、颜色、棋盘姿态与方格占用，并重建棋局位置；方法将棋子识别与棋盘几何估计结合，在合成数据集上取得较高准确率。
AI.motivation: 仅从单张三维棋盘图像识别棋局位置，需要同时预测棋盘相对相机的位姿、各方格占用情况以及棋子类型和颜色，任务复杂且具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出R-CNN框架，包含独立的棋子识别和棋盘几何估计组件。棋子识别改进Faster R-CNN，采用类别加权目标和更深的分类头，并保留候选假设，结合棋子数量和方格占用约束进行优化。棋盘检测使用Mask R-CNN关键点头预测八角形排列的8个带标签边界关键点，用于单应性估计和方向编码；再将棋子框代表点通过单应性映射到8x8网格。
AI.result: 在合成数据集上，棋子检测的平均精度均值从61.59%提升至90.14%；97.11%的预测棋盘关键点与标注目标的误差在图像对角线的1%以内；使用真实棋子框和预测单应性时，所有测试位置均能正确分配方格；完整框架可精确恢复76.61%的测试位置，允许至多一个方格错误时恢复96.49%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效完成单张三维棋盘图像的棋局位置识别，棋盘关键点与棋子检测改进显著提升了单应性估计和方格分配精度，并在精确及近似精确恢复上取得良好效果。

title: LACE-CRAFT: Robot Co-Design with Actor Inheritance and Blackboard Collaboration
comment: 16 pages including appendix. Project website: https://deemostech.github.io/lace-craft/
summary: Robot co-design couples morphology search with policy learning, yet training every new design from scratch discards acquired control experience. We present LACE-CRAFT, which compares continued learning on the current robot with policy adaptation to new morphology-reward pairs. LACE resumes the incumbent's full learning state and initializes compatible challengers with its actor parameters and observation statistics. A fixed task metric selects among both branches and the frozen incumbent. CRAFT coordinates Feedback, Morphology, Reward, and Integration roles through shared experimental records and behavioral replays to generate and cross-review paired proposals. A generative extension converts generated meshes into editable articulated models with configured joints, actuator interfaces, and consistently updated simulation assets. Across five locomotion benchmarks, mean scores over three evaluation seeds are 6.4-91.9% higher than D2C. Both methods train 30 new morphology-reward pairs over five rounds; LACE additionally uses four continuation training units. Five-task ablations examine policy inheritance and replay-derived feedback. A fabricated prototype demonstrates indoor walking and illustrates the geometry-to-hardware workflow.

AI.tldr: LACE-CRAFT 是一种机器人协同设计框架，通过复用已有策略学习经验来提升新形态-奖励对的训练效率，并支持从生成网格到可编辑 articulated 模型及实体原型的流程。
AI.motivation: 机器人协同设计通常将形态搜索与策略学习耦合，但每个新设计都从头训练会丢弃已获得的控制经验，效率低且浪费先前知识。
AI.method: LACE-CRAFT 比较在当前机器人上持续学习与对新形态-奖励对进行策略适应。LACE 恢复当前最优设计的完整学习状态，并用其 actor 参数和观测统计初始化兼容的新设计；固定任务指标在两条分支与冻结的当前最优设计之间选择。CRAFT 通过共享实验记录和行为回放协调反馈、形态、奖励与集成角色，生成并交叉评审成对提案。生成式扩展将生成网格转换为具有配置关节、执行器接口和一致更新仿真资产的可编辑 articulated 模型。
AI.result: 在五个 locomotion 基准上，三个评估种子的平均分数比 D2C 高 6.4% 至 91.9%。两种方法都在五轮中训练了 30 个新形态-奖励对；LACE 额外使用四个持续训练单元。五项任务的消融实验考察了策略继承和回放反馈。一个制造原型展示了室内行走，并说明了从几何到硬件的流程。
AI.conclusion: 表明复用策略经验可有效改进机器人协同设计，LACE-CRAFT 能提升形态-奖励搜索与策略适应性能，并支持生成设计到实体原型的落地验证。

title: Justice After Identity: Large Language Models and the View from Everywhere
summary: The search for a common view of justice and fairness has challenged human collective activity, as our diverging judgments are unavoidably shaped by the self-interests of social position, personal benefit, cultural inheritance, and historical circumstance. John Rawls famously attempted to overcome this limitation through popularizing a philosophical tradition known by the phrase "the original position" - a thought experiment by which people select principles of justice without knowing the identities or advantages they will possess. Critics, however, have long questioned whether people can meaningfully suspend their social identities and suppress morally relevant forms of lived experience. Artificial intelligence engaged to calculate algorithmic and agentic fairness introduces a novel possibility. LLMs have no singular class, race, gender, nationality, or biography, yet their parameters encode linguistic representations of a vast range of human identities and moral traditions. Perhaps the ethical judgments of LLMs could approximate an integrative original position - a "view from everywhere" generated not by excluding social identities but by computationally incorporating their diversity.It is unlikely that humankind will "hand over the keys" to computational systems by simply delegating complete agentic control of distributive and procedural collective processes. But AI may play a role, perhaps a positive one, interacting with individual and collective human judgment as we often confront increasingly polarized views on what is fair and just. We present data comparing human, base model, and frontier/fine-tuned model judgments about classic moral dilemmas while systematically varying identity relationships and Rawlsian constraints on identity. We conclude by speculating whether, if advanced AI systems provide humans with thoughtful advice, humans would actually be likely to accept it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨能否用大语言模型近似罗尔斯的“原初立场”，通过比较人类、基础模型与前沿/微调模型在道德困境中的判断，考察身份关系与罗尔斯式身份约束对公平正义判断的影响。
AI.motivation: 人类对正义与公平的判断常受社会地位、个人利益、文化传承和历史情境等自利因素影响，难以达成共识。罗尔斯“原初立场”试图让人们在不知自身身份与优势的情况下选择正义原则，但批评者质疑人能否真正悬置社会身份与生活经验。LLM 没有单一阶级、种族、性别、国籍或生平，却编码了广泛人类身份与道德传统，因此可能提供一种“从 everywhere 看”的整合性原初立场。
AI.method: 呈现数据，比较人类、基础模型和前沿/微调模型对经典道德困境的判断，并系统改变身份关系以及罗尔斯式身份约束条件。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体结果，但研究框架旨在观察不同模型与人类在身份关系变化和身份约束下的道德/公平判断差异，并评估 LLM 是否能近似整合性原初立场。
AI.conclusion: 人类不太可能完全把分配与程序性集体过程的代理控制权交给计算系统，但 AI 可能以建议形式与人类判断互动，帮助应对日益极化的公平正义观点。作者最后推测：若先进 AI 提供深思熟虑的建议，人类是否真的会接受。

title: Arctic Questions, Missing Answers: A Dataset and Benchmark for LLM Abstention in Arctic Science
summary: Large language models (LLMs) should abstain from scientific multiple-choice questions when no option is valid, but frequent abstention alone does not demonstrate sensitivity to answer availability. We introduce ArcticQA, a dataset of 194 questions derived from primary Arctic research, with automated checks of answer support and distractor contradiction against source evidence. We further develop ArcticAbstain, a paired benchmark comparing answer-present and answer-absent conditions, with the correct answer replaced by a distractor in the latter and an explicit abstention option in both. We evaluate eight models from the Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT families at high reasoning effort, with three trials per condition, yielding 9,312 recorded responses. Answer-present abstention rates range from 0.0% to 63.0%, whereas replacing the correct answer increases abstention by 5.05 percentage points on average. These findings highlight substantial baseline differences and the need to evaluate abstention frequency and responsiveness jointly. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://github.com/BenWilcox8/arctic-qa.

AI.tldr: 论文提出北极研究科学多选题数据集 ArcticQA 及配对基准 ArcticAbstain，用于评估大语言模型在答案存在与答案缺失时的弃答行为。
AI.motivation: LLM 应在科学多选题无有效选项时弃答，但仅看弃答频率高并不能证明模型能敏感判断答案是否可用，因此需要配对比较答案存在与缺失条件。
AI.method: 构建 194 道源自北极研究的 ArcticQA 问题，并自动检查答案支持和干扰项与证据的矛盾；设计 ArcticAbstain 配对基准，在答案缺失条件下用干扰项替换正确答案，且两个条件均提供明确弃答选项；评估 Gemini、Claude、ChatGPT 八个模型，高推理努力，每条件 3 次，共 9312 条响应。
AI.result: 答案存在时弃答率为 0.0% 至 63.0%；将正确答案替换为干扰项后，弃答率平均增加 5.05 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 模型间基线差异显著，评估弃答能力应同时考察弃答频率和对答案可用性的响应性；数据集与基准已公开。

title: Co${}^{2}$Skill: Whole-Body Control via Skill Composition for Long-Horizon Human-Environment Interaction
summary: Achieving human-level dexterity in complex, unstructured environments requires the seamless integration of whole-body scene interaction and dexterous object manipulation skills. While existing physics-based controllers generate physically plausible behaviors in each domain, they largely address these two capabilities independently. In this paper, we present Co${}^{2}$Skill that integrates scene interaction and dexterous manipulation through a unified policy formulation. Built on a pretrained motion prior, the policy uses task and phase dependent observation masks to select information relevant to the current interaction goals. We introduce a goal-conditioned loco-manipulation curriculum that combines partial reference guidance for precision with exploration from varied initial states while allowing goal-directed execution beyond the demonstrated trajectories. We further introduce a cross-task curriculum that jointly trains individual skills and selected task sequences, preserving physical states across task boundaries and maintaining grasps during subsequent scene interactions. Together, these support sequential task execution and simultaneous scene interaction with object manipulation. We evaluate sitting, standing, climbing, stair traversal, and goal-directed manipulation, together with sequential execution and with random different conditions. Additionally, we demonstrate skill compositions in indoor environments, illustrating their integration within the same control formulation.

AI.tldr: 提出Co²Skill统一策略框架，整合全身场景交互与灵巧物体操作，实现复杂环境中的序列任务执行。
AI.motivation: 现有基于物理的控制器虽能分别生成场景交互或物体操作的合理行为，但二者独立处理，无法满足复杂非结构化环境中人类级灵巧性的需求。
AI.method: 基于预训练运动先验，使用任务和阶段相关的观测掩码选择信息；提出目标条件的移动操作课程学习，结合部分参考引导与多样化初始状态探索，允许超越演示轨迹的目标导向执行；引入跨任务课程，联合训练单项技能与任务序列，保持任务边界物理状态和抓取。
AI.result: 在坐、站、攀爬、爬楼梯、目标导向操作及序列执行和随机条件下进行评估，并在室内环境中演示技能组合。
AI.conclusion: 该统一策略公式能够集成场景交互与物体操作，支持序列任务执行和同时交互操作。

title: Epistemic Uncertainty-Aware Defect Detection for Quality Control in Medical Device Manufacturing
summary: Objective: We investigate whether accounting for epistemic uncertainty can improve the reliability of automated defect detection in medical device manufacturing. Methods: We consider a machine learning framework that operates on heterogeneous manufacturing and device-report data represented with Knowledge Graphs. To mitigate errors arising from uncertainty in the decision model, we analyze a principled rejection strategy to abstain from predictions whose estimated epistemic uncertainty exceeds a specified threshold. We evaluate the approach using standard synthetic benchmarks and real-world medical device report data. Results: The theoretical results establish the validity of the method characterizing the regimes under which it is expected to be effective. Empirically, the rejection strategy enables explicit control of coverage, that is, the proportion of samples for which the model issues predictions, while improving performance on the retained samples. On 266,170 real-world FDA MAUDE device reports, a 10% abstention rate reduces classification error by 48%, and more aggressive rejection (approximately 70% coverage) yields near-perfect accuracy on the retained samples. On standard synthetic manufacturing benchmarks, abstaining on 9% of the decisions, our approach reduces the risk up to 63% compared with the standard no-abstention approach. Conclusions: Abstaining from predictions with high epistemic uncertainty can provide a practical tool for controlling the reliability of machine learning-based defect detection, especially in high-stakes medical device manufacturing applications. Significance: Uncertainty-aware defect detection may support safer and more reliable quality assurance in medical device manufacturing by identifying cases that require additional inspection rather than issuing potentially harmful predictions.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨考虑认知不确定性是否能提升医疗器械制造中自动化缺陷检测的可靠性，提出基于知识图谱和不确定性阈值拒绝预测的方法，并在合成基准与真实FDA MAUDE报告上验证。
AI.motivation: 医疗器械制造属于高风险场景，自动化缺陷检测中的模型不确定性可能导致错误预测，因此需要一种能控制预测可靠性、避免有害输出的机制。
AI.method: 采用基于知识图谱表示异构制造和设备报告数据的机器学习框架；估计决策模型的认知不确定性，当不确定性超过阈值时拒绝/弃权预测；在标准合成基准和真实医疗器械报告数据上评估，并进行理论分析。
AI.result: 理论结果验证了方法的有效性并刻画其适用区间。实验中，拒绝策略能显式控制覆盖率并提升保留样本性能。在266,170份FDA MAUDE真实报告中，10%弃权使分类误差降低48%，约70%覆盖率时保留样本接近完美准确率；在合成制造基准上，9%弃权使风险最高降低63%。
AI.conclusion: 对高认知不确定性预测进行弃权，可作为控制基于机器学习的缺陷检测可靠性的实用工具，尤其适用于高风险医疗器械制造；通过识别需额外检查的案例，支持更安全可靠的质量保证。

title: StyleFields: Multi-Scale AdaIN-Modulated Implicit SDFs for Coarse-to-Fine 3D Shape Reconstruction and Editing
comment: 39 pages, 20 figures, 3 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: We introduce StyleFields, a DeepSDF-based architecture for high-fidelity 3D reconstruction that enables controllable geometric style mixing: the coarse structure of one object can be combined with the fine-scale details of another. The core idea is depth-aware modulation: instead of a single global code, we inject latents via multi-level Adaptive Instance Normalization at several decoder depths, and supervise matching auxiliary heads with a coarse-to-fine schedule while gradually growing network depth. This aligns early layers with global shape and later layers with high-frequency detail, achieving content-style decoupling without part labels or adversarial training. StyleFields delivers faithful reconstructions, convincing cross-instance hybrids, and consistent gains in ablations over injection depth and supervision granularity. We further demonstrate a practical application in automotive aerodynamics: a learned surrogate drag predictor serves as a differentiable objective to optimize reconstructed cars, allowing targeted edits of global form or surface details by freezing the complementary latent stream. StyleFields offers a simple, effective recipe for controllable implicit reconstruction and downstream performance-driven design.

AI.tldr: 提出 StyleFields，一种基于 DeepSDF 的高保真 3D 重建架构，可实现可控的几何风格混合，将一物体的粗结构另一物体的细尺度细节结合，并应用于汽车气动性能优化。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式重建方法难以在无需部件标签或对抗训练的情况下解耦内容与风格，因此需要一种简单有效的可控隐式重建方法，并支持下游性能驱动的设计。
AI.method: 采用深度感知调制：不只用单一全局编码，而是通过多级自适应实例归一化在多个解码器深度注入潜变量；用粗到细的调度监督匹配辅助头，并逐步增加网络深度。这使早期层对齐全局形状，后期层对齐高频细节，实现内容-风格解耦。还冻结互补潜流以定向编辑全局形状或表面细节，并利用可微代理阻力预测器作为目标优化重建的汽车。
AI.result: 方法能实现忠实重建和有说服力的跨实例混合；消融实验表明注入深度和监督粒度带来一致增益；在汽车气动应用中，可优化重建汽车并定向编辑整体形态或表面细节。
AI.conclusion: StyleFields 为可控隐式重建和性能驱动设计提供了一种简单有效的方案。

title: Do Vision Models Learn Physical Constraints or Rendering Shortcuts? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Grounded Physical Consistency
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026 the 1st Workshop on Physical World AI
summary: Modern image editing models can satisfy a text instruction while breaking the physics of the edited scene. A new object may cast no shadow, a mirror may fail to reflect visible geometry, or an object may float above a surface that should support it. We study physical plausibility diagnosis, detecting whether an edited image violates scene physics, naming the violation type, localizing the affected region, and explaining the failure in language. We introduce a counterfactual benchmark whose controlled synthetic component uses Mitsuba~3 to generate 5,500 images from 500 scene families. Each family contains one clean image and ten matched violations involving shadows, reflection, support, surface response, and occlusion. The renderer pipeline provides category labels, affected-region masks and boxes, scene metadata, and explanation targets. We use LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B as diagnostic baselines rather than proposed methods. On a 1,650-image synthetic test set, the adapted baselines reach 64.0--67.8\% category macro-F1 on standard held-out scenes. For LLaVA-1.5-7B, category macro-F1 falls from 64.0\% on the standard split to 40.8\% under intervention shift. This gap shows that high in-distribution accuracy partly reflects cues tied to rendering and counterfactual construction.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究图像编辑中的物理合理性诊断，提出一个反事实基准，用于检测编辑图像是否违反场景物理规律，并识别违规类型、定位区域和用语言解释失败原因。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑模型虽能遵循文本指令，却可能破坏场景物理，例如物体无阴影、镜子不反射、物体悬浮等，因此需要系统诊断编辑图像的物理不合理性。
AI.method: 构建反事实基准，使用Mitsuba 3生成合成数据：500个场景族共5,500张图像，每个族含1张干净图像和10张匹配的违规图像，覆盖阴影、反射、支撑、表面响应和遮挡五类。渲染流程提供类别标签、受影响区域掩码与框、场景元数据和解释目标。采用LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL3.5-8B作为诊断基线。
AI.result: 在1,650张合成测试集上，适应后的基线在标准留出场景上达到64.0%至67.8%的类别宏F1。LLaVA-1.5-7B在标准划分上为64.0%，但在干预偏移下降至40.8%。
AI.conclusion: 标准划分上的高准确率部分依赖与渲染和反事实构造相关的线索；在干预偏移下性能明显下降，说明模型对物理合理性的诊断仍不稳健。

title: Right Number, Wrong State? Measuring Cross-Jurisdiction Substitution in LLM Recall of State Policy
summary: When an LLM answers a state-specific policy question wrongly, it may be hallucinating, or it may be returning a real value that holds in another state. We test this with a minimal-set design: the question wording is fixed and only the jurisdiction varies, across the 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia (51 jurisdictions) and three exactly defined Medicaid income-eligibility quantities. Gold values come from an official data book and agree with an independent source in 101 of 102 checked cells. Under a pre-registered protocol, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol reproducibly give another state's current value, identical across two independent repeats, for 10 and 25 of 153 items. Attribution is fragile, however. Crediting any wrong answer that equals another state's value yields 3-5x more reproducible substitutions than checking every number in the asked state's own records, because many apparent cross-state answers are the asked state's own values under another convention or from an earlier year. Claims about cross-jurisdiction error need a complete same-state reference set. We will release the protocol, gold table, and all model outputs.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验LLM回答州级政策问题时，错误答案究竟是幻觉，还是其他州的真实值。作者以美国51个司法辖区和3项Medicaid收入资格标准构建最小对照设计，发现部分模型会稳定复现其他州的当前值，但也指出跨州错误归因很脆弱，需要完整的同州参照集。
AI.motivation: 当LLM对州特定政策问题给出错误答案时，不清楚它是凭空幻觉，还是返回了另一个司法辖区的真实值。作者希望区分这两类错误，并评估跨辖区错误的可归因性。
AI.method: 采用最小集设计：固定问题措辞，仅改变司法辖区，覆盖美国50州和哥伦比亚特区共51个辖区，以及3个精确定义的Medicaid收入资格数量。金标准来自官方数据手册，并在102个抽查单元中与独立来源一致101个。按预注册协议，对Claude Sonnet 5.5和GPT-5.6 Sol进行两次独立重复测试。
AI.result: Claude Sonnet 5.5和GPT-5.6 Sol分别在153个项目中，有10个和25个可重复地给出另一个州的当前值，且两次独立重复完全一致。但归因脆弱：若把任何等于其他州值的错误答案都算作跨州替换，可重复替换数会多出3至5倍；原因是许多看似跨州的答案，其实是所问州自身在不同统计口径或更早年份下的值。
AI.conclusion: 关于跨司法辖区错误的结论，需要完整的同州参照集才能可靠判断。作者将发布协议、金标准表和所有模型输出，以支持后续验证。

title: Predicted Futures Are Not Enough: Learning Executable Goals for Robot Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/ Code and models: https://github.com/Claire0730/executable-goals
summary: Generative world models provide rich predictions of how manipulation scenes may evolve toward task objectives, yet those futures do not directly expose the compact task variables required by control. When training supervises future prediction alone, terminal goal accuracy is not an explicit learning objective, even when geometric recovery is available. We present Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned prediction-to-execution interface that makes the executable terminal goal an explicit output of a 3D trace world model. It combines object-centric pose prediction with translation grounded in observed depth to produce a compact goal in SE(3). A shared Pose-Native Executor consumes this fixed goal with online object-pose feedback for closed-loop control without rerunning the world model. Across five manipulation tasks, the pipeline achieves a mean success rate of 79.69%. Goal diagnostics directly measure terminal goal accuracy, while controlled translation perturbations characterize how execution degrades under goal error. Zero-shot deployment on a Franka arm achieves 73.33% success on nominal StackCube, 66.67% with distractors, and 75.00% on PickPlate with a target unseen during policy training. These results support treating the prediction-to-execution interface as an explicit learned component of world-model planning rather than incidental post-processing in the control pipeline itself. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/

AI.tldr: 提出实体级目标读出接口，将3D轨迹世界模型的预测转化为可执行的SE(3)终端目标，并用共享位姿原生执行器进行闭环控制。在五类操作任务上平均成功率为79.69%，并在Franka机械臂上实现零样本部署。
AI.motivation: 生成式世界模型能够预测操作场景如何朝任务目标演化，但这些未来预测并不直接给出控制所需的紧凑任务变量。仅以未来预测为监督时，终端目标精度并非显式学习目标，即使几何恢复信息可用。
AI.method: 提出Entity-Level Goal Readout，将物体中心位姿预测与基于观测深度的平移结合，输出紧凑的SE(3)终端目标。共享的Pose-Native Executor以该固定目标和在线物体位姿反馈进行闭环控制，无需重新运行世界模型。还使用目标诊断直接测量终端目标精度，并通过受控平移扰动分析目标误差下的执行退化。
AI.result: 在五种操作任务中平均成功率为79.69%。零样本部署到Franka机械臂：StackCube标称任务成功率73.33%，存在干扰物时66.67%，PickPlate中目标在策略训练时未见时成功率为75.00%。
AI.conclusion: 应把预测到执行的接口视为世界模型规划中的显式学习组件，而不是控制流程中的附带后处理。

title: ClimbLab: MATLAB Simulation Platform for Legged Climbing Robotics
comment: Author's version of a manuscript in the proceedings of CLAWAR 2021. The final published version is available at: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-86294-7_20
summary: This paper presents an open-sourced MATLAB simulation and analysis platform dedicated to legged climbing robots. This simulator enables the design of any limbed robotic system as an articulated multi-body with a floating base and simulates it walking and climbing in an arbitrary environment. The main variable environmental parameters are inclination, gravity, and ground stiffness, and any point cloud can be installed as the terrain map. Furthermore, the simulator employs a rigid body dynamics engine. This paper first describes the simulator structure, and the computational flow and next presents the representative simulation examples where quadrupedal robots assumed gripping on the wall or climbing on the steep slope.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个开源的MATLAB仿真与分析平台，用于腿式攀爬机器人，可设计任意多肢体机器人并模拟其在任意环境中的行走与攀爬。
AI.motivation: 为腿式攀爬机器人的设计与分析提供专用仿真平台，支持在可变的倾角、重力、地面刚度以及任意点云地形中进行验证。
AI.method: 基于MATLAB开发仿真平台，采用刚性体动力学引擎，将机器人建模为带浮动基座的铰接多体系统，并支持设置环境参数与点云地形图。
AI.result: 实现了该仿真平台的结构与计算流程，并给出四足机器人抓附墙壁或在陡坡上攀爬的代表性仿真示例。
AI.conclusion: 该开源平台能够支持任意肢体机器人系统在复杂环境中的行走与攀爬仿真，适用于腿式攀爬机器人的设计与分析。

title: BanglaRhet: Benchmarking Classical and Transformer Models for Rhetorical and Persuasion Detection in Bangla Political Speech
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 2026 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication, Electrical, and Smart Systems (iCACCESS), Dhaka, Bangladesh. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23162113. Code: https://github.com/TSRohit99/banglarhet. Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tsrohit99/banglarhet
summary: Political discourse often uses rhetorical and persuasive language to frame narratives, influence public opinion, and mobilize audiences. While Bangla natural language processing has made progress in sentiment analysis and opinion mining, systematic benchmarking of transformer models for fine-grained rhetorical and persuasion technique detection in Bangla political speech remains largely underexplored. This paper presents a benchmark study of transformer-based models for detecting rhetorical form and persuasive intent in Bangla political discourse. Using BanglaRhet, a manually annotated corpus of 30,289 Bangla political speech segments collected from publicly available political news sources, we formulate two supervised single-label classification tasks: rhetorical technique detection (contrast, repetition, exaggeration, metaphor, rhetorical questions) and persuasion technique detection (blame assignment, call to action, unity call, moral, emotional, and logical appeals). We evaluate four transformer-based models, BanglaBERT, BanglaBERT-Base, SahajBERT, and XLM-RoBERTa-Base, against classical TF-IDF baselines. BanglaBERT achieves the highest performance, with 65.40% macro-F1 for rhetorical technique detection and 66.46% for persuasion technique detection, outperforming the best tuned classical baseline by 19.2 and 13.8 macro-F1 points, respectively. Class-level analysis indicates that errors are mainly associated with semantic overlap among labels, figurative language, and class imbalance. The results provide initial benchmark baselines for Bangla rhetorical and persuasion-aware political discourse analysis and highlight the need for context-aware and multi-label modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文对孟加拉语政治话语中的修辞和说服技巧检测进行了基准研究，使用手动标注的BanglaRhet语料库，评估了四种Transformer模型在两项分类任务上的性能，BanglaBERT取得了最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语自然语言处理在情感分析和观点挖掘方面已有进展，但对政治演讲中细粒度修辞和说服技巧检测的Transformer模型系统性基准测试仍很少被探索。
AI.method: 使用从公开政治新闻中收集的30,289个手动标注的孟加拉语政治演讲片段构成的BanglaRhet语料库，制定两个有监督的单标签分类任务：修辞技巧检测（对比、重复、夸张、隐喻、反问）和说服技巧检测（指责、行动号召、团结呼吁、道德、情感和逻辑诉求）。评估四种Transformer模型（BanglaBERT、BanglaBERT-Base、SahajBERT、XLM-RoBERTa-Base）并与经典TF-IDF基线进行比较。
AI.result: BanglaBERT表现最佳，修辞技巧检测的宏F1为65.40%，说服技巧检测的宏F1为66.46%，分别比最佳调优的经典基线高出19.2和13.8个宏F1点。类别级分析表明错误主要与标签间的语义重叠、比喻性语言和类别不平衡有关。
AI.conclusion: 结果为孟加拉语修辞和说服感知的政治话语分析提供了初始基准，并强调了需要上下文感知和多标签建模。

title: RippleCP: Measuring Counterfactual Checkpoint Advantage in Coding Agents
summary: Agent checkpoint systems decide what state is recovery-relevant, how to snapshot it, and whether rollback is admissible. None decides which of the safe boundaries they expose are worth materializing. We formulate this as counterfactual checkpoint advantage, the reduction in future recovery cost obtained by checkpointing a candidate rather than skipping it, and measure it by driving a CP branch and a SKIP branch to the same logical failure and recovering both under matched model, tool, verifier, and stopping conditions. On a frozen pilot of 12 SWE-bench Verified tasks and 106 real recovery branches, checkpointing saves 49.4 s per task, and that figure resolves into two regimes two orders of magnitude apart. The first checkpoint returns 100.0 s on 156.5 s of protected work, a conversion of 0.64; a second one step later returns-1.1 s on 41.8 s, a conversion of -0.03. Recovery is a re-derivation rather than a replay, so preserved work is a poor guide to saved work, and the classical elapsed-work rule misprices the second checkpoint by its full nominal cost. We identify where placement can pay, and set the bar a placement policy must clear.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“反事实检查点优势”来评估智能体检查点是否值得创建，即在匹配条件下比较设置检查点（CP）与跳过检查点（SKIP）两条分支对同一逻辑失败进行恢复的代价差异。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体检查点系统关注状态是否可恢复、如何快照以及回滚是否可行，却没有判断哪些安全边界真正值得物化为检查点，导致检查点放置可能低效甚至有害。
AI.method: 将检查点价值形式化为反事实检查点优势：相比跳过候选检查点，创建它能在未来降低多少恢复成本。通过让CP分支和SKIP分支经历同一逻辑失败，并在模型、工具、验证器和停止条件匹配的情况下分别恢复，进行测量。
AI.result: 在12个SWE-bench Verified任务、106个真实恢复分支的冻结试点中，检查点平均每任务节省49.4秒；但收益分为相差两个数量级的两类。第一个检查点在156.5秒受保护工作上返回100.0秒收益，转化率为0.64；紧接着一步后的第二个检查点仅返回-1.1秒，转化率为-0.03。恢复过程是重新推导而非重放，因此已保存的工作量不能很好代表节省的工作量，经典按已耗工作量计价的规则会高估第二个检查点的全部名义成本。
AI.conclusion: 检查点放置需要新的定价标准：并非所有安全边界都值得检查点化，某些边界甚至带来负收益。论文识别了检查点放置可能获利的条件，并为放置策略设定了必须达到的门槛。

title: A Deterministic Evidence Layer for Vision-Language Autism Screening from Naturalistic Home Video
summary: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is diagnosed through specialist observation of a child's social behavior, and access to that expertise is the bottleneck for early identification. Vision-language models (VLMs) describe a child's behavior from video well; the verdict drawn from the description is unstable: at temperature~0, across eight pipeline configurations on one backbone, 16--37\% of clips change their predicted label between repeated runs, and the cause lies in the serving stack. We keep the VLM frozen and move the decision out of the model. Under our grounded perception constraints the VLM writes an event table of timestamped, glossary-labeled events that names the eliciting press and logs counter-evidence; a text-only stage age-calibrates the confidence of each row; a deterministic weight-of-evidence scorer sums it into an evidence total and stratifies it into a risk category, so every decision decomposes into named per-feature contributions and can be re-scored from the saved table. On 43 caregiver-recorded, protocol-free home free-play clips of preschool children, the pipeline reaches AUC $0.851 \pm 0.012$, 86.0\% accuracy, and F$_1$ 71.8 over three runs. It labels 74.4\% of clips correctly in every run (60.5\% for the zero-shot baseline) and flags no typically developing clip in every run (9 of 31 at zero-shot). An ablation on the same backbone attributes the gain to the grounded perception constraints read through the deterministic scorer.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对自闭症谱系障碍早期识别中专家资源瓶颈及视觉语言模型输出不稳定的问题，提出将决策从模型内部移到外部的可解释流水线：冻结VLM生成事件表，再经年龄校准和确定性证据加权评分输出风险等级。
AI.motivation: ASD诊断依赖专家观察儿童社交行为，专家资源是早期识别的瓶颈。尽管VLM能较好描述视频中儿童行为，但其直接判断不稳定：在温度约0时，同一骨干网络的8种流水线配置中，16–37%的视频片段在重复运行间改变预测标签，原因在于服务栈而非模型本身。
AI.method: 保持VLM冻结，在 grounded perception constraints 下让VLM生成带时间戳和术语标签的事件表，记录引发性按压并记录反证；文本阶段对每行置信度做年龄校准；确定性证据加权评分器汇总为证据总分并分层为风险类别，使每个决策可分解为命名特征贡献，并可从保存的事件表重新评分。
AI.result: 在43个照护者录制、无协议约束的学龄前儿童家庭自由玩耍视频上，流水线三次运行达到AUC 0.851±0.012、准确率86.0%、F1 71.8。每次运行均正确标注74.4%的片段（零样本基线为60.5%），且每次运行均未误标任何典型发育片段（零样本为31个中9个）。同一骨干网络上的消融实验表明，性能提升归因于 grounded perception constraints 与确定性评分器的结合。
AI.conclusion: 将决策从VLM中移出，并通过受约束的感知、年龄校准和确定性证据评分，可提高ASD视频筛查的稳定性、准确性和可解释性，同时减少对典型发育儿童的误报。

title: Constraint Tree Exploration for Learning from Language Feedback
summary: Natural-language feedback in interactive learning often explains why an action failed by pointing to violated requirements. Misinterpreting this feedback can lead an agent to rule out valid solutions. We study this setting by modeling user intent as latent constraints over an action space and formulating learning from language feedback as pure exploration over feasible regions. We introduce TRACE, an algorithm that organizes candidate constraints in a tree and tests each proposed refinement by generating actions that satisfy it. TRACE commits to the refinement only if the resulting feedback does not contradict it over repeated tests. We distinguish two ways of using the same feedback: (i) falsification, which detects contradictions to the constraint set currently being tested, and (ii) identification, which may additionally name a violated constraint. We prove high-probability coverage bounds with dependence on the candidate class size $H$ for TRACE-Falsification. With reliable identification, TRACE-Identification can replace this dependence by $K/p_{\mathrm{ext}}$, where $K$ is the number of latent constraints and $p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ lower-bounds the probability of extracting a missing true constraint from informative feedback. We evaluate TRACE across six language-feedback tasks. On RecMovie, TRACE-Identification achieves 73% and 86% final-output success under caps of 20 and 60 evaluated outputs, compared with at most 42% and 48% for the evaluated prompting baselines given the same feedback and output caps. Controlled identity-corruption experiments further show greater robustness than direct accumulation when the falsification detector remains reliable.

AI.tldr: 论文研究从自然语言反馈中学习潜在约束的问题，提出 TRACE 算法，将候选约束组织成树，并通过生成满足约束的动作反复测试，从而在避免误解反馈导致排除有效解的前提下进行可行域探索。
AI.motivation: 交互学习中的自然语言反馈常通过指出违反的需求来解释动作失败，但智能体若误解反馈，可能会错误排除有效解。因此需要建模用户意图为动作空间上的潜在约束，并将从语言反馈学习转化为对可行域的纯探索问题。
AI.method: 提出 TRACE 算法：将候选约束组织为树结构，对每个提议的约束细化生成满足该约束的动作进行测试；只有当重复测试得到的反馈不与细化矛盾时才提交该细化。区分两种反馈使用方式：TRACE-Falsification 仅检测与当前约束集的矛盾；TRACE-Identification 还可识别被违反的约束。理论上证明 TRACE-Falsification 的高概率覆盖界依赖候选类大小 H；在可靠识别下，TRACE-Identification 可将该依赖替换为 K/p_ext，其中 K 为潜在约束数，p_ext 为从信息反馈中提取缺失真实约束的概率下界。
AI.result: 在六项语言反馈任务上评估 TRACE。在 RecMovie 任务中，输出评估上限为 20 和 60 时，TRACE-Identification 最终输出成功率分别达到 73% 和 86%，而相同反馈与输出上限下，所评估的提示基线最高仅为 42% 和 48%。受控的身份破坏实验进一步表明，当伪造检测器保持可靠时，TRACE 比直接累积方法具有更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TRACE 能有效利用自然语言反馈中的约束信息，通过树式约束组织和重复测试避免误解反馈导致的错误排除，并在语言反馈任务中显著优于提示基线，且在反馈可靠性受限时表现出更好鲁棒性。

title: Goldsmith: Gold-Loss-Guided Definition Optimization with an Agentic Annotation Harness
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to the main conference of EMNLP 2026
summary: Many annotation projects begin before experts have a stable guideline or enough labels to train a task-specific model. We present Goldsmith, an agentic pipeline that turns a small gold set---expert-annotated calibration examples representing the intended task boundaries---into a reusable structured annotation definition. Goldsmith treats this definition as a trainable textual object. Candidate definitions are run on the same gold examples and scored with an executable structured loss, while the output schema, formatting, retrieval, repair, judging, and human review remain in an external harness. A large language model (LLM) editor converts the highest-loss failures into textual-gradient revisions, which are accepted only when the measured loss decreases. In prompt-optimization comparisons, Goldsmith improves over direct rewriting, OPRO, APE, and PromptBreeder under matched evaluation protocols. The resulting definition also improves downstream annotation when combined with retrieval, score-based routing, and human review across typed span, pair-level relation, and fixed-trigger event-argument tasks. These results show that scarce expert supervision can support both task-definition learning and scalable annotation.

AI.tldr: Goldsmith 是一个智能体流水线，可将少量专家标注的校准样本转化为可复用的结构化标注定义，并用于提升下游标注效果。
AI.motivation: 许多标注项目在专家尚未形成稳定指南或缺乏足够训练标签时就开始，因此需要利用稀缺专家监督来同时学习任务定义并支持规模化标注。
AI.method: 将标注定义视为可训练文本对象：在相同金标样本上运行候选定义，并用可执行的结构化损失评分；输出模式、格式化、检索、修复、评判和人工审核由外部 harness 处理；LLM 编辑器将高损失失败转化为文本梯度式修订，仅在损失下降时接受修订。
AI.result: 在匹配评估协议下，Goldsmith 优于直接重写、OPRO、APE 和 PromptBreeder；结合检索、基于分数的路由和人工审核后，在 typed span、pair-level relation 和 fixed-trigger event-argument 任务上均提升下游标注效果。
AI.conclusion: 稀缺的专家监督既能支持任务定义学习，也能支持可扩展的标注流程。

title: MCFR: A Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression Framework for Robust Multi-Variant Board-to-Board Connector Assembly
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026). Finalist for the IROS Best Paper Award for Industrial Robotics Research for Applications
summary: Automated insertion of board-to-board (BTB) connectors in 3C manufacturing requires both high visual accuracy and strong deployment robustness. This problem remains challenging because multi-variant connectors exhibit significant morphological and appearance variations, making stable cross-variant generalization difficult, while the mismatch between training and deployment under fixed-view inspection settings induces background spurious correlation and degrades real-world performance. To address these issues, this paper proposes MCFR, a Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression framework for multi-variant BTB connector assembly. By introducing an object-aware mask prior and explicit photometric refinement, the proposed method suppresses background interference and improves alignment accuracy and robustness in practical deployment. Experiments on a self-constructed multi-variant dataset, a BTB batch insertion testbed, and a real smartphone assembly task show that MCFR consistently outperforms representative baselines and achieves an average real-world insertion success rate of 99.25%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical potential of MCFR for automated assembly of multi-variant BTB connectors.

AI.tldr: 提出MCFR（掩码引导的由粗到细回归）框架，用于多型号BTB连接器自动插装，提升视觉精度与部署鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 3C制造中BTB连接器自动插装需高精度与鲁棒性，但多型号连接器形态与外观差异大导致跨型号泛化难，且固定视角下训练与部署不匹配引入背景虚假相关，降低实际性能。
AI.method: 提出Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression (MCFR)框架，引入目标感知掩码先验和显式光度细化，抑制背景干扰，提高对准精度和部署鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在自建多型号数据集、BTB批量插装试验台和真实手机装配任务上，MCFR优于代表性基线，平均实际插装成功率达99.25%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明MCFR对多型号BTB连接器自动装配有效且具有实际应用潜力。

title: Learning Unknown Constraints without Unsafe Data via Optimality and Counterfactual Regularization
summary: Learning from demonstrations (LfD) provides a framework for inferring unknown constraints from locally optimal, constraint-satisfying expert behavior. Existing approaches largely fall into two paradigms, constrained inverse optimal control (CIOC) and inverse constrained reinforcement learning (ICRL). CIOC exploits optimality conditions such as the Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) conditions but typically assumes known dynamics and structured constraint representations. Meanwhile, ICRL accommodates complex unknown constraints and unknown transition dynamics but often requires extensive online exploration, during which unsafe constraint violations may occur. In this work, we introduce Counterfactual KKT (CF-KKT), a constraint learning framework that leverages learned dynamics and locally optimal demonstrations to recover unknown constraints without requiring known dynamics or additional risky exploration, thereby combining the data efficiency and safety advantages of CIOC with the flexibility of ICRL. First, we use a locally learned differentiable dynamics model to impose KKT-inspired optimality conditions directly on the demonstrations. Second, we use the learned dynamics to generate reward-improving counterfactual behaviors near the demonstrations, revealing behaviors that would be preferable in the absence of the unknown constraint and thus providing synthetic infeasible data. When the constraint parameterization is known, the same learned-dynamics framework enables direct CIOC-based parameter recovery, and we characterize its sensitivity to dynamics misspecification. Across high-dimensional robotic control tasks, our approach learns neural constraint representations with improved safety and data efficiency relative to state-of-the-art offline ICRL baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Counterfactual KKT（CF-KKT）框架，利用学习到的动力学与局部最优示范来恢复未知约束，无需已知动力学或额外危险探索，结合了 CIOC 与 ICRL 的优势。
AI.motivation: 现有从示范学习约束的方法分为 CIOC 和 ICRL：CIOC 依赖 KKT 条件但假设已知动力学和结构化约束；ICRL 可处理未知复杂约束和转移动力学，却常需大量在线探索，可能造成不安全约束违反。
AI.method: 使用局部学习的可微动力学模型，在示范上施加 KKT 启发的优化条件；再用学习到的动力学生成靠近示范的、能提升奖励的反事实行为，以揭示无未知约束时更优的行为，从而提供合成的不可行数据；当约束参数化已知时，同一框架支持直接基于 CIOC 的参数恢复，并分析其对动力学建模误差的敏感性。
AI.result: 在高维机器人控制任务中，相比最先进的离线 ICRL 基线，该方法学习到神经约束表示，并提升了安全性和数据效率。
AI.conclusion: CF-KKT 无需已知动力学或高风险探索，即可从局部最优示范中学习未知约束，兼具 CIOC 的数据效率与安全性优势以及 ICRL 的灵活性。

title: Pooling Representation Autoencoders for Efficient Diffusion
summary: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) generate images from pre-trained visual fea- tures, but their dense token grids make generative modeling expensive. Motivated by local feature correlations, we introduce PoolDINO, a learned affine pooling operator that merges neighboring tokens. Training the pooling operator jointly with the RGB decoder preserves the standard two-stage RAE procedure without a separate feature auto-encoder. On ImageNet-256, 4x token compression retains comparable generation quality under internal guidance, while 16x compression trades some quality for greater efficiency. At a fixed budget of 100 sampling steps, latent-sampling throughput increases by 3.7x and 9.0x, respectively, relative to the unpooled baseline. Classification and dense prediction evaluations show that comparable guided generation quality can coexist with weaker performance on other tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PoolDINO，一种可学习的仿射池化算子，用于压缩 Representation Autoencoders（RAEs）中的密集 token 网格，从而降低生成建模成本并提升采样效率。
AI.motivation: RAEs 基于预训练视觉特征生成图像，但其密集 token 网格导致生成建模计算开销大；受局部特征相关性启发，希望合并相邻 token 来提升效率。
AI.method: 提出 PoolDINO：学习一个仿射池化算子来合并相邻 token，并与 RGB 解码器联合训练；无需单独的特征自编码器，保留标准两阶段 RAE 流程。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，4 倍 token 压缩在内部引导下保持可比的生成质量；16 倍压缩牺牲部分质量换取更高效率。固定 100 步采样时，潜在采样吞吐分别提升 3.7 倍和 9.0 倍。分类与密集预测评估表明，可比的引导生成质量可能与较弱的下游任务性能并存。
AI.conclusion: PoolDINO 能有效压缩 RAE 的 token 表示并显著加速采样，但生成质量与下游任务性能之间存在权衡。

title: PVSync: A Unified Lip-Sync Expert for Timing and Articulation
summary: Lip movements can match the timing of speech without matching the spoken sounds. We introduce PVSync, a unified model for audio-visual offset estimation and phoneme-level articulation scoring. PVSync combines window-level contrastive learning for synchronisation with a phoneme-level articulation objective that aligns audio and video embeddings of the same viseme class across clips. Visemes group phonemes with similar visible articulation. Viseme labels are derived automatically from forced-aligned transcripts, without manual annotations. On offset-corrected videos from 13 talking-head video generation models, PVSync matches human rankings of lip-sync quality more closely than LSE-C, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.83 versus 0.34. On an automatically constructed benchmark from held-out speech, PVSync distinguishes viseme-matched from mismatched audio-visual pairs with an ROC AUC of 0.91. PVSync also outperforms SyncNet and MTD-VocaLiST in temporal offset recovery on held-out in-the-wild clips. Code and benchmark data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出 PVSync，一个统一的音视频偏移估计与音素级发音评分模型，利用窗口级对比学习和视素级发音目标，无需人工标注即可自动构建视素标签，并在唇同步质量排序、视素匹配判别和时序偏移恢复上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 唇部动作可能只与语音时间对齐，而不一定与实际发音内容匹配。因此，需要同时评估音视频同步性和发音 articulation 的一致性，现有指标如 LSE-C 等在此方面存在不足。
AI.method: PVSync 结合窗口级对比学习进行同步建模，并引入音素级发音目标，将同一视素类别的音视频嵌入跨片段对齐。视素将发音时视觉上相似的音素分组，其标签通过强制对齐转录文本自动生成，无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在来自 13 个说话头视频生成模型的偏移校正视频上，PVSync 与人类唇同步质量排名的 Spearman 相关性为 0.83，优于 LSE-C 的 0.34；在自动构建的留出语音基准上，区分视素匹配与不匹配音视频对的 ROC AUC 为 0.91；在留出真实场景片段上的时序偏移恢复也优于 SyncNet 和 MTD-VocaLiST。
AI.conclusion: PVSync 能更接近人类判断地评估唇同步质量，并有效完成视素匹配判别和时序偏移恢复，证明统一建模同步与发音评分的有效性，且代码和基准数据将在录用后发布。

title: A Comparative Study of Evaluation Metrics for Long-Document Financial Narrative Summarization with Transformers
summary: There are more than 2,000 listed companies on the UK's London Stock Exchange, divided into 11 sectors who are required to communicate their financial results at least twice in a single financial year. UK annual reports are very lengthy documents with around 80 pages on average. In this study, we aim to benchmark a variety of summarisation methods on a set of different pre-trained transformers with different extraction techniques. In addition, we considered multiple evaluation metrics in order to investigate their differing behaviour and applicability on a dataset from the Financial Narrative Summarisation (FNS 2020) shared task, which is composed of annual reports published by firms listed on the London Stock Exchange and their corresponding summaries. We hypothesise that some evaluation metrics do not reflect true summarisation ability and propose a novel BRUGEscore metric, as the harmonic mean of ROUGE-2 and BERTscore. Finally, we perform a statistical significance test on our results to verify whether they are statistically robust, alongside an adversarial analysis task with three different corruption methods.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对英国伦敦证券交易所上市公司冗长年报的摘要生成任务，基准测试了多种预训练Transformer与抽取技术，并比较了多种评估指标，提出新的BRUGEscore指标。
AI.motivation: 英国上市公司年报平均约80页，篇幅长且每年至少发布两次财务结果，自动摘要需求明显；同时现有摘要评估指标可能无法真实反映摘要能力。
AI.method: 在FNS 2020共享任务数据集上，对多种预训练Transformer模型和不同抽取技术进行摘要方法基准测试，并采用多种评估指标；提出BRUGEscore作为ROUGE-2与BERTscore的调和平均；最后进行统计显著性检验和三种损坏方法下的对抗分析。
AI.result: 研究比较了不同摘要方法和评估指标的行为与适用性，发现部分指标可能不能真实反映摘要能力，因此提出BRUGEscore；同时通过统计显著性检验和对抗分析验证结果的统计稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 针对金融年报摘要任务，需要更合理的评估指标，BRUGEscore被提出以结合ROUGE-2和BERTscore；统计检验与对抗分析有助于验证摘要系统评估的稳健性。

title: GeoNatureAgent (GNA): A Framework and Benchmark for Pre-Production Evaluation of Tool-Using Agents on Geospatial and Environmental Tasks
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Extended version of arXiv:2606.12821 (ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026 poster paper). Published at GeoIndustry '26 (ACM SIGSPATIAL Workshop)
summary: Before tool-using LLM agents are deployed in environmental and geospatial workflows, teams need evidence that an agent reliably selects the right operations against real APIs. We introduce GeoNatureAgent (GNA), a framework for pre-production evaluation of tool-using agents: a fixed sixteen-tool geospatial interface published as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so the agent under test is the only variable, scored against an identical tool layer, task suite, and deterministic scorer. Its flagship instance is a 103-task benchmark (a 93-task main suite across 18 categories plus a ten-task comparison expansion) evaluated against an open, self-hostable geospatial API serving three environmental indicators across Spain and Portugal. We evaluate nine LLMs under three temperature-1.0 seeds, reporting capability and per-case cost as orthogonal axes. (1) Claude Sonnet 4 achieves the highest capability (61.7% +/- 0.7% on all 103 tasks; 60.8% on the main suite), followed closely by DeepSeek V3.2 (57.9%), while no other model exceeds 53%; (2) the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier is mostly open-weight, with DeepSeek V3.2 offering 93% of Claude's capability at 11.3x lower list-price cost; (3) under strict all-checks scoring the best model sits 24-36 points below the 85-97% reported on general-purpose GIS benchmarks, whereas per-check partial credit for the top four models (86-90%) is comparable, so much of that gap reflects scoring strictness rather than task difficulty alone. The MCP server, evaluation harness, benchmark, and API are publicly available; swapping the tool executors and task suite instantiates an equivalent benchmark for any geospatial domain.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GeoNatureAgent (GNA)，用于在真实 API 上对工具调用型 LLM 智能体进行预部署评估。它固定 16 个地理空间工具并发布为 MCP 服务器，使被测智能体成为唯一变量，并用统一的评分器进行评测。旗舰基准包含 103 个任务，面向西班牙和葡萄牙的三类环境指标，评估了 9 个 LLM。
AI.motivation: 在环境和地理空间工作流中部署工具型 LLM 智能体之前，团队需要证据表明智能体能针对真实 API 可靠地选择正确操作。现有评测往往难以隔离智能体本身能力，因此需要固定工具层、任务套件和确定性评分器的可复现评估框架。
AI.method: GeoNatureAgent 框架将 16 个地理空间工具封装为公开的 MCP 服务器，并对相同工具层、任务套件和确定性评分器下的智能体进行评估。旗舰实例为 103 任务基准（93 个主任务、18 个类别，外加 10 个对比扩展任务），调用一个开放可自托管、覆盖西班牙和葡萄牙三类环境指标的地理空间 API。研究在 temperature 1.0 下用三个随机种子评估九个 LLM，并将能力与单例成本作为正交维度报告。
AI.result: Claude Sonnet 4 能力最高，在全部 103 个任务上为 61.7%±0.7%，主套件为 60.8%；DeepSeek V3.2 紧随其后为 57.9%，其他模型均不超过 53%。成本-准确率帕累托前沿主要由开放权重模型占据，DeepSeek V3.2 以约 11.3 分之一的列表价格成本达到 Claude 约 93% 的能力。严格全检查评分下，最佳模型比通用 GIS 基准报告的 85%-97% 低 24-36 个百分点；但按每项检查部分给分时，前四名模型达 86%-90%，与通用基准可比，说明差距很大程度来自评分严格性而非任务难度。
AI.conclusion: GNA 提供了可公开使用的 MCP 服务器、评估工具链、基准和 API，可用于工具型地理空间智能体的预生产评估。通过替换工具执行器和任务套件，可为任意地理空间领域实例化等价基准。结果强调需同时报告严格评分与部分得分，并关注能力-成本权衡。

title: COOL: Curiosity-Driven Object Ownership Learning for Personalized Robotic Assistance
summary: Robots are increasingly expected to provide personalized services in everyday environments. To do so, they must ground natural-language commands such as "Where is my backpack?" or "Find my bottle" and execute them by reasoning about object instances, people, locations, and ownership. This is challenging because ownership is rarely labeled explicitly and must be inferred from long-term, behavioral evidence of human-object interactions. To address this, we present COOL, a novel robotic framework for autonomously learning object ownership from everyday observations and maintaining a long-term spatial memory of its environment. To keep its memory current, COOL uses an agent-based curiosity-driven data collection strategy that guides the robot toward the most promising locations to gain information and refresh stale observations. Offline experiments, ablation studies, and real-world evaluations show that COOL can infer ownership relations from real-world interactions and use this knowledge for ownership-conditioned navigation and task execution.

AI.tldr: 机器人需提供个性化服务，需理解自然语言指令并推理物体所有权。本文提出COOL框架，从日常观察中自主学习物体所有权并维护长期空间记忆，通过好奇心驱动的数据收集策略更新记忆。实验表明能推断所有权并用于导航和任务执行。
AI.motivation: 机器人在日常环境中提供个性化服务，需要根据自然语言指令如“我的背包在哪？”来执行任务，这需要推断物体所有权。但所有权很少被明确标注，必须从长期的人-物交互行为证据中推断。因此需要一种能自主学习所有权并维护空间记忆的方法。
AI.method: 提出COOL框架，从日常观察中自主学习物体所有权，并维护长期空间记忆。采用基于智能体的好奇心驱动数据收集策略，引导机器人前往最有希望的位置获取信息并刷新过时观察。通过离线实验、消融研究和真实世界评估验证。
AI.result: COOL能从真实世界交互中推断所有权关系，并利用该知识进行所有权条件下的导航和任务执行。
AI.conclusion: COOL框架能有效学习所有权并维护空间记忆，支持个性化服务。

title: RELATE: An Evaluation Framework for measuring Relational Orientation of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support, raising concern that sustained use may draw users away from their real-world relationships. Yet existing evaluations primarily focus on the safety, empathy, or helpfulness of responses, leaving under-examined a relational question: where does the model orient the user for continued support? To address this question, we introduce relational orientation, a property operationalized through two non-exclusive dimensions: inward-facing (IF) language, which positions the AI as the user's ongoing source of support, and outward-scaffolding (OS) language, which encourages real-world human connection. Grounded in psychological and sociological literature, we formalize a taxonomy of relational orientation and present RELATE, a persona-conditioned framework for measuring inward-facing and outward-scaffolding language at the sentence level in multi-turn dialogues. RELATE pairs 76 help-seeking situations adapted from naturally occurring questions with three simulated user styles, providing 228 evaluation stimuli. In our experiments, we evaluate seven LLMs using dialogues with six assistant turns each, yielding 1,596 dialogues and 69,194 assistant sentences. We assess these sentences using a primary rubric-based LLM judge and apply a secondary judge to a subset. Under automated evaluation, we find that the proportion of sentences labeled as IF is higher at the sixth assistant turn than at the first, while the proportion labeled as OS is substantially lower for hesitant, indirect simulated users than for explicit, reassurance-seeking users. RELATE provides a reproducible framework and a sentence-level signal for auditing and steering the relational orientation of supportive LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“关系取向”概念，用于衡量情感支持型LLM是将用户引向AI持续支持，还是鼓励其转向现实人际连接，并发布RELATE评估框架。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于情感支持，但已有评估多关注安全性、共情或有用性，较少考察模型在持续支持中将用户导向何方，即关系取向问题。
AI.method: 提出关系取向及两个维度：内向型（IF）和向外支架型（OS）；基于心理学与社会学文献建立分类体系；设计RELATE，一个基于人设、句子级、多轮对话的测量框架。使用76个求助情境与3种模拟用户风格，构成228个刺激；评估7个LLM、每个6轮助手回复，共1596段对话、69194句助手语句；以规则型LLM评委为主，并对子集使用第二评委。
AI.result: 自动评估发现：第六轮助手回复中IF句子比例高于第一轮；对于犹豫、间接的模拟用户，OS句子比例显著低于明确寻求安慰的用户。
AI.conclusion: RELATE提供了可复现的框架和句子级信号，可用于审计和引导情感支持型LLM的关系取向。

title: From Uncertainty to Action: Learning to Steer LLM Agents
summary: Steering an LLM agent means deciding whether to correct it, at which step, and with which mechanism. Uncertainty is often used to decide when to correct an agent, but whether it can guide these decisions remains unclear. We steer agent trajectories separately at every non-terminal step with each of four mechanisms and run each continuation to completion. The resulting stepwise outcome table (SOT) holds about 82,000 counterfactual continuations of 1,864 trajectories from three benchmarks and two agents. It shows that uncertainty can identify failing trajectories, but that no single signal reliably locates the step at which steering helps. We therefore propose VoS (Value of Steering), a trajectory-level monitor, offline or online, that learns from SOT the value of steering at each step and decides where to steer by it. A harm-budgeted trigger decides whether to steer, limiting the fraction of successful trajectories that VoS disturbs. VoS improves on unmodified execution in all 12 settings of benchmark, agent, and offline or online use, by 7.8 points on average, and outperforms the strongest of five existing uncertainty-triggered methods in 11, by 2.9 points on average. Ablations show that training on measured outcomes and a tight harm budget are both essential.

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何对LLM智能体进行转向干预：判断是否纠正、在哪一步纠正以及用哪种机制。作者构建了逐步反事实结果表SOT，并提出基于SOT学习每步转向价值的轨迹级监控器VoS，在是否转向时使用伤害预算触发器。
AI.motivation: 不确定性常被用于决定何时纠正智能体，但它是否能指导“是否纠正、在哪一步纠正、用何种机制纠正”仍不清楚。论文希望系统评估不确定性信号的局限，并寻找更可靠的转向决策方法。
AI.method: 对每个非终止步骤分别用四种机制进行转向，并将每条轨迹运行到结束，形成约82,000条反事实延续、覆盖1,864条轨迹、3个基准和2个智能体的SOT。提出VoS，一种离线或在线轨迹级监控器，从SOT学习每步转向价值并据此决定在哪里转向；另设伤害预算触发器决定是否转向，以限制对成功轨迹的干扰。
AI.result: SOT表明不确定性可识别失败轨迹，但没有单一信号能可靠定位转向有益的步骤。VoS在12种基准、智能体、离线/在线设置中全部优于未修改执行，平均提升7.8分；在11种设置中优于五种现有不确定性触发方法中最强者，平均提升2.9分。消融显示，基于实测结果训练和严格伤害预算都必不可少。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠不确定性不足以指导LLM智能体的转向干预；基于反事实实测结果学习转向价值，并结合伤害预算控制，可有效提升智能体表现。

title: PhyDiCT: Plug-and-Play CT Reconstruction from Sparse X-Rays via Differentiable Rendering and Strong Priors
comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026; to appear in LNCS 16888
summary: Reconstructing 3D Computed Tomography (CT) images from a few X-ray projections is a highly ill-posed inverse problem due to the loss of volumetric information. We propose PhyDiCT, a training-free framework that integrates a differentiable Physics-based forward model, grounded in the Beer-Lambert law, with a text-conditioned Diffusion as a strong prior to reconstruct 3D lung CT images. We refer to our approach as training-free since the prior model is used without fine-tuning, and our goal is to steer the denoising procedure to generate samples consistent with X-ray observations. We guide the diffusion generation using Split Gibbs sampling to jointly optimize for projection fidelity (reward) and consistency with prior knowledge. Also, we introduce a test-time refinement step that enhances image realism and anatomical coherence. We extensively evaluate our method on publicly available 3D CT datasets using both perceptual and semantic metrics, demonstrating that it surpasses existing plug-and-play diffusion and fully trained reconstruction approaches. Our findings highlight that combining a strong generative prior with the underlying physics of image formation substantially improves reconstruction quality, e.g., 7.5\% improvement on SSIM compared to full training methods. Code will be released at https://github.com/batmanlab/PhyDiCT.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhyDiCT，一种无需训练的三维肺部 CT 重建框架，将基于 Beer-Lambert 定律的可微物理前向模型与文本条件扩散先验结合，从少量 X 射线投影重建 3D CT。
AI.motivation: 从少量 X 射线投影重建 3D CT 是高度病态逆问题，因体积信息丢失严重。现有 plug-and-play 扩散或全训练重建方法在投影保真与解剖合理性上仍有不足。
AI.method: 利用可微物理前向模型描述成像过程，并以文本条件扩散模型作为强生成先验；无需微调先验模型。通过 Split Gibbs 采样联合优化投影保真度与先验一致性，并引入测试时细化步骤提升图像真实感与解剖连贯性。
AI.result: 在公开 3D CT 数据集上使用感知和语义指标评估，性能超过现有 plug-and-play 扩散和全训练重建方法；例如相比全训练方法，SSIM 提升 7.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将强生成先验与图像形成的底层物理相结合，可显著提升少视角 3D CT 重建质量。

title: Which Buildings Are Artificial Intelligence-Ready? A Measurement-Based Assessment Framework for AI Question Answering and Actuation
comment: 47 pages, 11 figures, 23 tables. Code, results and data supplement: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23197610
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are becoming the interface to buildings, answering questions and controlling operations, but a building's readiness for them has not been systematically assessed. This study proposes a framework to quantify it. First, a building's knowledge graph sets two ceilings.
