Across 13 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and Deep Blending, a fixed-policy AccuTile sweep gives dataset-macro speedups of $1.088\times$ at standard resolution and $1.238\times$ at 3840 pixels wide, with $-0.007/-0.023$ dB mean PSNR change. Six integrations with existing opacity-aware bounds yield $1.009\times$--$1.121\times$ compiler-only speedups. For four ports from $3σ$ rasterizers, we separately attribute the prior exact-bound transition and our incremental gain. Matched-quality ablations show modest gains over scene-global calibration and parity with per-Gaussian control; the standalone comparison with AdaGScale is regime-dependent.

AI.tldr: TileSkipper 为冻结的 3D Gaussian Splatting 检查点学习静态的逐高斯贡献截断策略，以减少 tile 枚举开销；仅需每高斯 1 字节，无需参数更新或额外内核，在多个数据集上实现低质量损失的速度提升。
AI.motivation: 现有分块 3D Gaussian Splatting 光栅化器通常对整个场景使用统一的贡献截断阈值，但不同内容对支撑截断的敏感度不同，统一阈值无法兼顾速度与质量。
AI.method: TileSkipper 在冻结检查点上选择静态的逐高斯截断策略。通过校准渲染测量候选对的节省量与孤立移除失真代理，后者考虑前向透射率和背景颜色；将截断值分配到 64 个高斯组，并仅在不相交选择视图上完整渲染后才接受策略。导出策略每高斯使用 1 字节，不更新参数、不增加额外内核、也不进行逐帧策略推断。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples 和 Deep Blending 的 13 个场景中，固定策略 AccuTile 扫描在标准分辨率下取得 1.088 倍数据集宏平均加速，在 3840 像素宽下取得 1.238 倍加速，平均 PSNR 变化为 -0.007/-0.023 dB。与现有 opacity-aware bounds 的六种集成带来 1.009 倍至 1.121 倍的仅编译器加速。对四个来自 3σ 光栅化器的移植，分别归因了先前精确边界转换与本文增量收益。匹配质量消融显示相对场景全局校准有适度增益，与逐高斯控制持平；与 AdaGScale 的独立比较依赖具体区间。
AI.conclusion: 逐高斯静态截断策略可在几乎不损失重建质量的情况下提升 3D Gaussian Splatting 渲染速度，且与 opacity-aware bounds 等方法互补，适合作为无需在线推断的轻量级优化。

title: Shaer: Controlled Arabic Poetry Generation with Meter Subform and Semantic Conditioning
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures. Code: https://github.com/AhmaddAbbass/Shaer ; models and datasets: https://huggingface.co/Shaer-AI
summary: Classical Arabic poetry generation requires simultaneously satisfying semantic, linguistic, and fine-grained prosodic constraints. Existing systems typically control broad poetic attributes but do not jointly model semantic intent, meter subform, and poem length. We present Shaer, a controllable Classical Arabic poetry generation framework jointly conditioned on natural-language descriptions, meter subforms, and target hemistich counts. To support this task, we construct an enriched corpus of 116,032 classical Arabic poems derived from Ashaar, containing normalized meter-subform labels and automatically generated, validated semantic descriptions. We then adapt Yehia-7B using QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning with a completion-only objective. Our evaluation combines automatic assessment of base-meter conformity, requested-subform adherence, and length control with three LLM judges, blinded human evaluation, and memorization analysis. Shaer achieves 95.17% base-meter accuracy, 91.75% poem-level meter-subform accuracy, and 83.40% exact count accuracy. Relative to its untuned foundation model, these results represent gains of 68.68, 57.77, and 38.93 percentage points, respectively; Shaer also attains the highest base-meter accuracy among all evaluated systems. Multi-LLM evaluation and a blinded human assessment of top-ranked outputs further indicate competitive semantic and literary quality. Finally, analysis of all 3,481 test generations finds no exact copies from the training corpus or paired source poems. Code, models, and datasets are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Shaer，一个可控的古典阿拉伯语诗歌生成框架，联合以自然语言描述、格律子形式和目标半句数为条件，并通过构建语料和微调 Yehia-7B 实现高精度格律、子形式与长度控制。
AI.motivation: 古典阿拉伯语诗歌生成需同时满足语义、语言和细粒度韵律约束，而现有系统通常只控制宽泛诗歌属性，无法联合建模语义意图、格律子形式和诗歌长度。
AI.method: 构建来自 Ashaar 的 116,032 首古典阿拉伯语诗歌增强语料，包含规范化格律子形式标签和自动生成并验证的语义描述；采用 QLoRA 监督微调与 completion-only 目标适配 Yehia-7B；评估结合自动指标、三个 LLM 评委、盲人工评估和记忆化分析。
AI.result: Shaer 达到 95.17% 基础格律准确率、91.75% 诗级格律子形式准确率和 83.40% 精确半句数准确率；相比未微调基础模型分别提升 68.68、57.77 和 38.93 个百分点，并在所有评估系统中基础格律准确率最高。多 LLM 与盲人工评估显示其语义和文学质量具有竞争力；3481 个测试生成中未发现与训练语料或配对源诗完全相同的复制。
AI.conclusion: Shaer 能有效联合控制古典阿拉伯语诗歌的语义意图、格律子形式和长度，在自动与人工评估中表现良好且无明显记忆化问题，代码、模型和数据集已公开。

title: Bookkeeping, Composition, or Unreachable Gold? Reading MemoryAgentBench's Conflict-Resolution Scores Against a Frozen Last-Write Resolver
comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 19 pages
summary: MemoryAgentBench's Conflict Resolution split is read as measuring "selective forgetting". We execute the benchmark's own rule - the newest statement about a fact wins - as a zero-learning resolver frozen on one of the four fact lists. Under the official metric the rule answers 80.25% of the questions (74.5% on the three held-out lists). Of the rest, 67 items have a released gold that the last-write graph cannot reach but overwritten statements would ("The capital of India is New Delhi." superseded by "The capital of India is Grosseto."; gold New Delhi); such items are a third of the multi-hop questions at 262K. Two long-context models and our pre-registered approximate re-implementation of the benchmark's BM25 agent, one retained run per item and outcomes only, score 84.7%, 82.6% and 41.6% on the items the rule solves against 10.4%, 11.9% and 6.0% on those 67. The failures are a reachability split plus a small parser-scope residual; the per-item split, not the aggregate, is the unit at which a score here can be read.

AI.tldr: 该文重新审视 MemoryAgentBench 的冲突消解子集：用“最新陈述胜出”的零学习规则作解析器，官方指标下可答 80.25%，但剩余 67 个样本的 gold 无法由 last-write 图到达，却可由被覆盖陈述到达，说明该基准分数混杂了可达性划分问题。
AI.motivation: MemoryAgentBench 的 Conflict Resolution 子集被解读为衡量“选择性遗忘”。作者希望检验该子集是否真正测量这一能力，还是受到基准自身规则、gold 设计与可达性划分的混淆。
AI.method: 将基准规则“关于某事实的最新陈述获胜”实现为零学习解析器，冻结在四个事实列表之一上；按官方指标评估。进一步找出 last-write 图不可达但被覆盖陈述可达的样本。另评估两个长上下文模型和一个预注册的 BM25 agent 近似复现，每个样本保留一次运行且只看结果，并按规则可解/不可解样本拆分分析。
AI.result: 规则解析器在官方指标下答对 80.25%（三个留出列表上 74.5%）。剩余样本中有 67 个的 gold 无法由 last-write 图到达但可由被覆盖陈述到达，例如“印度首都是新德里”被“印度首都是格罗塞托”覆盖后 gold 仍为新德里；这些占 262K 多跳问题的三分之一。两个长上下文模型和 BM25 近似复现分别在规则可解样本上得 84.7%、82.6%、41.6%，在这 67 个样本上仅得 10.4%、11.9%、6.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准的失败主要来自可达性划分，外加少量解析器范围残差；聚合分数会掩盖这一结构，因此应按逐样本划分而非总体分数来解读成绩。

title: Point It, Strike It: Direction-Conditioned Dynamic Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project Page: https://deformx.github.io/DeformY
summary: Goal-conditioned dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects has mainly specified goals as positions for a rope tip to reach. Many tasks, however, depend on how the tip arrives. We therefore study single-swing rope striking with goals that specify the tip's 3D position and arrival direction, across the workspace and on different ropes. This is challenging because rope dynamics are hard to model, no demonstrations exist, distinct swings reach the same goal with different reliability, and the sim-to-real gap extends beyond the rope. To address these challenges, we extend the state-of-the-art DLO simulator DeformX with GPU acceleration, a stable Cosserat rod solver, and a cross-flow aerodynamic model, yielding DeformX2.0, which is more than $20{,}000\times$ faster. We then propose TRACE (Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy), which generates striking data by warm-starting each new target from the stored swing whose tip path passes closest to it. Its cost penalizes rope bending and abrupt tip motion to favor repeatable swings. A conditional flow-matching policy trained on this data reaches 92.1% accuracy in simulation. Finally, we propose RECAP (Residual Calibration Policy), which fits the simulator's rope and rig parameters to a few calibration swings and adapts actions with a correction policy trained in simulation. On a real robot, across three ropes, RECAP raises success within 5cm from 72% to 87% for position goals, and within 10cm and 10° from 50% to 79% for goals that also specify the arrival direction.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究单次挥动绳索击打任务，要求绳索末端同时到达指定3D位置和方向，并提出仿真加速、数据生成与实机校准方法，显著提升真实机器人成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有可变形线性物体动态操作通常只指定绳索末端位置，但许多任务还取决于末端如何到达，即到达方向。同时绳索动力学难建模、缺少示范、不同挥动可靠性差异大，且仿真到现实存在差距。
AI.method: 扩展DeformX为DeformX2.0，加入GPU加速、稳定Cosserat杆求解器和横流气动模型；提出TRACE，通过热启动最接近目标末端路径的已存挥动来生成击打数据，并惩罚绳索弯曲和末端突变；使用条件流匹配策略训练；提出RECAP，用少量校准挥动拟合仿真绳索与装置参数，并在仿真中训练残差校正策略以适配真实动作。
AI.result: DeformX2.0比原方法快超过20000倍；条件流匹配策略在仿真中达到92.1%准确率；真实机器人上三种绳索中，RECAP将5cm内位置目标成功率从72%提升到87%，将同时指定位置和到达方向（10cm与10°内）的成功率从50%提升到79%。
AI.conclusion: 结合高效仿真、轨迹引导的数据生成、流匹配策略和残差校准，可以有效实现绳索单次挥打击打中位置与方向目标的动态操作，并缩小仿真到现实的差距。

title: Few Bits, One Law: Toward W2A4KV2
summary: Extreme low-bit LLM compression is most challenging when weights, activations, and KV caches are quantized together: their distributions differ, and quantization errors interact throughout the network. We introduce CanonQ, a unified quantization-aware training framework that addresses these challenges by separating source canonicalization from task-aware adaptation. Fixed rotations and energy normalization map heterogeneous tensor sources to canonical coordinates, enabling frozen Gaussian-reference codebooks to be reused across layers and models. Joint training then adapts the network to the coupled errors of weight, activation, and cache quantization within a common scalar/vector interface. We bound frozen-codebook transfer error and local task loss, and derive an exact normalization-aware straight-through Jacobian that links quantization distortion to gradient bias. The strongest gains arise under joint W2A4KV2 compression: across LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B, CanonQ-Omni achieves up to 14.28x lower WikiText-2 perplexity and up to 57.9% higher mean zero-shot accuracy than prior state-of-the-art and representative quantization baselines. The benefits extend to Qwen3-1.7B, code generation, and mathematical reasoning: on instruction-tuned MobileLLM-Pro-1B at W2A16KV16, CanonQ achieves relative improvements of 41.7% in HumanEval pass@1 and 39.1% in GSM8K exact match over the strongest evaluated quantization baseline.

AI.tldr: CanonQ 是一种统一的量化感知训练框架，用于同时压缩 LLM 的权重、激活和 KV 缓存。它通过源规范化与任务适配分离，复用冻结的高斯参考码本，并联合训练网络适应耦合量化误差。在 W2A4KV2 等极端低比特设置下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 极端低比特 LLM 压缩在权重、激活和 KV 缓存同时量化时最具挑战：三者分布不同，量化误差会在网络中交互传播。已有方法难以统一处理这些异构张量来源及其耦合误差。
AI.method: CanonQ 将源规范化与任务感知适配分离。固定旋转和能量归一化把异构张量源映射到规范坐标，使冻结的高斯参考码本可跨层、跨模型复用；随后联合训练在统一的标量/向量接口内适配权重、激活和缓存量化带来的耦合误差。论文还给出冻结码本迁移误差与局部任务损失界，并推导了精确的归一化感知直通雅可比，将量化失真与梯度偏差关联。
AI.result: 在联合 W2A4KV2 压缩下增益最强：LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B 上，CanonQ-Omni 相比先前 SOTA 和代表性量化基线，WikiText-2 困惑度最高降低 14.28 倍，零样本平均准确率最高提升 57.9%。优势也扩展到 Qwen3-1.7B、代码生成和数学推理：在指令微调的 MobileLLM-Pro-1B 上采用 W2A16KV16 时，HumanEval pass@1 和 GSM8K 精确匹配分别相对最强基线提升 41.7% 和 39.1%。
AI.conclusion: CanonQ 能有效统一处理 LLM 权重、激活和 KV 缓存的极端低比特联合量化，通过可迁移冻结码本、联合训练和理论分析，在多个模型与任务上显著优于现有量化方法。

title: Closing the Loop on Contrail Avoidance with Satellite Verification
comment: Accepted into Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning: workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Contrails are the thin ice clouds that aircraft leave behind. They cause a large share of aviation's warming, and rerouting the few flights that produce them could avoid much of it. However, an avoided contrail only counts if a satellite can confirm that it never formed, and this check is hard: contrails are one to two pixels wide, cover only 0.18% of pixels, and look very similar to natural cirrus. We build a small diffusion model (8.4M parameters, trained on one GPU) that detects them, and we run a controlled study to find out which components matter. The model reaches 0.476 PR-AUC, compared with 0.414 for a DeepLabV3+ baseline and 0.119 for an adapted MedSegDiff. Doubling the input resolution of the CNN brings it to parity (0.499, p=0.07). Three lessons apply beyond contrails. First, check the input resolution before designing a new architecture. Second, simple flips and rotations more than double accuracy and matter more than any architectural choice we measured. Third, pretraining the model on contrail shapes is harmful: the model learns that thin strokes appear everywhere and paints them onto empty scenes. Precision collapses to 1% while recall-based metrics still rate the degraded model as excellent, and no threshold or guidance heuristic repairs this failure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个仅8.4M参数、单GPU训练的小型扩散模型用于检测航空尾迹，并通过控制实验分析各组件作用；结果表明简单数据增强比架构选择更重要，而用尾迹形状预训练反而有害。
AI.motivation: 尾迹是航空变暖的重要来源，重路由少数产生尾迹的航班可避免大部分影响；但只有卫星确认尾迹从未形成，避免才算有效，而尾迹仅1-2像素宽、占像素0.18%，且与自然卷云相似，检测困难。
AI.method: 提出一个小型扩散模型（8.4M参数，单GPU训练），并进行控制实验；与DeepLabV3+和适配的MedSegDiff对比；测试输入分辨率加倍；采用翻转和旋转等简单增强；尝试在尾迹形状上预训练。
AI.result: 模型达到0.476 PR-AUC，高于DeepLabV3+的0.414和MedSegDiff的0.119；将CNN输入分辨率加倍后达到0.499（p=0.07）并与基线相当；简单翻转旋转使准确率提升一倍以上，比所测任何架构选择都更重要；尾迹形状预训练有害，精度崩溃至1%，但基于召回率的指标仍评价极好，且无阈值或引导启发式能修复。
AI.conclusion: 三条经验可推广至尾迹之外：设计新架构前先检查输入分辨率；简单翻转旋转等增强比架构选择更重要；用尾迹形状预训练会损害模型，使其在空场景中错误绘制细条纹，且召回类指标无法反映该失败。

title: AGAR: a reinforcement learning substrate for LLM program evolution
summary: Given a task and an evaluator, a language model can rewrite a candidate program while a search loop decides which rewrites survive, offering a practical route to algorithm discovery. But that loop is governed by five constants set by hand: which parent to select, how hard to mutate, how to keep diversity, what to remember, and a scalar score that never says which part of the program earned it. Reinforcement learning already has an estimator for each. The obstacle is that program evolution is not usually written down as a decision process. We formalize it as a Markov decision process whose action is the modular prefix the model is conditioned on, rather than the program it emits. Credit assignment, value estimation, adaptive exploration, and experience memory can then attach to distinct components. AGAR (Algorithm Generation As RL) provides the resulting substrate: any estimator can be replaced or switched off without changing the controller, making the transfer auditable one mechanism at a time, with no gradient training of the backend model. Across 19 tasks, two backends, and three seeds under one harness, AGAR improves on the stronger of two published baselines on most tasks, with gains concentrated in the competitive-programming family. The formalization also yields a checkable reading of prior work: these systems are implicitly zero-discount, not by choice, but because fitness is exogenous to an individual rather than a return over successors, leaving a discount factor nothing to act on.

AI.tldr: 该论文将语言模型重写程序与搜索循环的算法发现问题形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，并提出 AGAR 框架，使信用分配、价值估计、自适应探索和经验记忆等模块可插拔、可审计，且无需对后端模型做梯度训练。
AI.motivation: 现有程序进化搜索循环依赖五个手工设定的常数：选择哪个父代、变异强度、多样性维护、记忆内容和标量分数，而强化学习已有对应估计器；障碍在于程序进化通常未被写成决策过程。
AI.method: 把程序进化形式化为 MDP，动作是模型所条件化的模块化前缀而非其生成的程序本身。基于此提出 AGAR，使任意估计器可替换或关闭而不改变控制器，并逐个机制审计迁移；后端模型不做梯度训练。
AI.result: 在统一测试框架下，覆盖 19 个任务、2 个后端和 3 个随机种子，AGAR 在多数任务上优于两个已发表基线中更强的那个，增益集中在竞赛编程类任务。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化还能重新解读先前工作：这些系统隐含地采用零折扣，并非主动选择，而是因为适应度外生于个体而非后继回报，使折扣因子无从作用。

title: Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots
comment: International Symposium on Leveraging Applications of Formal Methods, Verification, and Validation 2026
summary: Deploying robots as Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS) in unknown and dynamic environments necessitates a transition from rigid command libraries toward intention-based autonomy, as natural language represents the only medium capable of articulating complex goals beyond the capacity of finite instruction sets. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a path toward natural language goal description, their integration introduces significant challenges: the formalization gap between imprecise intentions and executable actions, the taxonomy gap induced by unpredictable environments, and the challenge of maintaining temporal state and progress awareness. This work introduces an architectural framework that enables robotic control by leveraging generative AI. The system follows a dual-AI design: an LLM translates high-level intentions into executable program code restricted to a formal robotic library and constrained by verifiable syntax, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) provides semantic grounding via a distillation process. To ensure robustness, the framework incorporates environment-driven replanning triggers based on geometric and semantic thresholds, complemented by continuous runtime monitoring and an adaptive planning loop. Benchmarked across frontier models, our framework architecture demonstrates that grounding generative AI in a reactive, constrained loop enables robust fulfillment of complex intentions in dynamic and unknown environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双AI机器人控制架构：LLM将高层自然语言意图转为受限于形式化机器人库和可验证语法的可执行代码，VLM通过蒸馏提供语义 grounding，并结合环境驱动重规划、运行时监控和自适应规划循环，以在动态未知环境中稳健完成复杂任务。
AI.motivation: 机器人作为复杂自适应系统部署在未知动态环境时，需从刚性命令库转向基于意图的自主。自然语言能表达有限指令集难以覆盖的复杂目标，但LLM集成面临意图到动作的形式化鸿沟、不可预测环境导致的分类鸿沟，以及时序状态与进度感知维护难题。
AI.method: 采用双AI设计：LLM将高层意图翻译为可执行程序代码，代码受限于形式化机器人库并由可验证语法约束；VLM通过蒸馏过程提供语义 grounding。框架还引入基于几何和语义阈值的环境驱动重规划触发、持续运行时监控和自适应规划循环，并在多个前沿模型上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 基准测试表明，将生成式AI置于反应式、受约束的闭环中，能够支持在动态和未知环境中稳健地满足复杂意图。
AI.conclusion: 该架构说明，通过约束生成式AI的动作空间并让其参与反应式自适应闭环，可有效弥合自然语言意图与机器人执行之间的差距，实现复杂目标的鲁棒机器人控制。

title: Judging in Latent Space: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Semantics-Preserving Compression
summary: Reward modeling often requires jointly representing and reasoning over multiple evaluation criteria, yet verbalizing this process token by token can incur substantial inference cost. Recent work on latent reasoning suggests that continuous states may support this computation more compactly. We introduce LatentGRM, a latent evaluation framework built on semantic chunking, compression, and reconstruction. By using the structure of rubric-guided evaluations to guide compression, LatentGRM learns compact continuous trajectories that support autonomous pairwise judgments without generating textual assessments. A separate interpreter reconstructs evaluation text from these trajectories, providing an offline view of the information retained under compression. Under matched training data and backbones, LatentGRM achieves competitive aggregate preference accuracy relative to explicit Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) judges at both 4B and 8B scales. Across four benchmark domains, LatentGRM-8B compresses evaluation trajectories by 8.9--9.2x and reduces total judge inference time by 6.1--7.0x at vote@5. Controlled rubric interventions show that criterion-dependent preference information is carried through the latent sequence. Together, these results demonstrate that continuous latent evaluation can substantially reduce inference cost while preserving competitive judgment quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatentGRM：一种基于语义分块、压缩与重构的潜在评估框架，用紧凑连续轨迹替代逐 token 文本评估，在保持竞争性判断质量的同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 奖励建模通常需要联合表示和推理多个评价标准，但逐 token 生成文本化评估会带来高昂推理成本；近期潜在推理表明连续状态可能更紧凑地支持此类计算。
AI.method: LatentGRM 利用评分标准引导评估的结构来指导压缩，学习支持自主成对判断的紧凑连续轨迹，且不生成文本评估；另设解释器从轨迹重构评估文本，以离线观察压缩后保留的信息。
AI.result: 在训练数据和骨干匹配下，LatentGRM 在 4B 和 8B 规模上相对显式 SFT 评审取得竞争性总体偏好准确率；在四个基准领域，LatentGRM-8B 将评估轨迹压缩 8.9–9.2 倍，并在 vote@5 下将总评审推理时间减少 6.1–7.0 倍；受控评分标准干预表明偏好信息随潜在序列传递。
AI.conclusion: 连续潜在评估可在保持竞争性判断质量的同时大幅降低推理成本。

title: Do Image Editors Follow Depth-Dependent Blur and Aperture Response? A Rendered-Ground-Truth Pilot Audit
summary: General image editors are asked to make a photo look as if it were taken at f/1.4, yet it is rarely checked whether the blur they add follows thin-lens optics. A physical aperture edit spreads blur across depth in thin-lens proportions and changes the blur when the aperture changes; prior evaluations check blur monotonicity, sharpness-trend correlation, effective-aperture error, or vision-language judgments, and none we found reports the two properties separately at known depths. In this pilot audit of two editors (Gemini~3.1 Flash Image and GPT-image-2.5) we compare against a rendered oracle: Blender Cycles scenes with true thin-lens depth of field, one blur-width estimator applied identically to oracle and editor outputs, and preregistered depth and aperture indices. In 24 texture scenes rendered in one three-panel geometry, accepted and measurable panels show f/1.4-to-f/2.8 width ratios, $\barσ_{1.4}/\barσ_{2.8}$, of 0.99--1.18 against 1.98--2.13 for the oracle, and ratios of pooled median Gaussian-equivalent near/far blur widths of about 1.18--1.25 (Gemini) and 0.97--1.05 (GPT-image) against 1.69--1.82. Preregistered black-box interventions show that qualitative wording changes blur strength by roughly 2--10 times, whereas a request for 2 versus 6 px changes it 1.1--1.3 times and no tested wording of the f-number meets the registered ``followed'' criterion. The depth compression appears in the original and reversed centre-focus layouts; with the focus on the near panel, the available-panel depth index reaches the registered threshold, and the aperture response stays attenuated in every layout tested. Scalar metrics adapted from published ones give oracle-like scores to synthetic editors whose proportions are compressed.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计两个图像编辑器（Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 和 GPT-image-2.5）在模拟 f/1.4 景深时是否遵循薄透镜光学。结果发现，二者虽能生成模糊，但模糊随深度扩散和随光圈变化的响应均被明显压缩，且部分常用标量指标可能给出误导性的高分。
AI.motivation: 用户常要求图像编辑器把照片做得像 f/1.4 拍摄，但很少检查其添加的模糊是否符合薄透镜光学。物理光圈编辑应使模糊按薄透镜比例随深度扩散，并随光圈变化而变化；此前评估多检查模糊单调性、清晰度趋势相关性、有效光圈误差或视觉语言判断，未在已知深度下分别报告这两个关键属性。
AI.method: 采用预注册试点审计，比较两个编辑器与渲染 oracle。oracle 由 Blender Cycles 生成真实薄透镜景深场景；使用同一个模糊宽度估计器处理 oracle 和编辑器输出；在 24 个纹理场景、统一三面板几何中设置已知深度与光圈指数。还进行黑盒干预，测试定性措辞、2 px 与 6 px 请求、f-number 措辞等对模糊强度的影响，并检查原始与反转中心对焦布局。
AI.result: 在可接受且可测量的面板中，f/1.4 到 f/2.8 的模糊宽度比在编辑器中为 0.99–1.18，而 oracle 为 1.98–2.13；近/远高斯等效模糊宽度合并中位数比约为 1.18–1.25（Gemini）和 0.97–1.05（GPT-image），oracle 为 1.69–1.82。定性措辞可改变模糊强度约 2–10 倍，而请求 2 对 6 px 仅改变 1.1–1.3 倍；没有测试的 f-number 措辞满足预注册的“遵循”标准。深度压缩在原始和反转布局中均出现；近面板对焦时深度指数可达阈值，但光圈响应在所有布局中均衰减。改编的标量指标会给比例被压缩的合成编辑器类似 oracle 的分数。
AI.conclusion: 这两个编辑器未正确遵循薄透镜光圈与景深行为：模糊随深度的比例和随光圈的响应都被压缩。常见标量指标可能无法可靠检测此类失败，因此需要在已知深度下分别评估深度扩散与光圈响应。

title: Unified Multi-plane Autoregressive Diffusion for 3D Multi-contrast MRI Synthesis
summary: Acquiring a complete set of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) contrasts is time-intensive and uncomfortable for patients, despite the diagnostic value of multi-contrast imaging. This motivates synthesizing missing contrasts from those already acquired, which is an inherently 3D problem requiring anatomical coherence across axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. However, fully 3D generative models are often impracti- cal under computational resources that scale cubically with volume size. We propose a unified Multi-Plane Autoregressive Diffusion (MPAD), a latent diffusion framework that achieves full-volume 3D synthesis using efficient plane-wise 2D operations while preserving volumetric coherence. A 3D autoencoder first compresses MRI scans into an isotropic 3D la- tent representation. A 2D diffusion model is then trained to reconstruct masked latent slices of the target contrast, conditioned on both source- contrast slices and unmasked target-contrast slices. During inference, we introduce plane-wise autoregressive synthesis with inter-plane priors. Slices are generated autoregressively in random order within one plane orientation to maintain intra-plane continuity, then propagated as con- ditioning priors to orthogonal plane orientations to enforce inter-plane consistency. Compared to 3D latent diffusion baselines, MPAD reduces training and inference FLOPs by 7x and 3x, respectively, while also lowering inference time and peak memory consumption. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MPAD achieves superior perfor- mance, generating high-fidelity 3D volumes and supporting one-to-many translation within a single unified model.

AI.tldr: 提出MPAD，一种多平面自回归扩散框架，用高效的2D平面操作实现全体积3D MRI对比度合成，并保持体数据一致性。
AI.motivation: 多对比度MRI有诊断价值，但完整采集耗时且让患者不适，因此希望从已有对比度合成缺失对比度。该问题本质是3D问题，需要轴状、矢状、冠状面之间的解剖一致性，但全3D生成模型计算量随体积立方增长，资源消耗高。
AI.method: 先用3D自编码器将MRI压缩为各向同性3D隐表示；再用2D扩散模型重建目标对比度的掩码隐切片，条件包括源对比度切片和未掩码的目标对比度切片。推理时采用平面级自回归合成与面间先验：在同一平面方向内随机顺序生成切片以保持面内连续性，再传播到正交平面方向作为条件先验，以增强面间一致性。
AI.result: 与3D隐扩散基线相比，MPAD训练和推理FLOPs分别降低约7倍和3倍，同时降低推理时间和峰值内存。多个数据集实验表明，MPAD性能更优，能生成高保真3D体积，并在单一统一模型中支持一对多翻译。
AI.conclusion: MPAD通过结合3D隐表示与2D扩散及多平面自回归推理，在显著降低计算成本的同时实现高质量全体积3D MRI对比度合成，并保持跨平面一致性。

title: Fast and Robust Teach-and-Repeat Navigation Using MixVPR Visual Place Recognition*
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2025 European Conference on Mobile Robots (ECMR)
summary: Teach-and-repeat navigation systems employing advanced visual place recognition techniques for localization exhibit key attributes for long-term mobile robot navigation, such as the ability to operate in unstructured and dynamic environments. However, existing solutions based on deep-learning techniques are computationally demanding, limiting their applicability. This work introduces a novel and efficient teach-and-repeat system built on the modern visual place recognition method MixVPR. Real-world testing demonstrated its ability to operate both indoors and outdoors, achieving robustness and navigation precision comparable to other state-of-the-art systems. In addition, its lower hardware requirements make it suitable for a wide range of robotic platforms and practical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于MixVPR的高效示教-重复导航系统，在室内外实机测试中实现与先进系统相当的鲁棒性和导航精度，且硬件需求更低。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的视觉位置识别定位方案计算开销大，限制了其在长期移动机器人导航中的实际应用。
AI.method: 采用现代视觉位置识别方法MixVPR构建示教-重复导航系统，并进行真实环境下的室内外测试。
AI.result: 系统能够在室内外运行，鲁棒性和导航精度与其他先进系统相当，同时计算与硬件需求更低。
AI.conclusion: 该系统适合多种机器人平台和实际应用，为资源受限场景提供了高效导航方案。

title: PPCAR-Net: Projection-Refined Parametric 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Sparse X-ray Angiographic Views
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendix. Code and pretrained models: https://github.com/G2304138H/PPCAR-Net . Project page with video results: https://G2304138H.github.io/PPCAR-Net/
summary: Sparse-view 3D coronary reconstruction commonly relies on cross-view correspondence and triangulation, which are vulnerable to vessel overlap and foreshortening, or on volumetric prediction followed by vascular-graph extraction, which does not directly provide centrelines and radii. We introduce PPCAR-Net, a projection-refined parametric coronary artery reconstruction network that directly predicts a branch-structured centreline-and-radius representation without explicit point matching, triangulation, or an intermediate volume. Given a variable number of segmented views, a coarse predictor combines frozen VGGT features with learned branch queries to estimate branch presence, B-spline centreline trajectories, and dense radius profiles. Projection-guided geometry and radius refiners then sample local evidence from the input views and apply residual corrections learned with 3D supervision. We evaluate representation fidelity and sparse-view reconstruction quantitatively and qualitatively. On simulated angiographic masks generated from CT-derived coronary anatomy, PPCAR-Net produces better connected artery reconstructions and achieves strong centreline accuracy, particularly for RCA, while maintaining competitive volumetric overlap. Coarse-to-fine inference takes 121 ms, enabling real-time reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出PPCAR-Net，一种投影细化参数化冠状动脉重建网络，可直接预测分支结构化的中心线与半径表示，无需显式点匹配、三角化或中间体素。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角3D冠状动脉重建常用跨视角对应与三角化，易受血管重叠和透视缩短影响；或先体素预测再提取血管图，不能直接给出中心线和半径。
AI.method: 给定可变数量的分割视图，粗预测器将冻结的VGGT特征与可学习分支查询结合，估计分支存在性、B样条中心线轨迹和密集半径剖面；投影引导的几何与半径细化器从输入视图中采样局部证据，并在3D监督下进行残差校正。
AI.result: 在由CT冠状动脉解剖生成的模拟血管造影掩膜上，PPCAR-Net得到连通性更好的动脉重建，中心线精度强，尤其对RCA，同时保持有竞争力的体积重叠；粗到细推理耗时121 ms，可实现实时重建。
AI.conclusion: PPCAR-Net无需显式匹配、三角化或中间体积，即可实现稀疏视角下参数化冠状动脉中心线与半径重建，并在精度和实时性上表现良好。

title: MIRROR: From Imitation to Internalization in LLM Personalization
summary: The demand for personalized LLMs is shifting from style imitation toward content quality. We investigate whether self-distillation can bridge this gap in existing fine-tuning paradigm. To address this limitation, we introduce MIRROR(Meta- personalization by Internalizing Reference-Revealed On-policy Reflections), a novel self-distillation framework that shifts LLM personalization from imitation toward preference internalization. First, we replace reference-token imitation with reference-revealed on-policy self-distillation, aligning the model's next-token distributions along its own generation trajectories with those of its reference-conditioned self, thereby internalizing user preferences rather than reproducing reference wording.Second, we introduce MIRROR-F, a focal plug-in that augments on-policy distributional alignment with selective supervision over informative reference tokens, thereby strengthening content generation while preserving user-specific expression. Across three personalized generation benchmarks, two model scales, and complementary reference-based and LLM-based evaluations, MIRROR and MIRROR-F achieve leading overall personalization performance and superior text quality, while exhibiting less catastrophic forgetting than SFT-based baselines on three unseen personalized generation tasks. The gains are consistent across model scales and application scenarios, translating to improved performance in LLM personalization tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自蒸馏框架 MIRROR 及插件 MIRROR-F，将大语言模型个性化从参考文本模仿转向用户偏好内化，在多个个性化生成基准上取得领先性能并减少灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 个性化大语言模型的需求正从风格模仿转向内容质量，但现有微调范式难以弥合这一差距，因此作者探究自蒸馏能否解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出 MIRROR 自蒸馏框架：用参考揭示的在线策略自蒸馏替代参考 token 模仿，让模型沿自身生成轨迹对齐其参考条件自模型的下一个 token 分布，从而内化用户偏好；并引入 MIRROR-F 焦点插件，对信息量高的参考 token 进行选择性监督，在保留用户特定表达的同时增强内容生成。
AI.result: 在三个个性化生成基准、两种模型规模和基于参考与基于 LLM 的评估中，MIRROR 与 MIRROR-F 取得领先的总体个性化性能和更优文本质量；在三个未见过的个性化生成任务上，相比基于 SFT 的基线表现出更少的灾难性遗忘；增益在不同模型规模和应用场景中保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏能够弥合个性化中风格模仿与内容质量之间的差距；通过内化用户偏好而非复现参考措辞，MIRROR 系列方法可提升大语言模型个性化任务的整体表现。

title: RLDISCOVER: LLM-driven co-evolution of reinforcement learning algorithms
summary: LLM-guided program evolution has enabled discoveries in mathematics and computational optimization, raising the prospect of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms that self-evolve to improve how agents learn. However, realizing this prospect faces two obstacles. Joint search over coupled algorithmic components is difficult to scale: simultaneous changes can disrupt learning, while isolated changes overlook their dependencies. Evaluating candidate algorithms also requires costly training, with fitness remaining uncertain across random seeds. We introduce RLDiscover, a framework for the self-evolution of model-free deep RL algorithms. Progressive Co-Evolution advances from targeted component edits to joint evolution, while Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation balances search breadth and evaluation fidelity through staged training and repeated evaluation. Experiments across SAC, PPO, and DQN on four benchmark suites show substantial improvements in mean return, with per-family median gains of 32%-84% and a peak return ratio of approximately 363x over a near-zero baseline. These gains include transitions from failed learning to successful task completion, and improvements persist when evolution starts from stronger open-source implementations. On measured SAC locomotion runs, evaluation uses approximately one-fifteenth the estimated compute required to fully evaluate the same candidate pool. Remarkably, independent searches repeatedly discover interpretable combinations of adaptive robust losses, progress-dependent value targets, and running statistics, with selected programs transferring to unseen tasks. These findings point toward a broader role for self-evolution in AI: discovering interpretable algorithms that improve how agents learn.

AI.tldr: 提出RLDiscover框架，通过LLM引导的程序自进化来自动发现无模型深度强化学习算法，在多个基准上显著提升学习性能，并能发现可解释、可迁移的算法组件组合。
AI.motivation: LLM引导的程序进化已在数学和优化中展现潜力，有望让RL算法自我进化以改进智能体的学习方式；但面临耦合算法组件联合搜索难扩展，以及候选算法评估训练成本高、受随机种子影响不确定等障碍。
AI.method: RLDiscover包含两个核心机制：渐进式协同进化，从针对性组件编辑逐步过渡到联合进化，以平衡独立修改与耦合依赖；渐进式概率评估，通过分阶段训练和重复评估来平衡搜索广度与评估保真度。
AI.result: 在SAC、PPO和DQN及四个基准套件上，平均回报大幅提升，各算法家族中位数增益为32%-84%，峰值回报比近零基线高约363倍；部分从学习失败转为成功完成任务，且从更强开源实现出发仍有效。测量SAC locomotion运行中，评估计算量约为完整评估同一候选池估计计算量的1/15。独立搜索反复发现可解释的自适应鲁棒损失、进度依赖价值目标和运行统计等组合，且所选程序可迁移到未见任务。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明自进化在AI中有更广泛作用：能够发现可解释的算法来改进智能体的学习方式。

title: Design optimization of tendon-driven robots considering tendon wrapping and shortcut
summary: This study proposes a multi-objective optimization method for tendon-driven arm design, addressing the inherent trade-off between joint torque and arm thickness through tendon wrapping and shortcut effects. We formulate the problem to simultaneously maximize torque and minimize thickness, solved using NSGA-II. The algorithm optimizes tendon routing, pulley configurations, and attachment points. Results reveal Pareto-optimal designs with effective moment arm expansion via strategic shortcuts, providing practical guidelines for compact high-torque arms. The optimized configurations demonstrate non-trivial patterns beyond conventional design intuition, offering new insights for engineering efficient robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种腱驱动机器人手臂的多目标优化设计方法，通过腱绕线与捷径效应权衡关节扭矩与手臂厚度，并使用NSGA-II求解。
AI.motivation: 腱驱动机器人手臂设计中，关节扭矩与手臂厚度之间存在固有矛盾，传统设计难以同时实现高扭矩与紧凑结构。
AI.method: 将问题建模为同时最大化扭矩和最小化厚度的多目标优化问题，采用NSGA-II算法优化腱路径、滑轮配置和附着点。
AI.result: 得到帕累托最优设计，显示通过策略性捷径可有效扩展力臂，并发现超越传统设计直觉的非平凡优化构型。
AI.conclusion: 研究为紧凑高扭矩手臂设计提供实用指南，并为高效机器人系统设计提供新见解。

title: Decoupling Logic from Persona: Structural Immunity of Edge LLM Agents to Context Pollution
comment: 28 pages, 3 figures. Experiment code, scoring rubric, pollution fixtures, adapters and run logs are released (see Appendix G)
summary: Small language-model agents on edge devices must hold a persona and reason correctly at once, inside one context window that fills with conversational history and persona instructions. We study what happens to the logical part of such an agent when that history is long, misleading and persona-heavy (persona-logic interference), and present a Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) that separates logical inference ("What") from persona expression ("How") into two inference paths on one INT4 base model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters. The logic path receives only the core turn and emits a verifiable structured state (Micro-State); the persona path renders it in character with the full history. In same-base-model ablations on an Apple M2 laptop (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B-it, 4-bit; 480 runs over 4 pollution levels x 3 arms x 2 tasks x 2 personas x 5 seeds) we find: (i) the decoupled logic path is structurally invariant to pollution: its prompt stays at 180 (Llama) or 167 (Gemma) tokens while the mixed single-pass prompt grows from 242 to 1,203, and its outputs are byte-identical across levels (40/40); (ii) the mixed single pass degrades monotonically (composite logic score 0.669 to 0.150 on Llama, 0.487 to 0.150 on Gemma), mostly by failing to emit the required structured output (80-95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels); (iii) with the same pollution fed into the decoupled logic path, the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path is still more robust than the single pass on the 8B model (failure 0-20% vs 80-95%; paired $Δ$ +0.30 to +0.50, Cliff's $δ$ 0.50-0.85, Holm-adjusted $p \le 0.03$) but not on the 4B model, where both collapse. Separation costs one extra decode on a topic's first turn (28.2 s vs 18.2 s on Llama) and buys persona hot-swapping in 1.7 ms without re-running the logic path. Code, rubric, fixtures, adapters and logs are released.

AI.tldr: 论文研究边缘设备小模型智能体在长且误导性、人格化历史中出现的“人格-逻辑干扰”，提出解耦架构 AO-DA，将逻辑推理（What）与人格表达（How）拆成两条推理路径，共享同一 INT4 基座模型并可热插拔 LoRA。实验表明解耦逻辑路径对污染结构性不变，8B 模型上更稳健，但 4B 模型上增益消失。
AI.motivation: 单上下文窗口同时承载人格指令和对话历史，长历史与污染可能损害智能体的逻辑推理能力；作者希望验证并解决人格表达与逻辑推理相互干扰的问题。
AI.method: 提出 AO-DA 解耦架构：逻辑路径只接收核心对话轮，输出可验证的结构化状态 Micro-State；人格路径结合完整历史将其按人格渲染。两条路径在同一 INT4 基座模型上用可热插拔 LoRA adapter 实现。在 Apple M2 笔记本上对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Gemma-3-4B-it 做 4-bit 同基座消融，共 480 次运行：4 种污染水平 × 3 个实验臂 × 2 任务 × 2 人格 × 5 随机种子。
AI.result: （i）解耦逻辑路径对污染结构性不变：提示长度固定在 180（Llama）或 167（Gemma）token，而混合单次提示从 242 增至 1203，输出在 40/40 情况下逐字节一致。（ii）混合单次路径随污染单调退化：Llama 综合逻辑分从 0.669 降至 0.150，Gemma 从 0.487 降至 0.150，主要失败原因是未能输出所需结构化结果（Llama 在最高两级污染中 80%-95% 运行失败，Gemma 为 100%）。（iii）将同样污染输入解耦逻辑路径时，8B 模型上专用 adapter 和专用格式路径仍优于单次路径：失败率 0%-20% vs 80%-95%，配对 Δ +0.30 至 +0.50，Cliff's δ 0.50-0.85，Holm 校正后 p ≤ 0.03；但 4B 模型上两者均崩溃。分离成本为首轮多一次解码（Llama 28.2s vs 18.2s），但可在 1.7ms 内热切换人格且无需重跑逻辑路径。代码、评分标准、测试夹具、adapter 和日志均已发布。
AI.conclusion: AO-DA 能显著提升长且污染历史下的逻辑鲁棒性和结构化输出稳定性，并支持高效人格热切换，适合边缘设备智能体；但其有效性依赖模型规模，在 4B 模型上未能保持优势。

title: CM-DPO: Constraint-Margin Direct Preference Optimization for LLM Planning
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats all constraint violations equally: a $1 budget overshoot and a $1,000 overshoot induce the same training signal. It is also susceptible to length and style bias when preference pairs come from different model families. We introduce Constraint-Margin DPO (CM-DPO), which replaces DPO's binary preference signal with a continuous margin derived from a deterministic symbolic verifier and scaled by violation severity. Hard and soft constraints are separated through a lexicographic objective, ensuring hard constraints are never traded off against preferences. To supply CM-DPO with bias-reduced training pairs, we generate preference data through procedurally generated constraint profiles (DCCG) and minimal-edit distillation from a reasoning teacher (RT-MED), within a framework we call SynPlan-R. On TravelPlanner, NaturalPlan, and out-of-distribution PlanBench, an 8B model fine-tuned with CM-DPO achieves 89.2% pass rate and 93.4% solve rate, matching multi-agent systems at 13x lower latency while outperforming GPT-4o on unseen Blocksworld by 9.2 points.

AI.tldr: 提出 Constraint-Margin DPO（CM-DPO），用基于符号验证器的连续违规严重度边际替代 DPO 的二元偏好信号，并结合 SynPlan-R 数据生成框架，在规划任务上以 8B 模型取得高通过率与求解率。
AI.motivation: DPO 将所有约束违规视为同等错误，1 美元与 1000 美元的预算超支产生相同训练信号；同时，当偏好对来自不同模型族时，DPO 易受长度和风格偏差影响。
AI.method: CM-DPO 使用确定性符号验证器计算连续 margin，并按违规严重度缩放；通过 lexicographic 目标分离硬约束与软约束，避免硬约束被偏好权衡。数据侧提出 SynPlan-R 框架，包括程序化生成约束配置（DCCG）和来自推理教师的最小编辑蒸馏（RT-MED），以提供偏差更小的偏好数据。
AI.result: 在 TravelPlanner、NaturalPlan 和分布外 PlanBench 上，8B 模型经 CM-DPO 微调后达到 89.2% pass rate、93.4% solve rate；以 13 倍更低延迟匹配多智能体系统，并在未见过的 Blocksworld 上超过 GPT-4o 9.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CM-DPO 通过连续、严重度感知的约束边际和硬软约束分离，提升了规划中的约束满足能力与泛化性，同时保持较高效率。

title: NAViLoss: An Underwater Navigation-Aware Dual-Residual Objective for Physics-Consistent Learning
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) commonly rely on inertial navigation systems (INS) aided by Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) for reliable underwater navigation. Accurate DVL velocity estimation is therefore essential for successful operation. Recent learning-based methods have demonstrated improved DVL velocity estimation, particularly under degraded measurement conditions. However, their training objectives typically rely on conventional regression losses that are highly sensitive to large residuals and corrupted observations. Additionally, they do not explicitly account for the physical consistency and measurement uncertainty associated with the underlying sensing process. To address these limitations, this paper introduces navigation-aware loss (NAViLoss), a robust and uncertainty-aware objective function for learning-based AUV velocity estimation. NAViLoss jointly penalizes the velocity-estimation residual in the navigation-state domain and the beam-consistency residual in the DVL measurement domain. Its bounded formulation limits the influence of large residuals, while an adaptive mechanism regulates the uncertainty in beam geometry. Furthermore, NAViLoss is integrated with a DeepONet architecture to form a novel NAVi-DeepONet model for seamless estimation of an underwater vehicle's velocity. Lastly, our model is evaluated using approximately 10,000m of semi-synthetic AUV experimental data collected during multiple real-world sea trials. Experimental results demonstrate a 44% improvement in velocity-estimation accuracy compared with conventional and learning-based baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of navigation-aware and uncertainty-adaptive loss design for robust learning-based underwater velocity estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向AUV速度估计的导航感知损失函数NAViLoss，并将其与DeepONet结合为NAVi-DeepONet，用于提升基于学习的DVL速度估计精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的DVL速度估计方法多采用传统回归损失，对大的残差和损坏观测敏感，且未显式考虑物理一致性和测量不确定性。
AI.method: 提出鲁棒且不确定性感知的NAViLoss，联合惩罚导航状态域中的速度估计残差与DVL测量域中的波束一致性残差；采用有界形式限制大残差影响，并通过自适应机制调节波束几何不确定性；将NAViLoss与DeepONet集成，形成NAVi-DeepONet模型。
AI.result: 使用多个真实海上试验采集的约10,000米半合成AUV实验数据进行评估，相比传统和基于学习的基线，速度估计精度提升44%。
AI.conclusion: 导航感知和不确定性自适应的损失设计能够有效提升基于学习的鲁棒水下速度估计性能。

title: Do Better Visual Representations Always Lead to Better End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
summary: Visual foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly integrated into end-to-end autonomous driving for their powerful representations, yet it remains unclear when these representations improve driving performance. To investigate this question, we introduce ViRA, a planner-agnostic visual representation alignment framework that keeps the planner architecture and inference cost unchanged. Our study reveals three findings: (1) VFM-guided visual representations consistently improve driving performance across diverse end-to-end planners, with gains extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation. (2) The choice of VFM target matters for planning performance, and alignment to a different VFM can further benefit planners with pre-trained VFM encoders. (3) Auxiliary perception supervision reduces sensitivity to VFM target selection, narrowing the EPDMS spread across five targets from 2.7 to 0.5 points and potentially compensating for less effective VFM targets. Guided by these findings, we develop ViRA-Diffusion, a diffusion-based planner trained without auxiliary perception supervision, which achieves 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest, outperforming recent methods in our comparison by at least 1.9 points. The results motivate jointly considering target selection and planner supervision when integrating VFMs into end-to-end autonomous driving. The results and demo are available at https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出规划器无关的视觉表征对齐框架ViRA，研究视觉基础模型（VFM）何时能提升端到端自动驾驶性能，并基于发现构建ViRA-Diffusion，在NAVSIM v2上取得92.3 EPDMS。
AI.motivation: VFM虽被广泛用于端到端自动驾驶，但其表征何时真正提升驾驶性能尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出ViRA：一种保持规划器结构与推理成本不变的规划器无关视觉表征对齐框架；并基于研究发现开发了无需辅助感知监督的扩散规划器ViRA-Diffusion。
AI.result: 发现三点：VFM引导的表征可稳定提升多种端到端规划器性能，并泛化到零样本闭环评估；不同VFM目标会影响规划性能；辅助感知监督可降低对VFM目标选择的敏感性，将五个目标间的EPDMS差距从2.7缩小到0.5。ViRA-Diffusion在NAVSIM v2 navtest上达到92.3 EPDMS，至少领先对比方法1.9分。
AI.conclusion: 将VFM集成到端到端自动驾驶时，应联合考虑VFM目标选择与规划器监督设计。

title: Quantifying Volumetric Risk: Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Reliable volumetric segmentation is critical for clinical diagnostics, yet foundation models such as MedSAM remain deterministic and lack calibrated uncertainty under distribution shift. Existing conformal prediction methods offer statistical guarantees but are frequently applied in 2D and assume symmetric error distributions, so they do not capture the class-specific biases that arise in 3D multi-class segmentation. We propose Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction (CA-WCP), which combines latent-space density-ratio weighting for covariate shift with directional quantiles for the lower and upper volume bounds, and scales each bound by a class-specific asymmetry factor derived from validation-set false-positive and false-negative rates. We prove that CA-WCP retains the weighted-exchangeability marginal coverage guarantee for every class, and we evaluate it on 3D brain tumor segmentation (BraTS 2020) and on a synthetic multi-organ CT benchmark constructed under covariate shift. On both benchmarks the 95\% Clopper--Pearson interval for the observed coverage of CA-WCP contains the nominal 90\% level for every semantic class, while interval width is reduced by 8--14\% relative to symmetric weighted conformal prediction. We further encode the calibrated intervals into structured prompts for a multimodal large language model to produce uncertainty-conditioned radiology reports, linking distribution-shift-aware uncertainty quantification to interpretable clinical communication.

AI.tldr: 提出类别感知非对称加权保形预测（CA-WCP），用于3D多类分割中的分布偏移下不确定性量化。方法在保持每类边际覆盖保证的同时，比对称加权保形预测缩小了区间宽度，并可用于生成带有不确定性条件的放射学报告。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断需要可靠的体积分割，但MedSAM等基础模型是确定性的，缺乏分布偏移下校准的不确定性。现有保形预测多在2D应用且假设误差对称，无法捕捉3D多类分割中的类别特异偏差。
AI.method: CA-WCP结合潜空间密度比加权以处理协变量偏移，使用方向分位数分别估计体积下界和上界，并依据验证集假阳性率和假阴性率推导类别特异非对称因子来缩放边界。作者证明其保留每类的加权可交换边际覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020 3D脑肿瘤分割和协变量偏移下的合成多器官CT基准上，CA-WCP每类观测覆盖率的95% Clopper-Pearson区间均包含名义90%水平，且区间宽度相较对称加权保形预测减少8–14%。还将校准区间编码为结构化提示，输入多模态大语言模型生成不确定性条件化的放射学报告。
AI.conclusion: CA-WCP能够在分布偏移下为3D多类分割提供类别感知、非对称且保持覆盖保证的不确定性区间，并将此类不确定性量化与可解释的临床沟通相连接。

title: A Deafening Silence: Catastrophic Forgetting Lives in the Output Embeddings of Tokens the Data Never Speaks
summary: Continual pre-training and fine-tuning in Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably induce catastrophic forgetting, typically mitigated by replay using often-inaccessible original data. In this data-free regime, we analyze where forgetting occurs and why. Systematic parameter freezing across five settings up to 1.4B reveals that forgetting concentrates selectively in the output embeddings of tokens rarely seen in the new corpus, whereas the same sqrt(v-hat) band of the body is inert and new learning resides elsewhere. This localization is governed by the vocabulary deficiency of the corpus rather than the training mode, allowing pre-retraining risk ranking from token counts alone within a fixed base model. Mechanistically, absent tokens receive persistent one-sided softmax gradients that Adam's second-moment (sqrt(v-hat)) normalization amplifies into full-sized updates. We therefore propose an intervention: raising Adam's epsilon exclusively for the output projection during training. Across eight settings spanning 160M to 12B parameters and four model families, this removes 39.4% to 67.9% of forgetting across all seven stable configurations without degrading target learning or requiring per-model tuning. The defense combines additively or better with replay (79.8% on Qwen/Korean) and rescues released-head LoRA from a 23-fold forgetting surge. Because post-hoc editing of the drifted rows recovers under 5% of forgetting, the intervention must operate during training. Our findings indicate that a single-line optimizer adjustment may serve as the primary defense against catastrophic forgetting where the corpus starves the vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM持续预训练/微调中的数据无关灾难性遗忘，发现遗忘主要集中在输出嵌入中在新语料里罕见出现的token上，并提出仅对输出投影提高Adam epsilon的优化器干预来缓解遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续预训练和微调会引发灾难性遗忘，而常见回放方法依赖原始数据，在原始数据不可得的数据无关场景中难以使用，因此需要理解遗忘发生在哪里、为何发生，并寻找无需原始数据的防御方法。
AI.method: 通过最多1.4B参数的五种参数冻结设置系统定位遗忘位置；结合token计数分析词表缺乏与遗忘风险；从softmax梯度和Adam二阶动量归一化角度解释机制；提出在训练期间仅对输出投影提高Adam epsilon；在160M到12B参数、四个模型家族、八种设置上验证，并与回放、LoRA等结合测试。
AI.result: 遗忘选择性集中在输出嵌入中在新语料中罕见token上，而主体模型相同sqrt(v-hat)区间较惰性；该现象由语料词表缺乏而非训练模式主导，可仅凭token计数进行预训练风险排序。缺失token获得持续单侧softmax梯度，被Adam二阶矩归一化放大为完整更新。提高输出投影的Adam epsilon可在七个稳定配置中消除39.4%到67.9%的遗忘，不损害目标学习且无需逐模型调参；与回放结合可更好，在Qwen/韩语上达79.8%；还能挽救released-head LoRA的23倍遗忘激增。事后编辑漂移行仅能恢复不到5%的遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘的关键机制是语料词表缺乏导致输出嵌入漂移，因此防御必须在训练期间进行；仅调整优化器的一行代码即可在词表匮乏场景下作为对抗灾难性遗忘的主要防御手段。

title: Training Advisors for LLM Agents from Task Outcomes
summary: Large language model agents tackle multi-step tasks by interleaving reasoning and tool calls with observations from the environment. Prior work has shown that natural-language feedback can help these agents revise their decisions during task execution. We introduce Caddie, a method for training critics to provide natural-language analysis and advice as agents work through a task. Unlike approaches that rely on step-level labels or reference critiques, Caddie learns from whether the agent ultimately succeeds after receiving the critic's feedback. We optimize the critic through reinforcement learning while keeping the base model frozen. Trained on multi-hop question answering with a single base model, our Qwen3-4B critic improves success rates across four base models of different scales and architectures, including three not used during critic training. On the MuSiQue benchmark, the trained critic improves Qwen3-4B's success rate by more than 25 percentage points, surpassing the performance of Kimi K3 without a critic. The same critic also yields gains on out-of-domain interactive benchmarks, including $τ^3$ and DeepDive, with no additional training. Our results show that agents can decide when to seek help from a critic at inference time and that outcome-based critic training can produce guidance that transfers across base models and task domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Caddie，一种训练 critic 在 LLM agent 执行多步任务时提供自然语言分析与建议的方法；critic 基于最终任务成功与否进行强化学习，无需 step-level 标签或参考评论，并能跨模型、跨任务迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM agent 通过交替推理、工具调用和环境观察完成多步任务，自然语言反馈可帮助其修正决策；但已有方法常依赖 step-level 标签或参考 critiques，成本高且难扩展。作者希望仅凭最终结果来训练 critic，使其提供可迁移的指导。
AI.method: Caddie 在 base model 冻结的情况下，通过强化学习优化 critic。critic 不依赖逐步标签，而是根据 agent 在收到反馈后最终是否成功来学习。训练任务为 multi-hop question answering，使用单一 base model 训练 Qwen3-4B critic。
AI.result: 在 MuSiQue 上，训练后的 critic 使 Qwen3-4B 成功率提升超过 25 个百分点，超过无 critic 的 Kimi K3。该 critic 还提升了四种不同规模与架构 base model 的表现，其中三种未参与 critic 训练。在未额外训练的情况下，也在 out-of-domain 交互式 benchmark τ^3 和 DeepDive 上取得增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，agent 可以在推理时决定何时寻求 critic 帮助；基于结果的 critic 训练能够产生跨 base model 和任务领域迁移的指导。

title: Trajectory Abstraction for the Science of Language Agent Behavior
summary: Scientific studies of language agents need behavioral variables that support hypotheses across tasks and models. We formulate this research problem as learning and testing a hierarchy of trajectory abstractions. A concrete recursive procedure first measures role- and phase-indexed events, proposes temporally constrained relations, and tests their stability across conditions. It then constructs episode-level motif variables from selected relations and repeats the analysis on those variables. Explicit measurement functions connect every abstraction level to the original trajectories. Observations and randomized protocol experiments assess the resulting hypotheses, while comparisons between intervention realizations determine whether an abstraction should be retained, refined, or restricted. We derive a finite-depth bound for accepted reductions, identify protocol effects on fixed abstractions, and characterize realization disagreement and composition of abstraction error. A finite-sample test makes projected intervention consistency operational, and constructed examples illustrate motif construction and abstraction refinement. The formulation distinguishes this experimental approach from semantic taxonomies, qualitative theory induction, and behavior-model recovery. It specifies a proposed research procedure for discovering generalizable behavioral hypotheses, with literature-relative novelty assessed separately from model-relative surprise.

AI.tldr: 提出一种层级轨迹抽象的学习与检验程序，用于为语言智能体研究构建跨任务、跨模型的行为变量。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体研究缺乏能支持跨任务、跨模型假设的行为变量。
AI.method: 递归流程：先测量角色与阶段索引事件，提出时间约束关系并检验其跨条件稳定性；再基于选定关系构建情节级 motif 变量并重复分析。用显式测量函数连接各抽象层级与原始轨迹；通过观察和随机协议实验评估假设，并比较干预实现以决定抽象应保留、细化还是限制。
AI.result: 推导出可接受归约的有限深度界，识别协议对固定抽象的影响，刻画实现分歧与抽象误差的复合；提出有限样本检验使投影干预一致性可操作；构造示例展示 motif 构建与抽象细化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将实验方法与语义分类、定性理论归纳、行为模型恢复区分开，为发现可泛化行为假设提供研究程序，并将文献相对新颖性与模型相对惊奇性分开评估。

title: TiTok: Audio-Visual LLM for Multi-Segment Temporal Grounding
summary: Audio-visual multi-segment grounding (AV-MSG) in untrimmed videos, reasoning over audio-visual evidence and predicting multiple segments for a query, is a fundamental problem but remains challenging. Visual-only models overlook complementary acoustic cues, while audio-visual models often fail to calibrate the number of events - a phenomenon we refer to as count miscalibration. We present TiTok, an audio-visual large language model (AV-LLM) that localizes an arbitrary number of temporal event segments for each query. For precise boundary prediction, we introduce the Time Token Interleaving (TTI) method, which explicitly injects special time tokens into the audio-visual stream to align input-side temporal perception with output-side temporal prediction. We further propose decoupled, multi-segment-oriented rewards for reinforcement learning, consisting of global, local, count, precision, and format rewards, optimized with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). To assess the performance on AV-MSG, we establish a new UnAV-100-based evaluation protocol, and propose the CountF1 metric for quantifying count miscalibration that overlap metrics fail to capture. TiTok reaches 65.7 mIoU and 0.58 CountF1, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at this link.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TiTok，一种用于未剪辑视频中音视频多片段定位（AV-MSG）的音视频大语言模型，能针对查询定位任意数量的时间事件片段，并在新评测协议上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有纯视觉模型忽略互补的声学线索，而音视频模型常无法正确校准事件数量，即存在“数量误校准”问题，因此 AV-MSG 仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出 TiTok 音视频大语言模型；采用时间令牌交错（TTI）将特殊时间令牌注入音视频流，以对齐输入侧时间感知与输出侧时间预测；提出面向多片段的解耦强化学习奖励，包括全局、局部、数量、精度和格式奖励，并用 GDPO 优化；建立基于 UnAV-100 的新评测协议和 CountF1 指标。
AI.result: TiTok 达到 65.7 mIoU 和 0.58 CountF1，取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
AI.conclusion: TiTok 能有效处理任意数量时间片段定位，缓解数量误校准，并通过新指标更全面评估 AV-MSG；代码已公开。

title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Phase-Conditioned Flow Matching
summary: Cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) analysis relies on multi-frame sequences capturing the full cardiac cycle. However, standard multi-frame acquisition depends heavily on electrocardiogram (ECG) gating and repeated breath-holds, posing challenges in uncooperative populations, resource-limited settings, and temporally corrupted datasets. Existing methods that synthesize full cardiac sequences either rely on explicit ECG signals to parameterize myocardium function, or employ deformable registration without physiological constraints, failing to faithfully reproduce clinically relevant dynamic metrics such as ejection fraction (EF) and ventricular contraction magnitude. We present PhaseFlow, a unified generative framework that overcomes both limitations. PhaseFlow estimates a non-linear cardiac phase signal directly from the input sequence via a segmentation-derived left-ventricular (LV) area curve, capturing the asymmetric dynamics of systole and diastole without any ECG dependency. At inference, this phase signal is provided by a pathology-specific template, informing phase-specific frame generation. A rectified flow model conditioned on the phase and slice position synthesizes the full cardiac motion trajectory in the latent space, decoded into a diffeomorphic displacement field that warps end-diastole pixel intensities directly, eliminating the reconstruction blur often accompanying the variational autoencoder. On the ACDC benchmark, PhaseFlow achieves superior physiological fidelity and image realism, with best LV volume curve $R^2$, structural similarity (SSIM) and generative quality (FID) among all baselines. Ablation studies confirm that each proposed component contributes measurably to the overall performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhaseFlow，一种无需 ECG 的统一生成框架，用于合成完整心脏电影 CMR 序列，并在 ACDC 基准上取得更优的生理保真度与图像真实感。
AI.motivation: 标准多帧电影 CMR 采集依赖 ECG 门控和反复屏气，在不配合人群、资源有限场景或时间受损数据中难以应用；现有序列合成方法要么依赖显式 ECG 参数化心肌功能，要么使用无生理约束的可变形配准，难以忠实复现 EF、心室收缩幅度等临床动态指标。
AI.method: PhaseFlow 通过分割导出的左心室面积曲线直接从输入序列估计非线性心脏相位信号，不依赖 ECG，并捕捉收缩期与舒张期的不对称动态；推理时由病理特异性模板提供相位信号。采用以相位和切片位置为条件的整流流模型，在潜空间中合成完整心脏运动轨迹，并解码为微分同胚位移场，直接对舒张末期像素强度进行形变，避免 VAE 重建模糊。
AI.result: 在 ACDC 基准上，PhaseFlow 在生理保真度和图像真实感方面优于所有基线，取得最佳 LV 容积曲线 R²、SSIM 和生成质量 FID；消融实验证实各组件均有可测贡献。
AI.conclusion: PhaseFlow 克服了现有方法对 ECG 的依赖及缺乏生理约束的问题，能够统一生成完整心脏运动序列并忠实复现关键动态指标，验证了相位引导与整流流形变生成框架的有效性。

title: RoboPace: Contact-Aware Time-Optimal Retiming for Action-Chunk Policies
summary: Robot manipulation data collection has been shifting from teleoperation toward robot-free demonstrations, through interfaces such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) or directly from human hands. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained on such data inherit the demonstrator's timing. Yet human timing does not directly transfer to robots: compliant hands tolerate fast contact, whereas robots may overshoot due to actuator and tracking limitations; conversely, robots can move faster in free space. This motivates a unified approach that reconciles execution speed with contact safety. We present RoboPace, an online retiming layer that preserves the policy's geometric path while adapting its timing, respecting the target robot's kinematic and dynamic constraints. It adapts execution speed based on predicted contact, jointly accounting for contact-dependent speed limits and the robot's motion constraints. The method requires no policy retraining and operates in real time. Across three contact-rich tasks on a dual-arm robot, faster uniform execution and physical-limit-only retiming largely fail. RoboPace instead achieves higher overall success than slow uniform execution while completing four of five commands in approximately half the time, retaining the reliability of slow execution without its time cost.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RoboPace，一种在线重定时层，可在不重新训练策略的情况下，根据预测接触和机器人运动约束调整执行速度，从而兼顾任务成功率与执行效率。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作数据采集正从遥操作转向无机器人演示，如 UMI 或人手直接演示。VLA 策略会继承演示者的时序，但人类时序无法直接迁移到机器人：柔性手可承受快速接触，而机器人可能因执行器和跟踪限制而过冲；同时机器人在自由空间可更快移动。因此需要统一协调执行速度与接触安全。
AI.method: RoboPace 保留策略的几何路径，仅在线调整其时序。它根据预测接触自适应执行速度，联合考虑接触相关速度限制和机器人运动学/动力学约束，无需策略重训练，并可实时运行。
AI.result: 在双臂机器人的三个富接触任务中，更快的均匀执行和仅考虑物理限制的重定时大多失败。RoboPace 的总体成功率高于慢速均匀执行，同时五条指令中有四条能在约一半时间内完成，既保持慢速执行的可靠性，又避免其时间成本。
AI.conclusion: RoboPace 通过在线重定时有效解决了无机器人演示数据训练 VLA 策略时的时序迁移问题，在不牺牲接触安全与可靠性的前提下显著提升执行速度。

title: Itgan at NADI 2026 shared task: Parameter-Efficient Whisper Adaptation for Robust, Mixed-Dialect and Code-Switched Arabic ASR
summary: We describe the Itgan systems for the three ASR subtasks of NADI 2026, namely robust country-level ASR (1.1), mixed-dialect ASR (1.2), and Tunisian code-switched ASR (1.3). All three share one recipe, Whisper adapted with LoRA on consumer GPUs, and each was carried by a different addition to it. On 1.1, where the dialect label is given at test time, per-dialect specialists continued from a pooled adapter gave the largest gain, and the submitted system reached 57.1% country-average WER. A post-evaluation linear probe on frozen encoder features routes utterances without the label and recovers 44% of what oracle routing gives. On 1.2 the choice of base model mattered more than adapter capacity, and system combination helped only once we added a decorrelated member, reaching 46.7% WER. On 1.3 our system placed second at 14.49% WER with the lowest CER among the leading submissions, 5.38%. Its last 0.60 WER points came without further training, mostly from an exact weight-space average of independently trained runs, with ROVER voting adding the remainder. Every comparison carries a paired-bootstrap test, and we report eight directions that did not work.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ITGAN系统在NADI 2026三个阿拉伯语ASR子任务（国家级鲁棒ASR、混合方言ASR、突尼斯语码转换ASR）上的方案，均基于消费级GPU上使用LoRA微调的Whisper模型，并分别加入不同改进。
AI.motivation: 参与NADI 2026阿拉伯方言语音识别挑战，针对三个子任务探索在消费级GPU上高效适配Whisper模型的方法，并系统评估不同改进策略的效果。
AI.method: 共享同一配方：Whisper + LoRA在消费级GPU上微调。子任务1.1利用测试时方言标签，从池化适配器继续训练方言专家，并后评估线性探针路由；1.2比较基础模型与适配器容量，采用系统组合并加入去相关成员；1.3使用独立训练运行的精确权重空间平均及ROVER投票。所有比较均使用配对bootstrap检验。
AI.result: 1.1达到57.1%国家级平均WER，后评估线性探针路由恢复oracle路由44%的增益；1.2达到46.7% WER；1.3以14.49% WER排名第二，CER最低为5.38%，最后0.60 WER提升来自无额外训练的权重平均和ROVER投票。
AI.conclusion: 基于Whisper+LoRA的轻量适配在三个ASR子任务上均有效，但不同任务需针对性改进：1.1受益于方言专家，1.2基础模型选择比适配器容量更重要，1.3通过权重平均和ROVER投票获得显著提升；另报告了八个无效方向。

title: The Winner's Curse in LLM Self-Improvement Loops: Selection Noise, Lock-in, and Acceptance Rules
comment: 34 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables; code and saved experimental records included as ancillary files
summary: Self-improving LLM systems propose changes to themselves and keep those that score better on a small evaluation set. We treat this keep-if-better step as selection under measurement noise, model the correlated errors of the candidates in a single decision, and study empirically what happens when the evaluation set is reused. In runs where Qwen models rewrite their own instructions and every candidate is also scored on 600 held-out items, most proposals after the first are harmful, and the model gives the size of the winner's curse of a generation's best candidate. With a prior from a separate pilot, it matches the average overstatement of first-generation commits in native loops, though not setting by setting. In a pre-registered study, the final selection-set score of greedy loops exceeded held-out accuracy by 13 to 20 points with 16 selection items and by 1 to 5 points with 256. Held-out gains grew with the selection set on TREC but not on GSM8K, and the tested acceptance rules did not beat greedy acceptance over whole runs. Gains measured on the selection set also exceeded held-out gains when a current model refined a competent instruction, and in the validation scores of GEPA and MIPROv2. Scoring the starting and the current instruction on 64 items never used for selection removes the average bias of a loop's reported gain, but single estimates remain off by about 6 points. Self-improvement studies should report held-out gains with their uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 将自改进LLM系统的“更好才保留”视为测量噪声下的选择问题，研究发现小评估集重复使用会因赢家诅咒导致选择集分数高估真实泛化，建议报告留出集增益及其不确定性。
AI.motivation: 自改进LLM系统常在小评估集上选择候选，但评估噪声和重复使用可能使保留决策偏向过拟合，需要量化这种偏差。
AI.method: 将保留决策建模为测量噪声下的选择，并联合建模候选的相关误差；用Qwen模型重写自身指令，在600个留出项上评分；进行预注册实验，比较16与256个选择项、贪心接受规则、TREC与GSM8K，并检查GEPA和MIPROv2的验证分数；用未参与选择的64项评分校正。
AI.result: 第一代之后多数提案有害；选择集分数比留出准确率高13至20点（16项）和1至5点（256项）；TREC上留出增益随选择集增大，GSM8K上没有；测试的接受规则未优于贪心接受；GEPA和MIPROv2验证分数也高估；新鲜64项可消除平均偏差，但单次估计仍约差6点。
AI.conclusion: 自改进研究应报告留出集增益及其不确定性，避免仅依赖小选择集分数。

title: We Query, Therefore We Compute: On Oracle Computation beyond the Machine, with an Application to Agents
summary:
Agentic systems use large language models (LLMs) to carry out concrete tasks. Prior work often borrows abstractions such as scheduling, caching or isolation piecemeal from operating systems, so the mechanisms it builds share little common ground, and the shared view of the two forms of agentic system, Workflows and Agents, is limited. We construct an abstract machine that provides both.
  We treat the LLM as an Oracle and extend a two-stack pushdown automaton with one instruction, which hands the Oracle a whole stack as its query and appends the answer to that same stack. The machine thus performs two computations, the Oracle's and a Turing-complete one that we call the Priestess. A stack that the program only appends to grows autoregressively, as an agent's context does. Two symmetry breakings, S in storage and T in transitions, make a Priestess program the operating system of the programs the Oracle runs, and produce the Agent and the Workflow as the two placements of a task's program.
  For internally autoregressive Oracles, the two computations synchronize at the end of every answer under certain conditions, and through that synchronization we model caching and analyse scheduling. No guarantee that holds for every Oracle can fix which content crosses between the two computations, but such a guarantee does fix the boundary itself.
  The construction V fits the machine to a von Neumann computer. To show that it is realizable, we propose ArchNights, an extended RISC-V ISA and a Linux-style operating system implementing the machine by design. ArchNights-SE runs on gem5 as a computer system, becomes an agentic system when it runs an LLM as the Oracle, and will be open source.
  Agentic systems can then be designed as computer systems are. With a foundation built and a unified view, future work can share invariants and bounds, each with its conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个抽象机器，将LLM视为Oracle，并扩展双栈下推自动机以统一Workflows与Agents两类智能体系统，进而提出可在von Neumann计算机上实现的ArchNights架构。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统常零散借用操作系统的调度、缓存、隔离等抽象，机制之间缺乏共同基础，且Workflows与Agents的统一视角有限。
AI.method: 将LLM视为Oracle，为双栈下推自动机增加一条指令：把整个栈作为查询交给Oracle，并将答案追加到同一栈。由此产生Oracle计算与图灵完备的Priestess计算；通过存储S和转移T的两种对称破缺，将Priestess程序视为Oracle程序的“操作系统”，并把Agent与Workflow解释为任务程序的两种放置方式。进一步提出构造V以适配von Neumann计算机，并设计扩展RISC-V ISA和类Linux操作系统的ArchNights。
AI.result: 对于内部自回归的Oracle，在特定条件下两种计算会在每次答案结束时同步，从而可建模缓存并分析调度。不存在适用于所有Oracle的保证能固定两种计算间传递的内容，但这类保证能固定边界。ArchNights-SE可在gem5上运行，加载LLM作为Oracle后成为智能体系统，并将开源。
AI.conclusion: 智能体系统可以像计算机系统一样被设计。该工作提供了基础与统一视角，未来研究可在各自条件下共享不变量与界。

title: EASE: Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evading AI-generated Text Detectors
summary: AI-generated text (AIGT) detection can be sensitive to the decoding choices of the source large language model (LLM). We observe that perturbing next-token logits or adjusting sampling temperature can reduce detection performance, providing a clear signal of detector vulnerability to decoding-time distribution changes. Building on this observation, we propose EASE (Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evasion), a training-free and detector-agnostic framework for evading AIGT detectors. EASE computes predictive entropy directly from the source LLM's next-token distribution and uses it to adapt both logit perturbation and sampling temperature, without detector feedback or model fine-tuning. Experiments across three source LLMs and multiple detectors demonstrate consistent reductions in detection performance, with negligible degradation in text quality and negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出EASE，一种无需训练且与检测器无关的框架，通过源LLM下一词分布熵自适应调整logit扰动和采样温度，从而规避AI生成文本检测，同时几乎不损失文本质量和增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: AI生成文本检测对源大模型的解码选择很敏感。作者观察到扰动下一词logits或调整采样温度会降低检测性能，表明检测器对解码时分布变化存在脆弱性，因此希望利用这一信号来规避检测。
AI.method: EASE直接从源LLM的下一词分布计算预测熵，并据此自适应地调整logit扰动和采样温度。该方法不需要检测器反馈，也不需要模型微调，是一种训练-free、detector-agnostic的规避框架。
AI.result: 在三个源LLM和多个检测器上的实验表明，EASE能持续降低检测性能，同时对文本质量的损害可忽略，推理开销也可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过解码时分布塑造可以有效规避AI生成文本检测，揭示了现有检测器对解码分布变化的脆弱性；EASE是一种轻量、通用且实用的规避方法。

title: trACT: temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap
summary: Effective remote monitoring and surveillance using drones are frequently impeded by severe environmental and thermal clutter, dynamic vegetation, target camouflage, and system latency. Drawing inspiration from the hunting strategies of birds of prey that hover and stabilize their vision to isolate subtle ground motion, we introduce trACT (temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap), a lightweight, real-time aerial robotics framework designed for autonomous consumer drones. The system integrates Temporal Max Pooling (TMP), a low-level signal processing method that transforms imperceptible movement across a rolling integration window into robust value and time encodings, with self-supervised motion anomaly detection to isolate target motion from background environmental motion caused by wind gusts and drone drift. To overcome mechanical and processing delays, trACT combines motion prediction with automated gimbal-stabilized optical zoom verification and equitable multi-target verification balancing. Extensive real-world field experiments in densely forested wildlife habitats and surveillance scenarios demonstrate that trACT successfully bridges the gap between wide-area aerial monitoring and precise, autonomous target verification under challenging operational conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出 trACT，一种面向消费级无人机的轻量实时空中机器人框架，用于在复杂环境下自主监测与目标验证。
AI.motivation: 无人机远程监测常受环境与热杂波、动态植被、目标伪装和系统延迟影响；研究受猛禽悬停稳定视觉以识别地面细微运动的启发。
AI.method: 集成时序最大池化（TMP），将滚动积分窗口内的细微运动转化为稳健的值和时间编码；结合自监督运动异常检测，区分目标运动与风扰、无人机漂移等背景运动；并采用运动预测、云台稳定光学变焦验证和公平多目标验证平衡来克服延迟。
AI.result: 在茂密森林野生动物栖息地和监视场景的实地实验表明，trACT 能在挑战性条件下实现从广域空中监测到精确自主目标验证的衔接。
AI.conclusion: trACT 可帮助消费级无人机在复杂环境中实现轻量、实时的自主监测与目标验证，弥合广域搜索与精准确认之间的差距。

title: YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad manipulation capabilities via large-scale pretraining, yet eliciting them through language requires fine-grained alignment between instructions and physical interactions. Existing robot demonstrations typically provide only coarse task descriptions, omitting how actions are executed, including which gripper acts, which object is contacted, and how it is grasped and moved. We introduce YUBI-STAG, a framework for Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding that automatically enriches manipulation demonstrations with interaction-rich semantics to align pretrained VLAs with fine-grained manipulation language. Combining contact-object segmentation with vision-language models, YUBI-STAG annotates object identities, attributes and states, per-gripper actions, bimanual coordination, and spatially grounded interactions. To address YUBI-STAG's reliance on localized sequences and multi-stage VLM inference, we distill it into YUBI-VLM. YUBI-VLM directly recovers action structure and annotations from raw, unsegmented video in few inference calls and operates from wrist views alone. We evaluate both frameworks on YUBI-STAG-Bench across temporal, semantic, and spatial grounding tasks. YUBI-VLM retains much of YUBI-STAG's annotation accuracy with fewer inference calls and shorter runtime while generalizing to unseen manipulations. Finally, post-training VLA policies on these annotations aligns them with fine-grained language and contact-aware structure. Bimanual experiments demonstrate improved performance and instruction following, including control over object identity, acting gripper, target location, and spatial relations absent from original labels.

AI.tldr: 论文提出YUBI-STAG及蒸馏版YUBI-VLM，用交互语义自动标注机器人操作演示，并以这些标注后训练VLA策略，从而提升细粒度语言对齐与双臂操作表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽经大规模预训练具备广泛操作能力，但用语言驱动时需要指令与物理交互的细粒度对齐。现有机器人演示通常只有粗粒度任务描述，缺少由哪只夹爪执行、接触哪个物体、如何抓取移动等动作执行细节。
AI.method: 提出YUBI-STAG，结合接触物体分割与视觉语言模型，自动标注物体身份、属性与状态、每只夹爪动作、双臂协调及空间 grounding 交互。为减少对局部序列和多阶段VLM推理的依赖，将其蒸馏为YUBI-VLM，可直接从原始未分割视频、仅用腕部视角、少量推理调用恢复动作结构与标注。
AI.result: 在YUBI-STAG-Bench的时间、语义和空间 grounding 任务上评估。YUBI-VLM以更少推理调用和更短运行时间保留YUBI-STAG大部分标注精度，并能泛化到未见操作。用这些标注后训练VLA策略后，策略与细粒度语言及接触感知结构对齐；双臂实验显示性能与指令遵循提升，包括对物体身份、执行夹爪、目标位置和空间关系的控制，而原始标签中缺少这些信息。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动丰富操作演示中的交互语义，可有效对齐预训练VLA与细粒度操作语言，并提升接触感知和双臂指令遵循能力；蒸馏模型YUBI-VLM在效率与泛化间取得较好平衡。

title: RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment
summary: Rapid progress in AI agents has brought growing attention to agent safety, with extensive evaluation focused on digital environments. As agents move into the physical world, embodied safety becomes increasingly important: failures can cause human injury and costly hardware damage. Beyond selecting safe actions, embodied agents must also operate under real-time constraints: the physical world does not pause while an agent reasons. As pedestrians move and vehicles approach during inference, an action that appears safe at observation time may become unsafe before execution. Real-time embodied safety therefore depends on both decision quality and decision latency. We introduce RT-SAFE, a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied-agent safety under real-time constraints. RT-SAFE combines navigation tasks with moving actors, environmental hazards, and traffic rules, while allowing the world to evolve throughout inference and action execution. Across eight VLMs, agents achieve high task completion yet almost never complete safely: in the hardest setting, only 0.7% of episodes finish without a safety event. More strikingly, matched static and real-time evaluations yield task completion rates of 91.3% and 94.1%, respectively, while real-time execution increases collisions by $12.3\times$. These results reveal that standard task success can mask substantial safety failures, and that decision latency itself can become a source of physical risk. Finally, we show that RT-SAFE can support offline RL training and substantially reduce collision rates while achieving strong task completion.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RT-SAFE，一个在实时约束下评估具身智能体安全性的模拟城市基准。研究发现，智能体虽能高比例完成任务，却几乎无法安全完成；实时执行会显著增加碰撞，说明决策延迟本身也是物理风险来源。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体正从数字环境走向物理世界，具身安全变得至关重要，因为失败可能导致人员受伤和高昂硬件损坏。同时，物理世界不会等待智能体推理，环境在推理和执行期间持续变化，观察时安全的动作可能在执行前变得不安全。因此，具身安全不仅取决于决策质量，也取决于决策延迟。
AI.method: 提出 RT-SAFE 模拟城市基准，将导航任务与移动参与者、环境危险和交通规则结合，并允许世界在推理和动作执行期间持续演化。使用该基准评估八个视觉语言模型（VLM），并展示其可支持离线强化学习训练。
AI.result: 八个 VLM 任务完成率较高，但几乎无法安全完成：最难设置下仅 0.7% 的回合无安全事件。匹配的静态与实时评估任务完成率分别为 91.3% 和 94.1%，但实时执行使碰撞增加 12.3 倍。RT-SAFE 还可支持离线 RL 训练，显著降低碰撞率并保持较强任务完成能力。
AI.conclusion: 标准任务成功率可能掩盖重大安全失败，决策延迟本身可成为物理风险来源。实时约束对具身智能体安全至关重要，而 RT-SAFE 可作为评估和训练平台，帮助在保持任务完成的同时提升安全性。

title: Spatial Latent Reasoning for Embodied Reference Understanding
summary: Pointing-gesture visual grounding requires connecting hand geometry with the visual identity and extent of a referred object. A central challenge for continuous latent reasoning is how to organize these complementary cues into useful intermediate supervision. We propose Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR), a framework that structures this supervision around an ordered sequence of geometric and visual states. A spatial ray state is supervised by fingertip position and pointing direction, followed by four states aligned with target-region features. To construct the visual targets, we introduce parity pooling, which applies polyphase grouping to average region tokens on four interleaved spatial supports. All states are generated recurrently during training and inference; auxiliary annotations are required only during training. On EgoPoint-Ground, the framework improves mIoU over same-backbone supervised fine-tuning by 2.8, 17.5, and 21.1 percentage points on Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Qwen3-VL-8B, respectively, with improvements on both hard subsets. On YouRefIt, it achieves 77.6% precision at IoU 0.5, a numerical margin of 5.2 percentage points over the reported state of the art under differing evaluation protocols. Ablations support joint geometric and visual supervision on the standard and similar-object sets, and favor parity over three alternative pooling operators on the standard set. These results support task-structured supervision for continuous pointing grounding. We will release the code and supporting materials.

AI.tldr: 提出空间潜在推理（SLR）框架，用于指向手势视觉定位，通过有序的几何与视觉状态序列提供中间监督，在EgoPoint-Ground和YouRefIt上显著优于同骨干监督微调及已有方法。
AI.motivation: 指向手势视觉定位需要将手部几何与被指对象的视觉身份和范围联系起来；连续潜在推理的核心挑战在于如何把这些互补线索组织成有效的中间监督信号。
AI.method: SLR将监督结构化为有序的几何与视觉状态序列：空间射线状态由指尖位置和指向方向监督，随后四个状态与目标区域特征对齐。为构建视觉目标，提出parity pooling，利用多相分组在四个交错空间支撑上平均区域token。所有状态在训练和推理中循环生成，辅助标注仅在训练时需要。
AI.result: 在EgoPoint-Ground上，相比同骨干监督微调，mIoU在Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B上分别提升2.8、17.5、21.1个百分点，且两个困难子集均有提升。在YouRefIt上达到IoU 0.5下77.6%精度，比报告SOTA高5.2个百分点（评估协议不同）。消融支持几何与视觉联合监督，并显示parity优于三种替代池化算子。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持面向任务结构的监督用于连续指向定位，代码与相关材料将开源。

title: ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAM) improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction. However, much of the predictable future is dominated by appearance and scene persistence rather than action-dependent dynamics. We observe that several recent WAM designs, including optical flow, motion-centric representations, and latent actions, can be understood from a common perspective in which world supervision becomes more efficient as it contains a higher proportion of action-relevant variation. Based on this insight, we introduce Action Tangent Fields, which reformulate world supervision through a local Taylor expansion of how actions induce changes in future dynamics. We represent future dynamics in Residual-VAE space, where the future latent remains recoverable from the current latent and its residual, and use a strong action-conditioned world model (ACWM) to probe the local correspondence between action variations and residual-world variations. This local first-order structure is distilled into the WAM to guide its denoising supervision toward dynamics that are more tightly coupled to action, rather than merely predictable from appearance. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboTwin2.0-Plus, our method consistently improves robustness to lighting, background, camera, layout, and other environmental perturbations. Despite using no large-scale embodied pretraining, it achieves stronger robustness under several distribution shifts than pretrained policies. We further distill multi-step VideoDiT denoising into a single step for efficient inference. Our results suggest that effective WAM supervision should remain information-rich while concentrating its predictive capacity on the directions along which actions change the future.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Action Tangent Fields，通过局部泰勒展开重新定义世界监督，使世界动作模型更关注由动作引起的未来动态变化，而非仅由外观和场景持续性决定的可预测部分。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）利用密集未来预测增强稀疏动作监督，但未来中大量可预测内容来自外观和场景持续性，与动作相关性不高，导致世界监督效率有限。作者发现，光流、运动中心表示和潜在动作等设计可统一理解为：世界监督中动作相关变化比例越高，监督越有效。
AI.method: 将世界监督建模为动作如何引起未来动态变化的局部泰勒展开，即 Action Tangent Fields；在 Residual-VAE 空间中表示未来动态，使未来潜变量可由当前潜变量及其残差恢复；使用强动作条件世界模型（ACWM）探测动作变化与残差世界变化之间的局部对应关系；将这种局部一阶结构蒸馏到 WAM 中，引导去噪监督朝向与动作更紧密耦合的动态，而非仅由外观可预测的动态；并将多步 VideoDiT 去噪蒸馏为单步以提升推理效率。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 和 RoboTwin2.0-Plus 上，方法持续提升对光照、背景、相机、布局等环境扰动的鲁棒性。尽管未使用大规模具身预训练，在若干分布偏移下仍比预训练策略具有更强鲁棒性，并实现高效单步推理。
AI.conclusion: 有效的 WAM 监督应保持信息丰富，同时将预测能力集中在动作改变未来的方向上，即提高世界监督中动作相关变化的比例。Action Tangent Fields 提供了一种实现该目标的通用思路，并验证了其在鲁棒性和效率上的优势。

title: Cache the Encoder Within:Compact, Reusable Memory across LLM Queries
summary: Repeated queries over shared documents incur redundant encoding, while caching model states introduces persistent storage costs. Building on CoMem's intermediate-state interface, EncBank treats a pretrained LLM's lower layers as a reusable document encoder and compactly stores their outputs for an adapted upper-layer reader. A self-distilled suffix adapter is shared across storage precisions within each backbone, without quantization-specific retraining. Across five benchmark suites on three Qwen backbones spanning different sizes and full-attention and hybrid architectures, 4-bit storage keeps each reported benchmark aggregate within one score point of native-precision EncBank. In a fixed Qwen3-8B workload, it retains 28.1% of the native-precision persistent GPU store. Separate native-precision controls yield a 1.40x selected-pack prefill speedup over same-evidence, same-adapter text replay, at a 3.12-point RULER accuracy cost. A native-precision Qwen3.8-27B configuration also passes 70 of 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks. EncBank thus combines reusable computation with compact memory, while task fidelity and end-to-end benefits remain dependent on the workload, preparation costs, and reuse frequency.

AI.tldr: EncBank 将预训练 LLM 的下层作为可复用文档编码器，并紧凑存储其输出，由适配的上层阅读器使用，以降低重复文档查询的冗余编码和状态缓存成本。
AI.motivation: 重复查询共享文档会产生冗余编码，而缓存完整模型状态又带来持续的存储开销。
AI.method: 基于 CoMem 的中间状态接口，把预训练 LLM 下层视为可复用文档编码器，存储其输出供适配的上层阅读器使用；采用自蒸馏后缀适配器，在同一 backbone 的不同存储精度间共享，无需针对量化单独重训练。
AI.result: 在三个 Qwen backbone、五种基准套件上，4-bit 存储的基准聚合分数与原生精度 EncBank 相差不超过 1 分；固定 Qwen3-8B 负载中保留原生精度持久 GPU 存储的 28.1%；原生精度对照相对同证据同适配器文本重放取得 1.40 倍 selected-pack prefill 加速，但 RULER 准确率下降 3.12 分；原生精度 Qwen3.8-27B 配置通过 89 个 Terminal-Bench 2.1 任务中的 70 个。
AI.conclusion: EncBank 结合了可复用计算与紧凑内存，但任务保真度和端到端收益仍取决于工作负载、准备成本与复用频率。

title: AeroEval: Staged Program and Execution Validation for AI-Generated Drone Missions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate drone programs from natural-language mission descriptions, but syntactically valid programs may still violate user intent, environmental constraints, and mission-level behavior. This problem is pronounced in cyber-physical applications, where correctness depends on the interaction among generated code, mobile sensing, environmental geometry, event-driven analytics, and physical execution. Existing drone code-generation systems primarily use prompt guardrails or simulator outcomes and provide limited failure localization. We present AeroEval, an agent-assisted middleware for staged validation of AI-generated drone missions. AeroEval combines deterministic program analysis with context-grounded LLM agents. It first validates program syntax, platform API usage, and mission intent, and then evaluates the realized behavior using execution trajectories, mission requirements, and environmental context. Each stage returns structured failure information for iterative regeneration.
