A coach converts this information into concise coaching notes that describe how the agent can better anticipate user needs and adapt its behavior over the course of an interaction. CSD turns this feedback into dense, token-level supervision beyond sparse task rewards, yielding further gains across all nine evaluation user models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MIMESIS，一个基于真实人机对话训练的用户模拟器，带显式推理监督与 13 种真实用户行为模式；并以其为环境训练语言智能体，同时提出 Coached On-Policy Self-Distillation（CSD）方法，利用模拟器推理轨迹提供密集监督。
AI.motivation: 训练与评估交互式语言智能体需要丰富用户交互，但收集人类反馈成本高、难扩展；现有方案常用现成助手 LLM 充当模拟用户，其过度乐于助人、表达直白且行为同质，与真实用户差距大。因此需要既像真实用户、又能为智能体提供有效学习经验的用户模拟器。
AI.method: 提出 MIMESIS：在人类对话上训练的用户模拟器，加入显式推理监督与 13 种源自真实交互的行为模式。随后冻结模拟器，用多轮强化学习让智能体与其交互训练。进一步提出 CSD：利用模拟器生成的私有推理轨迹与后续话语作为反馈，由 coach 转化为简洁教练笔记，形成 token 级密集监督，补充稀疏任务奖励。
AI.result: 9B 的 MIMESIS 在 SOUL-Index 上达 65.7，超过最强前沿模型；相比 RealUserSim 与 SimulatorArena 上最强基线 Claude-Opus-5，行为保真度提升 13.4 分，Turing distance 降低 3.6 分。在八个环境中用 MIMESIS 训练，智能体在全部九个未见用户模拟器上均优于用 GPT-5.5 训练的智能体，泛化更强。CSD 在全部九个评估用户模型上带来额外提升。
AI.conclusion: 专用用户模拟器 MIMESIS 比通用助手 LLM 更真实且更能提升智能体训练效果与泛化能力；结合 CSD 将模拟器推理反馈转为密集监督，可进一步改进智能体对用户需求的预判与交互适应能力。

title: Nobody Truly Agrees on Sentiment: Humans, Bespoke Tools, and LLMs Struggle with Social Media Texts
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, accepted for publication at TPDL 2026
summary: Social media is a rich source of real-time public sentiment, but widely used sentiment analysis tools are often applied without understanding their limitations. In this study, we evaluate the inter-rater reliability of three bespoke sentiment analysis tools (TextBlob, VADER, and Twitter-roBERTa-base) and three large language models (LLMs: Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-4-Maverick-17B) against six human raters across 100 tweets. We measured agreement using two statistical measures: Cohen's kappa for pairwise comparisons and Fleiss' kappa for multiple raters. Even among the human raters, our results showed only fair agreement, highlighting the subjectivity of sentiment analysis. Higher agreement was observed under the binary sentiment classification (negative vs. non-negative and positive vs. non-positive) than under the three-class classification across both humans and automated tools. The Twitter-roBERTa-base model showed the strongest alignment with human ratings, outperforming both bespoke sentiment tools and LLMs, particularly in distinguishing negative versus non-negative sentiment. LLMs showed substantial agreement among themselves and moderate to substantial alignment with humans, performing better in positive vs. non-positive classifications. Our findings underscore that domain-specific fine-tuning remains crucial for reliable social media sentiment analysis, and human-centered evaluation remains essential for establishing gold-standard labels.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估三种情感分析工具和三种大语言模型与六名人工评分者在100条推文上的评分者间信度，发现人工评分一致性仅中等，Twitter-roBERTa-base与人类最一致，领域微调仍关键。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体是实时公众情绪的重要来源，但常用情感分析工具常在未充分理解其局限性的情况下被使用，因此需要评估其与人类判断的一致性和可靠性。
AI.method: 将TextBlob、VADER、Twitter-roBERTa-base及Qwen3-32B、GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-4-Maverick-17B与6名人工评分者在100条推文上比较；使用Cohen's kappa进行成对比较、Fleiss' kappa进行多评分者比较，并对比二分类与三分类设置。
AI.result: 即使人工评分者之间也仅达到中等一致性，体现情感分析的主观性；二分类一致性高于三分类；Twitter-roBERTa-base与人类评分最一致，优于专用工具和LLM，尤其在负向与非负向区分上；LLM彼此高度一致，与人类中等至较高一致，在正向与非正向分类上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调，可靠的社交媒体情感分析仍需要领域特定微调，而以人为中心的评估对于建立金标准标签仍然至关重要。

title: Learning to Act with Task Progress: Distilling Small Agents from Compact Teacher Supervision
summary: Learning from large-model demonstrations offers a way to train small agents that can complete recurring tasks without calling a large model at every step. A central design choice is what to retain from teacher trajectories that contain reasoning, actions, and information about task progress. We introduce Task-Progress Distillation (TPD), an offline approach that pairs each demonstrated action with a short label describing the current task stage. The student learns these compact targets and selects actions by jointly scoring admissible stage--action pairs, which a deterministic harness executes in the environment. On ALFWorld, a 1.7B student trained with 404 demonstrations achieves 72.4\% mean unseen task success with either TPD or action-only supervision, compared with 48.3\% for a reasoning-trained student using constrained action selection. Explicit stages provide an additional benefit at 200 demonstrations, improving success from 48.0\% to 67.7\% over action-only supervision. With more demonstrations, the action-only student closes the gap, and both approaches reach 76.9\% at 808 demonstrations. Shared-history analyses link part of TPD's local advantage to better decisions when moving between subgoals, particularly from object acquisition to processing. These results show that compact supervision can train effective small task agents, while explicit task progress provides additional guidance at an intermediate demonstration budget.

AI.tldr: 论文提出任务进度蒸馏（TPD），让小型学生智能体从大模型演示中学习紧凑的任务阶段标签与动作，并在ALFWorld上验证其能有效训练无需每步调用大模型的小型任务智能体。
AI.motivation: 希望训练小型智能体完成重复任务，避免每步调用大模型；关键问题是应从包含推理、动作和任务进度信息的教师轨迹中保留什么。
AI.method: TPD是一种离线蒸馏方法：将每个演示动作与描述当前任务阶段的短标签配对，学生学习这些紧凑目标，并通过联合评分可允许的阶段-动作对来选择动作，再由确定性执行器在环境中执行。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld上，使用404个演示训练的1.7B学生达到72.4%平均未见任务成功率，与仅动作监督相当，高于使用受限动作选择的推理训练学生的48.3%。在200个演示时，显式阶段标签将成功率从48.0%提升到67.7%；演示更多时仅动作监督追赶上来，808个演示时两者均达76.9%。共享历史分析表明，TPD的局部优势部分来自子目标切换时更优的决策，尤其是从获取物体到处理物体。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑监督可以训练有效的小型任务智能体；显式任务进度在中等演示预算下提供额外指导。

title: Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Project lead: Hanqiu Li Cai. Code and models: https://github.com/speridlabs
summary: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters. We test this claim along both routes to a pixel-space backbone. We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a $256\to512\to1024$ curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at $256^2$ to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space. We fine-tune both families for monocular depth estimation and for image restoration/super-resolution. We find no significant improvement from using a pixel-space generative prior. Fine-tuned for depth with one matched direct-regression recipe, Iris-3B is level with the latent FLUX.2 Klein and the converted pixel FLUX.2 Klein falls behind it, and on $4\times$ DIV2K restoration neither pixel model beats a latent FLUX.2 Klein fine-tune, the converted one trailing it slightly. We document the recipes, the failure modes and the remaining confounds behind this negative result. Nevertheless, Iris-3B shows that pixel-space pretraining with the pixel-transformer (PiT) head of PixelDiT scales to 3B parameters and to text-to-image quality competitive with latent models, matching Qwen-Image on OneIG under the official evaluators at $1024^2$. We release its weights and training code in the hope that they help pave the way for further work on pixel-space generation.

AI.tldr: 本文检验像素空间扩散模型是否因避免VAE损失而在细粒度下游任务中更具优势。作者从零预训练了3B参数的像素空间文生图Transformer Iris-3B，并将潜空间模型FLUX.2 Klein base 4B转换为像素空间；在深度估计和图像修复/超分上微调后，未发现像素空间生成先验带来显著提升。但Iris-3B证明像素空间预训练可扩展到3B，并在1024²文生图上达到与潜空间模型相当的水平。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型绕过了潜空间模型中有损的VAE，因此被认为可能在需要细粒度细节的下游任务上具有优势。本文旨在系统验证这一说法。
AI.method: 作者沿两条像素空间骨干路线开展研究：一是从零预训练Iris-3B，一个3B参数的像素空间文生图Transformer，采用256→512→1024课程学习，并先在256²下消融预测目标和表示对齐以决定缩放方案；二是将预训练的潜空间模型FLUX.2 Klein base 4B转换为像素空间。随后将两类模型族微调用于单目深度估计和图像修复/超分辨率，其中深度任务采用匹配的直接回归配方。
AI.result: 没有发现使用像素空间生成先验带来显著改进。在深度估计中，Iris-3B与潜空间FLUX.2 Klein持平，而转换后的像素空间FLUX.2 Klein落后；在4× DIV2K修复任务中，两个像素模型均未超过潜空间FLUX.2 Klein微调模型，转换版本略逊。与此同时，Iris-3B表明使用PixelDiT的PiT头进行像素空间预训练可扩展到3B参数，文生图质量可与潜空间模型竞争，并在1024²下于官方评估器OneIG上匹配Qwen-Image。
AI.conclusion: 本文的负面结果说明，在当前测试的下游任务中，像素空间生成先验并未优于潜空间生成先验。但Iris-3B证明像素空间预训练在PiT头下可扩展到3B并保持有竞争力的文生图质量。作者记录了配方、失败模式和剩余混杂因素，并发布权重和训练代码，以推动像素空间生成的后续研究。

title: The Attribution Blind Spot: Layerwise Trajectory Diagnostics for Source Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
summary: A retrieval-augmented model can match a document without relying on it. Controlled knowledge conflicts make source choice observable and let us ask a second question that prediction alone cannot answer: which internal-state properties define useful intervention directions? We study paired hidden-state changes with Latent Trajectory Shift (LTS), a signed projection onto a training-fitted first principal component (PC1), and keep verified training exposure separate from behavioral source choice. Across the evaluated conflicts, state-change magnitude is often the stronger predictor, whereas signed PC1 is the stronger selective controller: equal-norm interventions change source preference while better preserving non-target behavior, and the frozen direction transfers across the tested datasets and aligned model pairs. A same-system OLMo study further combines positive choice and control results with inconclusive exposure detection at the achieved power. The central result is a separation: representations that diagnose what a model will choose need not be the representations that best control that choice.

AI.tldr: 研究检索增强模型在受控知识冲突下的来源选择，并比较不同隐藏状态变化方向对预测与控制来源选择的作用。
AI.motivation: 模型可能匹配文档却不真正依赖它；需要将训练暴露与行为来源选择区分开，并探究哪些内部状态属性可作为有效干预方向。
AI.method: 通过受控知识冲突使来源选择可观察；使用配对隐藏状态变化与Latent Trajectory Shift（LTS），即投影到训练拟合第一主成分（PC1）的带符号投影；比较状态变化幅度与带符号PC1，并测试冻结方向在数据集和对齐模型对间的迁移；另用同系统OLMo研究结合选择、控制与暴露检测。
AI.result: 在评估的冲突中，状态变化幅度常是更强的预测指标；带符号PC1则是更强的选择性控制器：等范数干预能改变来源偏好，同时更好保持非目标行为，且冻结方向可迁移。OLMo研究中来源选择与控制结果积极，但暴露检测在现有功效下不确定。
AI.conclusion: 核心发现是一种分离：用于诊断模型将选择什么的表征，未必是最好控制该选择的表征。

title: Cognitive Schemas, Laws and Tasks
summary:
This paper asks how explicit representations can support reusable cognitive schemas in knowledge-based problem solving. We develop a structural framework in which schemas are organized by the information and relations required for their use, rather than introduced as unrelated primitives. The framework also distinguishes context-dependent relations from more stable structures that can be reused across different representations.
  Tasks are described through the information available, the unknowns to be determined, and the constraints that admissible solutions must satisfy. This makes it possible to separate limitations of the representation from limitations of the solving procedure. In particular, we distinguish inconsistency, underdetermination, and contextual insufficiency, where the current representation lacks distinctions or relations required by the external task meaning. We also show formally when a reduction of representation preserves the task-relevant solution structure.
  The resulting task--schema interface offers a structured way to describe representational conditions relevant to problem solving. It supports the reuse and stabilization of derived knowledge while remaining independent of the particular mechanism used to generate candidate solutions. This may provide a useful component for future solver architectures that combine structured knowledge, verification, and learned proposal mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结构化框架，用于说明显式表示如何支持知识型问题求解中可复用的认知图式。该框架以图式使用所需的信息与关系来组织图式，并区分任务表示的限制与求解过程的限制。
AI.motivation: 研究者希望理解显式表示如何支撑可复用的认知图式，避免将图式作为互不相关的原始元素引入，并厘清表示层面的缺陷与求解机制层面的缺陷之间的区别。
AI.method: 构建结构性框架：以使用图式所需的信息和关系来组织图式；区分依赖语境的关系与可跨表示复用的稳定结构；通过可用信息、待求未知量和约束条件来刻画任务；区分不一致性、欠定性和语境不充分性；形式化地给出表示约简保持任务相关解结构的条件。
AI.result: 提出了任务—图式接口，能够结构化地描述与问题求解相关的表示条件；该接口支持派生知识的复用与稳定化，同时独立于生成候选解的具体机制。
AI.conclusion: 该任务—图式接口可作为未来求解器架构的有用组件，这类架构结合结构化知识、验证机制与学习型候选生成机制。

title: Tactile Reconstruction of Contact Task Frames and Forces for Hybrid Force/Motion Control
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Video: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLejKMZmW8AvI. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23209032
summary: Hybrid force/motion control requires knowledge of the interaction force and of a task frame defining the force- and motion-controlled directions. These quantities are usually obtained from force/torque sensing or model-based residuals, often assuming also a nominal environment model. This work addresses the online estimation of the contact force and a possibly time-varying task frame using only soft optical tactile sensing, under the assumption of locally planar contact with a negligible contact moment. The proposed method maps a single image of the deformed elastomer of a soft optical tactile sensor to observable contact variables: indentation depth, two surface-to-sensor tilt angles, and 3D contact force, each with a per-sample uncertainty estimate. The mapping is learned through a self-labeling acquisition procedure, in which a manipulator imposes controlled contacts while an auxiliary Force/Torque sensor is used offline to provide ground-truth labels. The tactile measurement is then fused with robot proprioceptive data in an Extended Kalman Filter, producing a continuously updated estimate of the contact task frame and of the interaction force. Control experiments with a DigiTac sensor mounted on a UR10 manipulator demonstrate closed-loop contact force regulation against a flat rigid board in linear and angular motion by a human operator, with touch as the only exteroceptive feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出仅利用软光学触觉传感在线估计接触力与时变任务框架的方法，通过自标注学习触觉图像到接触变量的映射，并用扩展卡尔曼滤波融合机器人本体数据，实现闭环力控制。
AI.motivation: 混合力/运动控制需要交互力和定义力/运动方向的任务框架，传统方法依赖力/力矩传感或基于模型的残差，且常假设已知环境模型。本文旨在仅用触觉传感在线估计这些量。
AI.method: 将软光学触觉传感器弹性体形变的单张图像映射为可观测接触变量：压痕深度、两个表面-传感器倾斜角和3D接触力，并给出每样本不确定性。映射通过自标注采集学习：机械臂施加受控接触，辅助力/力矩传感器离线提供真值标签。触觉测量与机器人本体感受数据在扩展卡尔曼滤波中融合，持续估计接触任务框架和交互力。
AI.result: 在UR10机械臂上安装DigiTac传感器进行控制实验，仅以触觉作为外感受反馈，实现了对平坦刚性板的闭环接触力调节，包括人类操作者引起的线性和角度运动。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，仅用软光学触觉传感即可在线估计接触力和时变任务框架，并成功用于闭环力控制，无需额外力/力矩传感或环境模型。

title: Distributed Motion Planning for Multi-Robot Systems under Topological Constraints
summary: Efficient and distributed coordination of mobile robots is one of the main challenges in multi-robot systems. Topological constraints, often expressed as topological braids, are a popular tool to encode complex coordination patterns between multiple mobile robots, as they offer a compact and abstract representation of the desired qualitative relation between the space-time trajectories of the robots. However, execution of joint motion plans encoded as braid-based topological constraints via distributed controllers is challenging, with existing approaches, generally based on the execution of one braid generator at a time, producing slow and suboptimal trajectories. We propose a distributed controller based on Model Predictive Control (MPC) to efficiently execute braid-based topological specifications. Rather than directly tracking the braid specification, we propose to use winding numbers, which are topological invariants for braids, as a proxy. This has the twofold benefit of converting braids into a continuous function, which can be easily tracked by an MPC controller through an appropriate term in the cost function, and of decoupling the global braid specification into a set of pairwise specifications, which can be tracked distributedly through the solution of only local MPC problems. To maintain global coordination, we propose a consensus-based progress estimation approach, which allows the robots to synchronize their motion toward the desired specification. We validate the proposed approach in simulation and in real-world experiments, where we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and the improvement over existing approaches in terms of execution speed and control effort.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于分布式模型预测控制（MPC）的方法，用于高效执行以拓扑编织（braid）表示的多机器人协调规范，通过绕数将全局编织约束转化为可分布式跟踪的成对约束。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协调中，拓扑编织能紧凑表示复杂时空轨迹关系，但现有分布式控制器通常一次只执行一个编织生成元，导致轨迹缓慢且次优。
AI.method: 使用绕数作为编织的拓扑不变量代理，将离散编织规范转化为连续函数并加入MPC代价函数；把全局编织规范解耦为成对规范，通过局部MPC分布式跟踪；并采用基于共识的进度估计方法同步机器人运动。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中验证了方法的有效性，相比现有方法在执行速度和控制代价方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提分布式MPC方法能够高效执行编织型拓扑规范，实现多机器人协调并改善执行性能。

title: Document-Level Text Simplification in Estonian Using Large Language Models
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Published at LREC 2026
summary: Document-level text simplification involves transformations that go beyond sentence-internal edits, addressing discourse coherence, anaphora resolution, and cross-paragraph consistency. Despite advances in sentence-level simplification for high-resource languages, document-level simplification in morphologically rich, low-resource languages such as Estonian remains largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art multilingual large language models (LLMs) for document-level simplification in Estonian. Three prompting strategies are examined: single-pass generation, pipeline-based modular agents, and guideline-augmented pipelines. The evaluation framework integrates automatic metrics assessing readability, semantic preservation, and discourse coherence, alongside a structured manual annotation protocol. The findings indicate that Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 produce outputs with near-native fluency and strong meaning preservation, whereas other models display notable grammatical and semantic limitations. This work contributes novel document-level coherence metrics, evidence-based prompting strategies, and publicly available resources for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文对五种多语言大语言模型在爱沙尼亚语文档级简化任务上的表现进行了综合评估，比较了三种提示策略，并结合自动指标与人工标注分析。
AI.motivation: 文档级简化需处理语篇连贯、指代消解和跨段落一致性，但形态丰富、低资源语言（如爱沙尼亚语）的文档级简化研究仍很缺乏。
AI.method: 评估五种先进多语言大语言模型；采用单次生成、流水线模块化智能体、指南增强流水线三种提示策略；使用可读性、语义保持和语篇连贯性自动指标，并结合结构化人工标注协议。
AI.result: Gemini-2.0 和 LLaMA-3.3 的输出接近母语流畅度且语义保持较强，其他模型表现出明显语法和语义局限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了新的文档级连贯性指标、基于证据的提示策略，并公开资源以支持可复现研究。

title: InstanceBench: Diagnosing Referential Reasoning and Target Identity in Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) links natural-language descriptions to pixel-level object masks. Yet standard evaluation provides limited insight into instance-level referential reasoning: it does not systematically distinguish referential logics, test target preservation across valid grounding paths, or separate target-selection from mask-generation errors. We introduce InstanceBench, an instance-centered diagnostic benchmark comprising 6,194 images, 9,264 target instances, and 25,077 human-verified expressions. Each target-centric expression set (TCES) fixes the image and target mask while pairing a minimal expression with a same-target variant that uses another valid cue or grounding path. A compact referential-logic taxonomy spans direct target evidence, same-class selection, relational and compositional grounding, and exclusion, while logic-critical construction suppresses simpler shortcuts. Identity-aware metrics measure target retention and set-level success while separating selection from mask-generation errors. Across 22 native-mask RES checkpoints from 18 model families, the strongest checkpoint reaches 67.1% mIoU but only 59.6% All@0.7. Controlled interventions confirm language sensitivity, while failure decomposition identifies target selection rather than mask decoding as the main bottleneck. On a controlled training subset, matched supervision improves identity-aware performance, showing that the diagnosed capability responds to targeted supervision. Collectively, InstanceBench supports a measure-diagnose-improve cycle: measuring target consistency across grounding paths, localizing failure sources, and evaluating targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 InstanceBench——一个以实例为中心的 Referring Expression Segmentation（RES）诊断基准，包含6,194张图像、9,264个目标实例和25,077条人工校验表达，通过身份感知指标区分目标选择与掩码生成错误，揭示目标选择才是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有 RES 评测缺乏实例级指代推理的可解释性：无法系统区分指代逻辑、无法检验目标在不同有效 grounding 路径下是否被稳定保留，也无法将目标选择错误与掩码生成错误分离。
AI.method: 构建 InstanceBench：每个目标中心表达集（TCES）固定图像与目标掩码，将最小表达与使用其他有效线索/路径的同目标变体配对；设计涵盖直接证据、同类选择、关系与组合 grounding、排除等指代逻辑分类体系，并抑制捷径；提出身份感知指标，度量目标保留与集合级成功，并分离选择与掩码误差。
AI.result: 在来自18个模型家族的22个原生掩码 RES 检查点上评测，最强模型 mIoU 达67.1%，但 All@0.7 仅59.6%；干预实验证实语言敏感性，失败分解显示目标选择而非掩码解码是主要瓶颈；在受控训练子集上，匹配监督可提升身份感知性能。
AI.conclusion: InstanceBench 支持“度量—诊断—改进”循环：跨 grounding 路径衡量目标一致性、定位失败来源，并评估针对性干预，说明被诊断能力可通过定向监督改善。

title: Ream: Unfolding Mutual Awareness in Human-Agent Workspaces
summary: As AI agents work alongside humans in shared workspaces, a mutual awareness challenge arises: agents act at speeds that outpace human monitoring, and users' evolving interests are not always expressed in chat. This challenge is especially pressing in literature review, where both parties retrieve, read, and synthesize a growing body of papers. We present Ream, a literature review workspace that supports mutual awareness through structured artifacts, bidirectional engagement tracking, and localized visualizations. Users can see each party's activity within these documents, and agents can retrieve the same history to guide their work. In studies with eighteen researchers, participants used these traces to inspect evidence, steer agents, communicate through annotations, and reflect on their research focus. Shared histories also helped agents build on earlier work. These findings inform how engagement traces within shared documents can support transparency, personalized assistance, and coordination in human-agent knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Ream——一个文献综述工作空间，通过结构化产物、双向参与追踪和局部可视化，提升人与 AI 代理在共享工作区中的相互感知，并用 18 名研究者的研究验证其价值。
AI.motivation: 当 AI 代理与人类在共享工作空间中协作时，代理行动速度远超人类监控能力，且用户不断变化的兴趣未必会在聊天中表达，导致双方缺乏相互感知；文献综述场景中双方共同检索、阅读和综合论文，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 设计并实现 Ream 工作空间，支持结构化产物、双向参与追踪和局部可视化；用户可查看双方在文档中的活动，代理也可检索相同历史来指导工作；随后开展 18 名研究者的用户研究。
AI.result: 参与者利用这些痕迹检查证据、引导代理、通过注释沟通并反思研究重点；共享历史也帮助代理在早期工作基础上继续推进。
AI.conclusion: 共享文档中的参与痕迹能够支持人机知识工作中的透明度、个性化协助与协调。

title: An Invariant Tangent-Angle Descriptor and a Band U-Net for 2D Fragment Adjacency Prediction
summary: This paper addresses the prediction of adjacency between pairs of 2D fragments based on their contours. We improved the two-stage architecture proposed in Beaulac's thesis, in which a rotation-equivariant Siamese convolutional neural network scores pairs of local image windows along the two contours of two fragments. The scores are gathered in an adjacency matrix in which a ResNet detects the partial anti-diagonal band that reveals the adjacency of two fragments. In the current work, we keep the pipeline and replace the local score by a comparison of tangent-angle profiles of contour windows, making it, by construction, invariant to fragment rotation and agnostic to the selected contour-starting point. These adaptations may be either a training-free likelihood ratio or a small one-dimensional convolutional model trained on corresponding points. We also replaced the final classifier by a band U-Net that segments the band and classifies the pair, so that the shared arc is obtained along with the decision. In the synthetic data set of the original thesis, the tangent descriptor performs as well as or better than the image-window approach in all tested configurations. The proposed pipeline reaches an accuracy of 98%, vs 93% to 95% for the original approach once its evaluation is corrected. We tested our pipeline, with models trained only on synthetic data, on the PairingNet benchmark, and obtained an AUC of 0.93. Furthermore, under the PairingNet pair-searching protocol conditions, our learned descriptor obtains a Recall@10 of 0.82 on the real set against 0.56 from the best model of the original paper.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于轮廓的二维碎片成对邻接关系预测，改进Beaulac论文中的两阶段架构：用切线角轮廓比较替代局部图像窗口评分，并用带状U-Net替代最终分类器，从而同时完成配对判断和共享弧段分割。
AI.motivation: 原有方法依赖旋转等变Siamese CNN对局部图像窗口打分，并需后续检测邻接矩阵中的反斜带；作者希望提升对碎片旋转和轮廓起点的不变性，并进一步改善碎片配对准确率与真实数据上的泛化能力。
AI.method: 保留原有两阶段流程，将局部评分改为轮廓窗口的切线角轮廓比较，使其对旋转不变且不受轮廓起点影响；评分可采用无需训练的似然比，或基于对应点训练的小型一维卷积模型。同时用带状U-Net替换最终分类器，对邻接矩阵中的条带进行分割并分类碎片对。
AI.result: 在原始论文的合成数据集上，切线描述子在所有测试配置中表现不劣于或优于图像窗口方法；所提流程准确率达98%，而原方法经评估修正后为93%至95%。仅用合成数据训练后，在PairingNet基准上取得AUC 0.93；在PairingNet配对搜索协议下，学习描述子在真实集上Recall@10为0.82，原论文最佳模型为0.56。
AI.conclusion: 用切线角轮廓替代局部图像窗口评分，并结合带状U-Net，可更有效、更鲁棒地预测二维碎片邻接关系，并在合成与真实基准上优于原始方法，同时还能输出共享弧段。

title: RealtimeWAM: How Fast Can I Run My World Action Model?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) combine visual dynamics modeling with action generation, but their high inference latency limits responsive robot control. Recent efforts accelerate inference by removing explicit future-video generation at test time, as in FastWAM, an approach that requires a specially tailored architectural design. More general caching strategies exploit feature redundancy, but redundancy alone does not capture the changing computational demands of closed-loop control. To address these challenges, we present RealtimeWAM, a general, training-free framework that coordinates parallel execution with adaptive computation for low-latency inference across diverse WAM architectures. We exploit layerwise dependencies to overlap observation processing with prediction. However, concurrent branches still compete for GPU resources, limiting the benefit of parallel execution. We therefore adapt computation throughout the pipeline through selective reuse, caching observation features in visually stable regions and reusing Transformer residuals while reserving additional refinement for small predicted adjustments. We evaluate RealtimeWAM on FastWAM and OpenWAM across RoboTwin, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus. On an RTX 4090, measured mean inference latencies are 24.09 and 63.09 ms, corresponding to average speedups of 8.90$\times$ and 10.67$\times$. Average success rates are 82.75% and 87.41%, respectively, within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference. Across five real-world tasks, RealtimeWAM improves average success rates over native inference by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points on FastWAM and OpenWAM, respectively.

AI.tldr: RealtimeWAM 是一个通用且免训练的框架，通过协调并行执行与自适应计算，为多种世界动作模型（WAM）实现低延迟推理，从而支持响应式机器人控制。
AI.motivation: WAM 将视觉动态建模与动作生成结合，但推理延迟高，限制了机器人闭环控制的响应速度。现有加速方法如 FastWAM 依赖专门架构设计，而通用缓存策略仅利用特征冗余，无法适应闭环控制中动态变化的计算需求。
AI.method: 利用层间依赖关系，将观测处理与预测过程重叠执行；针对并发分支竞争 GPU 资源的问题，进一步采用自适应计算：在视觉稳定区域缓存观测特征，重用 Transformer 残差，同时为小幅预测调整保留额外细化计算。
AI.result: 在 FastWAM 和 OpenWAM 上，于 RTX 4090 测得平均推理延迟分别为 24.09 ms 和 63.09 ms，平均加速 8.90 倍和 10.67 倍；平均成功率分别为 82.75% 和 87.41%，仅比原生推理低 0.02 和 0.53 个百分点。在五个真实世界任务中，相比原生推理，成功率分别平均提升 17.2 和 37.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RealtimeWAM 能够以通用、免训练的方式跨多种 WAM 架构实现低延迟推理，在保持接近原生精度的同时，显著提升真实场景任务成功率。

title: CoTrace: Data Recipes for Training Terminal Agents with Harness-Model Co-Evolution
summary: Terminal-agent capability depends jointly on model weights and the runtime harness that formats prompts, binds tools, and handles error recovery. Existing harness-model co-evolution approaches improve both components, yet often treat trajectories produced during harness search as an undifferentiated replay buffer. This practice overlooks that a trajectory's value for model training depends on the harness under which it was generated. To systematically analyze this interface, we establish an alternating co-evolution framework that decouples harness search and policy training through component-wise promotion decisions. Within this framework, we introduce CoTrace, a harness-aware data recipe that explicitly governs trajectory routing, provenance matching, and curriculum refresh. Under CoTrace, recurring execution failures guide harness synthesis, while policy training is strictly conditioned on verified rollouts matched to the adopted runtime for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or fresh online interactions for reinforcement learning (RL). On the Tmax promotion split, CoTrace advances Qwen3.5-9B from 78 to 88 solved tasks under supervised fine-tuning while an online reinforcement variant reaches 90. Specifically, a compact harness-matched corpus produces steady model gains at substantially lower compute than much larger corpora pooled across sibling harnesses. Furthermore, evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench Lite show that out-of-distribution transfer depends fundamentally on harness compatibility, where maintaining consistency between training and evaluation runtimes prevents procedural execution breakdowns observed under foreign scaffolds.

AI.tldr: 论文研究终端智能体能力中模型权重与运行时harness的协同问题，提出交替式协同进化框架与CoTrace数据配方，通过harness感知的轨迹路由、来源匹配和课程刷新来提升训练效率与迁移表现。
AI.motivation: 现有harness-模型协同进化方法常将harness搜索中产生的轨迹视为无差别回放缓冲区，忽略了轨迹对模型训练的价值取决于其生成时所使用的harness。因此需要系统分析模型与harness之间的接口。
AI.method: 建立交替协同进化框架，将harness搜索与策略训练解耦，并通过组件级晋升决策进行协调。提出CoTrace数据配方，显式管理轨迹路由、来源匹配和课程刷新：执行失败用于指导harness合成，策略训练仅使用与当前运行时匹配的已验证rollout进行SFT，或用于RL的新鲜在线交互。
AI.result: 在Tmax晋升划分上，CoTrace将Qwen3.5-9B的SFT求解任务数从78提升至88，在线RL变体达到90。小型harness匹配语料比跨同类harness池化的大语料以更低计算量带来稳定增益。Terminal-Bench 2.1与SWE-bench Lite上的评测表明，分布外迁移根本上依赖harness兼容性，训练与评测运行时一致可避免外国脚手架下的程序性执行崩溃。
AI.conclusion: harness与模型必须协同考虑，轨迹数据应基于生成它们的harness进行路由和匹配。保持训练与评测运行时的一致性对终端智能体的稳定迁移和避免执行崩溃至关重要。

title: Gaussian Material Fields for Volumetric Multi-Energy CT Decomposition
summary: Volumetric material decomposition in multi-energy computed tomography requires a representation that organizes multiple three-dimensional material fields in a common spatial domain while retaining differences in composition and local structure. We observe that spatial primitives can be shared across materials without tying their coefficients, but their local capacity must respond to material-specific reconstruction needs. We introduce Gaussian material fields, which represent multiple material distributions with shared anisotropic 3D Gaussian primitives and independent nonnegative material coefficients. The shared geometry defines a continuous spatial basis, while the coefficients determine each primitive's contribution to the individual material fields. To reconstruct this representation from multi-energy projections, a differentiable spectral forward model combines Gaussian material path integrals with a calibrated basis matrix, enabling joint optimization of spatial geometry and material composition. Material-aware adaptive density control retains material-specific refinement evidence before aggregation and adjusts local representation capacity to accommodate both spatially extensive components and sparse details. Experiments use synthesized multi-energy projections generated from pseudo-reference material maps constructed by conventional methods from publicly available CT data. Across 15 cases, our approach improves average PSNR by 4.03 dB and SSIM by 4.96% over the strongest baseline, while reducing NRMSE by 33.45%. Material-wise comparisons and component ablations support improved recovery of localized structures, while runtime and memory measurements show favorable computational scaling. These results establish Gaussian material fields as an explicit, adaptive representation for volumetric multi-material reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高斯材料场，用共享的各向异性3D高斯基元表示多种材料分布，并通过可微能谱前向模型从多能CT投影中联合重建空间几何与材料组成。
AI.motivation: 多能CT体材料分解需要一种表示，能在共同空间域中组织多个三维材料场，同时保留材料间组成和局部结构差异；现有表示难以兼顾共享空间结构与材料特定重建需求。
AI.method: 引入高斯材料场：共享各向异性3D高斯基元与非负材料系数；构建结合高斯材料路径积分和校准基矩阵的可微能谱前向模型，实现几何与组成的联合优化；提出材料感知自适应密度控制，在聚合前保留材料特定细化证据并调整局部表示容量。
AI.result: 在由公开CT数据经传统方法构建伪参考材料图并合成多能投影的15个案例中，平均PSNR提升4.03 dB，SSIM提升4.96%，NRMSE降低33.45%；材料级比较与组件消融表明局部结构恢复更好，运行时间和内存测量显示计算扩展性良好。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，高斯材料场是一种面向体多材料重建的显式、自适应表示，可有效提升多能CT材料分解性能。

title: PHRBench: A Behavioral Evaluation of Post-Hallucination Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Hallucinated information can propagate through multi-stage LLM systems and become part of the context for subsequent reasoning. Existing studies of post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) mainly characterize changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, leaving how models resolve hallucinated premises at the response level insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce PHRBench, a controlled benchmark for behaviorally structured PHR across four domains and 18 large language models. PHRBench characterizes each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness through Hallucination Compliance, Hallucination Avoidance, and Heuristic Correction, and defines an insightful trajectory as successful correction that ultimately reaches the correct answer. Across 4820 controlled instances, we find that successful recovery remains relatively rare and is associated with more frequent belief updates along the reasoning trajectory. We further find that properties of the hallucinated prompt contain substantial predictive signal for successful recovery, with a lightweight predictor achieving an AUROC of 0.847. These findings provide a behavioral view of post-hallucination reasoning, characterizing how LLMs resolve erroneous context and when successful recovery is likely to occur.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PHRBench 基准，从行为层面研究大模型在多阶段系统中的幻觉后推理（PHR），发现成功纠错较为罕见，且与更频繁的信念更新及幻觉提示特征有关。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉后推理研究主要关注最终结果和总体推理动态，对模型在响应层面如何解决幻觉前提理解不足。
AI.method: 构建 PHRBench 受控基准，覆盖 4 个领域和 18 个大语言模型，基于 4820 个受控实例，用幻觉遵从、幻觉避免和启发式纠正对每条推理轨迹进行行为结构化刻画，并定义能最终得到正确答案的成功纠正为有洞察力轨迹。
AI.result: 成功恢复相对罕见，且与推理轨迹中更频繁的信念更新相关；幻觉提示的属性对成功恢复具有显著预测信号，轻量预测器达到 AUROC 0.847。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了幻觉后推理的行为视角，刻画了大模型如何解决错误上下文以及何时可能成功恢复。

title: Lifelong small-object navigation in changing object layouts: a benchmark and method
summary: Household robots need to continually navigate to different objects in the same environment, many of which are small and portable, such as tools and toys. Their small visual footprint and frequent occlusion make reliable observation difficult, and they may be moved by people without the robot observing the changes. We formulate this challenging task as Lifelong Small-object Navigation in Changing Object Layouts (LiSoNav-COL). Agents must seek suitable viewpoints for reliable observation, accumulate and reuse scene knowledge to efficiently locate subsequent targets, and update outdated memory after object relocation. To eliminate the need for prior scene scanning, we also require agents to start navigation with empty scene memory. Although practical, this task still lacks benchmarks designed around its defining assumptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiSoNav-Eval, a dedicated benchmark spanning 28 indoor scenes with 45 small-object categories. Its lifelong navigation sequences include both unchanged and relocated targets to evaluate memory reuse and adaptation to object relocation. To address this challenging task, we propose a navigation method based on multi-view Inspection with Viewpoint-Anchored Memory, dubbed IVAM-Nav. IVAM-Nav actively observes supporting surfaces from complementary viewpoints for reliable small-object perception and anchors the resulting memory to their observation viewpoints, supporting relational memory reuse and revalidation under similar viewing conditions. Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods. Benchmark analyses also show that smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances pose greater challenges. The dataset and code are available here.

AI.tldr: 论文提出终身小物体导航任务LiSoNav-COL，要求机器人在无先验扫描、空记忆下持续定位被移动的小物体，并构建了基准LiSoNav-Eval和基于多视角检查与视角锚定记忆的方法IVAM-Nav。
AI.motivation: 家庭机器人常需导航到小且可移动的物体（如工具、玩具），其视觉足迹小、易遮挡且可能被人移动而机器人未察觉。现有方法难以可靠观测、复用场景知识并更新过时记忆，且缺乏针对这些假设的基准。
AI.method: 提出LiSoNav-Eval基准，涵盖28个室内场景、45类小物体，包含未变与移位目标的终身导航序列。提出IVAM-Nav，基于多视角检查与视角锚定记忆：主动从互补视角观察支撑面，将记忆锚定到观察视角，支持关系记忆复用与再验证。
AI.result: 在LiSoNav-Eval上，IVAM-Nav优于代表性方法。基准分析表明，物体越小、环境越大、移动距离越长，任务挑战越大。
AI.conclusion: 该任务实用但此前缺乏对应基准；LiSoNav-Eval和IVAM-Nav为终身小物体导航提供了评估平台与有效方案，并揭示了影响难度的关键因素。

title: Your Prompt Should Do More: Effects of Retrieval Instructions in Embedding Models
summary: Prompted embedding models have recently received increasing attention, particularly for retrieval, where detailed retrieval instructions are provided as part of the retrieval prompt. Several new datasets and studies have examined this setting, showing that the current embedding models often struggle to follow such instructions reliably. In this paper, we study the mechanism of how instructions actually affect the representations of retrieval queries in asymmetric retrieval tasks. We show that models can fail to follow even simple task instructions when query-side distractors are included in the evaluation. We hypothesize that this behavior is driven by the training setup of current embedding models and their evaluation, and show that fine-tuning with added query-side distractors leads to substantial improvements, with minimal effect on other tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索提示中的指令如何影响非对称检索查询表示，发现查询侧干扰项会使模型难以遵循简单任务指令，并证明在微调中加入查询侧干扰项可显著改善该问题。
AI.motivation: 当前嵌入模型在检索中常被要求遵循详细指令，但已有研究表明它们难以可靠遵循，因此需要理解指令影响查询表示的机制及失败原因。
AI.method: 分析指令对非对称检索查询表示的影响，在评估中加入查询侧干扰项，并假设失败源于当前嵌入模型的训练设置与评估方式；随后通过加入查询侧干扰项进行微调。
AI.result: 模型在存在查询侧干扰项时甚至无法遵循简单任务指令；加入查询侧干扰项微调后，性能显著提升，且对其他任务影响很小。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循失败与当前训练和评估设置有关，在微调中引入查询侧干扰项是一种有效且影响较小的改进方向。

title: Reliability of LLM Judges for Evaluating Entity Alignment
summary: Entity Alignment (EA) identifies equivalent entities across knowledge graphs and is critical for knowledge base integration and ontology merging. Evaluating EA systems at scale requires expensive expert annotation, making systematic assessment across diverse domains practically infeasible. LLM-as-judge evaluation offers a potentially scalable alternative, yet its reliability for structured prediction tasks like EA remains unstudied. We present the first systematic benchmarking study across three frontier models, three datasets, and four EA systems, using perturbation bias diagnostics, meta-evaluation across all dataset-judge-prompt combinations, and counterfactual label-flip tests. We identify anchor bias, a failure mode in which judges invert discrimination when the system's decision label is visible. Label exposure causally collapses judge discrimination (J-ROC-AUC 0.12-0.87), while a label-free protocol recovers near-ceiling capability on distinctive-name datasets (0.93-1.00) and significant recovery on biomedical pairs (0.93-0.95). Counterfactual experiments confirm causality (FSR 53-99%) and reveal a frontier model paradox: stronger judges exhibit greater label sensitivity, not less. A blinded two-annotator human evaluation (102 pairs, Cohen's kappa=0.902) confirms this mechanism directly. We release the first biomedical EA benchmark (MeSH-SNOMED CT, 15K pairs) and a reproducible auditing framework for LLM judge reliability in EA. Code and data are available at https://github.com/vaibhavalakshmiravideshik/llm-as-a-judge-entity-alignment.

AI.tldr: 首个系统评测LLM-as-judge在实体对齐中的可靠性，发现标签暴露会导致锚定偏差，提出无标签协议恢复判别力，并发布生物医学EA基准与审计框架。
AI.motivation: 实体对齐评估需要昂贵的专家标注，难以规模化覆盖多领域；LLM-as-judge虽可能可扩展，但其在EA等结构化预测任务中的可靠性尚未被研究。
AI.method: 对3个前沿模型、3个数据集、4个EA系统进行系统基准测试；采用扰动偏差诊断、覆盖所有数据集-评判者-提示组合的元评估、反事实标签翻转测试，并进行双标注者盲评。
AI.result: 发现锚定偏差：当系统决策标签可见时，评判者判别能力反转；标签暴露使J-ROC-AUC降至0.12-0.87，而无标签协议在独特名称数据集恢复至0.93-1.00，在生物医学对上恢复至0.93-0.95。反事实实验确认因果性（FSR 53-99%），并揭示前沿模型悖论：更强评判者标签敏感性更高。人类盲评（102对，Cohen's kappa=0.902）直接确认该机制。发布首个生物医学EA基准（MeSH-SNOMED CT，15K对）及可复现审计框架。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-judge用于EA时必须避免暴露系统决策标签；无标签协议可显著恢复评判可靠性。该工作提供了首个生物医学EA基准和可复现的LLM评判可靠性审计框架。

title: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
comment: 34 pages main text, 92 pages supplementary material; 6 main figures. Project: https://DrugTargetWorld.vercel.app. Code: https://github.com/sammargolis/DrugTargetWorld. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sammargolis/DrugTargetWorld-assets
summary: Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets. Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.

AI.tldr: 提出DrugTargetWorld框架，程序化生成因果结构隐藏的模拟生物库，将端到端药物靶点发现转化为可扩展、带可验证奖励的训练与评估问题。
AI.motivation: 药物靶点发现需区分因果驱动疾病的分子与仅相关的分子，但真实生物库缺乏已知因果真值，且受试者级数据受访问控制，难以端到端训练和评估AI智能体。
AI.method: DrugTargetWorld程序化生成模拟生物库“世界”，每个世界含54,000名参与者的基因型、蛋白质、健康记录、结局和合成MRI，因果结构对评估者已知但对智能体隐藏。智能体需构建疾病表型、识别因果驱动蛋白、推断调控的有益方向，并可选做虚拟湿实验。在20个心血管世界、3种实验预算下对9个智能体进行了540个回合评估。
AI.result: Opus 5和GPT-5.6 Sol平均综合得分最高，分别为100分制的39.98和35.38，二者平均恢复64%的因果驱动因子。但没有任何智能体能可靠区分误导性非因果蛋白，且性能受限于连接表型构建、因果证据与干预决策所需的整合判断。
AI.conclusion: 通过将每个世界的因果结构对评估者公开、对智能体隐藏，DrugTargetWorld使端到端药物靶点发现成为具有可验证奖励的可扩展训练与评估问题。

title: SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models
summary: Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce \textbf{SpatialUQ}, a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches $0.784$ failure-detection AUC versus $0.664$ for MC-Dropout ($p{<}10^{-6}$) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ vs.\ $0.127$ for $\ell_1$), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and $\ell_1$ reaches $0.832$, outperforming a five-member ensemble ($0.813$). MUS scales with model quality, reaching $0.899$ with BiomedCLIP ($ρ= 0.846$), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ($ρ= 0.523$) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialUQ：一种仅依赖输出概率的事后不确定性方法，通过比较全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪在六次确定性前向传播中的 Jensen-Shannon 散度来衡量预测可信度。
AI.motivation: 临床视觉模型常以冻结黑盒部署，推理时无法访问内部结构、重新训练或真实标签，因此需要仅用输出概率的事后不确定性估计方法。
AI.method: SpatialUQ 基于“可信预测应在空间上一致”的假设，计算全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪平均预测之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度，得到 Multicrop Uncertainty Score（MUS）。在 NIH ChestX-ray14（DenseNet-121，N=25,596）上评估，并与熵、置信度、ℓ1 等进行监督融合。
AI.result: MUS 的失败检测 AUC 为 0.784，优于 MC-Dropout 的 0.664（p<10^-6），计算量仅为其五分之一；原生校准 SCE=0.049，优于 ℓ1 的 0.127，是 AUC>0.78 方法中校准最好的。MUS 与熵、置信度、ℓ1 的监督融合达到 0.832，超过五成员集成（0.813）。MUS 随模型质量提升而提升，BiomedCLIP 达 0.899（ρ=0.846）；同分布下关系仍显著（ρ=0.523），但严重分布偏移下失效（VinBigData，ρ=0.027）。MUS 适合弥漫性病变，对结节等小局灶病变较不可靠。
AI.conclusion: SpatialUQ 表明仅用输出概率、通过空间一致性即可实现有效且计算高效的事后不确定性估计，并具良好校准和融合潜力；但其可靠性受分布偏移和病变类型限制。

title: World Potential Model: Pretrained World Knowledge as Progress Potentials
summary: Long-horizon language agents often receive supervision only from terminal task outcomes, leaving little signal for distinguishing productive intermediate behavior from stagnation or even regression. Rather than learning a separate value function or process reward model for every task, we ask whether pretrained models can recognize task progress from their existing world knowledge. We formalize this capability with a World Potential Model (WPM), a goal-conditioned evaluator of task-relative realized progress in agent contexts. In ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, off-the-shelf pretrained models substantially outperform chance at recovering realized-progress structure without task-specific evaluator fine-tuning. We further anchor these progress judgments to task-specific milestones to obtain scalar world potentials, whose temporal differences provide process-sensitive step-level credit for policy optimization. Under matched comparisons, WPM-guided optimization improves success over outcome-only GRPO across all evaluated configurations. Together, these results provide initial evidence that pretrained world knowledge can support reusable realized-progress evaluation and provide useful supervision for long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出世界潜力模型（WPM），利用预训练模型的世界知识评估长程语言智能体的中间任务进展，并将其转化为过程敏感的步级信用信号，用于策略优化。
AI.motivation: 长程语言智能体通常仅从最终任务结果获得监督，难以区分有成效的中间行为与停滞甚至退步，而现有方法往往需要为每个任务单独学习价值函数或过程奖励模型。
AI.method: 将预训练模型识别任务进展的能力形式化为目标条件的世界潜力模型（WPM），用于评估智能体上下文中的任务相对已实现进展；在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld中测试现成预训练模型；进一步将进展判断锚定到任务特定里程碑，得到标量世界潜力，并用其时间差分提供过程敏感的步级信用，用于策略优化。
AI.result: 现成预训练模型在无需任务特定评估器微调的情况下，显著优于随机水平地恢复已实现进展结构；在匹配比较下，WPM引导的优化在所有评估配置中均比仅使用结果监督的GRPO取得更高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，预训练世界知识可支持可复用的已实现进展评估，并为长程智能体提供有用的监督信号。

title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Understand Instructions? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study on Language Grounding
summary: Vision-Language-Action models are designed to generalise across environments and task descriptions, raising the question of whether their action generation actually depends on the language instruction, or whether they largely rely on visual cues and superficial correlations. Robustness to variance in the visual and linguistic observation space is critical for real-world deployment, yet VLAs lack explicit grounding modules and instead rely on the intrinsic language grounding capabilities of their Vision-Language model backbones. For this reason, we conduct a controlled mechanistic interpretability study on the language grounding capabilities of two state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7, by applying activation and attribution patching to the residual stream of the action generation modules. We systematically corrupt the task instruction of input samples of the LIBERO benchmark following five strategies: synonym replacement, semantic scaling, directional corruption, random object substitution, and empty string. Our experiments find that both models are comparatively insensitive to abstract rephrasing and to referencing non-existent objects, but react strongly to empty task descriptions and, especially, to directional language. During action generation, this sensitivity is concentrated in different loci for each model: mainly in the early, periodic cross-attention layers for GR00T N1.7, versus distributed across the earliest and selected later layers for $π_{0.5}$. For GR00T N1.7, directional perturbations drive some of the largest causal effects while leaving the internal representational geometry comparatively unchanged, a dissociation we do not observe clearly for $π_{0.5}$. Finally, the reliability of attribution patching is model-dependent: it closely tracks activation patching for GR00T N1.7 but not for $π_{0.5}$.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过机制可解释性方法，探究了两个先进视觉-语言-动作模型（π_{0.5} 和 GR00T N1.7）在动作生成中对语言指令的依赖程度，发现它们对抽象改写和不存在物体不敏感，但对空描述和方向性语言高度敏感，且敏感位置因模型而异。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型缺乏显式语言接地模块，依赖视觉-语言模型骨干的内在接地能力，因此需要研究其动作生成是否真正依赖语言指令，以及视觉和语言变化下的鲁棒性，这对实际部署至关重要。
AI.method: 在LIBERO基准上，对两个模型（π_{0.5}和GR00T N1.7）的动作生成模块残差流应用激活修补和归因修补，采用五种指令破坏策略：同义词替换、语义缩放、方向性破坏、随机物体替换和空字符串。
AI.result: 两个模型对抽象改写和不存在物体相对不敏感，但对空描述和方向性语言反应强烈。GR00T N1.7的敏感性主要集中在早期周期性交叉注意力层，而π_{0.5}则分布在最早和部分后层。对于GR00T N1.7，方向性扰动产生最大因果效应但内部表示几何变化不大，π_{0.5}无此明显分离。归因修补的可靠性因模型而异：对GR00T N1.7与激活修补高度一致，对π_{0.5}则不然。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-语言-动作模型的语言接地能力存在差异，方向性语言和空描述是关键敏感因素；不同模型对语言敏感的位置不同；归因修补作为可解释性工具在不同模型上可靠性不同。

title: EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory
summary: Conditional memory architectures such as DeepSeek Engram use input n-grams to look up learned embeddings, expanding the capacity of large language models (LLMs) with limited additional computation. Beyond model scaling, this architecture has demonstrated the potential to decouple factual knowledge storage from general-purpose computation, offering a promising route to updating factual knowledge while keeping the Transformer backbone fixed. Realizing this potential is challenging because different expressions of a fact may activate different n-gram embeddings, while updating shared embeddings can unintentionally change the model's predictions about other facts. We propose EngramEdit for decoupled knowledge updates through conditional memory. EngramEdit first computes target memory representations that make the model predict the updated fact across multiple expressions. It then jointly updates the shared n-gram embeddings to match these targets across expressions and edits, penalizing updates to frequently reused embeddings more strongly to preserve unrelated knowledge. Experiments show that EngramEdit enables independent factual knowledge updates through conditional memory, achieving near-perfect editing success. Revised knowledge is usable across unseen expressions and in multi-hop reasoning, with nearly three times the strongest baseline's accuracy under chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Unrelated knowledge and general capabilities are largely preserved even as factual updates accumulate. These findings show that EngramEdit turns conditional memory into an editable knowledge interface, extending its role beyond model scaling to support decoupled knowledge updates.

AI.tldr: 提出 EngramEdit，通过条件记忆实现解耦的事实知识更新，可近乎完美地编辑知识并保持无关知识与通用能力。
AI.motivation: 条件记忆架构（如 DeepSeek Engram）有望将事实存储与通用计算解耦，但同一事实的不同表达会激活不同 n-gram 嵌入，更新共享嵌入可能意外改变对其他事实的预测。
AI.method: EngramEdit 先计算目标记忆表示，使模型在多种表达下预测更新后的事实；再联合更新共享 n-gram 嵌入以匹配这些目标，并对频繁复用的嵌入施加更强惩罚，以保护无关知识。
AI.result: 实验显示 EngramEdit 能独立更新事实知识，编辑成功率接近完美；新知识可迁移到未见表达和多跳推理，在 CoT 提示下准确率约为最强基线的 3 倍；即使事实更新累积，无关知识和通用能力也基本保持。
AI.conclusion: EngramEdit 将条件记忆转变为可编辑的知识接口，使其作用超越模型扩展，支持解耦的知识更新。

title: RT-DETR-World: Transferring Rich LLM Semantics to Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) recognizes categories unseen during training through textual category queries, yet achieving strong generalization with real-time efficiency remains challenging. Beyond vocabulary scaling, zero-shot generalization may benefit from reusable visual--semantic cues learned from seen data, including attributes, actions, states, and contextual relations. Existing real-time OVD methods primarily emphasize vocabulary coverage and efficient region/query--text matching; under strict efficiency constraints, compact detectors may struggle to absorb rich instance semantics and scene context. We propose RT-DETR-World, a compact DETR-style detector that transfers the rich semantics conveyed by descriptions during training while retaining lightweight query--text matching at inference. We construct GroundingCapv2 with three levels of supervision: category names for standard OVD, object descriptions conveying instance-level semantics, and image descriptions conveying object relations and scene context. These descriptions serve only as training-time semantic supervision. To help the compact detector absorb these semantics, we propose Dual-Path Description Alignment (DDA), combining a deployment-consistent MiniLM pathway with a training-only LLM teacher. MiniLM provides query--category supervision and object-description alignment, while offline teacher features supervise matched queries and global visual representations at the object and image levels, respectively. All teacher features are precomputed, and the teacher-side modules are removed after training. We further propose Relation-Aware Negative Relaxation (RNR), which uses teacher-derived semantic similarities to relax related negatives while preserving exact positives. Experiments demonstrate competitive zero-shot accuracy and a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出RT-DETR-World，一种紧凑的DETR式开放词汇检测器。通过训练时引入对象描述和图像描述等丰富语义监督，并利用离线大模型教师指导，在推理时仅保留轻量级查询-文本匹配，实现了有竞争力的零样本精度与良好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇检测需识别训练中未见类别，实时高效与强泛化难以兼得。现有实时方法侧重词汇覆盖和高效区域/查询-文本匹配，但紧凑检测器在严格效率约束下难以吸收丰富的实例语义和场景上下文。因此，可利用已见数据中可复用的视觉-语义线索（属性、动作、状态、上下文关系）来提升零样本泛化。
AI.method: 1. 构建GroundingCapv2，提供三级监督：类别名（标准OVD）、对象描述（实例级语义）、图像描述（对象关系与场景上下文），仅作训练时语义监督。2. 提出双路径描述对齐（DDA）：部署一致的MiniLM路径提供查询-类别监督和对象描述对齐；仅训练用的LLM教师提供离线特征，在对象和图像级分别监督匹配查询和全局视觉表示。教师特征预计算，训练后移除教师侧模块。3. 提出关系感知负样本松弛（RNR）：利用教师语义相似度松弛相关负样本，同时保留精确正样本。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法具有竞争力的零样本精度和有利的精度-效率权衡。代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: RT-DETR-World通过在训练阶段吸收描述中的丰富语义和教师模型知识，并在推理阶段保持轻量查询-文本匹配，有效提升了实时开放词汇检测的零样本泛化能力，同时不增加推理开销。

title: Benchmarking Behavioral Steerability in Behavior Foundation Models
summary: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) are emerging as a paradigm for translating human intentions into executable humanoid behaviors. As these models evolve beyond behavior generation toward general-purpose behavioral systems, a fundamental question arises: can they be reliably steered according to user intentions? In this paper, we introduce the concept of behavioral steerability, defined as the ability of BFMs to faithfully generate behaviors that satisfy user-specified intentions. To study this capability, we present RoboSteer, the first benchmark for behavioral steerability in BFMs. RoboSteer organizes behavioral steerability into a three-level hierarchy-Conditional Steering, Constraint Steering, and Compositional Steering-and establishes a unified evaluation framework supported by a large-scale multimodal motion corpus. Using RoboSteer, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of behavioral steerability across 9 existing BFMs. We view behavioral steerability as more than a capability for controlling motion: it concerns how embodied systems translate human intentions into purposeful actions. We hope RoboSteer will advance research on intention realization as a foundation for general-purpose embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行为可引导性概念，并发布首个面向行为基础模型（BFMs）的基准 RoboSteer，用于评估模型能否按用户意图忠实地生成行为；基于该基准对9个现有BFMs进行了大规模实证研究。
AI.motivation: BFMs正从行为生成走向通用行为系统，但一个关键问题尚未解决：它们能否被可靠地按照用户意图进行引导。因此需要研究并评估BFMs的行为可引导性。
AI.method: 提出行为可引导性定义，构建首个BFMs行为可引导性基准 RoboSteer；将其划分为三层：条件引导、约束引导和组合引导；建立统一评估框架，并配套大规模多模态运动语料库；利用该基准对9个现有BFMs开展大规模实证研究。
AI.result: 论文首次对9个现有BFMs的行为可引导性进行了大规模实证研究，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 行为可引导性不仅是运动控制能力，更关乎具身系统如何将人类意图转化为有目的的行动。作者希望RoboSteer能推动以意图实现为基础的通用具身智能研究。

title: LiG-DETR: Local-in-Global Reassembly in Latent Space for Aerial Object Detection
summary: Aerial object detection faces substantial scale and density variations. Small objects are easily degraded by downsampling and feature compression, while medium and large objects require sufficient global context. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: image slicing provides clearer local evidence but relies on independent crop-level prediction and post-processing, whereas feature- and query-level optimization preserves unified inference but operates on already compressed full-image representations, limiting recovery of fine-grained information. This raises a key question: can aerial detection directly acquire high-fidelity local evidence before feature degradation and integrate it into a unified end-to-end framework? To this end, we propose LiG-DETR, an Efficient Global-Local Reassembly framework that reformulates image slicing as high-fidelity local feature acquisition. A shared encoder extracts global and locally magnified features, which are projected into the detector feature space. The projected local features are reassembled according to their original spatial locations to form a globally aligned local feature level, and a single DETR decoder jointly decodes global and local features. To reduce redundant computation, Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly focuses high-resolution encoding on informative regions while preserving a dense feature layout, and Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation adapts the decoder query budget using encoder proposal scores. Experiments show substantial gains on small and medium objects while retaining strong large-object performance, with favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs and improved cross-domain generalization. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出LiG-DETR，一种高效全局-局部重组装框架，将图像切片重新表述为高保真局部特征获取，并在统一端到端DETR中联合解码全局与局部特征，以提升航拍目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 航拍目标检测存在显著的尺度与密度变化：小目标易因下采样和特征压缩而退化，中大型目标需要充分全局上下文。现有图像切片方法局部证据清晰但依赖独立裁剪预测与后处理，特征/查询级优化虽统一推理但基于已压缩的全图表示，难以恢复细粒度信息。核心问题是：能否在特征退化前直接获取高保真局部证据，并集成到统一端到端框架中。
AI.method: LiG-DETR将图像切片转化为高保真局部特征获取。共享编码器提取全局与局部放大特征，并投影到检测器特征空间；投影后的局部特征按原始空间位置重组装为全局对齐的局部特征层级，再由单个DETR解码器联合解码全局与局部特征。为降低冗余计算，提出Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly，对信息丰富区域进行高分辨率编码同时保持密集特征布局；并提出Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation，利用编码器提议分数自适应调整解码器查询预算。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在小目标和中目标上取得显著增益，同时保持较强的大目标性能，具有较好的精度-效率权衡，并提升了跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LiG-DETR通过全局-局部特征重组装与自适应查询分配，在统一端到端框架中有效利用高保真局部证据，为航拍目标检测提供了一种兼顾精度与效率的解决方案，代码将开源。

title: Dual- versus Single-Suggestion AI Support for Radiographic Interpretation in Residents: Randomized Multireader Study
summary:
Purpose: To compare dual- and single-suggestion AI support for radiographic interpretation by residents, particularly when the shared AI suggestion was incorrect.
  Materials and Methods: This prospective, multicenter, randomized three-arm reader study was conducted at three hospitals in China from July to September 2026 (ChiCTR2600129243). After specialty stratification, 132 residents with fewer than 3 years of clinical experience were randomized 1:1:1 to GPT-5.4 alone (group A), GPT-5.4 plus Kimi-K2.6 (group B), or GPT-5.4 plus Gemini-3.6 Flash (group C); 123 were analyzed. Participants interpreted 60 radiographs before and after AI support. The primary outcome was accuracy change. Welch ANOVA and Holm-adjusted t tests compared support conditions; HC3 linear models assessed specialty interaction.
  Results: Among 123 residents (mean age, 24.1 years +/- 1.4; 65 women), radiology residents showed greater accuracy improvement with dual- than single-suggestion support (B-A, 6.69 percentage points [95% CI, 0.97-12.40]; C-A, 7.87 percentage points [95% CI, 1.64-14.11]; Holm-adjusted P = .030 for both), whereas accuracy change did not differ in non-radiology residents (P = .20). When GPT-5.4 was incorrect, AI-assisted accuracy was higher with dual- than single-suggestion support in radiology residents (40.1% and 40.4% vs 20.0%) and non-radiology residents (31.3% and 31.0% vs 12.1%) (all Holm-adjusted P < .001). The dual-suggestion effect differed by specialty (interaction difference, 10.44 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.36-16.52; P < .001).
  Conclusion: Dual-suggestion support may mitigate the influence of erroneous AI suggestions, with greater accuracy improvement observed in radiology but not non-radiology residents.

AI.tldr: 这项前瞻性、多中心、随机三臂阅片研究比较了双建议与单建议AI支持对住院医师影像判读准确性的影响，尤其关注共享AI建议错误时的情况。
AI.motivation: 旨在评估当AI建议可能错误时，提供双AI建议是否能比单AI建议更好地帮助住院医师判读影像，并比较不同专业背景住院医师的差异。
AI.method: 在中国3家医院开展前瞻性、多中心、随机三臂阅片研究。132名临床经验少于3年的住院医师按专业分层后1:1:1随机分为GPT-5.4单独组、GPT-5.4+Kimi-K2.6组、GPT-5.4+Gemini-3.6 Flash组，最终123人纳入分析。参与者对60张X线片在AI支持前后进行判读。主要结局为准确性变化。采用Welch ANOVA和Holm校正t检验比较支持条件，并用HC3线性模型评估专业交互作用。
AI.result: 在123名住院医师中，放射科住院医师使用双建议支持时准确性提升大于单建议支持（B-A：6.69个百分点，95% CI 0.97-12.40；C-A：7.87个百分点，95% CI 1.64-14.11；Holm校正P=0.030），非放射科住院医师的准确性变化无差异（P=0.20）。当GPT-5.4建议错误时，双建议支持下的AI辅助准确性高于单建议支持，放射科住院医师为40.1%和40.4% vs 20.0%，非放射科住院医师为31.3%和31.0% vs 12.1%（所有Holm校正P<0.001）。双建议效应因专业而异（交互差异10.44个百分点，95% CI 4.36-16.52；P<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 双建议支持可能减轻错误AI建议的影响，并且在放射科住院医师中观察到更大的准确性提升，而非放射科住院医师中未见相同程度的提升。

title: TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment
comment: Preprint. Code and project page coming soon
summary: Latent actions supervise robot policies with action-like codes inferred from visual transitions, and their usefulness hinges on two questions: what a code keeps from a transition, and whether it still means the same thing when reused in a different initial state. The first is a tension in time: an endpoint difference discards how motion unfolds, while the full sequence admits nuisance variation. The second is left open by reconstruction, which only ever observes a latent together with the state it came from. We argue that both questions can be answered in the same place. TERRA (Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment) describes a transition by a compact temporal effect, its net feature change together with a low-order within-window dynamics component, and learns a continuous latent from this effect. The same effect space then serves as the reference for reuse: Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes a latent in other initial states and anchors the resulting effect to the one observed at its source, so that the latent is shaped by what it does across contexts rather than only by the transition it came from. With frozen linear readers, TERRA predicts actions more accurately than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, degrades more slowly under visual distractors, and keeps transported transitions faithful to the donor action as the recipient context moves farther away; a same-budget control shows that these gains come largely from EAT. At matched pretraining scale, the complete system reaches 93.4% average success on LIBERO, compared with 91.8% for UniVLA.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TERRA（时序效应表示与关系对齐）框架，用紧凑的时序效应（净特征变化加低阶窗口内动态分量）描述视觉转移并学习连续隐动作，同时通过Effect-Anchored Transport（EAT）在不同初始状态下解码并锚定效应，使隐动作由跨情境行为塑造。实验表明其动作预测优于UniVLA和LAPA式基线，抗视觉干扰更强，在LIBERO上达到93.4%平均成功率（UniVLA为91.8%）。
AI.motivation: 隐动作通过视觉转移推断动作式编码来监督机器人策略，其有效性取决于两个问题：编码从转移中保留了什么，以及在不同初始状态复用时是否仍保持相同含义。前者存在时间上的矛盾——端点差异丢失运动过程，完整序列又引入无关变化；后者被重建方法忽视，因为重建只能观察到隐变量及其来源状态，无法保证跨情境一致性。
AI.method: TERRA用紧凑的时序效应描述转移，该效应由净特征变化与低阶窗口内动态分量组成，并据此学习连续隐空间。同一效应空间作为复用的参照，Effect-Anchored Transport（EAT）在其他初始状态解码隐变量，并将产生的效应锚定到其来源处观察到的效应，使隐变量由跨情境的行为表现塑造，而非仅由其来源转移决定。
AI.result: 在冻结线性读取器下，TERRA的动作预测比UniVLA和LAPA式基线更准确；在视觉干扰下性能下降更慢；当接收情境距离越远时，搬运后的转移仍能忠实于供体动作。同预算对照实验表明增益主要来自EAT。在匹配预训练规模下，完整系统在LIBERO上达到93.4%平均成功率，优于UniVLA的91.8%。
AI.conclusion: TERRA表明，关于隐动作保留什么以及跨情境语义一致性的两个问题可在同一效应空间中得到统一解答：以时序效应为表示基础，并通过EAT进行关系对齐，可提升动作预测精度、抗干扰能力与跨情境迁移的忠实性，最终带来下游任务成功率的提升。

title: PARC-Loc: Text-to-Point-Cloud Localization with Partial Assignment and Relational Consistency
summary: Text-to-point-cloud localization estimates a position in a city-scale 3D map from descriptions of surrounding objects. Existing coarse-to-fine methods retrieve submaps using aggregate learned compatibility and then localize within a selected submap. However, repetitive or similar urban objects can inflate the embedding similarity between the query and multiple submaps, even when the instance layout within a submap violates the query description. Meanwhile, query-relevant instances often span submap boundaries, leaving the retrieved submap with incomplete contextual evidence. We term these failure modes layout-inconsistent aliasing and boundary evidence incompleteness, respectively. To address them, we propose PARC-Loc, a coarse-to-fine localization framework built on Partial Assignment with Relational Consistency (PARC). PARC jointly models hint-object compatibility and pairwise spatial relations, allowing unmatched elements while favoring assignments consistent with the queried layout. At the coarse stage, its candidate-level assessment complements neural similarity for layout-consistent submap selection. At the fine stage, the context is expanded with query-relevant instances from adjacent submaps, while PARC yields object-level matching weights that guide cross-modal attention. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose and CityLoc show that PARC-Loc outperforms conventional coarse-to-fine baselines. On KITTI360Pose, our method improves Top-1 localization recall at 5 m from 0.50 to 0.67, achieving a 34% relative gain over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 PARC-Loc 粗到精定位框架，通过部分分配与关系一致性（PARC）解决文本到点云城市级定位中的布局不一致混叠和边界证据不完整问题，并在 KITTI360Pose 和 CityLoc 上取得优于基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有粗到精方法依赖聚合学习兼容性检索子图，但重复或相似城市物体会导致查询与多个子图嵌入相似度虚高，即使子图内实例布局与查询描述不符；同时查询相关实例常跨越子图边界，使检索到的子图缺乏完整上下文证据。
AI.method: 基于部分分配与关系一致性（PARC），联合建模提示物体兼容性和成对空间关系，允许未匹配元素并偏好与查询布局一致的分配。粗阶段用候选级评估补充神经相似度以选择布局一致子图；精阶段从相邻子图扩展查询相关实例，并利用 PARC 输出的物体级匹配权重引导跨模态注意力。
AI.result: 在 KITTI360Pose 和 CityLoc 上，PARC-Loc 优于传统粗到精基线；在 KITTI360Pose 上，5 米 Top-1 定位召回从 0.50 提升至 0.67，相对最强基线提升 34%。
AI.conclusion: PARC-Loc 能有效缓解布局不一致混叠和边界证据不完整两类失败模式，提升城市级文本到点云定位性能。

title: Design of a Fully Actuated 4-DOF Robotic Finger With Joint-Specific Hybrid Remote Actuation
comment: 10 pages, 10 figures. This manuscript has been submitted for possible publication
summary: This paper presents a fully actuated 4-DOF robotic finger using a joint-specific hybrid remote-actuation architecture. The metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joint is driven by two coordinated rigid-link transmission sets, whereas the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) and distal interphalangeal (DIP) joints are independently actuated by closed-loop wire transmissions incorporating circular rolling-contact joints (RCJs). A larger transmission radius is used at the PIP joint than at the DIP joint. The RCJ wire geometry maintains the total wire-loop length during joint rotation, and the DIP wire routing is designed so that PIP motion does not affect its differential actuation for a fixed MCP configuration. The distal wire transmission, MCP linkage, and fingertip kinematics are analytically modeled. In experiments, the transmission behavior was quantitatively evaluated from the ball-screw displacements measured using ArUco-marker tracking. MCP actuation produced measurable displacements of the PIP and DIP transmission units, whereas isolated PIP and DIP actuation with the MCP fixed supported the intended mechanical decoupling between the distal transmissions. The mean peak fingertip forces under isolated MCP, PIP, and DIP actuation were 21.28 N, 9.22 N, and 5.75 N, respectively. The resulting finger postures were also examined using objects of different geometries and sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全驱动4自由度机械手指，采用关节专用混合远程驱动架构：MCP由两组协调刚性连杆驱动，PIP和DIP由带圆滚动接触关节的闭环线传动独立驱动。论文完成建模与实验验证，实现远端传动解耦并测试指尖力与抓取姿态。
AI.motivation: 为实现4自由度机械手指的全驱动，同时解决远程线传动中多关节运动耦合、线长变化和紧凑传动等问题。
AI.method: 设计混合远程驱动架构：MCP关节使用两套协调刚性连杆传动；PIP和DIP关节使用独立闭环线传动并集成圆滚动接触关节，PIP传动半径大于DIP。DIP布线设计使固定MCP时PIP运动不影响其差动驱动。建立远端线传动、MCP连杆和指尖运动学模型。实验中使用ArUco标记追踪测量滚珠丝杠位移，并测试孤立关节驱动、指尖输出力和不同几何尺寸物体下的手指姿态。
AI.result: MCP驱动会引起PIP和DIP传动单元的可测位移；在MCP固定时，孤立PIP和DIP驱动支持远端传动之间的预期机械解耦。孤立MCP、PIP和DIP驱动下的平均峰值指尖力分别为21.28 N、9.22 N和5.75 N。不同几何形状和尺寸物体下的手指姿态也得到考察。
AI.conclusion: 该混合远程驱动架构能够实现全驱动4自由度机械手指的独立或解耦驱动，并提供有效的指尖力输出，实验验证了传动、运动学建模和抓取姿态设计。

title: Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents
summary: Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出一种情境条件化思维记忆框架，将历史推理经验转化为轻量策略，用于预测当前情境下应思考什么，而具体推理仍交给大语言模型；同时跨多个独立片段周期性地提炼可复用的新思维知识。
AI.motivation: 长期自主智能体需要复用积累的推理经验，但不能让显式历史记忆和LLM上下文无限增长；现有记忆机制主要检索、总结或压缩过去内容，无法直接学习何时激活特定思维，也难以从时间分散的经验中发现新思维知识。
AI.method: 构建情境条件化思维记忆：将历史推理经验转化为轻量策略，预测当前情境下应激活何种思考；情境可表示时间或时空演化而非仅当前状态；周期性分析多个独立片段中的临时经验，发现重复的长程规律，并将其固化为新思维知识，再内化到轻量策略中。
AI.result: 在时间规则泛化上达到1.000 F1；将DeepSeek推理F1从0.789提升至0.868；在30,000个历史情境下，每查询在线处理时间从0.3636 ms降至0.0382 ms；在足够多次跨经验证据后，关系发现F1和未来思维准确率达到1.000。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效复用历史推理经验，避免记忆和上下文无限增长，同时学习何时激活思维并提炼新思维知识，在泛化、推理性能、效率及关系发现等指标上取得显著提升。

title: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
summary: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing. We introduce OmniCam, an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions. Its geometry-grounded pose token learning combines three components: a panoramic point-cloud encoder for omnidirectional geometric context; hybrid absolute-rotation and relative-translation tokenization with temporally consistent quaternion signs; and separate geometric and semantic conditioning streams with an explicit 3D target anchor. We also construct OmniCaT, containing 267,700 trajectories across four camera behaviors. On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28--47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT. Against the best baseline for each metric, the ATE and collision reductions are 43.0% and 62.3%, respectively. Component ablations support the use of geometric and target-aware conditioning, while downstream experiments examine camera-controlled video generation and robotic active perception.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniCam，一种从单张全景图和文本轨迹描述自回归生成相机位姿序列的模型，并构建了 OmniCaT 数据集。
AI.motivation: 相机轨迹控制视频生成、场景重建和机器人感知中的视角变化；从语言生成轨迹需要同时理解场景几何和目标感知取景。
AI.method: OmniCam 采用几何接地的位姿 token 学习：全景点云编码器提供全向几何上下文；混合绝对旋转与相对平移 token 化，并使用时间一致的四元数符号；分离几何与语义条件流，并加入显式 3D 目标锚点。同时构建 OmniCaT，包含四类相机行为的 267,700 条轨迹。
AI.result: 在 OmniCaT 评测中，相比在 OmniCaT 上重训练的 GenDoP，轨迹误差降低 28–47%，碰撞率降低 65.8%；相比各指标最佳基线，ATE 和碰撞率分别降低 43.0% 和 62.3%。消融实验支持几何和目标感知条件的作用。
AI.conclusion: OmniCam 能有效从全景图和语言生成相机轨迹，并可用于相机控制的视频生成和机器人主动感知等下游任务。

title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
summary: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了高分辨率动态触觉传感对多指灵巧手抓取稳定性预测与模型引导抓取的作用，构建了包含1万次抓取试验、200个物体及视觉/本体/触觉多模态数据的数据集，并验证触觉可提升抓取稳定性预测与在线重抓取成功率。
AI.motivation: 人类可借助指尖触觉近乎完美地抓取物体，但机器人抓取研究多依赖视觉和两指夹爪，缺乏对高分辨率动态触觉在灵巧手抓取中作用的系统研究。
AI.method: 使用配备四个Digit 360触觉传感器的多指机械手，在200个物体上采集1万次抓取试验，记录外部视觉、本体感知和触觉流；训练端到端时序多模态模型，从提拉前观察预测提拉后稳定性，并比较不同传感模态与编码骨干网络，进行受控输入消融。
AI.result: 实验和输入消融表明，引入触觉尤其是高分辨率动态触觉可提升抓取稳定性预测；将学习到的预测器作为在线稳定性门控部署到真实机器人后，视觉-触觉模型引导的重抓取相比非触觉门控将执行提拉成功率提高了10.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 丰富指尖传感与捕捉触觉动态的时序模型可在无需显式接触或力建模的情况下支持多指手学习抓取，为从触觉经验走向稳定灵巧操作提供了可扩展的数据驱动路径，数据集已公开。

title: From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving
comment: Accepted at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems extracted from four sets of papers, solving about 200 open problems. One experiment used papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science. There, we answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by their authors.

AI.tldr: Bolzano 是一个开源多智能体系统，结合并行证明智能体与验证智能体，并维护人类可读的研究状态，用于数学证明搜索与验证。它在人工引导下取得 8 个经专家验证的结果，并在约 3800 个开放问题上自动求解了约 200 个，其中在 STOC 2026 论文相关实验中回答了 4 个问题并获作者确认。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正越来越多地参与数学研究，而数学进展往往依赖高效证明搜索、增量改进和仔细验证。作者希望通过多智能体系统提升证明搜索与验证能力，并检验其在无问题特定人工引导下解决开放问题的潜力。
AI.method: 提出 Bolzano：一个开源多智能体系统，使用并行证明智能体、一个验证智能体，并维护人类可读的研究状态。先在专家选定的问题上进行人工使用，随后在从四组论文中提取的约 3800 个开放问题上进行无问题特定人工引导的实验，其中一组论文来自 STOC 2026。
AI.result: 初始人工使用产生 8 个结果，其证明由领域专家检查通过。无问题特定人工引导的大规模实验中，系统从约 3800 个开放问题中解决了约 200 个。在 STOC 2026 论文实验中，回答了论文提出的 4 个问题，并得到作者确认。
AI.conclusion: Bolzano 能够辅助数学研究，在人工引导和自动搜索两种模式下都展现出解决开放问题的能力，尤其可在无问题特定人工引导时发现并验证有价值的结果。

title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
summary: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. We introduce LiveMACEBench, a process-aware benchmark that uses live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed for persistent LLM agents. Five frontier LLMs operate along continuous trajectories under matched Tool Use, Persistent Memory, Rule Following, and Multi-Agent Collaboration configurations. We evaluate them through both realized outcomes and mechanism-specific diagnostics derived from complete decision traces. Across 30 days of live evaluation, we find a pronounced outcome-capability gap: realized returns often diverge from capability-specific measurements, and similar outcomes can arise from markedly different patterns of mechanism use. Trace-level diagnostics further expose distinct bottlenecks across capabilities, demonstrating that mechanism access, effective mechanism use, and downstream performance are not interchangeable measures of agent capability. LiveMACEBench makes this distinction measurable, turning live markets from a performance leaderboard into a diagnostic environment for agent capability

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LiveMACEBench，一个以真实金融市场为动态环境的流程感知基准，用于评估持久性 LLM 智能体；它不仅看最终结果，还通过完整决策轨迹诊断工具使用、持久记忆、规则遵循和多智能体协作等机制能力。
AI.motivation: 仅以结果评估智能体会掩盖产生结果的能力差异，尤其在动态演化环境中，结果来自智能体行为与外部条件变化的闭环交互，因此需要过程感知的评估方法。
AI.method: 让五个前沿 LLM 在匹配的工具使用、持久记忆、规则遵循和多智能体协作配置下，沿连续轨迹运行；以真实金融市场为自然演化测试床，进行 30 天在线评估，并结合结果指标与基于完整决策轨迹的机制特异性诊断。
AI.result: 发现显著的结果—能力差距：实现收益常与能力特异性测量不一致，相似结果可能来自截然不同的机制使用模式；轨迹级诊断还揭示不同能力存在不同瓶颈，表明机制可访问、机制有效使用与下游表现并非可互换的智能体能力度量。
AI.conclusion: LiveMACEBench 使结果与能力的区分可测量，将真实市场从单纯性能排行榜转变为面向智能体能力的诊断环境。

title: STRIKE: Learning Visual State Transitions for Physical World Modeling
summary: Physical world modeling requires predicting how interactions change a scene, not merely generating coherent motion. We propose STRIKE, a framework that separates visual state transition learning from dense video generation. We construct event-aligned supervision by extracting observed states from training videos and pairing them with transition descriptions and temporal offsets. An image-based transition model learns to predict the next scene configuration from the current image, a local transition specification, and elapsed time. At inference, a pretrained vision-language planner predicts time transition specifications, and recursive application of the learned transition model produces a sequence of future visual states. A separately trained dynamic model then generates the complete rollout conditioned on these states and their temporal locations. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified, PhyGenBench, Pisa-Experiments, and RoboTwin2.0 show improvements of STRIKE over the corresponding video-backbone baselines in benchmark measures of physical consistency and manipulation-video fidelity. These results support learned visual state transitions as an effective intermediate representation for physical world modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIKE框架，将视觉状态转移学习与密集视频生成分离，用于物理世界建模。
AI.motivation: 物理世界建模需要预测交互如何改变场景，而不仅是生成连贯的运动。
AI.method: 从训练视频中提取观测状态，并与转移描述和时间偏移配对，构建事件对齐监督；训练基于图像的转移模型，根据当前图像、局部转移规范和时间预测下一场景配置；推理时，预训练视觉语言规划器预测时间转移规范，递归应用转移模型生成未来视觉状态序列；再以单独训练的动态模型根据这些状态及其时间位置生成完整视频。
AI.result: 在Physics-IQ Verified、PhyGenBench、Pisa-Experiments和RoboTwin2.0上，STRIKE相比对应视频骨干基线，在物理一致性和操作视频保真度指标上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的视觉状态转移可作为物理世界建模的有效中间表示。

title: Making Task Abstractions Executable: Control-Aware Layout Repair for a Fixed Controller
summary: A task abstraction can specify the intended events while its spatial layout prevents a fixed agent and controller from completing them. Starting from a supplied structured task record, we compile whole-task tracking, clearance, and actuation requirements into auditable affine layout constraints. We repair only declared continuous coordinates, preserving event order, timing, topology, and the controller. A most-violated-row update admits conditional finite-certification and net-displacement bounds; a same-compiler quadratic projection separates the representation from the optimizer. On three researcher-authored task abstractions, both backends certify all three layouts and complete all 300 fresh paired rollouts per backend. A risk-target sweep also exposes fixed event tests that the chosen certificate cannot satisfy through layout edits alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将结构化任务记录编译为可审计的仿射布局约束，通过仅调整声明的连续坐标来修复空间布局，使固定智能体与控制器能够完成任务，同时保持事件顺序、时序、拓扑和控制器不变。
AI.motivation: 任务抽象虽指定了预期事件，但空间布局可能使固定智能体与控制器无法完成这些事件；因此需要在不改变任务语义和控制器的前提下修复布局。
AI.method: 从结构化任务记录出发，将全任务跟踪、间隙和驱动要求编译为仿射布局约束；仅修复声明的连续坐标，保持事件顺序、时序、拓扑和控制器。采用最违反行更新，提供条件性有限认证和净位移界；并用同一编译器的二次投影分离表示与优化器。
AI.result: 在三个研究者编写的任务抽象上，两种后端均认证全部三个布局，并各完成300次新配对rollout；风险目标扫描还发现某些固定事件测试无法仅通过布局编辑满足所选证书。
AI.conclusion: 布局编辑可在固定控制器下认证并完成任务，且保持事件顺序、时序和拓扑；但存在仅靠布局编辑无法满足的固定事件测试，表明该方法及证书有其适用边界。

title: How Do Agentic LLMs Decide to Call Tools? A Tool-Call Vector Shaped by Suppression
