summary: Tool calling, invoking external tools on demand, is central to agentic LLMs, yet the mechanism that decides whether a model calls a tool or responds directly remains poorly understood. Agentic prompts are long and heavily scaffolded, combining role instructions, tool schemas, format templates, and the user's request across hundreds of tokens, creating a noisy, highly entangled context in which no single controllable variable for mechanistic analysis is obvious. To obtain such a variable, we propose a method that converts complex agentic prompts into minimal contrastive pairs in which a single request verb determines the tool-call decision: replacing an execution-verb (e.g., \textit{write}) with an analysis-verb (e.g., \textit{discuss}) reliably flips the decision, suggesting it is mediated by a compact internal state. We construct 500 such paired prompts across Python, Java, and C++ (300 for mechanistic analysis, 200 held out for evaluation). We trace the decision to a vector, $μ_Δ$, that is both causally necessary and sufficient and generalizes beyond the discovery prompts to native multi-turn $τ^2$-Bench trajectories and verb-free requests. Behavioral ablations show that the scaffold establishes a tool-call prior; Transcoder decomposition then reveals that analysis verbs suppress this prior through features signaling that tool use is unnecessary, whereas execution verbs largely leave it intact. Downstream scaffold-reading attention heads and MLP features read out the resulting state, and the same mechanism recurs across seven models from the Qwen, Mistral, and Granite families. Our code is available at https://github.com/XijieGo/MI4ToolCalling.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究智能体LLM中决定调用工具还是直接回答的内部机制，提出用最小对比提示对将复杂智能体提示简化为由请求动词控制的工具调用决策，并定位到一个因果必要且充分的中介向量。
AI.motivation: 工具调用对智能体LLM至关重要，但模型何时调用工具、何时直接回答的机制尚不清楚。智能体提示通常很长且高度纠缠，包含角色指令、工具模式、格式模板和用户请求，难以找到单一可控变量进行机制分析。
AI.method: 提出将复杂智能体提示转换为最小对比对的方法：仅替换请求动词，如把执行动词write换成分析动词discuss，从而可靠翻转工具调用决策。构建500对提示，覆盖Python、Java和C++，其中300用于机制分析、200用于评估。追踪决策到向量μΔ，并检验其因果必要性与充分性、泛化性。结合行为消融、Transcoder分解以及注意力头和MLP特征分析。
AI.result: 发现μΔ对工具调用决策因果必要且充分，并能泛化到原生多轮τ²-Bench轨迹和无动词请求。行为消融表明脚手架建立了工具调用先验；Transcoder分解显示分析动词通过表示“无需使用工具”的特征抑制该先验，而执行动词基本保持先验不变。下游读取脚手架状态的注意力头和MLP特征读出最终状态，且该机制在Qwen、Mistral和Granite家族的七个模型中重复出现。
AI.conclusion: 工具调用决策由紧凑的内部状态中介，可由请求动词通过最小对比对稳定操控；该机制在不同模型家族中具有可复现性，为理解智能体LLM的工具调用行为提供了机制解释。代码已开源。

title: SafeEvo: Deciphering the Safety Alignment Mechanism and Evolution in Language Models
summary: Safety interpretability advances the study of Large Language Model (LLM) alignment from behavioral constraints driven by data or algorithms towards a deeper understanding of internal mechanisms. However, existing works have focused primarily on safety-related representations, attention heads, or neurons after alignment, while largely overlooking the safety mechanisms in pretrained-only models and their evolution across alignment checkpoints. To address this, we propose SafeEvo, an interpretability framework from the circuit (sparse subgraphs of an LLM) perspective. SafeEvo first applies an optimization-based extraction algorithm to identify weak refusal circuits in pretrained base LLMs that can independently express refusal behavior. Causally ablating these circuits completely eliminates the base model's refusal of harmful inputs. SafeEvo then traces the evolution of refusal circuits across successive alignment checkpoints and finds that their structures change progressively, suggesting that the alignment tax may result from refusal-circuit updates affecting utility-related parameters. To validate this, SafeEvo introduces Safety Circuit Alignment (SCA), which confines safety updates to the refusal circuits. Experiments across three LLMs and two alignment algorithms show that, on average, SCA outperforms vanilla alignment in three aspects: \textbf{(1) stronger alignment}, lowering harmfulness score by 63.21\%; \textbf{(2) less over-refusal}, yielding a 58.44\% decrease in refusal rates for benign queries; and \textbf{(3) better utility}, retaining 99.58\% of the original model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SafeEvo，一个从电路视角研究LLM安全机制的可解释性框架。它提取预训练模型中的弱拒绝电路，追踪其在对齐检查点中的演化，并提出安全电路对齐（SCA）方法，将安全更新限制在拒绝电路内，从而在提升对齐效果的同时减少过度拒绝并保持模型效用。
AI.motivation: 现有安全可解释性研究主要关注对齐后的安全表征、注意力头或神经元，而忽视了预训练模型中的安全机制及其在对齐检查点中的演化。为填补这一空白，本文从电路视角展开研究。
AI.method: SafeEvo：1) 基于优化的提取算法识别预训练基础LLM中可独立表达拒绝行为的弱拒绝电路；2) 因果消融这些电路完全消除对有害输入的拒绝；3) 追踪拒绝电路在对齐检查点中的演化；4) 提出安全电路对齐（SCA），将安全更新限制在拒绝电路内。
AI.result: 在三个LLM和两种对齐算法上，SCA平均优于原始对齐：有害性得分降低63.21%，对良性查询的拒绝率降低58.44%，并保留原始模型能力的99.58%。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝电路在对齐过程中结构逐渐变化，对齐税可能源于拒绝电路更新影响效用相关参数。SCA通过将安全更新限制在拒绝电路，实现了更强对齐、更少过度拒绝和更好效用。

title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
summary: Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge. It is therefore critical to verify each skill's reusability: whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled. Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised. To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox, a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel. A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill. The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency. Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillSandbox框架，为每个技能动态合成技能相关但新颖的任务与环境，通过对比有无技能的执行来验证技能可复用性，决定是否保留技能。
AI.motivation: 自进化智能体将任务经验蒸馏为技能，但技能可能编码错误流程或不可迁移知识，因此需验证技能是否可复用。现有任务可能无法暴露技能适用情境，需主动构造新情境。
AI.method: SkillSandbox包含Proposer、Builder和Verifier：Proposer指定需保留的条件与可变细节；Builder构建可执行场景；Verifier对比有无技能的执行，评估可执行性、效用和效率，给出Keep或Reject判定。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上使用三种模型，SkillSandbox持续获得最强下游性能并提升执行效率。进一步分析表明收益反映对技能可复用性的准确评估，并识别了各组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: SkillSandbox能有效验证技能可复用性，提升自进化智能体的下游性能与执行效率。

title: Hall Effect-Based Tactile Force Detection Sensor for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: Robotic minimally invasive surgery has revolutionized surgical practice. However, as the surgeons are mechanically separated from the surgical tools, loss of tactile feedback occurs. We present a compact force sensor with three, millimeter scale sensing elements (taxels) that can be affixed to the grasping face of a robotic surgical tool. The sensor features a miniaturized design using Hall effect sensors and magnets embedded in a deformable elastomer contact layer. Sensor calibration is achieved with a 6 degree of freedom (DoF) parallel robot. Each taxel can detect applied normal and shear forces with average RMSE of 2.133 kPa. The calibrated sensor was validated on phantom and ex vivo porcine tissue, demonstrating tactile sensing during retraction as well as slip. This work introduces a small-scale Hall effect based tactile sensor, enabling sensing for force-sensitive robotic surgical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可贴附于机器人手术工具夹持面的紧凑型三触点霍尔效应触觉传感器，用于恢复机器人微创手术中的力/触觉反馈。
AI.motivation: 机器人微创手术中，外科医生与手术工具机械分离，导致触觉反馈丧失。
AI.method: 设计包含三个毫米级传感单元（taxels）的紧凑力传感器，采用霍尔效应传感器与嵌入可变形弹性体接触层中的磁体；使用6自由度并联机器人进行标定，并能在每个taxel上检测法向力和剪切力。
AI.result: 每个taxel检测法向和剪切力的平均RMSE为2.133 kPa；在体模和离体猪组织上验证，展示了牵拉和滑动过程中的触觉感知。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种小型霍尔效应触觉传感器，可为力敏感机器人手术应用提供触觉感知。

title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
summary: Complementing the many efforts in providing semantic representations of concepts, notions, and entities in materials science, we report and illustrate a process by which we can automatically build a knowledge graph of the fast evolving field of machine learning applied to the prediction of material properties, focusing on MLIP (Machine Learning Interatomic Potential). This LLM-based process relies on multiple steps, from information extraction in documents and articles to a validation loop using SHACL constraints to detect and correct errors. It is carried out on a model-by-model basis, focusing on the consistency of representation, therefore enabling an iterative construction where the addition of new models is facilitated. We illustrate the process by showing a few interesting aspects that can be queried from a knowledge graph built from the models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于LLM的流程，可自动构建机器学习势（MLIP）领域的知识图谱，并通过SHACL约束进行验证与纠错，最终以Matbench Discovery排行榜中的模型为例展示查询结果。
AI.motivation: 材料科学中已有语义表示工作，但机器学习用于材料性质预测、尤其是MLIP领域发展迅速，亟需自动构建结构化知识图谱以补充现有表示并支持知识整合。
AI.method: 采用LLM驱动的多步骤流程：从文档和文章中抽取信息，使用SHACL约束构建验证循环以检测和纠正错误；以模型为单元进行构建，强调表示一致性，支持迭代式加入新模型。
AI.result: 成功构建了基于Matbench Discovery排行榜所列模型的知识图谱，并展示了若干可从该图谱中查询到的有趣方面。
AI.conclusion: 该流程能够自动、一致且可迭代地构建MLIP领域知识图谱，便于新增模型扩展，并支持对领域知识进行有效查询与分析。

title: ActiveLang: Active Open-Vocabulary 3D Mapping with Semantic-Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
summary: As robots increasingly assist humans with diverse tasks, they need both geometric and semantic understanding of their surroundings. Moreover, robots often operate in unfamiliar environments and take on new tasks without knowing the relevant concepts ahead of time. This motivates language-annotated 3D maps that support open-vocabulary scene understanding and human-robot interaction. We introduce ActiveLang, an autonomous system for active open-vocabulary 3D mapping with semantic-uncertainty-guided exploration. ActiveLang performs online language-feature adaptation on a compact dual-Gaussian representation to jointly reconstruct scene geometry, appearance, and open-vocabulary semantics with modest memory overhead. Its planner efficiently selects informative viewpoints, enabling effective mapping with fewer observations and lower computational cost. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ demonstrate substantial improvements in 2D and 3D open-vocabulary segmentation over both online and offline baselines, highlighting that actively exploring scenes builds language-annotated 3D maps more efficiently.

AI.tldr: ActiveLang 是一个主动开放词汇3D建图系统，利用语义不确定性引导探索，在紧凑双高斯表示上在线适应语言特征，高效构建语言标注3D地图。
AI.motivation: 机器人需同时理解几何与语义，且在陌生环境执行新任务时无法预知相关概念，因此需要开放词汇3D地图以支持场景理解与人机交互。
AI.method: 在紧凑双高斯表示上进行在线语言特征适应，联合重建几何、外观与开放词汇语义，内存开销小；规划器基于语义不确定性高效选择信息量大的视角，减少观测与计算成本。
AI.result: 在Replica和ScanNet++上，2D和3D开放词汇分割相比在线与离线基线均有显著提升，表明主动探索能更高效地构建语言标注3D地图。
AI.conclusion: 主动探索场景可更高效地构建语言标注3D地图，提升开放词汇分割性能。

title: Energy-Efficient Gait Adaptation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Diverse Terrains
comment: 9 pages. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Ammar Issa, Anubhav Singh, and Anton Tsaritsin contributed equally
summary: While energy efficiency is a critical objective for legged-robot locomotion control, achieving low energy consumption while maintaining robust performance across different velocity ranges and terrain conditions remains a key challenge. This is particularly true for end-to-end RL policies, where gait generation, motion execution, and energy optimization are tightly coupled, leading to high sensitivity to reward design. In this work, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that separates a high-frequency policy for stable and robust joint-level motion execution from low-frequency gait adaptation that explicitly minimizes the cost of transport (CoT). The three-stage Isaac-based training procedure enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with improved tracking accuracy, robustness, and energy efficiency. The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds. We validate the proposed approach in simulation against representative single-policy and hierarchical locomotion baselines, demonstrating reduced CoT over a broad range of commanded velocities, while maintaining robust locomotion across flat, uneven rough, and inclined terrains. We further demonstrate its practical feasibility through zero-shot deployment on a physical Unitree AlienGo quadruped.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层强化学习框架，将高频的关节级运动执行策略与低频的步态自适应策略分离，后者显式最小化运输成本（CoT），并通过三阶段Isaac训练实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，在仿真和Unitree AlienGo四足机器人上验证了其节能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 腿足机器人运动中，在广泛速度范围和地形条件下同时实现低能耗与鲁棒性是一大挑战。端到端强化学习策略将步态生成、运动执行与能量优化紧密耦合，导致对奖励设计高度敏感，难以兼顾能效与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出分层强化学习（HRL）框架：高频策略负责稳定鲁棒的关节级运动执行，低频策略进行步态自适应并显式最小化运输成本（CoT）。采用三阶段基于Isaac的训练流程，实现零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.result: 在仿真中与单策略及分层运动基线对比，所提方法在广泛指令速度范围内降低了CoT，并在平地、崎岖不平和倾斜地形上保持鲁棒运动。学习到的分层策略表现出自动的速度相关步态适应：低速时踱步，高速时小跑。在Unitree AlienGo四足机器人上实现零样本部署。
AI.conclusion: 该分层强化学习框架能够有效降低能耗，同时在不同速度和地形下保持鲁棒运动，并成功实现零样本真实机器人部署，验证了其实际可行性。

title: Reasoning-Token Spikes Under Prompted Untruthful Responding in Large Language Models
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/Wakaranaino/token-spike-project ; Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21895296
summary: Monitoring the chain-of-thought of reasoning artificial intelligence (AI) models remains a key approach to detecting deception and other forms of misbehavior in such models. However, semantic chain-of-thought monitoring depends on reasoning traces being legible and sufficiently faithful to the underlying computations that produced the model's behavior, not to mention accessible. Moreover, there is increasing evidence that chain-of-thought outputs may soon become illegible or unfaithful, if they even remain accessible. Based on cognitive load theory, we investigate a lower-bandwidth signal -- the number of reasoning tokens generated -- which does not require access to the content of the reasoning trace. Three reasoning-capable large language models answered 210 multiple-choice questions -- across analytic, descriptive, and normative reasoning types as well as moral and non-moral domains -- under system prompts instructing them to respond truthfully, falsely, or without regard for truth. Across all three models, truth-directed responding elicited fewer reasoning tokens than both lie-directed and truth-indifferent responding. These findings show that explicitly prompted untruthful response policies can produce robust group-level differences in test-time reasoning-token use. While not yet establishing reasoning-token count as a detector of spontaneous deception or general misalignment, our results are a proof of concept that it can serve as a simple, content-independent candidate signal for differentiating untruthful from truthful model behavior when raw reasoning traces are unavailable or unreliable. Future work should test instance-level detection rates, out-of-distribution generalization, learned deceptive policies, hidden objectives, and robustness under adversarial pressure.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索一种不依赖思维链内容的新型监测信号：推理令牌数量。实验发现，当要求大语言模型如实作答时，其使用的推理令牌少于要求撒谎或无视真伪时，表明该低带宽信号可区分不真实与真实的模型行为。
AI.motivation: 语义层面的思维链监测依赖推理轨迹可读、忠实且可访问，但这些条件可能逐渐不成立。因此，作者希望寻找一种无需访问推理内容、更简单且内容无关的替代信号，以检测模型欺骗等不当行为。
AI.method: 基于认知负荷理论，研究选取三个具备推理能力的大语言模型，让它们回答210道多项选择题，涵盖分析性、描述性和规范性推理，以及道德与非道德领域。通过系统提示分别要求模型如实回答、虚假回答或不在乎真伪，并比较其测试时生成的推理令牌数量。
AI.result: 在所有三个模型中，如实作答导向的提示所引发的推理令牌数量均少于撒谎导向和无所谓真伪导向的提示。这表明，明确提示的不真实回答策略会在群体层面稳定地改变测试时推理令牌的使用量。
AI.conclusion: 推理令牌数量可作为内容无关的候选信号，在原始推理轨迹不可用或不可靠时，用于区分不真实与真实的模型行为。目前尚不能证明其能检测自发欺骗或普遍失准，但结果为未来研究提供了概念验证，后续需测试实例级检测率、分布外泛化、学习到的欺骗策略、隐藏目标及对抗条件下的稳健性。

title: It Is Not Seeing the Hazard: A Frozen Vision-Language Safety Score Measures Its Caption Bank
summary: Frozen vision-language models increasingly provide safety signals for reinforcement learning. Their use assumes that similarity to language describing danger indicates the hazard itself. Yet policy return and collision rate cannot reveal whether a score detects hazards or responds to correlated features of the scene. VLM-based methods have reported gains in driving and safe-RL benchmarks by converting image-text similarity into rewards, costs, or confidence weights. Such signals promise to reduce reliance on manually designed feedback. They may also reflect prompt structure, embedding geometry, or camera viewpoint, leaving their safety meaning unverified. To address this gap, we present a controlled evaluation of a frozen CLIP prompt-margin safety score. We apply the score to trajectories generated by policies that never receive it, match pre-contact observations to contact-free observations with comparable hazard geometry, and vary the captions, encoder, and camera view. Across three policies, 180 episodes, and 130 isolated contact onsets, the score decreases for about twenty steps before contact. Mechanism controls indicate that the score mainly tracks resemblance to the scene shared by its captions and changes with caption separation and camera view. A constant-confidence control retains the lower catastrophe-rate point estimate, so policy gains do not establish hazard perception.

AI.tldr: 本文对冻结CLIP提示边际安全分数进行受控评估，检验其是否真正感知危险，而非仅响应与危险相关的场景特征。
AI.motivation: 越来越多工作用冻结视觉语言模型为强化学习提供安全信号，并假设图像-文本相似度能指示危险本身；但策略回报与碰撞率无法区分该分数是在检测危险，还是在响应提示结构、嵌入几何或相机视角等混杂特征。
AI.method: 在策略从未接收该分数的轨迹上应用冻结CLIP提示边际安全分数；将接触前观测与危险几何可比的非接触观测配对；并改变标题、编码器和相机视角进行机制控制。
AI.result: 在三个策略、180个回合和130个孤立接触起始中，分数在接触前约20步下降；机制控制表明该分数主要追踪标题所共享的场景相似性，并随标题分离度和相机视角变化；恒定置信度控制仍保留较低灾难率点估计。
AI.conclusion: 该CLIP安全分数的危险感知含义未经验证；策略性能提升不能证明其具备危险感知能力，使用VLM安全信号需谨慎解释。

title: MeshSIPP: Efficient Lattice Planning in Dynamic Environment
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments requires computing spatiotemporal trajectories that satisfy non-holonomic motion constraints. When the trajectories of the moving obstacles are predictable or known, a promising approach is to rely on the combination of state lattices constructed from precomputed feasible motion primitives and Safe Interval Path Planning -- a search-based algorithm with strong theoretical guarantees. While this approach yields feasible paths, the rich primitive sets needed for smooth navigation induce a large branching factor, which becomes costly when coupled with time-dependent obstacle intervals. To this end, we present MeshSIPP, an efficient planner that removes the computational bottleneck by exploiting the fact that many primitives sweep the same regions and can therefore be validated together. MeshSIPP propagates primitives as spatial bundles, screens them with lightweight bounding-interval checks, and defers the expensive exact departure-time search until a primitive reaches its terminal state. A time-aware pruning rule additionally discards redundant space-time branches early in the search. We prove that the resulting search is complete and optimal. Extensive experiments over more than 6,000 benchmark instances and real-time ROS~2 simulations show that MeshSIPP achieves up to a 3$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art spatiotemporal planners.

AI.tldr: MeshSIPP是一种高效时空轨迹规划器，用于动态环境下的自主导航。它结合状态格与Safe Interval Path Planning，通过将运动基元作为空间束传播、轻量级边界区间筛选、延迟精确出发时间搜索以及时间感知剪枝，缓解大量基元带来的分支因子问题，并证明完备性与最优性。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中自主导航需满足非完整运动约束的时空轨迹。基于预计算可行运动基元的状态格与Safe Interval Path Planning结合虽具理论保证，但为平滑导航所需的丰富基元集会导致大分支因子，与时间相关障碍区间结合时计算代价高。
AI.method: 提出MeshSIPP规划器。利用许多基元扫过相同区域可一起验证的特点，将基元作为空间束传播，用轻量级边界区间检查筛选，并在基元到达终止状态后才进行昂贵的精确出发时间搜索；同时引入时间感知剪枝规则，提前丢弃冗余时空分支。论文证明该搜索完备且最优，并在6000多个基准实例和实时ROS 2仿真中评估。
AI.result: MeshSIPP相比当前最先进的时空规划器最高实现3倍加速，同时保持搜索的完备性与最优性。
AI.conclusion: MeshSIPP通过空间束传播与延迟精确时间搜索有效消除计算瓶颈，是动态环境中高效且实用的时空轨迹规划方法。

title: GAGR-Lab: Evaluating Joint Spatial-Geometric and Analytic Function Reasoning
summary: Joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning requires translating a perceived spatial configuration into a symbolic function whose executed curve satisfies geometric constraints. We present GAGR-Lab, a framework for measuring this capability through Cartesian game scenes, explicit function semantics, and authoritative Rust trajectory execution. It distinguishes spatial perception, metric grounding, geometric relations, function interpretation, function construction, and constrained synthesis. We specify four configurable scene-difficulty presets and a prospective 24-cell diagnostic design, while reporting only the subset actually evaluated. A bounded pilot of one hosted model (Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct) using two API credentials as execution replicas yields 72 balanced games with 432 attempts, 429 valid provider responses, and no target hits; exploratory ordinary-function prompt variants also fail to hit, while the structured localization interface yields no scoreable outputs. A privileged analytic search control independently succeeds on 600 directional cases from 300 generated scenes, with exact repeatability and 1,200 successful vertical-reflection or translation checks. The framework separates serving reliability, symbolic compliance, and geometric success, and preserves exact model-visible inputs and realized paths. A staged protocol outlines diagnostic calibration, held-out replication, multi-model comparison, and paired robustness tests. The contribution is an operational research framework with an executed pilot and a clearly identified prospective study plan; the full difficulty matrix and comparative model results remain untested.

AI.tldr: 提出 GAGR-Lab 框架，用于评测从空间构型到符号函数、再经轨迹执行满足几何约束的联合推理能力；执行了一个小规模试点，但最强模型未命中目标，完整难度矩阵与多模型比较尚待研究。
AI.motivation: 联合空间几何与解析函数推理要求将感知到的空间构型转化为符号函数，并使其执行曲线满足几何约束；现有评测尚缺乏能同时区分空间感知、度量接地、几何关系、函数解释、函数构造与约束合成的操作化框架。
AI.method: 构建 GAGR-Lab：使用笛卡尔游戏场景、显式函数语义与权威 Rust 轨迹执行；区分六类能力，设定四种场景难度预设与前瞻性 24 细胞诊断设计。试点使用 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct，以两个 API 凭证作为执行重复，共 72 个平衡游戏、432 次尝试。另设特权解析搜索控制，并规划分阶段校准、留出复现、多模型比较与配对鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: 试点获得 429 个有效提供商响应，目标命中数为 0；普通函数提示变体也未命中，结构化定位接口未产生可评分输出。特权解析搜索控制在 300 个生成场景的 600 个方向案例上成功，且可精确重复，并完成 1200 次垂直反射或平移检查。
AI.conclusion: 该工作贡献是一个可操作研究框架、已执行试点与明确的前瞻研究计划；框架能分离服务可靠性、符号合规性与几何成功，并保留模型可见输入与实际路径。完整难度矩阵和比较性模型结果仍未测试。

title: KASALv2: Fully Automatic 3D Rotational Symmetry Classification and Axis Localization
comment: CVPR 2026. 10 pages, 4 figures. Mengxin Zhang and Yulin Wang contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Chen Luo and Yijun Zhou
summary: Rotational symmetry is an important prior in 6D pose estimation, improving pose accuracy and supporting symmetry-aware evaluation. However, current symmetry annotations for 3D objects remain largely manual or semi-automatic, often requiring predefined types or orders, which limits scalability. This work introduces a fully automatic, reference-free framework for symmetry-type classification, rotational-order identification, and full-axis localization across all eight canonical 3D rotational symmetry types. The method localizes a dominant high-order axis, infers its rotational order through self-consistency analysis, and reconstructs the complete symmetry structure under a hierarchy-guided formulation. A texture-aware extension further models appearance-induced reductions in rotational order while preserving axis orientations. Experiments on idealized and real-world datasets demonstrate strong accuracy and generalization, achieving 94.75% accuracy on 438 symmetric objects in GSO. Training FoundationPose with these priors improves accuracy by up to 0.9% across five BOP datasets, showing that automatically estimated rotational priors improve downstream 6D pose estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/KASAL.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全自动、无需参考的3D旋转对称性分析框架，可完成对称类型分类、旋转阶数识别与全轴定位，并证明其先验能提升6D位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 旋转对称是6D位姿估计的重要先验，但现有3D物体对称性标注多为手动或半自动，往往需要预定义类型或阶数，限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: 构建覆盖八种标准3D旋转对称类型的全自动无参考框架：先定位主导高阶轴，通过自一致性分析推断旋转阶数，再在层级引导下重建完整对称结构；纹理感知扩展可建模外观导致的旋转阶数降低，同时保持轴方向。
AI.result: 在理想与真实数据集上取得较高精度和泛化能力，在GSO的438个对称物体上达到94.75%准确率；使用这些先验训练FoundationPose，在五个BOP数据集上精度最高提升0.9%。
AI.conclusion: 自动估计的旋转对称先验能够有效改进下游6D位姿估计。

title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
summary: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.

AI.tldr: MultiFly 是一个真实世界低空无人机多模态数据集，包含 RGB、热成像、LiDAR 和雷达数据，提供 17,272 个同步样本、15 类逐帧语义标注，并建立了四种模态的语义分割基准。
AI.motivation: 低空无人机多模态语义感知需要真实世界数据，但为每种模态单独标注成本高昂且容易不一致，因此需要一种可扩展、跨模态一致的标注与评测方案。
AI.method: 构建 MultiFly 数据集，在四个郊区场景中同步采集 RGB、热成像、LiDAR 和雷达数据，并提供标定与 GNSS-RTK/IMU 测量；仅手工标注 115 张 RGB 图像，再通过共享几何表示将标签传播到其他模态，最后为四种模态建立语义分割基准。
AI.result: 数据集提供 17,272 个同步样本和 15 类逐帧标注，标签传播额外生成 17,157 张 RGB、17,272 张热成像、840M 个 LiDAR 点和 3.4M 个雷达点的语义标签；转移标注与留出手工标注平均一致率为 89.93%，所有六个模态对的平均语义一致性为 90.94%；基准显示密集 LiDAR 与稀疏雷达数据具有不同架构行为。
AI.conclusion: MultiFly 为多模态空中感知提供了可扩展基础，并且是首个公开的真实世界低空航空基准，结合了 RGB、热成像、LiDAR 和雷达的一致逐帧语义标注。

title: Semantic-Aware Predictive Mapping for Exploration and Navigation
summary: Predictive mapping can support robotic exploration and navigation by estimating unseen geometric layouts from partial occupancy observations. However, occupancy-only representations may fail to distinguish semantically different structures with similar geometry. This is particularly relevant for indoor doors, which may appear as occupied cells like walls but indicate possible connected rooms or corridors beyond the observed region. This work investigates whether semantic door cues improve predictive geometric occupancy mapping around such ambiguous regions. We modify a subset of the CogniPlan dataset by inserting door-induced ambiguities into partial occupancy maps while keeping the ground-truth layouts unchanged. We compare a geometry-only control model with a semantic-cued model trained on the same modified dataset, where the semantic-cued model receives an additional door channel. Evaluation uses L1 error, F1 score, and Intersection over Union (IoU) over both the full map and a 10-pixel door-region mask. Full-map performance remains broadly similar between models, but localized door-region results show a clear qualitative improvement: L1 decreases from 0.004342 to 0.000025, while F1 and IoU improve from 0.031311 and 0.015905 to 1.000000 and 1.000000, respectively. These results suggest that semantic cues can improve predictive occupancy completion in regions where geometric observations alone are ambiguous.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语义门线索是否能改善预测性几何占据建图，尤其是在仅凭几何信息难以区分的门/墙歧义区域。
AI.motivation: 预测建图可从部分占据观测估计未见图纸，但纯占据表示难以区分几何相似而语义不同的结构，例如室内门可能像墙一样表现为占据单元，却暗示后方可能存在连通房间或走廊。
AI.method: 基于 CogniPlan 数据集子集，在保持真实布局不变的情况下，将门诱导的歧义插入部分占据图中；比较仅几何的控制模型与增加门语义通道的语义线索模型，并用 L1 误差、F1 和 IoU 在全图及 10 像素门区域掩码上评估。
AI.result: 全图性能两模型大体相似，但门区域局部结果显著改善：L1 从 0.004342 降至 0.000025，F1 从 0.031311 升至 1.000000，IoU 从 0.015905 升至 1.000000。
AI.conclusion: 语义线索可改善几何观测本身存在歧义区域的预测性占据补全。

title: RunningTab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs
summary: Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. Through direct corpus interaction, an agent can search and read any of those files from a terminal with no indexing, and producing a deliverable from many of them in this way is what we call direct workspace interaction (DWI). Reaching the files, however, is only half the task: nothing keeps track of what the task asks for, what has been read, and what was listed but never opened, all of which slip through the context window without leaving a trace, so an agent may extract a figure and still deliver a report without it. To address this, we present RunningTab, a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab: a per-task record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment alongside the agent. Specifically, the agent adds its requirements, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every listed but unopened file as a candidate; the agent can then see each requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and top unopened candidates, resolve it against matching content or set it aside with a reason, and, should it try to finish with requirements still open, receive them in a finish check. We validate RunningTab on three benchmarks with three LLMs, where it consistently outperforms plain DWI and baselines that keep the record in the model, while its tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RunningTab 框架，为 LLM 智能体的直接工作区交互（DWI）引入环境侧任务标签，跟踪任务需求、已读文件摘录和未打开候选文件，从而提升多文件知识工作交付物的完整性。
AI.motivation: 知识工作常需从工作区已有文件中生成新交付物，LLM 智能体已开始接管此类任务。直接在工作区搜索和读取文件虽可行，但上下文窗口无法持续记录任务要求、已读内容和列出但未打开的文件，导致智能体可能遗漏关键信息，例如提取了图表却未写入报告。
AI.method: RunningTab 在环境侧维护每个任务的标签：智能体添加任务要求，环境将每次读取记录为带来源的摘录，并将列出但未打开的文件记为候选。智能体可查看每项要求及其最匹配摘录和顶部未打开候选，从而解决要求或附理由搁置；若尝试结束仍有未完成要求，则触发完成检查。
AI.result: 在三个基准和三个 LLM 上验证，RunningTab 持续优于普通 DWI 以及将记录保存在模型内的基线；其标签通常能保留交付物一旦被看到就需要的值。
AI.conclusion: 环境侧任务标签能有效弥补 DWI 智能体在需求跟踪和文件覆盖上的不足，提升从大量工作区文件中生成交付物的性能与完整性。

title: WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 19 pages, 4 figures. Yulin Wang and Mengting Hu contributed equally. Corresponding author: Chen Luo
summary: Real-world applications require 6D pose estimation to be accurate, fast, and scalable to unseen objects. This paper introduces WAPR, a zero-shot wide-angle pose refinement model that refines candidate poses with rotational deviations up to 90 degrees. With as few as 12 candidate poses per detected object instance, WAPR supports fast inference within 1 s per frame and reaches a pose-estimation throughput of up to 25 detected object instances per second. To support wide-angle training for rotationally symmetric objects, WAPR uses rotational symmetry priors to canonicalize symmetry-equivalent pose targets before loss computation. We further construct SA6D, a large-scale 6D training dataset with such priors. SA6D obtains KASAL-assisted rotational symmetry priors for 944 GSO scans and expands them through geometry and texture augmentation into about 50K augmented object instances and about 2M rendered RGB-D images. In addition, an angle-balanced loss stabilizes learning across different angular ranges by reducing the influence of uninformative large-error cases. Experiments on seven BOP core datasets show that WAPR achieves state-of-the-art performance in unseen-object 6D pose localization and detection under both fast and unconstrained inference settings. Project page: https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.

AI.tldr: 提出 WAPR，一种零样本宽角度 6D 位姿细化模型，可在旋转偏差高达 90 度时细化候选位姿，并兼顾速度、精度与对未见物体的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 真实应用要求 6D 位姿估计准确、快速，并能扩展到未见物体；现有方法在宽角度旋转偏差、旋转对称物体和大规模训练数据方面仍面临挑战。
AI.method: WAPR 使用每个检测实例少量（如 12 个）候选位姿进行宽角度位姿细化；利用旋转对称先验在损失计算前规范化对称等价位姿目标；构建大规模 6D 训练集 SA6D，为 944 个 GSO 扫描获取 KASAL 辅助的旋转对称先验，并通过几何与纹理增强扩展到约 5 万个增强物体实例和约 200 万张渲染 RGB-D 图像；同时提出角度平衡损失，降低无信息大误差样本影响。
AI.result: WAPR 支持每帧 1 秒内快速推理，位姿估计吞吐量最高可达每秒 25 个检测物体实例；在七个 BOP 核心数据集上，在快速和无约束推理设置下，对未见物体的 6D 位姿定位与检测均达到当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: WAPR 通过宽角度细化、旋转对称先验、SA6D 数据集和角度平衡损失，有效提升了未见物体 6D 位姿估计的准确性与效率，并在多个基准上取得领先结果。

title: Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification
summary: Program verification establishes software correctness through machine-checkable proofs constructed in theorem provers. It's a guarantee especially valuable for code generated by large language models (LLMs), which is fluent but carries no assurance of correctness. Almost all existing provers, however, pursue pass rates alone at whatever sampling or search budget it takes, and overlook the success-vs-cost frontier; yet real software often carries hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so what matters at scale is not whether one theorem can be proved, but how many can be proved economically. We introduce CoCo-Prover, which formalizes cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs: an AND/OR proof hypergraph within each declaration is joined to a lemma-dependency graph across declarations; and at each step, it answers two questions: which open goals to select, and which actions to purchase on these goals. Selection stays symbolic as a topological pass over the proof graphs. Action choice is agent orchestration via metalevel decision-making: an agentic router treats every bounded specialist invocation as a separately priced, best-effort computation, matching heterogeneous specialist agents together with configurations, under evolved routing rules as evidence accumulates. On five program verification benchmarks in Lean 4 including function-level CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, and repository-level NTP4VC and Vero, we show that CoCo-Prover achieves a better success-vs-cost frontier than baselines including frontier coding agents and state-of-the-art LLM-based provers: it achieves the best solve rate on every benchmark and up to 100% on two benchmarks. It also reduces cost by up to 30.9% compared to the strongest baseline with the strongest LLM in our evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoCo-Prover，将程序验证中的证明搜索视为带成本约束的元级决策问题，基于声明内 AND/OR 证明超图与跨声明引理依赖图的两层结构，通过符号化目标选择与智能体路由行动购买，在 Lean 4 的五个基准上同时优化求解率与成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的代码流畅但缺乏正确性保证，程序验证可提供机器可检查的证明。然而现有证明器大多只追求通过率，忽视成功与成本的权衡；真实软件常包含数百个相互依赖的证明义务，规模化场景下关键不是能否证明单个定理，而是能以多低成本证明多少定理。
AI.method: 将成本高效的程序证明形式化为成本下的元级决策。构建两层证明图：每个声明内部的 AND/OR 证明超图，以及跨声明的引理依赖图。每步回答两个问题：选择哪些开放目标，以及为这些目标购买哪些动作。目标选择保持符号化，作为证明图上的拓扑遍历；动作选择采用智能体编排的元级决策，由智能体路由器将每个有界专家调用视为单独计价、尽力而为的计算，在证据积累下演化路由规则，把异构专家智能体与配置匹配起来。
AI.result: 在 Lean 4 的五个程序验证基准（函数级 CLEVER、VERINA、AlgoVeri，以及仓库级 NTP4VC、Vero）上，CoCo-Prover 相比前沿编码智能体和最先进的基于 LLM 的证明器等基线，取得了更好的成功-成本前沿；在每个基准上取得最佳求解率，其中两个基准达到 100%；在最强调用最强 LLM 的评估中，相比最强基线成本降低最多 30.9%。
AI.conclusion: CoCo-Prover 表明，将程序证明建模为带成本约束的元级决策，并结合两层证明图与智能体路由，能够在规模化证明义务下同时提升求解率并显著降低成本，优于现有 LLM 证明方法。

title: Validity Without Ground Truth: What Stated-Preference Economics Offers the Evaluation of Language Models
summary: Many of the questions now put to large language models have no correct answer to score against: what a policy is worth, which option a user should choose, how to weigh competing values. Stated-preference economics has faced this problem for decades. It judges survey responses without knowing the true value, through a framework of validity and related concepts: content, construct, and criterion validity, reliability, incentive compatibility, and consequentiality. We argue that this framework is a general method for evaluating language models, and we set out what each concept means for LLM evaluation. We demonstrate the approach using a published water-quality stated preference economic valuation survey (Vossler et al. 2023) administered to six models. In this economic application, the validity tests take the form of predictions from economic theory: demand should slope down, and willingness to pay should respond to the scope of the good and to income. The tests separate the models sharply. Two older models fail the most basic test at a household income level of \$75,000, and the two newest pass every test of theoretical validity we can score, but diverge on convergent validity. Passing validity tests shows that a model's answers are coherent, not that they are correct.

AI.tldr: 本文将陈述偏好经济学中的效度框架用于评估大语言模型，并以一项水质经济价值调查对六个模型进行测试，发现该框架能区分模型表现，但通过效度检验仅说明回答具有内在一致性，而非正确性。
AI.motivation: 许多向大语言模型提出的问题没有客观正确答案可评分，例如政策价值、用户选择或价值权衡；陈述偏好经济学长期面对类似问题，因此其效度评估框架可能适用于LLM评估。
AI.method: 采用陈述偏好经济学的效度概念（内容效度、构念效度、效标效度、信度、激励相容性、后果性等）构建LLM评估框架，并将其应用于Vossler等2023年发表的水质陈述偏好经济价值调查，对六个模型进行测试；效度检验转化为经济学理论预测：需求曲线应向下倾斜，支付意愿应随商品范围和收入变化。
AI.result: 模型表现被明显区分：两个较旧模型在家庭收入75000美元水平上未通过最基本检验；两个最新模型通过了所有可评分的理论效度检验，但在收敛效度上出现分歧。
AI.conclusion: 通过效度检验表明模型的回答具有连贯性，而不是表明其回答正确；该框架可作为评估无标准答案LLM任务的一般方法。

title: Visual Evidence Under Cross-Examination: Evaluating and Controlling Decision-Level Evidence Use in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models increasingly reason through crops, regions, and tool-produced observations. Yet an observation can influence the answer without benefiting the candidate it supports. We study candidate-bound visual contribution: valid evidence should help, invalidating its supporting relation should remove its additional effect, and valid rebinding should redirect that effect to the newly supported candidate. We introduce CROSS-Bench, a benchmark of 28,000 decision problems, with matched invalidation and rebinding tests on a dedicated evaluation subset. Our RIVET interface preserves evidence identity and uncertainty, composes a candidate-conditioned response, and separately controls its strength. Shared-evidence experiments show that task accuracy and evidence ownership can diverge. Under matched capacity and training, RIVET increases normalized effect transfer from 0.512 to 0.651 where clean evidence has a positive effect. The advantage persists on common evaluation examples and across repeated decision-layer fits. With evidence predicted from raw inputs, RIVET improves CROSS-Bench accuracy by an average of 5.70 pp across four frozen backbones, relative to the same models without auxiliary evidence. These results separate the utility of visual evidence from the candidate-specific destination of its effect.

AI.tldr: 论文研究视觉证据对候选答案的定向贡献，提出CROSS-Bench基准和RIVET接口，区分证据本身的效用与其影响具体候选答案的归属关系。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多依赖裁剪区域、工具观察等证据进行推理，但观察结果可能影响答案却并未真正支持其所指向的候选，因此需要研究候选绑定的视觉贡献。
AI.method: 构建包含28,000个决策问题的CROSS-Bench，并在专门子集上设置匹配的失效与重绑定测试；提出RIVET接口，保留证据身份与不确定性，生成候选条件响应并单独控制其强度，同时在共享证据、匹配容量与训练条件下进行评估。
AI.result: 共享证据实验显示任务准确率与证据归属可能分离；在干净证据有正向作用时，RIVET将归一化效应转移从0.512提升至0.651，优势在常见评估样本和重复决策层拟合中持续存在；使用原始输入预测证据时，RIVET在四个冻结骨干模型上平均提升CROSS-Bench准确率5.70个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究将视觉证据的效用与其影响的具体候选目的地区分开来，表明证据是否有效并不等同于其效应是否被正确绑定到相应候选答案。

title: OpenViTac: Learning and Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Policies in a Unified Sim-and-Real Framework
summary: Tactile feedback provides embodied agents with physical information beyond visual observations, enabling more reliable interaction with the real world. However, despite the rapid progress of vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) policies, there remains a lack of unified benchmarks for evaluating tactile-enabled robot manipulation across simulation and the real world. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViTac, a visuo-tactile manipulation benchmark for evaluating robot policies across simulation and the real world. OpenViTac organizes contact-rich manipulation into four tactile-relevant capability dimensions and provides paired simulation-real-world settings for consistent evaluation of VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies. Building upon this benchmark, we investigate how different tactile representations and integration strategies affect the performance of pretrained VLA models. Correspondingly, we introduce OpenVTLA, a tactile augmentation framework that combines the best-performing representation and integration strategy. Furthermore, we leverage the paired benchmark setting to study sim-real co-training and analyze factors affecting cross-domain policy learning. Together, OpenViTac provides a unified platform for evaluating and advancing visuo-tactile robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenViTac统一视觉-触觉机器人操作基准，含仿真-真实配对设置与四类触觉能力维度，并基于此提出OpenVTLA触觉增强框架，研究触觉表示、融合策略及仿真-现实协同训练。
AI.motivation: 触觉反馈为具身智能体提供视觉之外的物理信息，有助于真实世界交互；但VTLA策略发展迅速，仍缺乏跨仿真与真实世界评估触觉机器人操作的统一基准。
AI.method: 构建OpenViTac基准，将接触密集操作划分为四个触觉相关能力维度，并提供配对的仿真-真实设置以一致评估VLA、WAM和VTLA策略；研究不同触觉表示与集成策略对预训练VLA性能的影响；提出OpenVTLA框架，结合最佳表示与集成策略；利用配对设置研究仿真-现实协同训练并分析跨域策略学习因素。
AI.result: OpenViTac提供了跨仿真与真实世界的统一视觉-触觉操作评测平台；实验表明不同触觉表示与集成策略会影响预训练VLA模型性能，OpenVTLA采用最佳组合；该基准还支持仿真-现实协同训练研究并分析跨域策略学习因素。
AI.conclusion: OpenViTac为评估和推进视觉-触觉机器人操作提供了统一平台，有助于推动更可靠的触觉增强机器人策略研究。

title: Shared and structured inputs undermine collective random choice by reasoning AI agents
summary: Random selection is widely used in resource allocation and auditing, making reliable implementation essential for AI-agent systems. Behavioural tests across six reasoning models uncovered threshold and divisibility rules used in identifier-based choices. For threshold-following GPT-6 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash, single-agent measurements prospectively predicted correlated participation under shared identifiers and biased participation under distinct identifiers with common timestamp bits. Changing dates, formats and identifier labels revealed when these predictions held. Explicit instructions to randomize independently reduced but did not eliminate shared-input correlation. To test implications for oversight, we asked four models to select customer requests randomly for human review. GPT-6 Sol approached the target rate while selecting predictably from identifiers; the others rarely selected requests. All four closely followed supplied random draws. These findings expose collective and audit vulnerabilities that selection rates alone miss, making input-dependent bias, correlation and predictability central targets for agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 对六个推理模型进行随机选择行为测试，发现它们会使用基于标识符的阈值或整除规则，导致可预测偏差、相关参与和审计漏洞；显式要求独立随机化也无法完全消除共享输入相关性。
AI.motivation: 随机选择广泛用于资源分配和审计，AI代理能否可靠实现随机性对公平性和监督至关重要；仅看选择率可能遗漏输入依赖偏差、相关性和可预测性等问题。
AI.method: 对六个推理模型开展行为测试，考察基于标识符选择中的阈值和整除规则；用单代理测量预测共享标识符下的相关参与和不同标识符共同时间戳位下的偏差；改变日期、格式和标识符标签；加入显式独立随机化指令；并让四个模型随机选择客户请求供人工复核，同时测试其是否遵循给定随机抽样。
AI.result: GPT-6 Sol和Gemini 3.8 Flash表现出阈值跟随行为，单代理测量可前瞻性预测共享标识符下的相关参与及共同时间戳位下的偏差；改变日期、格式和标签可揭示预测成立条件。显式独立随机化指令减少但未消除共享输入相关性。在人工复核选择任务中，GPT-6 Sol接近目标选择率但选择仍可预测，其他模型很少选择请求；所有四个模型都紧密遵循给定随机抽样。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现暴露了选择率本身无法揭示的集体和审计漏洞，说明输入依赖偏差、相关性和可预测性应成为AI代理评估的核心目标。

title: NeRFifyMesh: Optimizing Neural Radiance Fields from Textured Meshes for Robotics Scene Building
summary: In robotics, scene representation plays a pivotal role in understanding and interacting with the environment. The advent of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and its variants, as a novel representation, has opened a new frontier of research. In applications such as semantic mapping and simulation, roboticists aim to build scenes using multiple NeRF models, each representing an object. While extensive datasets of 3D mesh models already exist, there is an urgent need to develop tools to convert these assets to NeRF models for rapid algorithm development and testing. This paper presents a new pipeline for converting existing mesh models to NeRF representations by artificially generating a ground truth point-based radiance field through sampling mesh geometry and texture. This approach alleviates the need for camera-based sampling or rendering multi-view images of the original mesh to train the NeRF model. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that our method yields comparable rendering quality to the baselines. Additionally, the application of this representation is shown by constructing unified NeRF scenes and performing collision simulations with extracted geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将已有3D网格模型转换为NeRF表示的流程，通过采样网格几何与纹理生成点基辐射场，从而避免多视角渲染训练，并应用于统一NeRF场景构建与碰撞仿真。
AI.motivation: 机器人领域需要NeRF作为场景表示，且常需用多个NeRF模型构建物体级场景；尽管已有大量3D网格资产，但缺少将其快速转为NeRF模型的工具，以支持算法开发与测试。
AI.method: 通过采样原始网格的几何与纹理，人工生成基于点的真实辐射场，再据此转换得到NeRF表示，无需相机采样或多视角图像渲染来训练NeRF。
AI.result: 大量基准测试表明，该方法在渲染质量上与基线方法相当；同时可构建统一NeRF场景，并利用提取的几何进行碰撞仿真。
AI.conclusion: 该流程能有效将现有网格资产转换为NeRF表示，为机器人场景表示、仿真与算法快速验证提供了实用途径。

title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RoboQuest基准，用于评估具身智能体在目标导向探索中主动获取任务相关信息的能力，发现当前多模态基础模型表现极差，主要失败原因在于过早停止探索和无法处理探索带来的干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态基础模型在陌生环境中执行操作任务时，常需通过物理交互主动获取缺失的任务相关信息（如物体位置、未观测属性或新工具效果），但缺乏系统评估此类能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建RoboQuest基准，包含10个移动操作任务，围绕搜索、基于操作的检查、交互测试三类不确定性；通过统一视觉运动接口评估五个前沿多模态智能体及微调后的π0.5策略，并进行失败分析与孤立技能测试。
AI.result: 最佳智能体仅23%成功率，微调π0.5几乎全败；孤立技能测试表明智能体大多能执行所需动作，失败主要并非执行问题，而是过早停止探索、未在获得足够证据前决策，且很少预防或修复探索干扰；试错学习对多数模型仍困难。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态基础模型在主动具身探索与自适应决策方面存在根本缺陷，RoboQuest为未来研究提供了挑战性基准和全回合演示数据。

title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
summary: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RobotWorld，一个用于评估通用智能体在物理世界机器人任务中表现的挑战性仿真测试平台，包含84个覆盖操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶和空中控制的任务，并揭示智能体能力迁移的不均衡与关键缺口。
AI.motivation: 通用智能体已能写代码、使用工具并完成复杂数字任务，但其能力在多大程度上能迁移到物理世界尚不明确，因此需要系统性的机器人使用评测环境。
AI.method: 构建RobotWorld仿真测试平台，将指令和观测通过机器人接口转化为物理任务执行；任务涵盖多个机器人领域，并设置显式交互预算和可执行成功检查。通过分析任务结果与执行轨迹，评估智能体表现。
AI.result: 智能体能构建图像分割、相机标定、空间估计和基于动力学的计算等复杂感知与控制流程，但这些能力不能稳定组合为成功行为：包括丢失任务相关物体状态、未能纠正无效动作、恢复过晚或将未完成任务误判为完成。不同模型表现差异明显，Astra更擅长空间和受限接触目标，Opus 5.5更擅长连续平衡和定时交互目标。
AI.conclusion: RobotWorld既提供了严格的机器人智能体测试基准，也给出了能力缺口的实证分析，为训练和设计更可靠的物理世界智能体提供了具体目标。

title: Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are strikingly sensitive to instruction phrasing and do not inherit the language robustness of the vision-language models they are built on. A one-word edit can move success by tens of points: $π_{0.5}$ turns on a LIBERO stove 100% of the time for "switch on the stove" and 2% for "switch on the hot plate", and a $π_0$ checkpoint finetuned with rephrase augmentation still shows swings of up to 61 points. We characterize this sensitivity with statistically tested single-edit swings and an oracle phrase search, which shows that phrasing alone nearly closes the 21-point gap between in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. We then reduce it without modifying the policy. Because the sensitivity is systematic, it can be expressed as explicit rules: we score many phrasings of a few training tasks, have a large language model distill the evidence into ten to twenty rephrasing rules, and at deployment rewrite each incoming instruction once under these rules. The rules improve the frozen $π_0$ by 16 to 27% relative on twelve held-out tasks across adversarial, VLM-generated, and human-generated phrasings, with gains concentrated on out-of-distribution tasks. The pipeline replicates on $π_{0.5}$ and LIBERO, lifting in-finetune success from 93.6% to 97.8%. The method requires no retraining and no per-step verification, and applies zero-shot to unseen tasks and instructions. Project website: https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act

AI.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作模型对指令措辞高度敏感，本文提出用大语言模型蒸馏改写规则，在部署时改写指令，从而在不修改策略的情况下显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽基于视觉-语言模型，却未继承其语言鲁棒性；仅一词改动就能使任务成功率变化数十个百分点，因此需要理解并缓解这种措辞敏感性。
AI.method: 通过统计检验的单编辑波动和oracle短语搜索刻画敏感性；对少量训练任务的多种措辞打分，让大语言模型蒸馏出10到20条改写规则，并在部署时对每条输入指令按规则改写一次。
AI.result: 在12个留出任务上，冻结的π0相对提升16%到27%，增益集中在分布外任务；在π0.5和LIBERO上复现，finetune成功率从93.6%提升到97.8%；oracle搜索显示仅靠措辞几乎可弥合21个百分点的分布内与分布外差距。
AI.conclusion: 措辞敏感性是系统性的，可表示为显式规则并加以缓解；该方法无需重训练和逐步验证，可零样本应用于未见任务与指令。

title: STORK: Spatio-Temporal Observation of uterine contRactions via neural networKs
comment: Accepted at the PIPPI Workshop at MICCAI 2026 and will appear in the workshop proceedings (Springer)
summary: Uterine contractions in fetal MRI are typically identified manually and discarded, limiting insights into contraction dynamics. We formalize Uterine Contractile Activity Detection (UCAD) as a weakly-supervised learning problem and introduce STORK, a multi-instance learning model trained on dynamic MRI series using only coarse, series-level labels. STORK factorizes 3D spatio-temporal convolutions into parallel branches across temporal hyperplanes to capture coherent tissue motion without the cost of full 4D convolutions. Per-frame embeddings, combining intensity and Demons-estimated displacement fields, are aggregated by a linear mean-pooling head. This ensures that frame-level contraction scores can be recovered post-hoc without frame-level training supervision. Evaluated on around 700 multi-vendor dynamic fetal MRI series, STORK achieves a series-level AUROC of 95.0% and AUPRC of 94.6%, substantially outperforming 3D ResNet and ConvNeXt baselines. Grad-CAM analysis suggests that the model draws on predictive features extending beyond the placenta into the uterine tissue, offering an automated tool for richer phenotyping of uterine behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文将子宫收缩活动检测形式化为弱监督学习问题，提出基于多示例学习的STORK模型，仅用序列级标签从动态胎儿MRI中检测子宫收缩，并取得高分类性能。
AI.motivation: 子宫收缩在胎儿MRI中通常被人工识别并丢弃，限制了对收缩动态的研究；因此需要自动化方法，在仅有粗略序列级标签的条件下检测子宫收缩活动。
AI.method: 提出STORK多示例学习模型，将3D时空卷积沿时间超平面分解为并行分支，以较低计算成本捕捉组织运动；结合强度和Demons估计位移场的逐帧嵌入，并通过线性平均池化头聚合，从而在无逐帧监督下事后恢复帧级收缩分数。
AI.result: 在约700个多厂商动态胎儿MRI序列上评估，STORK达到序列级AUROC 95.0%和AUPRC 94.6%，显著优于3D ResNet和ConvNeXt基线；Grad-CAM分析表明模型利用了超出胎盘、延伸至子宫组织的预测特征。
AI.conclusion: STORK为子宫行为提供了自动化检测工具，可支持更丰富的子宫收缩表型分析，并表明弱监督多示例学习在动态胎儿MRI分析中具有潜力。

title: Self-Evolve With a Reference:Anchored Training of Tool-Integrated Agents
summary: Self-evolving tool-integrated agents learn from tasks and feedback generated within their own training loop. A Curriculum Agent generates tasks, while an Executor Agent learns from self-consistency signals through reinforcement learning. However, relying solely on the current Executor for feedback has two limitations: group-relative advantages vanish under full consensus, while uncertainty-based curriculum rewards favor disagreement without showing whether the generated tasks support further learning. These limitations motivate an additional reference beyond the current Executor. We propose \textit{AnchorLoop}, which introduces a frozen copy of the previous iteration's Executor as a historical reference and reuses it on both sides of the training loop. For the Executor, the anchor provides a cross-reference advantage that evaluates current outputs against both current and historical majority answers. For the Curriculum, it provides an agreement-based reference based on differences in sampled majority agreement. Since the Executor and anchor have identical parameters during Curriculum training, this comparison serves as a proxy for task selection rather than evidence of inter-version improvement or correctness. Across 13 reasoning benchmarks, AnchorLoop improves over Agent0 by 2.5\% on mathematical reasoning and 2.8\% on general reasoning tasks. It also maintains higher effective-advantage variance and continues improving in later iterations as the unanchored baseline shows diminishing gains. These results demonstrate the benefit of introducing a lightweight historical reference into self-evolving tool-integrated agents without external task or answer supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AnchorLoop，在自进化工具集成智能体中引入上一轮 Executor 的冻结副本作为历史锚点，同时用于 Executor 训练与 Curriculum 任务选择，从而在无外部任务和答案监督下提升推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅依赖当前 Executor 提供反馈存在两点局限：完全共识时组相对优势消失；基于不确定性的课程奖励偏向选择有分歧的任务，却不能说明这些任务是否有助于进一步学习。因此需要当前 Executor 之外的额外参考。
AI.method: AnchorLoop 将上一轮迭代的 Executor 冻结为历史参考，并在训练循环两侧复用：对 Executor，提供跨参考优势，用当前与历史多数答案共同评估当前输出；对 Curriculum，提供基于采样多数一致度差异的 agreement-based reference。由于 Curriculum 训练时 Executor 与 anchor 参数相同，该比较仅作为任务选择代理，而非版本改进或正确性证据。
AI.result: 在 13 个推理基准上，AnchorLoop 相比 Agent0 在数学推理上提升 2.5%，在通用推理任务上提升 2.8%；同时保持更高的有效优势方差，并在后续迭代中持续改进，而未加锚点的基线收益逐渐递减。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在自进化工具集成智能体中引入轻量级历史参考，可以在没有外部任务或答案监督的情况下带来收益，缓解仅依赖当前 Executor 反馈的局限。

title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles
summary: Memory-augmented reinforcement learning strengthens LLM agents' ability to solve complex long-horizon tasks. Skills are one such form of memory, pairing instructions with an applicability condition over task types. However, retaining every skill indiscriminately as the policy improves lets obsolete or harmful entries accumulate and mislead the agent. We propose SkillForge, an agentic RL method that compiles and evolves the skill library through a fitness-driven skill lifecycle of trial, active, stable, and retired states, so that the skills and the model co-evolve throughout training. A pre-RL evaluation phase first uses the base model's own rollouts to pre-retire low-fitness skills, yielding a filtered library that then seeds supervised fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning takes over from this checkpoint, and at each iteration selective retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation continue to forge the skill library alongside policy optimization. Across multiple interactive agent benchmarks, SkillForge achieves the highest aggregate success rate, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline while keeping the skill library compact throughout training. We introduce SkillFurnace, a dataset of 5k+ annotated records bundling retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories to support research on skill quality and lifecycle management.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillForge，一种通过适应度驱动的技能生命周期（试验、活跃、稳定、退役）来编译和演化技能库的智能体强化学习方法，使技能与模型在训练中共同演化，并发布 SkillFurnace 数据集。
AI.motivation: 记忆增强强化学习可提升 LLM 智能体解决复杂长时程任务的能力，技能是一种记忆形式，包含指令与适用条件；但若随着策略改进不加区分地保留所有技能，过时或有害条目会累积并误导智能体。
AI.method: 先进行 RL 前评估阶段，利用基座模型自身 rollout 预退役低适应度技能，得到过滤后的技能库并用于监督微调；随后 RL 接管，每轮迭代中通过选择性退役、稳定化和 LLM 引导变异，持续锻造技能库并优化策略。技能生命周期包括 trial、active、stable、retired 四种状态。
AI.result: 在多个交互式智能体基准上取得最高总体成功率，相对最强基线最高提升 7.8%，同时训练全程保持技能库紧凑。发布 SkillFurnace 数据集，包含 5k+ 条标注记录：退役过滤后的 SFT 轨迹、带适应度注释的演化技能库、退役事件及人工标注的失败类别。
AI.conclusion: 适应度驱动的技能生命周期管理可与策略优化协同，提升 LLM 智能体在长时程任务中的表现，并控制技能库的质量与规模；SkillFurnace 可支持技能质量与生命周期管理研究。

title: A Tale of Two Error Categories: Exploring Concealed Trade-Offs in the Errors of Automated Judges in Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantifiers
summary: The wide adoption of LLMs across broad NLG applications heightens the importance of providing users with the means to avert errors and hallucinations. Uncertainty quantification is poised to fill that gap; with low uncertainty (high confidence), as a proxy for correctness, allowing users to be selective (e.g., reject low-confidence, likely incorrect responses). Correlation between confidence and correctness then serves as a useful criterion for evaluation of uncertainty quantifiers (UQs). But in NLG, where diverse responses can be adequate to a prompt, obtaining reliable correctness judgements is not simple, especially without human intervention. Errors in automated judgement are hardly avoidable and known to diminish the reliability of evaluation protocols (Santilli et al., 2025; Ielanskyi et al., 2025). In a meta-analysis of published work, we show that automated judgement is the present norm. Besides, automated judgements are rarely validated against human ones, and the validation of the UQ evaluation they automate is even rarer. With experiments in question answering, using 4 LLMs, human and automated judgements and 7 popular UQs, we find that i) a judge's performance can only coarsely predict the observed impact of its errors on the reliability of UQ evaluation, and that ii) judgement errors tend to misrepresent informative UQs most. We link these observations to patterns of correlation between confidence and categories of judgement error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不确定性量化（UQ）评估中自动判断误差的影响：在NLG中，自动正确性判断是常态但很少经人工验证，且其误差会降低UQ评估可靠性，尤其对信息量高的UQ更不利。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛用于NLG，需要不确定性量化帮助用户识别错误和幻觉；置信度与正确性的相关性是评估UQ的关键，但NLG中答案多样，获取可靠正确性判断困难，自动判断误差不可避免，可能影响评估协议可靠性。
AI.method: 对已发表工作进行元分析；在问答任务中用4个LLM、人工与自动判断以及7种流行UQ进行实验，分析判断误差对UQ评估可靠性的影响，并考察置信度与判断错误类别之间的相关性。
AI.result: 元分析显示自动判断是当前主流，且很少用人工判断验证，对自动化UQ评估的验证更少。实验发现：1）判断器性能只能粗略预测其误差对UQ评估可靠性的实际影响；2）判断错误往往最严重地错误呈现高信息量UQ。
AI.conclusion: 自动正确性判断的误差会系统性影响UQ评估结论，尤其会扭曲对优质UQ的识别；评估UQ时应重视人工验证，并关注置信度与判断错误类别之间的关联。

title: Gradient-Based Trajectory Optimisation over Continuous Poses for Sparse-View Cone-Beam CT
summary: Trajectory optimisation for cone-beam computed tomography (CT) determines which information sparse-view scans acquire. Fixed candidate pools prevent off-grid refinement and require new object-specific precomputation for each acquisition manifold. We make every source pose an individual continuous variable and move all poses jointly by gradient ascent on the scanner's kinematic manifold. The objective combines soft-Tuy plane coverage, continuous View Covariance Loss, and an analytic attenuation-aware ray-bundle penalty. The same optimiser handles circular, limited C-arm, two-axis, and freesphere parametrisations. On a Defrise flange, continuous selection recovers laminar defects invisible to a circular orbit, matches discrete swap search on the free sphere at the sparser budget, and leads at the denser one, with the same objective evaluated in every arm. A moderate elevation band already recovers most of the free-sphere gain at the defects, so the same optimiser transfers to bounded scanner envelopes. Photon noise preserves the ordering on the flange and compresses it on a dense fuel nozzle. Sparseprescan planning benefits from matching prescan and planned acquisition manifolds. Selection takes seconds rather than minutes without an object-specific reconstruction basis. Prescan-planned poses were executed on a robot CT bench and reconstructed in a common frame, demonstrating feasibility but no consistent metric gain over uniform band sampling. Continuous pose optimisation incorporates attenuation and scanner constraints directly into sparse-view acquisition design.

AI.tldr: 提出用于稀疏视图CBCT的连续源位姿联合轨迹优化，直接在扫描仪运动流形上梯度上升，统一支持多种轨迹参数化，并在仿真和机器人CT台架上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹优化依赖固定候选池，无法离格细化，且每个采集流形需针对物体重新预计算，限制灵活性与效率。
AI.method: 将每个源位姿作为连续变量，在扫描仪运动流形上联合梯度上升；目标函数结合软Tuy平面覆盖、连续视角协方差损失和解析衰减感知射线束惩罚；统一处理圆形、有限C臂、双轴和自由球参数化；在Defrise法兰、致密燃料喷嘴仿真及预扫描规划中评估，并在机器人CT台架执行。
AI.result: 在Defrise法兰上，连续选择能恢复圆形轨道不可见的层状缺陷；在自由球上稀疏预算时匹配离散交换搜索，较密预算时领先。中等仰角带即可恢复大部分自由球增益，并迁移至受限扫描包络；光子噪声下法兰上排序保持、燃料喷嘴上差异压缩。预扫描规划受益于匹配预扫描与计划采集流形；选择仅需数秒而非数分钟，无需物体特定重建基。机器人CT台架证明可行性，但相对均匀带采样无一致指标增益。
AI.conclusion: 连续位姿优化可将衰减和扫描仪约束直接纳入稀疏视图采集设计，提升轨迹设计效率与灵活性，但实际增益仍需进一步验证。

authors: for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
title: Identity-Duplication Auditing in National-Scale Neuroimaging Repositories
summary: National-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) repositories increasingly integrate data from different studies and institutions. However, subject identifiers that are valid only within individual datasets are no longer guaranteed to remain globally unique after aggregation, making it possible for the same subject to be assigned multiple identifiers, which we define as identity duplication. Such duplication can create leakage between training and test data and inflate apparent performance in downstream biomedical studies. Existing methods do not provide an end-to-end, image-based workflow for auditing this problem at repository scale. In this work, we present HAPPEN, a human-in-the-loop pipeline for auditing identity duplication in T1-weighted brain MRI repositories. It combines SHA-256 fingerprinting for exact-duplicate detection with supervised contrastive retrieval of non-identical scans that may originate from the same person. Retrieved pairs are reviewed as candidates in a locally hosted interface rather than automatically classified as duplicates. We deployed the workflow in a 95,129-scan aggregated repository and assessed end-to-end recovery using 54 genetic-reference pairs. Transferability was assessed by locally deploying the same workflow on 22,386 scans at an independent institution without model retraining or image transfer. Deployment in the study repository identified 1,316 exact-duplicate scan groups and 1,275 reviewer-supported near-duplicate subject groups. Of these groups, 56% and 82%, respectively, crossed dataset boundaries. All 54 genetic-reference pairs were recovered. The external team independently completed the full workflow using a locally selected operating threshold and review standard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAPPEN，一种用于审计T1加权脑MRI库中身份重复的人机协同流程，结合SHA-256精确重复检测与监督对比检索可能来自同一人的非相同扫描，并在本地界面中由人工复核候选对。
AI.motivation: 全国性MRI数据仓库整合不同研究和机构的数据后，仅在单个数据集内有效的受试者标识符不再保证全局唯一，可能导致同一受试者被赋予多个标识符，即身份重复。这会造成训练集与测试集之间的信息泄漏，并虚高下游生物医学研究的性能。现有方法缺乏面向仓库规模、端到端、基于图像的审计流程。
AI.method: HAPPEN流程：使用SHA-256指纹进行精确重复检测；使用监督对比检索找出可能来自同一人的非相同扫描；将检索到的配对作为候选在本地托管界面中供人工复核，而非自动判定为重复。在包含95,129次扫描的聚合仓库中部署，并使用54对遗传参考配对评估端到端恢复效果。通过在独立机构的22,386次扫描上本地部署相同流程，且不重新训练模型、不传输图像，评估可迁移性。
AI.result: 在研究仓库中识别出1,316个精确重复扫描组和1,275个经复核者支持的近重复受试者组；其中分别有56%和82%跨越了数据集边界。全部54对遗传参考配对均被恢复。外部团队使用本地选择的运行阈值和复核标准，独立完成了完整流程。
AI.conclusion: HAPPEN可实现仓库规模的身份重复审计，能够发现精确重复和近重复，并恢复遗传参考配对，且无需重新训练即可迁移至其他机构。该人机协同流程有助于减少因身份重复导致的数据泄漏和性能虚高问题。

title: RFPO: Rectified Flow Policy Optimization for Embodied Control
summary: Flow-based policies provide an expressive framework for continuous robot control, but their iterative ODE integration incurs substantial inference cost. Naively reducing the integration budget can severely degrade control, since policies optimized under full-step execution are not explicitly constrained to remain reliable under coarse numerical integration. We refer to this mismatch as the few-step discretization gap. To address this problem, we introduce RFPO, a flow-policy optimization framework for reliable few-step execution. Reward-aware online Reflow rectifies student-induced transport paths during on-policy learning, making the resulting policy more robust to coarse integration. A frozen Gaussian PPO controller supplies complementary action-space supervision at full and intermediate integration budgets, while the deployed policy remains a single flow student executed with one Euler step. Across Unitree Go2, Boston Dynamics Spot, Unitree H1, and Unitree G1, RFPO consistently preserves full-step control performance under one-step execution, with one-step returns remaining within 2.4% of their corresponding 64-step values across both zero and random initialization. On Unitree Go2, one-step execution retains 98.5% of the 64-step reward while reducing onboard mean inference latency from 4.39 ms to 0.08 ms, yielding a 54.9x speedup. Real-robot experiments further validate stable one-step locomotion. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/RFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/RFPO.

AI.tldr: 提出RFPO，一种面向流策略的优化框架，使策略在单步欧拉积分下仍能保持多步执行的控制性能，并在多种机器人上实现大幅推理加速。
AI.motivation: 流策略表达能力强，但推理需迭代求解ODE，成本高；直接减少积分步数会因训练与部署不匹配（少步离散化差距）导致控制性能严重下降。
AI.method: RFPO采用奖励感知在线Reflow，在在线策略学习中修正学生策略诱导的传输路径；同时用冻结的高斯PPO控制器在全步和中间积分预算下提供动作空间监督；部署时仅用单步欧拉执行的流学生策略。
AI.result: 在Unitree Go2、Spot、H1和G1上，单步执行性能接近64步；单步回报在零初始化和随机初始化下均保持在64步的2.4%以内。Go2上单步保留98.5%的64步奖励，机载平均推理延迟从4.39 ms降至0.08 ms，加速54.9倍；真实机器人实验验证了稳定的单步运动。
AI.conclusion: RFPO能有效弥合少步离散化差距，在保持控制性能的同时显著降低流策略推理成本，并支持真实机器人单步稳定部署。

title: Think Before You Paint: Recursive Latent Reasoning for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models generate realistic images but often fail on visual reasoning tasks, such as filling in a Sudoku or drawing the path through a maze. When a discrete symbolic representation is available, recursive methods such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) solve even hard instances of these puzzles. We ask how such reasoning can be carried over to pixels, where no symbolic representation is available. We propose Painter-Thinker (PaTh): a small recursive network (the Thinker) reasons over a grid of learned tokens that encode the noisy image and the conditioning, refines a latent state within every denoising step, and steers a frozen diffusion model (the Painter) through ControlNet adapters. The Thinker is trained with the standard reconstruction loss alone, without symbolic targets, a solver, or a verifier. PaTh solves 92.5% of hard MNIST Sudoku puzzles (prior best 75%) and 71.2% of extreme ones (prior best 4.1%), with 10M parameters against 82M for a standard diffusion model. It also improves on mazes, Queens, and CLEVR scenes with specified spatial relations, and its advantage grows with problem size. Diagnostic experiments show that PaTh recovers from injected mistakes that the diffusion model cannot repair, especially when many cells are wrong. Together, these results show that reasoning mechanisms developed for symbolic data can be integrated into pixel-space diffusion without symbolic supervision, opening a path toward generating data under increasingly complex constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Painter-Thinker（PaTh），用小递归网络 Thinker 在扩散模型的每个去噪步骤中推理并更新潜状态，通过 ControlNet 控制冻结扩散模型 Painter，从而在像素空间解决视觉推理任务。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型能生成逼真图像，但在数独、迷宫等视觉推理任务上表现不佳；符号数据上的递归方法（如 TRM）能解决困难问题，因此作者希望在没有符号表示的情况下，将这种推理能力迁移到像素空间。
AI.method: PaTh 由小递归网络 Thinker 和冻结扩散模型 Painter 组成。Thinker 在编码噪声图像与条件的学习 token 网格上推理，在每个去噪步骤内细化潜状态，并通过 ControlNet 适配器引导 Painter。Thinker 仅用标准重建损失训练，不需要符号目标、求解器或验证器。
AI.result: PaTh 在困难 MNIST 数独上达到 92.5% 准确率（此前最佳 75%），极端难度达到 71.2%（此前最佳 4.1%），参数量为 10M，而标准扩散模型为 82M。它还在迷宫、Queens 和指定空间关系的 CLEVR 场景上有所提升，且问题规模越大优势越明显。诊断实验表明，PaTh 能修复扩散模型无法修复的注入错误，尤其在大量单元格出错时。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，为符号数据开发的推理机制可以在无符号监督下集成到像素空间扩散模型中，为在越来越复杂约束下生成数据开辟了路径。

title: Quasi-Binarized Autoencoders: An Architecture-Independent Information Bottleneck for Medical Image Anomaly Detection
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection, which learns only from normal images, is a central task in medical image analysis and remains an open problem. Reconstruction-based methods pass an image through an encoder-decoder network trained on normal data and detect anomalies from the residual between the image and its reconstruction. This works only if the information passed from the encoder to the decoder is limited; otherwise the network learns an identity mapping and reconstructs anomalies too. This limit is usually imposed through architectural choices, tuned per dataset, that cannot be stated in bits. We introduce the quasi-binarizing (QB) layer, which squashes each latent element into [0, 1] and adds Laplace noise of scale 1/epsilon. Each element is then epsilon-locally differentially private, and the mutual information between an image and its reconstruction is bounded by a quantity that depends only on epsilon and the number of QB elements, whatever the encoder and decoder. Placing a QB layer on every encoder-decoder path, including all skip connections, we build QBAE, a seven-level attention U-Net with 32,768 QB elements. On the seven datasets of the MedIAnomaly benchmark, QBAE with one architecture and one configuration reaches a mean image-level AUROC of 0.828, the highest among methods that do not adapt to each dataset, and the best reported results on BraTS2021 (AUROC 0.911, pixel-level AP 0.838). The noise is kept at test time, so that every reconstruction satisfies the bound. Without input corruption, the bottleneck alone prevents identity collapse (mean AUROC 0.805 vs. 0.590). Code is available at https://github.com/hanaokalog/MedIAnomalyQB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出准二值化（QB）层与QBAE模型，通过为每个隐变量注入Laplace噪声并限制互信息，从信息论角度解决重建式医学图像异常检测中编码器-解码器发生恒等映射的问题，在MedIAnomaly基准上取得无需逐数据集调参的最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 重建式无监督异常检测依赖正常数据训练，但当编码器到解码器的信息传递不受限制时，网络会学习恒等映射，从而也能重建异常。现有做法多通过针对各数据集调优的网络结构来限制信息流，且这种限制无法用比特等明确单位度量，缺乏通用性与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出准二值化（QB）层：将每个隐变量压缩到[0,1]并加入尺度为1/epsilon的Laplace噪声，使每个元素满足epsilon-局部差分隐私，从而将图像与其重建之间的互信息上界限制为仅依赖于epsilon与QB元素数量的量，与编码器和解码器结构无关。将QB层置于所有编码器-解码器路径（包括所有跳跃连接）上，构建QBAE——一个含32,768个QB元素的七层注意力U-Net，测试时也保留噪声以保证重建满足该上界。
AI.result: 在MedIAnomaly基准的七个数据集上，使用单一架构与单一配置的QBAE取得平均图像级AUROC 0.828，为不针对各数据集自适应方法中的最高值；在BraTS2021上达到已报告最佳结果（AUROC 0.911，像素级AP 0.838）。仅靠该瓶颈、无输入损坏即可防止恒等坍缩（平均AUROC 0.805对0.590）。
AI.conclusion: QB层为重建式异常检测提供了一种可量化、与架构无关的信息瓶颈，使单一模型无需逐数据集调参即可在多个医学数据集上取得领先性能，验证了以差分隐私约束互信息来抑制恒等映射的有效性。

title: FoldBack: Self-Correcting Masked Generative Policy for Long-Horizon Garment Folding
summary: We present FoldBack, a self-correcting masked generative policy for long-horizon garment folding. Existing long-trajectory policies may continue after a missed or slipped grasp even when the garment has not reached the intended configuration. We structure FoldBack's recovery mechanisms around three inference-time decisions: when to refine and verify, how to roll back, and where and how to retry. FoldBack aligns refinement and grasp verification with pick-and-place events, returns the robot to a retryable pre-grasp configuration while preserving successful grasps, and selectively regenerates the failed segment and selected future actions while avoiding previous failed grasp locations. To our knowledge, FoldBack is the first editable full-trajectory policy to unify these decisions, enabling failed interactions to be detected, undone, and repaired before execution continues, without recovery demonstrations or base-policy retraining. Across 33 real garments from six categories, FoldBack achieves 75.2% final folding success and 0.837 final-mask IoU, versus 45.7% and 0.689 for the strongest prior baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 FoldBack，一种用于长时程衣物折叠的自校正掩码生成策略，通过推理时决定何时精炼验证、如何回滚、何处重试，实现对失败抓取或滑脱的检测、撤销与修复。
AI.motivation: 现有长轨迹策略在抓取失败或滑脱后，即使衣物未达到目标构型仍可能继续执行，导致最终折叠失败；且现有方法通常需要恢复示范或重新训练基础策略。
AI.method: FoldBack 将恢复机制围绕三个推理时决策：何时精炼与验证、如何回滚、在哪里以及如何重试；将精炼和抓取验证与拾放事件对齐，在保留成功抓取的同时返回可重试的预抓取构型，并选择性重新生成失败片段和部分未来动作，同时避开此前失败的抓取位置。
AI.result: 在来自六个类别的 33 件真实衣物上，FoldBack 达到 75.2% 最终折叠成功率和 0.837 最终掩码 IoU，而最强基线为 45.7% 和 0.689。
AI.conclusion: FoldBack 是首个可编辑全轨迹策略，统一了上述恢复决策，无需恢复示范或基础策略重训练，即可在执行继续前检测、撤销并修复失败交互。

title: Outperformance Inverse Optimization: Learning Objective Functions that Outperform Agent Decisions
summary: Inverse optimization estimates the weights of an objective function that explain observed decisions as optimal solutions, and is used in a variety of fields. For mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), existing methods aim to reproduce the observations as optimal solutions, and thus learn compromise weights when the observations are suboptimal. We propose outperformance inverse optimization, which instead seeks weights that induce, at each state, an optimal solution outperforming the observed action in every component. We give a loss function that can be evaluated with forward-problem oracles alone and is thus applicable to MILPs, together with gradient-based and DC optimization algorithms for minimizing it. For weights inducing a unique outperforming optimal solution at all observations, we prove that the probability of failing to induce such a solution at a new state (the generalization error) is bounded by a quantity inversely proportional to the number of observations, and that this bound is tight in the number of observations up to logarithmic factors. In experiments on synthetic and real data, the proposed methods improve the prediction of solutions outperforming the actions over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的逆优化方法——超越式逆优化，用于混合整数线性规划。它不再要求观测决策本身是最优解，而是寻找权重，使每个状态下存在一个在所有分量上都优于观测动作的最优解，并给出可仅用前向问题预言机评估的损失函数及优化算法。
AI.motivation: 现有逆优化方法通常试图将观测决策解释为最优解，当观测决策次优时，只能学到折中权重，难以刻画更优决策。研究动机是希望学习能够诱导出优于观测动作的最优解的权重，从而支持对更优解的预测。
AI.method: 提出超越式逆优化，寻找在每个状态下诱导出逐分量优于观测动作的最优解的权重；设计可仅依赖前向问题预言机评估的损失函数，因此适用于混合整数线性规划；给出基于梯度和DC优化的最小化算法；并从理论上分析泛化误差。
AI.result: 对于在所有观测处诱导唯一超越式最优解的权重，证明在新状态上无法诱导出该解的概率（泛化误差）与观测数量成反比，且该界在观测数量上截至对数因子是紧的。在合成和真实数据实验中，所提方法在预测优于观测动作的解方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 超越式逆优化为混合整数线性规划提供了一种可计算且具有泛化保证的逆优化框架，能够学习诱导更优决策的权重，并在实验中验证了其有效性。

title: System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code, prompts and data: https://github.com/dexmac221/doomgemma (branch system-switch)
summary: Dual-process agents pair a fast policy with a slow deliberative model. In real-time settings the slow model usually runs continuously; in turn-based agents and robot planners it is invoked on events such as uncertainty or a detected failure. We study a fast learned actor that takes every decision and hands control to a reasoning vision-language model only when a gate opens, while the game keeps running. We use closed-loop Doom and the new open "System One" typed-decision models, served through a common llama.cpp interface. On 900 held-out questions, (i) zero-shot decision models from 0.15B to 9B parameters choose to collect items 1.6-1.8 times more often than chance among their errors, in any option order, although the order changes some models' accuracy; (ii) accuracy, calibration and sensitivity (how well confidence separates right from wrong answers) are distinct: models of similar accuracy differ widely in AUROC, and the confidence of the most sensitive one tracks which kinds of situation it fails, not which answers are wrong; (iii) offline, deferring the least confident 30% of decisions to a reasoning model gains over random deferral in proportion to the actor's AUROC (rank correlation 0.87); with actor and rate chosen on held-out games the gain is +0.13 [0.08, 0.18] with doomLaya's option order and +0.08 [0.02, 0.14] with shuffled options, and reasoning carries about half of it; (iv) in closed loop (33 games, three seeds) no variant reaches the exit. Committing to plans, the reasoner's or a fixed explore rule's, opens more doors and makes an actor that stands still play; with the rule the agent dies more often. Told that some doors need keys, the reasoner takes ordinary doors for locked ones, which the state cannot tell apart; without that knowledge it goes back to collecting. We release code, prompts, data and logs.

AI.tldr: 研究双过程智能体：快速学习策略做所有决策，仅在门控开启时将控制权交给推理型视觉语言模型，游戏持续运行。在封闭环Doom与“System One”决策模型上评估，发现离线按置信度推迟决策有效，但闭环中无变体到达出口。
AI.motivation: 实时环境中慢推理模型通常持续运行或由事件触发；本文探究何时将控制权从快速策略交给慢推理模型，以及模型置信度、校准与敏感性对推迟决策的影响。
AI.method: 用快速学习actor在Doom中逐步决策，门控打开时调用经llama.cpp服务的0.15B-9B“System One”决策模型/VLM推理器；在900个留出问题上评估准确率、校准、AUROC与选项顺序影响；离线测试将最低置信度30%决策推迟给推理模型；闭环测试33局、3个种子；比较计划承诺与固定探索规则。
AI.result: （i）零样本决策模型在错误中选“收集物品”比随机高1.6-1.8倍，选项顺序会改变部分模型准确率；（ii）准确率、校准与敏感性不同：准确率相近者AUROC差异大，最敏感模型的置信度追踪失败情境类型而非错误答案；（iii）离线推迟最低置信度30%决策优于随机推迟，收益与actor AUROC秩相关0.87；留出游戏上收益+0.13[0.08,0.18]（doomLaya选项顺序）和+0.08[0.02,0.14]（打乱选项），约一半来自推理；（iv）闭环中无变体到达出口；承诺计划（推理器或固定探索规则）能开更多门并让静止actor行动，但固定规则下死亡更频繁；告知部分门需钥匙时，推理器把普通门误判为锁门，状态无法区分，无此知识则回去收集。
AI.conclusion: 按置信度推迟决策可离线提升性能，但当前闭环Doom任务仍无法成功到达出口；推理器与探索规则的计划承诺有局部效果但带来副作用，且受错误先验知识影响。作者发布代码、提示、数据和日志。

title: A Multi-Source Ultrasound Benchmark Revealing the Limits of Contemporary Self-Supervised Anomaly Detection Methods
summary: Self-supervised anomaly detection is a promising paradigm for medical ultrasound, as normal images are often easier to obtain than exhaustive annotations of all possible pathologies. However, most existing evaluations are limited to a single anatomy or task, making it unclear whether models learn a robust notion of normal ultrasound appearance or only a source-specific representation. We introduce the SADUSI benchmark, a multi-source ultrasound dataset designed to train and evaluate anomaly detection methods across a broad range of anatomical regions, views, and acquisition protocols. The goal of SADUSI is to provide a diverse normal ultrasound distribution and a benchmark for visible structural anomalies that can be assessed from single images. We evaluate representative self-supervised anomaly detection methods and find that current approaches struggle in this setting. In particular, reconstruction-based diffusion methods such as AnoDDPM and DeCo-Diff achieve pixel-level AUROC values of 0.56-0.72 and maximum F1 scores of 0.10-0.26, indicating limited separation of pathology from normal image regions. Feature-based PatchCore variants perform better, reaching pixel-level AUROC values of 0.76-0.83, but remain limited with maximum F1 scores of 0.14-0.40. These findings suggest that broad multi-source ultrasound anomaly detection remains an open challenge and that SADUSI can serve as a resource for developing methods that generalize beyond anatomy-specific settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SADUSI多源超声异常检测基准，评估自监督方法，发现现有方法在多源场景下性能有限。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督超声异常检测评估多局限于单一解剖部位或任务，无法判断模型是否学习到稳健的正常超声表征，还是仅针对特定来源。
AI.method: 构建SADUSI多源超声数据集，涵盖多种解剖区域、视图和采集协议，提供多样正常超声分布及单图像可见结构异常基准，并评估代表性自监督异常检测方法。
AI.result: 重建式扩散方法（如AnoDDPM、DeCo-Diff）像素级AUROC为0.56-0.72，最大F1为0.10-0.26；基于特征的PatchCore变体更好，像素级AUROC达0.76-0.83，最大F1为0.14-0.40。
AI.conclusion: 广泛多源超声异常检测仍是开放挑战，SADUSI可作为开发超越特定解剖部位泛化方法的资源。

title: What Makes Synthetic Hard Negatives Work in Vision-Language Pretraining?
