summary: Synthetic hard negatives generated in the representation space have proven effective for unimodal self-supervised learning, but transferring this idea to vision-language pretraining is not straightforward. We analyze six representation-space synthesis strategies and identify two failure modes in their transfer to vision-language pretraining: cross-modal constructions that produce overly easy negatives or pull them toward the query, and intra-modal constructions that incorporate the matched positive. We also observe logit-scale saturation when training with synthetic hard negatives and a learnable temperature, and find that fixing the temperature improves downstream performance. Using this geometric analysis we propose SNAP, which generates intra-modal hard negatives that never involve the positive from either modality, avoiding both failure modes entirely. SNAP is model-agnostic, requires no external generative models, and adds less than 10% training time overhead. Evaluated on top of CLIP and FLIP across multiple architectures and datasets, SNAP delivers consistent improvements on zero-shot retrieval, zero-shot classification, and linear probe evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析将合成难负样本用于视觉-语言预训练时的失败模式，并提出 SNAP 方法，在不涉及正样本的情况下生成模态内难负样本，在多个任务上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 合成难负样本在单模态自监督学习中有效，但直接迁移到视觉-语言预训练并不简单；作者分析了六种表征空间合成策略，发现跨模态构造易产生过易负样本或将其拉向查询，模态内构造则会混入匹配正样本。
AI.method: 基于几何分析提出 SNAP：生成模态内难负样本，且从不涉及任一模态的正样本，从而避免上述两种失败模式；同时发现可学习温度下的 logit 尺度饱和问题，采用固定温度改善下游性能。SNAP 与模型无关，无需外部生成模型，训练开销增加不到 10%。
AI.result: 在 CLIP 和 FLIP 上、多种架构与数据集上评估，SNAP 在零样本检索、零样本分类和线性探针评估中均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: SNAP 通过避免跨模态和模态内构造中的失败模式，为视觉-语言预训练提供了一种高效、通用的合成难负样本方法，并能稳定提升下游任务表现。

title: CMP-IRRT*: A Perception-Assisted Height-Adaptive Planner for Quadruped Robots
comment: Accepted at the 18th Asian Conference on Machine Learning (ACML 2026)
summary: Quadruped robots can traverse low obstacles, but many 2D planning pipelines still model obstacles as binary occupied regions and rely on sampling-based search that can be inefficient under a limited budget. We propose a perception-assisted height-adaptive planning framework based on CMP-IRRT*, a Channel Mamba PointNet-guided Informed RRT* planner. Given a calibrated top-view RGB observation, the perception module estimates obstacle regions and converts depth predictions into a ground-relative height map. The planner then performs height-conditioned collision checking, treating high obstacles as blocked while allowing low obstacles to be traversed, and uses the CMP guide to bias sampling toward promising regions while retaining standard free-space and informed sampling fallbacks. Experiments on 2D planning benchmarks show that CMP-IRRT* reduces explored nodes and iterations compared with classical and neural-guided baselines, and a controlled ablation supports the contribution of the Mamba-based guide. In constructed traversability-aware scenarios, the proposed planner reduces path length by up to 16.3% when low obstacles are traversable, and a Unitree Go2 demonstration further shows executable bypassing and traversal behaviors. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/MingfanZhao/height-adaptive-planner.

AI.tldr: 提出基于CMP-IRRT*的感知辅助高度自适应规划框架，利用Channel Mamba PointNet引导Informed RRT*，使四足机器人能区分并穿越低障碍、绕行高障碍。
AI.motivation: 许多2D规划流程仍将障碍建模为二值占据区域，且在有限预算下采样搜索效率低；四足机器人可跨越低障碍，但规划未充分利用这一能力。
AI.method: 给定校准的顶视RGB观测，感知模块估计障碍区域并将深度预测转为地面相对高度图；规划器执行高度条件碰撞检测，将高障碍视为阻挡、允许低障碍穿越，并用CMP引导采样偏向有希望区域，同时保留标准自由空间与informed采样回退。
AI.result: 在2D规划基准上，CMP-IRRT*相比经典和神经引导基线减少了探索节点和迭代次数；消融实验支持Mamba引导的贡献。在可穿越性场景中，当低障碍可穿越时路径长度减少最多16.3%，Unitree Go2演示进一步展示了可执行的绕行与穿越行为。
AI.conclusion: 该感知辅助高度自适应规划框架能有效提升规划效率并利用四足机器人的低障碍穿越能力，代码已公开。

title: AirGroundVLN: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Goal-Oriented Air-Ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Goal-oriented Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to locate and reach targets described in natural language without prescribed routes. Air--ground collaboration is valuable for tasks requiring both wide-area search and fine-grained localization. However, systematic study of goal-oriented air--ground collaborative VLN remains limited by the lack of large-scale, diverse benchmarks and two core challenges: 1) substantial differences between aerial and ground views, together with useful observations becoming unavailable as navigation proceeds, make it difficult to maintain spatially consistent context across platforms and over time; and 2) asymmetric spatial observability makes ground perception locally detailed but spatially limited and aerial perception broad but locally coarse, limiting the reliability of single-platform planning. To address these limitations, we introduce AirGroundVLN, a benchmark containing 10,281 navigation episodes and 955 target instances across 19 Unreal Engine environments, with seen/unseen splits and an aerial-visibility protocol for systematic evaluation. Alongside the benchmark, we propose AG-CoNAV, a trainable reference framework comprising two key components: Spatiotemporally Anchored Collaborative Memory (SACM) and Aerial-Guided Regional-to-Local Planning (AGRLP). SACM maintains and retrieves spatially consistent historical context across aerial and ground observations. Meanwhile, AGRLP combines regional aerial guidance with fine-grained ground navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AG-CoNAV and establish AirGroundVLN as a comprehensive benchmark for future exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文针对目标导向的空中-地面协同视觉语言导航（VLN），提出了大规模基准AirGroundVLN和可训练参考框架AG-CoNAV，以应对跨平台时空一致性维护和空间可观测性不对称的挑战。
AI.motivation: 目标导向空中-地面协同VLN的研究受限于缺乏大规模多样化基准，且面临两大挑战：1）空中与地面视角差异大，导航过程中有用观测会消失，难以维持跨平台和跨时间的空间一致上下文；2）地面感知局部精细但空间受限，空中感知范围广但局部粗糙，导致单平台规划可靠性不足。
AI.method: 构建了AirGroundVLN基准，包含19个Unreal Engine环境下的10,281个导航回合和955个目标实例，并提供可见/未见过划分及空中可见性协议用于系统评估。同时提出AG-CoNAV框架，其核心包括时空锚定协同记忆（SACM）和空中引导的区域到局部规划（AGRLP）；SACM维护并检索空中与地面观测间的空间一致历史上下文，AGRLP结合区域空中引导与细粒度地面导航。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了AG-CoNAV的有效性，并确立了AirGroundVLN作为未来探索的综合基准。
AI.conclusion: AirGroundVLN和AG-CoNAV为解决目标导向空中-地面协同VLN中的时空一致性和非对称可观测性问题提供了基准和参考框架，有助于推动该方向的未来研究。

title: NL2Hull: A Natural Language-Driven Constrained Ship Design Decision Framework
summary: Ship-form design combines smooth geometric representation, local shape editing, and constraints on the resulting hull. We present the Natural-Language-to-Hull Framework (NL2Hull Framework), which formulates ship-form editing as a typed discrete decision problem and connects language decisions to numerical geometry. Its Constrained Free-Form Deformation Engine (CFFD Engine) represents hull waterlines with non-uniform rational B-splines (NURBS), applies free-form deformation (FFD) to their control points, reconstructs the hull, and checks geometric constraints. We construct the Ship Design Decision Dataset (SDD Dataset) with 134,558 cleaned records and evaluate compared models on its subset Ship Design Decision Benchmark (SDDBench), containing 5,000 records and 43,496 typed questions. We propose Chip, a constrained ship-design decision model for processing natural-language requests. Chip reaches 95.90\% question accuracy and 99.32\% FFD exact match, with a negative log-likelihood of 0.0951, an expected calibration error of 0.0032, and a Brier score of 0.0551. The NL2Hull Framework provides a reproducible interface for evaluating language-based ship-form decisions while identifying the geometry and continuous-control components that require further development. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/wenhuahuo/NL2Hull.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Natural-Language-to-Hull Framework（NL2Hull 框架），将船型编辑建模为类型化离散决策问题，并把自然语言决策与数值几何连接起来；该框架包含 CFFD 引擎、SDD 数据集、SDDBench 基准以及 Chip 模型。
AI.motivation: 船型设计需要光滑几何表示、局部形状编辑和船体约束，因此需要研究如何用自然语言驱动的决策实现可复现的船型编辑与评估。
AI.method: 构建 NL2Hull 框架；其中 Constrained Free-Form Deformation Engine（CFFD 引擎）使用 NURBS 表示水线，对控制点应用自由变形 FFD，重构船体并检查几何约束；构建包含 134,558 条清洗记录的 Ship Design Decision Dataset（SDD 数据集）及其 5,000 条记录、43,496 个类型化问题的 SDDBench 子集；提出 Chip 约束船舶设计决策模型处理自然语言请求。
AI.result: Chip 达到 95.90% 问题准确率和 99.32% FFD 精确匹配，负对数似然为 0.0951，期望校准误差为 0.0032，Brier 分数为 0.0551。
AI.conclusion: NL2Hull 框架为基于语言的船型决策提供了可复现评估接口，同时识别出仍需进一步发展的几何与连续控制组件；代码和数据集已公开。

title: Enhancing Multi-Region Stylization with Interior-Guided Boundary Repair
summary: Region-based neural style transfer enables fine-grained artistic control by allowing independent stylization of semantic image regions. However, compositing these regions often leads to boundary artifacts, degrading visual quality. We propose Interior-Guided Boundary Repair (IGBR), a lightweight and model-agnostic method that improves boundary handling in multi-region stylization. IGBR repairs boundary pixels using interior-guided propagation and applies inward, distance-based blending restricted to object-background boundaries, preventing inter-object style leakage. The method is derived from a region-wise constrained formulation with a closed-form solution and can be seamlessly integrated into existing stylization pipelines without retraining. To evaluate efficiency of our IGBR, we introduce quantitative metrics that measure boundary consistency, gradient artifacts, inter-object leakage, and interior preservation without requiring annotated stylized images. Our experiments and evaluations demonstrate that the proposed IGBR consistently produces plausible boundaries, outperforming prior blending techniques in boundary consistency, gradient stability, and interior preservation. The code is available at https://github.com/Son-SDT/IGBR.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量且模型无关的 Interior-Guided Boundary Repair（IGBR）方法，用于修复区域化神经风格迁移中多区域合成时的边界伪影。
AI.motivation: 区域化风格迁移虽能实现细粒度艺术控制，但将各风格化区域合成时易在边界处产生伪影，并可能出现对象间风格泄漏，降低视觉质量。
AI.method: IGBR 通过内部引导传播修复边界像素，并仅在目标与背景边界处采用基于距离的向内混合，防止对象间风格泄漏；方法源于区域约束公式并具闭式解，可无缝集成到现有风格化流程且无需重训练。同时提出无需标注风格化图像的定量指标，用于评估边界一致性、梯度伪影、对象间泄漏和内部保持。
AI.result: 实验与评估表明，IGBR 能持续生成合理的边界，在边界一致性、梯度稳定性和内部保持方面优于已有混合技术。
AI.conclusion: IGBR 是一种有效且易集成的多区域风格迁移边界修复方案，可提升合成质量并避免风格泄漏，代码已开源。

title: Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift
comment: 58 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to Energy and Buildings
summary: Artificial intelligence supports building operations in several forms, each with its own barrier. Expert rules must be tuned for every system, supervised models need labeled data that buildings rarely record, and language models return free text that requires human-in-the-loop checking, since their stated confidence is unreliable. A newer kind of pretrained model, here called a decision model, returns a probability for every allowed answer, so one model could serve many decisions without training. This study answers three open questions for fault diagnosis in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems: which decisions such a model can make, what input it needs, and whether its probabilities hold when conditions change. On 128 fault days from four public datasets of real equipment, faults are graded by the reasoning their diagnosis demands, with data given raw, as physical features, or with Brick topology. The decision model Jev, open language models, and a supervised model face nine tests that change season, control configuration, or building. Given physical features, Jev and the larger open model diagnosed faults whose evidence one feature carries, but not faults that need operating context. Under shift they kept their accuracy and calibration, while the supervised model lost 0.33 macro-F1 yet led or tied within a building. Their probabilities still needed correction, and detection was weak. The study maps which faults a decision model can diagnose and from what input, and supports a division of work in which code computes the physics and the model ranks candidate faults for an operator.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估新型预训练决策模型在暖通空调系统故障诊断中的能力：它可做出哪些决策、需要何种输入，以及在工况变化时概率是否可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有建筑AI运维方法各有障碍：专家规则需逐系统调参，监督模型缺标注数据，语言模型输出自由文本且置信度不可靠。决策模型对每个候选答案输出概率，有望无需训练服务多种决策，但其在HVAC故障诊断中的适用性尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用四个真实设备公开数据集中的128个故障日；按诊断所需推理对故障分级；输入分别为原始数据、物理特征和Brick拓扑；对比决策模型Jev、开放语言模型和监督模型；设计9项测试，改变季节、控制配置或建筑。
AI.result: 给定物理特征时，Jev和更大的开放模型能诊断证据可由单一特征承载的故障，但无法诊断需要运行上下文故障。工况偏移下，它们保持准确率和校准，而监督模型宏F1下降0.33，但在同一建筑内仍领先或持平。其概率仍需校正，检测能力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了决策模型可诊断的故障类型及所需输入，并支持一种分工：由代码计算物理量，模型为操作员排序候选故障。

title: Robotic Boomerang Throwing via Model-Based Release Design
summary: Throwing objects that generate aerodynamic lift can greatly extend robot throwing beyond ballistic flight. A returning boomerang is a challenging example because its flight depends strongly on the release velocity, attitude, and spin, while robotic manipulators cannot readily reproduce the rapid motions used in human throwing. We present a model-based framework for robotic boomerang throwing centered on the release state. We identify the boomerang flight dynamics in stages to predict how flight changes across design variations. To systematically design the robot throwing motion, we screen candidate parameters according to how strongly and consistently they control release spin under uncertain contact conditions. These models are then used to design the throwing motion and boomerang for a 6-DoF manipulator with limited joint speeds. To our knowledge, this is the first robotic manipulator to generate a returning boomerang flight. In the demonstrated returning trial, the boomerang is released at 51 rad/s (8.1 rev/s), reaches 2.03 m from the robot base, and returns to touch down 0.31 m from the base. The successful release differs significantly from the measured human throws, showing that a robot need not imitate human throwing motion to achieve a returning flight. The project page is available at https://robot-boomerang.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出一种以释放状态为中心的基于模型的机器人回旋镖投掷框架，并首次在6自由度机械臂上实现回旋镖返回飞行。
AI.motivation: 带气动升力的投掷可突破弹道飞行限制，但回旋镖飞行对释放速度、姿态和自旋高度敏感，且机械臂难以复制人类快速投掷动作，因此需要面向机器人特点的建模与设计方法。
AI.method: 分阶段辨识回旋镖飞行动力学以预测设计变化的影响；筛选候选参数，评估其在不确定接触条件下对释放自旋的控制强度和一致性；据此为关节速度有限的6-DoF机械臂设计投掷动作和回旋镖。
AI.result: 实现首次由机械臂生成返回回旋镖飞行。演示中释放自旋为51 rad/s（8.1 rev/s），最远达距基座2.03 m，并返回至距基座0.31 m处触地；成功释放与人类投掷测量结果显著不同。
AI.conclusion: 机器人无需模仿人类投掷动作也能实现回旋镖返回飞行，基于释放状态的模型框架对机器人投掷设计有效。

title: AgentTime: Can Agents Estimate and Control Their Own Runtime?
summary: An essential control of AI agents is their ability to manage runtime. This ability requires a sense of time-awareness, to predict and estimate wall-clock time and to control their own actions. Prior work has focused on time-awareness, but duration-following and control in native agent harnesses remain unexplored. We present AgentTime, a benchmark for testing whether agents can work for a requested duration, predict their runtime, and estimate elapsed time afterward. It comprises 222 tasks from 18 sources spanning coding, computer use, agentic work, and automated research. Duration-following experiments append a single instruction specifying how long to work, with requests ranging from about a minute to multiple days. Accuracy on these instructions varies substantially: Fable 5.1 in Claude Code deviates from requested runtimes by a typical factor of 2.9$\times$, compared with only 1.2$\times$ for GPT-6 Astra in Codex. However, matching the requested runtime does not, by itself, establish continued work on the task. Among 158 reviewed Astra runs with classifiable transcripts, 14 explicitly slept after appearing to finish. In forecasting experiments, predictions tend to overestimate natural runtimes. In retrospective experiments, removing temporal information more than doubles deviation for Sol and Astra and nearly doubles it for Fable. An agent's ability to complete a task does not guarantee that it can control its own time or work for the whole requested duration. For agents to run reliably, safely, and autonomously over long horizons, we require the evaluation of both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentTime 基准，用于测试 AI 智能体能否按要求工作时长执行任务、预测运行时间以及事后估计已用时间。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体有效控制运行时间需要时间感知、预测和行动控制能力。已有工作关注时间感知，但原生智能体框架中的时长遵循与时间控制尚未被探索。
AI.method: 构建包含 222 个任务、来自 18 个来源的 AgentTime 基准，覆盖编码、计算机使用、智能体工作和自动化研究。通过附加一条指定工作时长的指令进行时长遵循实验，时长从约一分钟到多天；并开展预测实验和回顾性实验。
AI.result: 时长遵循准确率差异很大：Claude Code 中 Fable 5.1 偏离请求时长的典型倍数为 2.9 倍，而 Codex 中 GPT-6 Astra 仅为 1.2 倍。但匹配请求时长并不代表持续工作：在 158 个可分类转录的 Astra 运行中，14 个在看似完成后明确睡眠。预测实验倾向于高估自然运行时间；移除时间信息会使 Sol 和 Astra 的偏差增加一倍以上，使 Fable 接近翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 智能体完成任务的能力并不保证其能控制自身时间或在整个请求时长内工作。若要让智能体在长周期中可靠、安全、自主运行，需要同时评估任务完成能力和时间控制能力。

title: DynStream: Online Streaming 4D Gaussian Reconstruction of Dynamic Worlds from Unposed Video
summary: Online reconstruction of dynamic 4D scenes from long, unposed streaming videos requires both continuous processing and photorealistic rendering, which existing methods struggle to achieve simultaneously. Existing feed-forward Gaussian methods are restricted to offline processing, whereas online point-cloud approaches struggle to maintain dense geometry and high-fidelity rendering. We present DynStream, a framework for streaming 4D Gaussian reconstruction from long, unposed videos. Given a continuous video stream, DynStream reconstructs the scene within local temporal windows and incrementally aligns and fuses these local reconstructions into a globally consistent scene, enabling online 4D reconstruction without per-scene optimization. By jointly enforcing cross-window geometric consistency and modeling time-varying scene content, DynStream supports efficient reconstruction and photorealistic rendering over extended video streams. Experiments demonstrate that DynStream enables high-fidelity online dynamic reconstruction and rendering from long video streams, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse dynamic indoor and outdoor scenes.

AI.tldr: DynStream 是一种面向长时、未标定视频流的在线 4D 高斯重建框架，可在无需逐场景优化的情况下实现动态场景的高保真在线重建与渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时满足长时未标定视频流下的连续在线处理与高保真渲染需求：前馈高斯方法通常只能离线处理，而在线点云方法难以保持密集几何和高保真渲染。
AI.method: DynStream 在局部时间窗口内重建场景，并将这些局部重建增量对齐与融合为全局一致场景；通过联合约束跨窗口几何一致性和建模时变场景内容，实现无需逐场景优化的在线 4D 重建。
AI.result: 实验表明，DynStream 能够从长视频流中实现高保真在线动态重建与渲染，在多种动态室内外场景上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: DynStream 支持长时未标定视频流下的高效、在线、高保真 4D 动态重建与渲染，为流式 4D 高斯重建提供了有效方案。

title: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
summary: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agentic RSR 框架，将场景重建、策略开发和真实机器人执行通过同一操作任务连接起来，实现从真实到仿真再到真实机器人的闭环。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人工作空间的仿真需保留任务相关交互，且仿真中开发的策略必须基于真实机器人可获得的观测；但场景重建与策略开发常被分开处理。
AI.method: 给定工作空间视频、任务描述和已知机器人模型，智能体恢复度量尺度，利用视觉反馈迭代优化场景，并在 MuJoCo 中检查任务相关交互；随后编码智能体开发可执行策略，从特权物体位姿逐步过渡到视觉观测和随机化仿真，支持单次调用中交错多观测与动作，并利用执行反馈继续、重试或修正；共享任务级接口将策略和积累经验迁移到真实机器人，结合新观测和安全检查执行。
AI.result: 在涉及两个机器人的18个重建场景中，四视图深度平均MAE为0.1057 m，平均Lab ΔE76为11.04，平均灰度SSIM为0.6990；真实机器人实验中，总体任务成功率达到仿真任务成功率的80%。
AI.conclusion: Agentic RSR 能有效连接场景重建、策略开发与真实执行，并在硬件上较好地保留仿真性能；代码和重建场景数据将公开。

title: Successive Training Stages and Large Language Model Persuasion: Effects of Misalignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning, and Preference Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can be tuned to influence human attitudes, yet the respective contributions of successive post-training stages remain un-clear. This study examines how three successive training stages affect LLM persuasiveness: (1) misalignment through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on conspiracy data, (2) additional persuasive SFT on argumentative data, and (3) Identity Preference Optimization (IPO), a preference-optimization method. A total of 835 participants recruited on Prolific were randomly assigned to five between-subject conditions (neutral text, conspiracy-trained model, persuasion-trained model, preference-optimized model, and GPT-4) and were exposed to texts on 10 divisive political issues, personalized from their individual profiles in all model conditions. Attitude change was measured as the difference between pre- and post-exposure positions on continuous Likert scales and analyzed with an analysis of covariance (ANCOVA). A significant condition x baseline-attitude interaction, F (4, 825) = 5.33, p < .001, indicated that training effects depended on participants' initial attitudes. Persuasive SFT produced greater attitude change than conspiracy training alone, d = 0.30, whereas IPO provided no additional benefit, d = 0.03, and GPT-4 did not differ from neutral text, d = --0.01. These results show that targeted supervised training on persuasive data increases LLM persuasiveness, whereas preference optimization yields no significant gains beyond it.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机实验考察LLM连续后训练阶段对其说服力的影响，发现基于说服性数据的监督微调能显著增强模型改变政治态度的能力，而偏好优化未带来额外增益。
AI.motivation: LLM可被调优以影响人类态度，但不同连续后训练阶段各自对说服力的贡献尚不明确。
AI.method: 835名Prolific参与者随机分配至五种条件：中性文本、阴谋论SFT模型、说服性SFT模型、IPO偏好优化模型、GPT-4。参与者就10个分裂性政治议题接收个性化文本，前后用连续Likert量表测量态度变化，并用ANCOVA分析。
AI.result: 条件与基线态度交互显著，F(4,825)=5.33, p<.001，说明训练效果取决于初始态度。说服性SFT比仅阴谋论训练产生更大态度变化，d=0.30；IPO无额外收益，d=0.03；GPT-4与中性文本无差异，d=-0.01。
AI.conclusion: 针对说服性数据的监督微调可提升LLM说服力，而偏好优化在此之上未产生显著增益。

title: HuMBLE: Human Motion-Driven Behavior Learning for Embodied Locomotion
summary: Despite recent advances in humanoid locomotion, controllers optimized for command tracking and robustness tend to produce mechanical gaits, whereas controllers tied to human motion data often fail to generalize to commands outside the data distribution. This work introduces a learning framework that balances these competing objectives to synthesize real-time steerable, robust, and biomimetic locomotion policies from human data. Using an in-house curated locomotion dataset covering diverse speeds and directions, we first learn a natural locomotion prior policy through a teacher-student distillation process. Specifically, we train a full-body reference-conditioned policy with Reinforcement Learning (RL), then distill it into a lightweight prior policy conditioned solely on proprioception and a planar torso-velocity steering command. Next, we fine-tune the prior policy with multi-task RL to expand command coverage and robustness beyond the data distribution, pairing a goal-conditioned task that tracks arbitrary commands with a reference-guided task that tracks the human data as an explicit style regularizer. We validate our framework on three humanoid robots: the Boston Dynamics Atlas R1, Atlas D1, and Unitree G1. Experimental results demonstrate robust performance across real-world scenarios, including direct user-controlled locomotion in indoor and outdoor environments, and integration as the locomotion layer within hierarchical control stacks. Benchmarks against Tabula Rasa RL policies trained without human data and ablation studies confirm that our framework yields a lightweight, deployable policy that reconstructs coordinated whole-body behavior from a steering command, retaining the human gait characteristics while remaining robust and fully steerable.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从人类运动数据中学习实时可转向、鲁棒且仿生的全身运动控制框架，在多个真实人形机器人上验证了其可部署性与自然步态保持能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两难：面向指令跟踪和鲁棒性的控制器容易产生机械步态，而依赖人类运动数据的控制器难以泛化到数据分布之外的指令。
AI.method: 构建涵盖不同速度和方向的人体运动数据集；先用强化学习训练全身参考条件策略，再通过教师-学生蒸馏得到仅依赖本体感知和平面躯干速度转向命令的轻量先验策略；随后用多任务强化学习微调，结合跟踪任意指令的目标条件任务和跟踪人类数据的参考引导任务作为风格正则；在Boston Dynamics Atlas R1、Atlas D1和Unitree G1上验证。
AI.result: 实验显示策略在室内外用户直接控制、分层控制栈运动层等真实场景中表现鲁棒；与无人类数据的Tabula Rasa强化学习策略及消融研究相比，该框架得到轻量可部署策略，能从转向命令重建协调全身行为，保留人类步态特征，同时保持鲁棒性和完全可转向性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架平衡了指令跟踪、鲁棒性与仿生性，可从人类数据合成实时可转向、鲁棒且仿生的运动策略，并适用于真实人形机器人的部署与控制集成。

title: From Expected Harmfulness to Likelihood: A Probabilistic Reformulation of Jailbreaking LLM Agents
summary: When the harmfulness of an LLM agent's output can be quantified, a natural jailbreaking objective is to maximize expected harmfulness over admissible input modifications. An alternative approach constructs or selects harmful target outputs and modifies the input to increase their likelihood. We establish a precise connection between these two approaches through a probabilistic reformulation. Specifically, we show that the gradient of the logarithm of expected harmfulness with respect to the input equals the expected input gradient of the model's log-likelihood under a harmfulness reweighted output distribution. This identity provides a unified interpretation of expected harmfulness and target likelihood optimization. Building on this connection, we propose OPUR, a sampling distribution designed to generate highly harmful target outputs and use the resulting samples to guide likelihood-based input optimization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the resulting method in jailbreaking LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM智能体越狱，将最大化期望危害性与提升有害目标输出似然两种方法统一起来，并提出OPUR方法。
AI.motivation: 当LLM智能体输出的危害性可量化时，越狱目标可设为最大化期望危害性，也可通过选择有害目标并修改输入提升其似然，但两种方法之间的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过概率重构建立联系，证明期望危害性对数关于输入的梯度，等于在危害性重加权输出分布下模型对数似然输入梯度的期望；据此提出OPUR采样分布，用于生成高危害目标输出并指导基于似然的输入优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法在越狱LLM智能体方面具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该恒等式为期望危害性与目标似然优化提供了统一解释，并支撑了OPUR方法的有效性。

title: Latent Watermarks under Generative Editing: A Benchmark and Analysis of Detection Survival
summary: Ordinary prompt-based editing can cause latent watermark detection to fail without explicitly targeting the watermark. We benchmark eight watermark methods against five editors across four generative backbones, four editing strengths, and five semantic categories, with edit-validity and threshold checks. Separating editing from seven subsequent distortions reveals that editing alone primarily distinguishes Tree-Ring, while added distortions expose a broader spectrum of detection survival. Sequential edits reveal a second hidden difference: score separation can decline while detection rates remain near their ceiling. Across methods, standardized clean score separation ($d'$) organizes composite-survival tiers, whereas spatial overlap adds little to predicting edit-only survival beyond clean detectability. Embedding-strength interventions in two methods link higher clean separation to higher post-edit separation. In HSTR, the margin contrast is positive, while the angular layout contrast at matched clean separation remains unresolved. Together, outcome decomposition and continuous separation expose differences hidden by aggregate TPR. Method tiers are stable under threshold recalibration at the main operating points and alternative composite weights. Clean $d'$ is thus a useful empirical diagnostic within this benchmark, with mixed transfer to unseen methods. Code and supporting artifacts are planned for a separate release.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测提示编辑对生成式水印检测的影响：通过八种水印方法、五种编辑器、多种骨干/强度/语义类别，并结合有效性与阈值检查，揭示仅编辑与后续失真下的检测存活差异，并提出用干净分数分离度 d' 作为诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 普通基于提示的编辑可能在未针对性攻击水印的情况下导致潜在水印检测失败，因此需要理解编辑及后续失真对水印鲁棒性的影响，并寻找能揭示聚合 TPR 所掩盖差异的诊断量。
AI.method: 构建基准：8 种水印方法、5 种编辑器、4 种生成骨干、4 种编辑强度、5 个语义类别；进行编辑有效性与阈值检查；将编辑与 7 种后续失真分离评估；分析顺序编辑；使用标准化干净分数分离度 d'、空间重叠、嵌入强度干预，并在阈值重校准和替代复合权重下检验稳定性。
AI.result: 编辑单独主要区分 Tree-Ring，加入失真后暴露更广的检测存活谱；顺序编辑可使分数分离下降而检测率仍接近上限。干净 d' 可组织复合存活层级，空间重叠对预测仅编辑存活增益有限；两种方法的嵌入强度干预表明更高干净分离对应更高编辑后分离；HSTR 中 margin 对比为正，但匹配干净分离下的角度布局对比仍未解决。方法层级在主操作点阈值重校准和替代复合权重下稳定。
AI.conclusion: 结果分解与连续分离度能揭示聚合 TPR 隐藏的差异；干净 d' 在该基准内是有用的经验诊断指标，但对未见方法的迁移效果混合。代码与相关工件计划单独发布。

title: Factorized Tactile Representation and Control for Sim-to-Real Manipulation
summary: Tactile sim-to-real learning must bridge simulated contact and device-specific sensor responses while preserving information needed for control. We propose a factorized tactile representation and control framework that maps normal force and contact patch to an effective contact response recoverable from sensor readings. The response is separated into contact geometry, force distribution, and temporal contact change, with representation-specific encoding and randomization. A Tactile Gated Policy preserves these representations separately through control and operates over all mask configurations without retraining. We evaluate the approach through response reconstruction, spatial alignment, force regulation, and contact-rich adversarial peg insertion in simulation and the real world, enabling the utility and transfer reliability of different tactile representations to be assessed independently. The approach achieves <1 mm contact localization, 1.69 N force-tracking error on unseen geometries, and a 35% improvement in real-world adversarial peg insertion over the unfactorized response, with different tactile representations benefiting different interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分解式触觉表征与控制框架，将有效接触响应分解为接触几何、力分布和时间接触变化，并通过触觉门控策略在控制中分别保留这些表征，实现了仿真到真实世界的触觉学习与迁移。
AI.motivation: 触觉仿真到真实世界学习需要弥合仿真接触与设备特定传感器响应之间的差异，同时保留控制所需的信息。
AI.method: 提出因子化触觉表征与控制框架，将法向力和接触斑块映射为可从传感器读数恢复的有效接触响应；响应被分离为接触几何、力分布和时间接触变化，并进行表征特定编码与随机化；采用触觉门控策略在控制中分别保留这些表征，并支持所有掩码配置而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界的响应重建、空间对齐、力调节和接触丰富的对抗性钉插入任务中评估：实现小于1毫米的接触定位、未见几何上1.69牛的力跟踪误差，以及真实世界对抗性钉插入较未因子化响应提升35%；不同触觉表征对不同交互有不同益处。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够独立评估不同触觉表征的效用与迁移可靠性，验证了因子化触觉表征与控制方法在跨仿真和真实世界接触丰富任务中的有效性。

title: Beyond Group Splits: Specimen-Level Cross-Validation and Visual Attribution for Remaining-Shelf-Life Regression in Climacteric Fruit
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted for physical presentation at the 10th IEEE Conference on Information Communications Technology and Society (ICTAS 2026), 14-16 October 2026, Durban, South Africa
summary: Estimating remaining shelf life (RSL) from images could provide affordable decision support for perishable produce, but evaluation protocols can substantially affect reported performance when repeated images are available from the same biological specimen. We use the Hass Avocado Ripening dataset, comprising 8,834 image-RSL pairs from 426 fruits across three storage regimes, to evaluate a frozen ImageNet-pretrained visual backbone with a lightweight regression head. Our contributions are threefold: we quantify the effect of observation-level versus specimen-disjoint evaluation, compare lightweight and heavier visual backbones under specimen-disjoint cross-validation, and examine their spatial attributions using Grad-CAM. Across ten observation-level random splits, the model achieves a mean RMSE of 2.37 days with a standard deviation of 0.03 days, whereas specimen-disjoint 5-fold cross-validation yields a mean RMSE of 3.12 days with a standard deviation of 0.11 days. The corresponding mean coefficient of determination is 0.553. A matched per-specimen comparison confirms higher error under specimen-disjoint evaluation, with a probability value below 0.001 across 426 specimens, showing that observation-level partitioning gives a substantially more optimistic estimate for this dataset and model configuration. Under specimen-disjoint evaluation, MobileNetV3-Small (0.93 million parameters) achieves accuracy comparable to ResNet-18 while providing substantially higher throughput, and Grad-CAM reveals differences in spatial attribution between the lightweight backbones. These results support specimen-disjoint evaluation and attribution analysis when assessing lightweight vision models for longitudinal shelf-life prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用Hass牛油果成熟图像数据集，评估冻结ImageNet预训练视觉骨干加轻量回归头来预测剩余货架期，并比较观测级与按样本分离评估协议对性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 图像预测易腐品剩余货架期可提供低成本决策支持，但同一生物样本的重复图像会使评估协议显著影响报告性能，因此需要明确更合理的评估方式并考察轻量模型适用性。
AI.method: 使用8,834个图像-RSL对，来自426个牛油果和三种贮藏条件；采用冻结ImageNet预训练视觉骨干加轻量回归头；进行观测级随机划分与按样本分离5折交叉验证；比较轻量与较重视觉骨干，并用Grad-CAM分析空间归因。
AI.result: 观测级十次随机划分平均RMSE为2.37±0.03天；按样本分离5折平均RMSE为3.12±0.11天，平均R²为0.553；逐样本匹配比较显示样本分离评估误差显著更高（p<0.001，426个样本）。样本分离下MobileNetV3-Small（0.93M参数）精度与ResNet-18相当且吞吐更高，Grad-CAM显示轻量骨干的空间归因存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，评估轻量视觉模型用于纵向货架期预测时应采用按样本分离评估并进行归因分析；观测级划分会给出明显更乐观的性能估计。

title: SoccerNet-FoulRet: Retrieving Semantically Similar Soccer Foul Videos
summary: Refereeing decisions in professional soccer remain inconsistent because referees cannot easily compare a contentious foul against similar past cases. We cast this as a retrieval problem and introduce SoccerNet-FoulRet, the first benchmark for semantic foul retrieval. Given a query foul, the task is to retrieve past fouls judged to be relevant precedents, regardless of camera angle, teams, or appearance. This differs from prior video-to-video retrieval, which matches clips by visual similarity or a shared event. Here, relevance is defined by refereeing interpretation. We build the benchmark from the SoccerNet-MVFoul dataset and evaluate retrieval ability of zero-shot video and vision-language embedders together with a task-specific fine-tuned baseline on 693 human-verified queries and category-relevance labels. Semantic foul retrieval remains challenging. The strongest zero-shot model achieves under 5% HitRate@10 on human-verified precedents, while category-supervised fine-tuning improves category relevance but transfers only modestly to precedent retrieval. We release SoccerNet-FoulRet to establish semantic foul retrieval as an open problem: https://github.com/SoccerNet/sn-foulret.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个语义犯规检索基准 SoccerNet-FoulRet，将裁判判罚不一致问题转化为检索问题，并评估现有视频与视觉语言模型在检索过往相似犯规判例上的能力。
AI.motivation: 职业足球裁判判罚不一致，主要因为裁判难以将当前争议犯规与以往类似判例进行有效比较。
AI.method: 基于 SoccerNet-MVFoul 数据集构建基准，包含 693 个人工验证查询和类别相关性标签；将任务定义为给定查询犯规，检索被判定为相关先例的过往犯规，不受摄像机角度、球队或外观影响；评估零样本视频/视觉语言嵌入模型及任务特定微调基线。
AI.result: 语义犯规检索仍具挑战性。最强零样本模型在人工验证先例上的 HitRate@10 低于 5%；类别监督微调可提升类别相关性，但对先例检索的迁移效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 发布 SoccerNet-FoulRet，将语义犯规检索确立为一个开放问题，推动后续研究。

title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
summary: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Long-WAM——一个在实时控制约束下扩展因果世界-动作模型上下文的模型-系统框架。核心发现是：拥有历史不等于有效利用历史，只有在视频基础模型采用自回归预训练时，更长历史才带来显著收益。
AI.motivation: 实时机器人控制需要足够的视觉历史来推断运动与任务进度，但处理历史会延迟动作。现有方法面临历史利用效率与实时性之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 先在无动作标签的机器人与第一视角视频上学习因果预测（自回归预训练），再在世界-动作适配中保留历史到未来的结构。系统层面采用流式观测编码、异步执行和硬件特定加速，以在实时约束下部署。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa GR-1上，上下文从0.0秒增至19.2秒使成功率从63.3%升至78.7%，而双向预训练初始化无净增益；机器人域AR预训练进一步提升GR-1与LIBERO-Long峰值成功率。在LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0、DOMINO上均优于对比方法。RTX 5090上每个动作块（含未来视频潜变量预测）耗时107.4 ms，并可部署于RTX 5090、DGX Spark、Jetson AGX Thor。在Unitree G1与YAM上支持动态长时操作，动态叠杯成功率达95%，而Pi0.5与Fast-WAM在20次试验中均失败。作为记忆型执行器，Long-WAM还能与高层规划互补完成复合任务。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文的收益依赖于自回归预训练所建立的历史到未来结构；通过模型-系统协同设计，可在实时控制约束下实现长历史世界-动作控制，并提升动态与长时操作性能。

title: Flow-of-Thought: A Framework for Visual Reasoning
summary: Mental imagery, ``seeing with the mind's eye'' is an essential aspect of human cognition. Despite rapid progress Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) still underperform on tasks requiring spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce Flow-of-Thought (FoT), a framework that integrates the generation of visual sketches as intermediate reasoning steps, mimicking mental imagery in humans. We train coordinate-aware trajectory flow fields on $SO(2)$ group orbits and cumulative shortest paths, then freeze the learned dynamics; same vs. different decisions compare competing generative hypotheses using foreground-weighted reconstruction energy. On locked tests FoT reaches 100.0% accuracy on Tetris and 99.0% on colored shapes. Under frozen transfer, the orbit-trained 2D flow improves over its endpoint-only control on BLINK Multi-view (72.2% vs. 63.9% on 133 public validation pairs), supporting continuous visual traces as an effective and interpretable representation for spatial reasoning in some out-of-distribution settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Flow-of-Thought（FoT）框架，将视觉草图生成作为中间推理步骤，以模拟人类心理意象，从而提升需要空间理解的任务表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型和视觉Transformer进展迅速，但在需要空间理解的任务上仍表现不足，因此作者希望借鉴人类“心灵之眼”的心理意象能力来改进模型推理。
AI.method: FoT在SO(2)群轨道和累积最短路径上训练坐标感知的轨迹流场，并冻结学习到的动力学；在判断相同与不同时，通过前景加权重建能量比较相互竞争的生成假设。
AI.result: 在锁定测试上，FoT在Tetris上达到100.0%准确率，在彩色形状上达到99.0%；在冻结迁移设置下，基于轨道训练的2D流在BLINK Multi-view的133个公开验证对上达到72.2%，优于仅端点控制的63.9%。
AI.conclusion: 连续视觉轨迹可作为一种有效且可解释的空间推理表示，在某些分布外场景中具有优势。

title: UltraWorld: Learning Interactive Ultrasound World Models from Untracked Clinical Videos with Acoustic Sampling Map
summary: World models can enable autonomous ultrasound scanning by predicting the outcomes of probe motions from local observations. Learning this action--observation relationship typically relies on synchronized video--pose pairs, which are costly to collect at scale and largely unavailable in routine clinical recordings. Reliable action following further requires modeling ultrasound's cross-sectional sampling geometry. We present UltraWorld, a self-distillation recipe that transfers priors from clinical ultrasound videos into interactive world models without real action annotations. Starting from clinical videos, we adapt a video foundation model into an ultrasound generator conditioned on reference images and anatomical masks. Anatomical masks sampled along programmable trajectories through 3D anatomy provide spatial guidance for synthesizing action--video pairs. We then use these synthetic pairs to self-distill the generator into a world model that predicts future observations from local observations and actions, without requiring anatomical masks or other 3D assets at inference time. To further improve action following, we introduce the Acoustic Sampling Map (AsMap), which represents probe poses and imaging settings as pixel-wise 3D sampling positions, beam directions, and depths. Experiments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity and action following. Across nine simulated closed-loop local planning episodes, UltraWorld reduces the mean final distance to the goal and orientation error by 29\% and 38\%, respectively, compared with visual servoing. Project Page: https://ultraworld-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出UltraWorld，一种自蒸馏方法，无需真实动作标注即可将临床超声视频先验迁移为可交互世界模型，用于自主超声扫描。
AI.motivation: 学习超声探头动作-观察关系通常依赖大规模同步视频-姿态数据，临床中难以获取；同时可靠动作跟随需建模超声的截面采样几何。
AI.method: 从临床视频出发，将视频基础模型适配为以参考图像和解剖掩码为条件的超声生成器；沿可编程轨迹在3D解剖中采样掩码，合成动作-视频对；再用这些合成对自蒸馏生成器为世界模型，推理时无需掩码或3D资产；引入声学采样图（AsMap）以像素级3D采样位置、波束方向和深度表示探头姿态与成像设置。
AI.result: 实验显示预测保真度和动作跟随均有提升；在九个模拟闭环局部规划回合中，相比视觉伺服，UltraWorld将平均最终目标距离和方向误差分别降低29%和38%。
AI.conclusion: UltraWorld可无真实动作标注地从临床超声视频学习可交互世界模型，并有效提升自主超声扫描中的预测与动作跟随性能。

title: Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve their performance by reusing knowledge distilled from past interactions. However, curating new experiences into a knowledge bank that becomes more useful as it grows remains challenging. Effective knowledge accumulation should limit redundant overlap among entries and ensure that new knowledge contributes beyond what the bank already provides. Yet training a curator with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on standalone task success can reinforce general guidance even when it duplicates existing knowledge. Therefore, we propose Knowledge Weaver, a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation. Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge. Standalone success rewards also favor entries that are useful on their own. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Knowledge Weaver achieves mean success rates of 54.0\% and 42.0\% with k=10 retrieved entries, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Its knowledge banks also outperform the evaluated prompt-based and established banks, including human-written banks, in overall ALFWorld success rate and WebShop score with the executor frozen. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Knowledge Weaver，一个用强化学习训练语言模型从智能体轨迹中筛选可复用知识的框架，以提升 LLM 智能体的知识库积累效果与任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体可通过复用过去交互中蒸馏的知识提升性能，但如何将新经验整理为随增长而更有用的知识库仍具挑战：需限制条目冗余，并确保新知识带来超出已有知识库的贡献。现有用 GRPO 仅基于独立任务成功训练整理器，可能强化即使重复已有知识的一般性指导。
AI.method: Knowledge Weaver 将知识整理建模为强化学习问题，训练语言模型作为知识整理器。方法结合受 token 级互信息（MI）启发的反馈与边际成功奖励，并配合独立成功奖励，引导整理器保留经验中的独特信息，并生成在加入现有知识库后能提升任务成功的条目。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，使用 k=10 检索条目时，Knowledge Weaver 平均成功率分别达到 54.0% 和 42.0%，比 GRPO 分别高 16.9 和 18.7 个百分点。其知识库在执行器冻结时，在 ALFWorld 总体成功率和 WebShop 得分上优于所评估的基于提示的知识库及已有知识库，包括人工编写知识库。
AI.conclusion: 通过将互信息启发信号与边际成功奖励结合，Knowledge Weaver 能鼓励整理器保留独特信息并生成真正提升任务成功的知识条目，从而实现更有效的知识积累。

title: MeshCarve: Artisan Mesh Generation with Flow Matching in Compact Latent Spaces
summary: Prior artisan mesh generation works largely predict face tokens autoregressively, which makes inference slow. Recent methods instead flow match continuous latents built by Variational AutoEncoders (VAEs), but reconstruction quality drops significantly when geometry and topology are jointly encoded, and further when the latent space is compressed. We present MeshCarve, a flow matching method that generates entirely in compact latent spaces, generating vertex positions and edge connections separately and sidestepping the difficulty of a joint compact latent. To shorten the token sequence, we propose a hierarchical sparse transformer backbone, instantiated as VertexVAE and EdgeVAE. Instead of encoding fields over the surface voxels, both VAEs anchor on discrete vertices in their latent spaces, which drastically reduces the token sequence length, and our spatial-aware compression shortens it further without costing reconstruction. VertexVAE directly encodes vertex occupancy. For connectivity, we propose vertex-link encoding, which turns arbitrary connectivity between vertices into fixed-length continuous per-vertex embeddings and recovers complex artistic topology faithfully. MeshCarve combines these VAEs with an anchor generator and flow matches on the shortened token sequences. It shows advantages over state-of-the-art autoregressive and flow matching methods on Objaverse and generalizes to Toys4K. To the best of our knowledge, it is among the first artisan mesh generation methods whose every generative stage runs in a spatially compressed latent, with a token sequence only a fraction of the most compressed previous autoregressive and flow matching works.

AI.tldr: MeshCarve是一种在紧凑潜在空间中进行流匹配的工艺网格生成方法，分别生成顶点位置和边连接，避免联合紧凑潜在空间，并采用分层稀疏Transformer（VertexVAE和EdgeVAE）与顶点链接编码来大幅缩短token序列，在Objaverse上优于现有自回归和流匹配方法，并能泛化到Toys4K。
AI.motivation: 先前工艺网格生成工作主要自回归预测面token，导致推理缓慢；近期方法虽用流匹配VAE构建的连续潜在变量，但当几何与拓扑联合编码时重建质量显著下降，进一步压缩潜在空间时更差。因此需要一种能在紧凑潜在空间中生成、同时保持高重建质量并缩短token序列的方法。
AI.method: MeshCarve完全在紧凑潜在空间中进行流匹配生成，将顶点位置和边连接分开生成；提出分层稀疏Transformer骨干网络，实例化为VertexVAE和EdgeVAE。两个VAE均锚定在离散顶点而非表面体素上，大幅减少token序列长度，并通过空间感知压缩进一步缩短序列而不损失重建。VertexVAE直接编码顶点占用；对于连接性，提出顶点链接编码，将任意顶点间连接转换为固定长度的连续逐顶点嵌入，忠实恢复复杂艺术拓扑。最后将VAE与锚点生成器和流匹配结合，在缩短的token序列上进行生成。
AI.result: 在Objaverse上，MeshCarve相比最先进的自回归和流匹配方法展现出优势，并能泛化到Toys4K。它是首批每个生成阶段都在空间压缩潜在空间中运行的工艺网格生成方法之一，token序列长度仅为先前最压缩的自回归和流匹配工作的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: MeshCarve通过分离顶点位置与边连接的紧凑潜在生成、分层稀疏Transformer和顶点链接编码，实现了高效且高质量的工艺网格生成，克服了联合潜在空间压缩导致的重建质量下降问题，并在多个数据集上验证了有效性和泛化能力。

title: Loud Failures, Quiet Failures: Fault Detection and Recovery in Tool-Using Language Model Agents
summary: Tool-using agents are usually scored on whether they finish a task while the tools work. Deployments are less forgiving: services time out, endpoints disappear, parameter names change, and results come back well formed but wrong. Prior work has shown that language models over-trust tool outputs that fail silently; we ask how that over-trust plays out across the stages of failure handling in multi-turn agents. Wrapping the executable environments of an established function-calling benchmark in a fault-injection layer, we inject one of four typed faults at a controlled point in the trajectory and record whether the agent notices, changes plan, recovers the task, or repeats itself. Six models from three families, half of them reasoning variants, ran 1,920 trials over 24 multi-step tasks. Agents treat a failure as a problem in 91.3% of trials when the tool returns an explicit error, but in 58.8% of trials when it returns a plausible wrong value, against a 26.8% rate of reporting problems when nothing was wrong. Reasoning models are not better placed: paired against instruct siblings, they notice less (-9.3 points, p < .001) and change plan more (+10.4 points, p < .001), and recovery is unchanged (p = .512). Because agents are stochastic, two fault-free runs of the same task end in the same state only 63.3% of the time; against that baseline, only a missing tool clearly lowers recovery (39.9%), while timeouts, schema drift, and corruption stay within run-to-run variation. After a fault, agents return to the same tool three or more times in a row in up to 22.2% of trials, though strictly identical repeats are rare. A prompt line asking the agent to check each result did not move detection. Agents respond to the error channel rather than to the content of what a tool returns, so failures that stay inside the expected format pass through.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多轮工具调用智能体在工具故障下的处理能力，通过在函数调用基准环境中注入四类故障，评估六款模型（含推理变体）在1920次试验中的检测、改计划、恢复与重复行为。
AI.motivation: 现有评测通常假设工具始终可用，而实际部署中服务超时、端点消失、参数名变更、返回格式正确但内容错误等故障频发；已有研究表明语言模型会过度信任静默失败的工具输出，但尚不清楚这种过度信任在多轮智能体各故障处理阶段如何表现。
AI.method: 在既有函数调用基准的可执行环境外包裹故障注入层，在轨迹的受控位置注入四种类型故障之一；使用六个模型（来自三个家族，半数为推理变体），覆盖24个多步任务，共运行1920次试验；记录智能体是否察觉、改变计划、恢复任务或重复行为，并设置无故障基线对照。
AI.result: 工具返回显式错误时91.3%的试验被智能体视为问题，但返回看似合理的错误值时仅58.8%，而无故障时误报问题率为26.8%。推理模型并未更优：相比同族指令模型，察觉更少（-9.3个百分点，p<.001），改计划更多（+10.4个百分点，p<.001），恢复率无差异（p=.512）。智能体随机性导致同一任务两次无故障运行仅63.3%最终状态一致；以此基线衡量，仅“工具缺失”明显降低恢复率（39.9%），超时、模式漂移和损坏均在运行间波动范围内。故障后智能体最多在22.2%的试验中连续三次以上调用同一工具，但严格完全重复少见。要求智能体检查每次结果的提示语未能提升故障检测。
AI.conclusion: 智能体主要对工具返回的“错误通道”作出反应，而非对返回内容本身进行判断，因此那些符合预期格式的故障（如静默错误值）会被轻易放过。现有智能体在故障检测与恢复上存在系统性盲区，推理能力并未带来改善。

title: What the Sleeve Feels: Explainable Machine Learning for Textile Pressure-Based Postural Screening
summary: Pressure-sensing smart textiles convert body-surface contact into a dense, image-like signal closely tied to posture and movement, making them a promising low-cost route to wearable posture screening. Realizing that promise, however, requires more than classification accuracy: a deployable system must generalize to wearers unseen during training, expose the physical evidence behind its decisions, and tolerate the small donning offsets that occur whenever a garment is removed and re-worn. This paper addresses these three requirements jointly using a knitted piezoresistive sleeve worn on the forearm as a testbed. We regroup fine-grained everyday activities into three coarser screening categories (neutral, potentially undesirable, and functional or transitional), engineer 29 interpretable pressure-distribution features spanning global intensity, spatial center of pressure, quadrant asymmetry, distribution complexity, and short-horizon temporal change, and evaluate under a strict subject-wise split. A tuned XGBoost classifier reaches 0.818 accuracy, 0.788 balanced accuracy, and 0.801 macro F1 on unseen test subjects, with tight frame-level bootstrap 95% intervals of about plus-minus 0.01 and a subject-to-subject standard deviation near 0.06 under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation. A simple 2D-CNN baseline trained on raw frames achieves broadly similar performance, showing that hand-engineered features are not left behind by a learned spatial representation on this task. SHAP-based explanation, a feature-group ablation, per-activity error analysis inside the pooled undesirable class, class-mapping sensitivity, and a simulated donning-rotation stress test together locate what the model relies on, where it degrades, and why, directly targeting the generalization, interpretability, and robustness gaps that determine whether such a system is deployable.

AI.tldr: 本文以针织压阻前臂袖套为压力传感智能纺织品测试平台，将细粒度日常活动归并为三类筛查类别，构建29个可解释压力分布特征，并在严格按受试者划分下评估。XGBoost在未见受试者上达到0.818准确率、0.788平衡准确率和0.801宏F1，同时通过SHAP、消融、误差分析和穿戴旋转压力测试考察泛化性、可解释性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 压力传感智能纺织品有望低成本用于可穿戴姿态筛查，但可部署系统不能只看分类准确率，还必须泛化到训练中未见过的穿戴者、解释决策背后的物理证据，并容忍衣物脱下再穿时产生的穿戴偏移。
AI.method: 使用前臂针织压阻袖套；将细粒度日常活动重组为中性、潜在不良、功能性或过渡性三类；设计29个可解释压力分布特征，涵盖全局强度、空间压力中心、象限不对称、分布复杂度和短时变化；采用严格subject-wise划分；使用调优XGBoost分类器，并与原始帧训练的2D-CNN基线比较；通过SHAP解释、特征组消融、不良类内逐活动误差分析、类别映射敏感性以及模拟穿戴旋转压力测试进行分析。
AI.result: XGBoost在未见测试受试者上达到0.818准确率、0.788平衡准确率和0.801宏F1，帧级bootstrap 95%区间约为±0.01，留一受试者交叉验证的受试者间标准差约为0.06。简单2D-CNN基线表现大致相近，说明手工特征在该任务上未被学习到的空间表示明显超越。SHAP、消融、误差分析和穿戴旋转测试定位了模型依赖的信息、性能下降场景及原因。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，在此任务上手工可解释特征可与2D-CNN相当，并且所提出的评估与分析方法直接针对泛化、可解释性和鲁棒性这些决定系统能否部署的关键缺口；该系统在未见受试者和模拟穿戴偏移下展现出潜力，但仍需进一步验证其实际可部署性。

title: RoboPrompt: Intuitive Robot Policy Steering with Sparse Human Input
summary: End-to-end robot policies trained through imitation learning remain constrained by limited data diversity, making reliable zero-shot deployment in real-world settings challenging. Shared-autonomy methods enable human correction through teleoperation, but specialized hardware and operator training hinder deployment at scale. Other approaches incorporate human guidance as additional policy inputs, often requiring architectural changes and dedicated training for steerability, which limits their applicability across policies. We present RoboPrompt, a general-purpose, lightweight robot policy steering system that enables users to guide policy behavior through intuitive, sparse inputs, including drawn traces, target points, and coarse directional instructions. RoboPrompt decouples human-intention translation from the underlying policy: a reusable module converts human guidance into action drafts, which are refined through the diffusion or flow-matching dynamics of the base policy. By controlling action generation in noise space, RoboPrompt balances human intent with the policy prior without modifying the base policy architecture or fine-tuning it for steerability. Experiments demonstrate effective steering across Diffusion Policy, $π_{0.5}$, and FastWAM. We further use steered rollouts for online policy improvement through DAgger. After 2-3 rounds of iteration, average success rates increase by 15.5\% for $π_{0.5}$ across three tasks and by 21.3\% across three policies(Diffusion Policy, $π_{0.5}$, FastWAM) on the Insert Bread task, while average human intervention counts decrease by 44.0\% (2.86 to 1.60) and 81.9\% (2.60 to 0.47), respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoboPrompt，一种通用轻量机器人策略引导系统，通过稀疏人类输入（轨迹、目标点、方向指令）控制基础策略行为，无需修改策略架构或微调，并可结合 DAgger 实现在线策略改进。
AI.motivation: 端到端模仿学习策略受限于数据多样性，零样本真实部署困难；现有共享自治方法依赖专用硬件和操作培训，其他人类引导方法常需改变架构并专门训练可操控性，难以通用。
AI.method: RoboPrompt 将人类意图翻译与底层策略解耦：可复用模块把人类引导转换为动作草案，再利用基础策略的扩散或流匹配动力学在噪声空间精炼动作生成，从而平衡人类意图与策略先验，无需修改基础策略架构或微调。
AI.result: 在 Diffusion Policy、π0.5 和 FastWAM 上验证有效引导；通过 DAgger 进行在线策略改进，2-3 轮迭代后，π0.5 在三个任务上平均成功率提升 15.5%，三种策略在 Insert Bread 任务上平均成功率提升 21.3%；平均人工干预次数分别从 2.86 降至 1.60（减少 44.0%）和从 2.60 降至 0.47（减少 81.9%）。
AI.conclusion: RoboPrompt 是一种通用、轻量的策略引导方法，能在不改变基础策略的情况下有效融合人类稀疏引导，提升任务成功率并显著减少人工干预，支持跨策略应用和在线改进。

title: Relational Abstractions for Spatial Reasoning with Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models excel at image synthesis, but they remain limited in their ability to reliably satisfy structured spatial reasoning constraints. In conditional data distribution modeling tasks with implicit logical structure, such as puzzles defined by visible clues paired with consistent solutions, state-of-the-art generative models tend to approximate pixel-space distributions without learning the underlying logical rules required for inference. To address this limitation, we present a novel framework for spatial reasoning with diffusion models that leverages unsupervised object discovery and abstractions of object relations. We show that the relational knowledge derived from object-centric representations enriches diffusion models with structural primitives, allowing them to effectively guide the generative representation space during both training and inference, and enabling conditional image generation that satisfies reasoning constraints. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale generative spatial reasoning benchmark with four datasets inspired by human-solvable puzzles. Our results show that relational abstractions significantly improve reasoning capabilities of diffusion models on a variety of complex reasoning tasks, while enabling robust generalization in out-of-distribution settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用无监督物体发现与物体关系抽象的扩散模型空间推理框架，并构建大规模生成式空间推理基准，以提升扩散模型在结构化空间约束下的条件生成与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在图像合成上表现优异，但在需要满足结构化空间推理约束的任务中仍不可靠；现有生成模型常只近似像素空间分布，未能学习隐含逻辑规则，难以处理类似谜题的条件生成任务。
AI.method: 提出面向扩散模型的空间推理框架，利用无监督物体发现获得物体中心表示，并抽象物体间关系；将这些关系知识作为结构原语注入扩散模型，在训练和推理阶段引导生成表示空间，从而实现满足推理约束的条件图像生成。同时构建包含四个数据集的生成式空间推理基准。
AI.result: 关系抽象显著提升了扩散模型在多种复杂推理任务上的推理能力，并在分布外设置下实现稳健泛化。
AI.conclusion: 从物体中心表示中提取的关系知识能够为扩散模型提供结构原语，有效增强其满足空间推理约束的条件生成能力，并为生成式空间推理提供新的基准与方向。

title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出VPP2，一种世界动作模型，通过大规模操作视频预训练、视频模型蒸馏为单步视觉规划器以及混合Transformer架构的动作模块，实现了视频预测与动作生成的强零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型在开放环境中常产生错误的动作预测，导致错误动作。原因有二：基础视频模型未针对操作任务优化；简单地将动作组件融入视频模型会严重损害其泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模多样化操作视频数据集，用详细描述标注并进行事件级视频预训练，以增强开放操作任务的泛化；2) 对视频模型进行后训练并蒸馏为固定预测视界的单步视觉规划器；3) 通过混合Transformer（MoT）架构引入动作模块，学习隐式逆动力学模型。
AI.result: 1) VPP2-14B在开放任务视频预测指令遵循成功率上比Cosmos3-64B高11.0个百分点；2) 在真实世界零样本ALOHA操作任务上，成功率比最强基线高18.5个百分点；3) 经基准特定后训练后，在LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-OOD和RoboDojo基准上取得最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: VPP2在视频预测和动作生成两方面均实现了强零样本泛化能力。

title: HGP:An on-device personalized agent memory via hybrid graph storage
summary: LLM-based agents face challenges in personalized interactive tasks due to heterogeneous, multi-typed, and implicitly constrained long-term traces. Existing memory mechanisms struggle with accurate routing and retrieval, especially on-device where personalization is critical. Most methods use single-vector representations, blurring type distinctions and relational structure. We propose HGP, a hybrid graph memory framework. HGP employs a lightweight self-enhancement classifier for personalized memory routing and constructs episodic, semantic, and procedural memories as graphs. It also extracts working memory as a state trajectory to capture current state and implicit constraints, ensuring reliable decision-making. The classifier reduces large-model calls, enabling on-device deployment, while graph storage enables accurate retrieval and incremental user profile refinement. Experiments on two benchmarks show that on PAL-Set solution selection, HGP achieves an S-score of 35.58, nearly 7 points above the strongest baseline. Code and data are at https://github.com/Ouan6/HGP-.git.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM智能体在个性化交互中面临长期记忆异构、多类型和隐式约束的挑战，本文提出混合图记忆框架HGP，通过图结构组织情节、语义和程序记忆，并提取工作记忆状态轨迹，实现准确检索与设备端部署。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆机制多使用单向量表示，模糊了记忆类型区分和关系结构，难以在设备端进行准确的记忆路由和检索，而个性化交互任务对此要求很高。
AI.method: HGP包含轻量级自增强分类器用于个性化记忆路由，将情节、语义和程序记忆构建为图，并提取工作记忆为状态轨迹以捕获当前状态和隐式约束；分类器减少大模型调用，图存储支持准确检索和增量用户画像更新。
AI.result: 在两个基准上实验，在PAL-Set解决方案选择任务中，HGP取得35.58的S-score，比最强基线高出近7分。
AI.conclusion: HGP通过混合图记忆和轻量级路由分类器，有效提升个性化交互中的记忆检索与决策性能，并支持设备端部署。

title: CIRSeg: Coarse-to-Fine Intensity-Robust Liver Segmentation with Source-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the CARE 2026 Workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable liver segmentation in contrast-enhanced MRI is essential for quantitative hepatic assessment, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. However, limited annotated data and scanner- or vendor-dependent intensity variations can cause overfitting and poor generalization to unseen acquisition domains. Moreover, simultaneously achieving robust global localization and precise boundary delineation remains challenging, while predictions may contain isolated false-positive regions outside the main liver component. To address these challenges, we propose CIRSeg, a coarse-to-fine, intensity-robust liver segmentation framework based on nnU-Netv2. CIRSeg combines 3D CutMix with stochastic intensity transfer using either Nyul augmentation or histogram matching to improve robustness to heterogeneous MRI intensities. Its cascaded architecture decouples low-resolution anatomical localization from full-resolution boundary refinement. At inference, source-free test-time adaptation based on confidence-filtered predictions and probability-prior regularization further improves robustness to out-of-distribution inputs. As a final deterministic post-processing step, largest connected component filtering removes isolated false-positive regions. On the CARE 2026 test set, CIRSeg achieves Dice scores of 97.13\% and 97.93\% on the in-domain and unseen-domain subsets, with corresponding HD95 values of 20.18 mm and 11.30 mm, respectively. These results demonstrate consistently accurate segmentation across both in-domain and unseen acquisition settings. The code is available at https://github.com/jingkunchen/MICCAI_CARE_2026

AI.tldr: 提出CIRSeg，一种基于nnU-Netv2的由粗到细、强度鲁棒的肝脏MRI分割框架，结合3D CutMix、随机强度迁移、级联分割、测试时自适应和最大连通域后处理，在CARE 2026上取得高精度分割。
AI.motivation: 对比增强MRI肝脏分割对定量评估、治疗规划和纵向监测很重要，但标注数据有限、扫描仪/厂商导致的强度差异易造成过拟合和跨域泛化差；同时全局定位与边界精细分割难以兼顾，预测中常出现孤立假阳性区域。
AI.method: 在nnU-Netv2基础上构建CIRSeg：使用3D CutMix并结合Nyul增强或直方图匹配进行随机强度迁移；采用级联架构，将低分辨率解剖定位与全分辨率边界细化解耦；推理时使用基于置信度过滤预测和概率先验正则化的无源测试时自适应；最后用最大连通域滤波去除孤立假阳性。
AI.result: 在CARE 2026测试集上，CIRSeg在同域子集Dice为97.13%、HD95为20.18 mm；在未见域子集Dice为97.93%、HD95为11.30 mm。
AI.conclusion: CIRSeg在同域和未见采集设置下均能实现一致且准确的肝脏分割，表明其对MRI强度差异和域偏移具有较强鲁棒性。代码已开源。

title: Diffusion-Generated Image Watermarking: A Two-Axis Taxonomy and Three Protocol-Bounded Case Studies
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the non-archival track of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Workshop. English translation with partial reorganization of our article in Journal of Broadcast Engineering 31(4), 687-699 (2026)
summary: Watermarking diffusion-generated images requires balancing provenance signals with image quality, robustness, and computational cost. This work organizes methods along two axes: insertion mechanism and primary signal-bearing representation, and formalizes a representative $z_T$-Fourier pipeline for verification and identification. We then use the taxonomy to structure three protocol-bounded case studies. The first examines associations among frequency integrity, detection, quality, and cropping behavior. The second revisits persistence under seed-linked and seed-independent editing and formulates a scoped Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis without claiming a localized carrier or causal mechanism. The third studies single-shot VAE-latent phase modulation, including its efficiency, regeneration robustness, and robustness--quality operating points. Finally, we separate four content-level attack families from model/pipeline adaptation, propose corresponding evaluation protocols and testable conjectures for parameter-tuning threats, and identify additional temporal extensions for video. These analyses do not establish a universal ranking; instead, they provide a framework for matched, protocol-aware comparisons of watermarking systems for diffusion-generated images.

AI.tldr: 该工作针对扩散生成图像水印，提出按插入机制与主要信号承载表示分类的框架，并形式化一个代表性的 z_T-Fourier 验证/识别流程；通过三个受协议约束的案例研究及攻击与评估讨论，旨在支持公平、协议感知的水印系统比较。
AI.motivation: 扩散生成图像水印需在来源溯源信号与图像质量、鲁棒性、计算成本之间取得平衡；现有方法缺乏统一、可匹配比较的组织框架和评估协议。
AI.method: 沿插入机制和主要信号承载表示两个维度组织方法；形式化 z_T-Fourier 管道用于验证与识别；用该分类构建三个案例研究：频率完整性/检测/质量/裁剪行为、种子相关与独立编辑下的持久性及语义印记假说、单次 VAE 隐空间相位调制的效率/再生鲁棒性/鲁棒性-质量折中；并区分四类内容级攻击与模型/管道适配，提出评估协议和可检验猜想，讨论视频时序扩展。
AI.result: 案例研究揭示了频率完整性、检测、质量与裁剪行为之间的关联；在 seed-linked 和 seed-independent 编辑下考察持久性并提出有边界的 Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis；评估了 VAE 隐空间相位调制的效率、再生鲁棒性及鲁棒性-质量操作点；给出了针对参数调优威胁的评估协议与可检验猜想。
AI.conclusion: 该分析不建立普适排名，而提供一个匹配且协议感知的框架，用于比较扩散生成图像水印系统，并指出内容级攻击、模型/管道适配及视频时序扩展等方向。

title: Counterfactual Route Optimization for Gaussian Head Avatar Modeling
summary: Head avatar modeling requires jointly optimizing multiple objectives with different dominant effects on geometry, appearance, and cross-view consistency. However, their relative effectiveness varies across training states, while existing pipelines typically rely on fixed loss weights or handcrafted stage-wise schedules. A central challenge is therefore to identify which optimization direction is more beneficial at each training state. We propose a counterfactual route optimization framework for Gaussian head avatar modeling, which characterizes state-dependent optimization preference from the realized effects of alternative updates rather than predefined heuristic weighting. Starting from the same training state, we perform short-horizon route-restricted lookahead over geometry, appearance, and joint update routes and evaluate their outcomes under a unified utility. The resulting counterfactual evidence is factorized into a geometry--appearance preference and a residual joint advantage, separately capturing the relative preference between individual update directions and the additional benefit of coordinated optimization. We further amortize this offline evidence into a lightweight controller that directly estimates the current optimization preference and applies bounded modulation to the training objectives during full avatar optimization. Experiments on the NeRSemble dataset validate the effectiveness of the proposed design, consistently outperforming existing methods while preserving clearer local facial structures and finer details.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于高斯头部化身建模的反事实路径优化框架，通过短时前瞻评估几何、外观与联合更新路径的收益，学习随训练状态变化的优化偏好，并用轻量控制器动态调节训练目标。
AI.motivation: 头部头像建模需同时优化几何、外观和跨视角一致性等多个目标，但其相对有效性随训练状态变化；现有方法多依赖固定损失权重或手工分阶段调度，难以判断每个训练阶段哪个优化方向更有益。
AI.method: 从同一训练状态出发，对几何、外观和联合更新路径进行短时、路径受限的前瞻，并用统一效用评估结果；将反事实证据分解为几何—外观偏好和残差联合优势；再将该离线证据摊销为轻量控制器，在完整化身优化中直接估计当前优化偏好，并对训练目标进行有界调制。
AI.result: 在NeRSemble数据集上验证了所提设计的有效性，一致优于现有方法，并能保留更清晰的局部面部结构和更精细的细节。
AI.conclusion: 基于反事实证据的状态依赖优化偏好可替代固定权重或启发式调度，从而更有效地优化高斯头部化身建模中的多目标训练。

title: RewardWeaver: Long-Horizon Interactive Learning for Language Agents via Self-Evolving Reward Adaptation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in domains where task outcomes can be reliably evaluated, but long-horizon interaction remains challenging due to sparse terminal feedback and difficult credit assignment. Process rewards provide denser supervision, yet the capabilities most relevant for training can change as the policy evolves: a behavior that is easy to evaluate or frequently deficient need not be the bottleneck currently limiting task success. We introduce RewardWeaver, a self-evolving reward adaptation framework for language agents in long-horizon interaction. RewardWeaver maintains a validated capability space in which the semantics of admitted Rubrics remain fixed, and closes the loop between policy optimization, task evaluation, failure attribution, and reward adaptation. After each training stage, it performs outcome-grounded backward attribution on low-outcome trajectories, aggregates recurrent and policy-controlled capability bottlenecks, and dynamically selects the corresponding process rewards for the next stage. Recurrent failures not covered by the existing capability space trigger a separate, controlled expansion procedure. We evaluate REWARDWEAVER on SOTOPIA, Amazon?HistoryPrice, and a newly constructed Sales Benchmark. Across social interaction, bilateral bargaining, and domain-specific sales, REWARDWEAVER establishes new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results. Ablations further demonstrate the importance of dynamic reward allocation, failure-grounded attribution, and stable semantics for admitted capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出 RewardWeaver，一种面向长时程语言智能体的自演化奖励适配框架。它通过失败归因动态选择过程奖励，并在多个交互与领域任务上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: RLVR 在结果可验证任务中进展显著，但长时程交互仍受稀疏终端反馈和信用分配困难限制。过程奖励虽更密集，但最相关能力会随策略演化而变化，固定或易评估的奖励未必针对当前瓶颈。
AI.method: RewardWeaver 维护一个已验证的能力空间，其中已接纳 Rubric 的语义保持固定，并闭环连接策略优化、任务评估、失败归因与奖励适配。每阶段后，对低结果轨迹进行基于结果的反向归因，聚合反复出现且受策略控制的能力瓶颈，动态选择下一阶段过程奖励；对现有能力空间未覆盖的反复失败，则触发受控扩展。
AI.result: 在 SOTOPIA、Amazon HistoryPrice 和新建 Sales Benchmark 上，RewardWeaver 在社交交互、双边议价和领域销售任务中均取得新的 SOTA。消融实验表明，动态奖励分配、失败驱动归因以及已接纳能力语义稳定都很重要。
AI.conclusion: RewardWeaver 能通过自演化过程奖励适配缓解长时程交互中的稀疏反馈与信用分配问题，并验证了动态奖励分配和稳定能力语义对语言智能体训练的重要性。

title: Rubix: Global Correspondence-Free Point Set Alignment through Assignment Geometry
comment: 67 pages, 20 figures. Includes full proofs and experimental appendices
summary: Procrustes-Wasserstein alignment jointly estimates a matching and rotation without supplied correspondences, but alternating minimization can stop at suboptimal solutions. Rubix solves the equally weighted planar problem globally under squared Euclidean loss. Each matching $σ$ of two centered $n$-point sets defines a complex correlation $z_σ=\sum_i\bar x_i y_{σ(i)}$. Their convex hull is the permutation polygon: supporting vertices give optimal matchings at fixed rotations, and the farthest vertex gives the global alignment. We prove the sharp bound of $n(n-1)$ vertices for $n\ge2$, answering Rote's rotation-assignment open problem. In exact arithmetic, assignment queries recover the polygon in $\mathcal O(n^5)$ operations. Assignment-based bounds extend the approach to three-dimensional rotations and partial matching at a supplied translation through branch-and-bound. On timed MPEG-7 shape pairs, Rubix attains every numerical reference value in 12 ms on average, 50 times faster than a rotation grid at the same accuracy. Its distances improve gravity-aligned matching of real 3D scans, shape retrieval and noisy crystal classification over alternating minimization.

AI.tldr: Rubix 提出一种全局求解等权平面 Procrustes-Wasserstein 对齐的方法，通过将匹配对应的复相关值构成置换多边形，并利用其最远顶点获得全局最优旋转与匹配。
AI.motivation: Procrustes-Wasserstein 对齐常用交替最小化，但容易陷入次优解；同时 Rote 的旋转分配开放问题需要解决，因此需要精确且高效的全局对齐方法。
AI.method: 将两个中心化点集的匹配映射为复相关 zσ，构造其凸包即置换多边形；支撑顶点对应固定旋转下的最优匹配，最远顶点对应全局对齐。使用赋值查询恢复多边形，并证明顶点数上界；进一步用基于赋值的界和分支定界扩展到三维旋转及给定平移下的部分匹配。
AI.result: 证明置换多边形顶点数的紧界为 n(n-1)（n≥2），回答了 Rote 的开放问题；精确算术下可在 O(n^5) 次操作内恢复多边形。在 MPEG-7 形状对上平均 12 ms 达到所有数值参考值，比同精度旋转网格快 50 倍；在真实 3D 扫描重力对齐匹配、形状检索和噪声晶体分类上优于交替最小化。
AI.conclusion: Rubix 为平面等权 Procrustes-Wasserstein 对齐提供了全局最优且高效的解法，并可推广到三维旋转与部分匹配，在精度和速度上均优于现有交替最小化方法。

title: ECHO: Embodied Camera Observations of Human Object Carrying
summary: Embodied and assistive agents must do more than recognize objects: they must reason about where an object belongs given the layout of an environment and the habits of the people who live in it. Progress on this problem has been limited, in part because no dedicated benchmark or dataset exists to define and evaluate it. Existing RGB-D scan datasets reconstruct static rooms without human activity, while human-object-interaction datasets capture motion without a navigable, fully reconstructed scene or a ground-truth notion of an object's natural destination. We introduce contextual object placement as a benchmark task: predicting an object's destination during an observed object-carrying episode. To support this task, we present Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying (ECHO), a large-scale synthetic dataset that pairs dense RGB-D scans of indoor scenes with recordings of an embodied human carrying everyday objects to context-appropriate destinations. ECHO is the first publicly available dataset to combine reconstructed scenes, human activity, natural language, and contextual-placement annotations. It comprises 3,805 human-annotated episodes across 159 floors of 115 HM3D scenes, involving 198 distinct objects. Each floor includes a complete RGB-D scan with human-annotated room labels and a surface list. Each episode provides synchronized RGB-D encounter clips; 6-DoF camera, human, and object trajectories; start and destination surfaces; an action caption; and a human-written context: a single sentence describing the inhabitant's routine that implies the destination without naming it. We evaluate contextual object placement using input-masked probes and an end-to-end baseline. Results show that no single input modality is sufficient, highlighting the need to jointly reason over scene structure, human activity, and contextual knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“情境化物体放置”基准任务，并发布ECHO大规模合成数据集，用于预测人类搬运物体时的目的地。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-D扫描数据集仅重建静态房间，人-物交互数据集又缺少可导航的完整场景和物体自然目的地的真值，因此缺少专门基准来定义和评估该问题。
AI.method: 提出情境化物体放置任务；构建ECHO数据集，包含115个HM3D场景、159层楼、3805个人工标注片段和198类物体，提供RGB-D扫描、6DoF轨迹、起止表面、动作描述及隐含目的地的情境句子；采用输入掩码探测和端到端基线进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明没有任何单一输入模态足够，需要联合推理场景结构、人类活动和情境知识。
AI.conclusion: 情境化物体放置需多模态联合推理；ECHO是首个结合重建场景、人类活动、自然语言和情境放置标注的公开数据集。

title: UniSkill: Learning Actor-Aligned Skill Proposals for an Evolving Policy
summary: Large language model agents can improve across tasks by retaining reusable skills distilled from prior interactions. Recent work jointly optimizes task execution and skill extraction, enabling the policy and skillbank to co-evolve. However, as the actor continues learning, rewarding skill proposals through their reuse in subsequent training steps may conflate skill benefits with actor improvement, while directly testing each proposed skill requires costly additional actor rollouts. In this paper, we introduce UniSkill, which uses a shared policy to interact with the environment and propose skillbank edits (Add, Update, or No Edit) from the resulting trajectories. Specifically, the actor learns from environment rewards, while contrastive action feedback guides skill proposal learning. This feedback provides an actor-alignment signal by measuring how replacing the retrieved skill with a proposed skill changes the current actor's action log-likelihood gap between previously collected successful and failed trajectories from the same task, thereby avoiding new rollouts for each proposal. Since proposal-level feedback may suppress an otherwise appropriate edit operation when the proposed skill content scores poorly, we further apply skill-edit support regularization to preserve exploration. Empirically, UniSkill achieves strong performance, reaching 98.4% success on ALFWorld and 84.7% on WebShop while maintaining stable joint training. Further ALFWorld experiments show that UniSkill remains effective when the shared policy uses a smaller backbone. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/LimOkii/UniSKill.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniSkill，让共享策略在执行任务时提出技能库编辑（添加、更新、不编辑），并通过对比动作反馈指导技能提议学习，避免额外 rollout，在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上取得高性能。
AI.motivation: 现有联合优化任务执行与技能提取的方法中，随着 actor 持续学习，通过后续训练复用奖励技能提议会混淆技能收益与 actor 改进，而直接测试每个提议技能需要昂贵的额外 actor rollout。
AI.method: 共享策略与环境交互，从轨迹中提出技能库编辑（Add/Update/No Edit）。Actor 从环境奖励学习；对比动作反馈通过测量用提议技能替换检索技能后，当前 actor 在先前收集的同一任务成功与失败轨迹上的动作对数似然差的变化，提供 actor 对齐信号，避免为每个提议做新 rollout。并应用技能编辑支持正则化以保持探索。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 上达到 98.4% 成功率，WebShop 上 84.7%，联合训练稳定。ALFWorld 实验显示共享策略使用更小骨干网络时仍有效。
AI.conclusion: UniSkill 能有效实现任务执行与技能库的共同进化，避免额外 rollout 成本，并在多个任务和较小模型上保持性能。

title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RoboJEPA，一个基于 JEPA 的机器人世界模型，在涵盖 12 种机器人本体的大规模真实机器人数据上训练，并首次系统研究了多本体机器人世界模型的缩放规律。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型在预测未来状态和规划方面表现优异，但缺乏原则性方法估计其能力如何随模型规模、数据和计算量扩展，这阻碍了领域进展。
AI.method: 提出 RoboJEPA，基于联合嵌入预测架构 JEPA 构建世界模型；使用覆盖 12 种机器人本体的大规模数据集训练；分析想象误差随计算量的缩放规律，并评估下游机器人规划性能与想象误差的关系，同时在真实硬件上进行零样本部署和长时程规划。
AI.result: RoboJEPA 的想象误差随计算量呈二阶幂律，可外推预测模型质量；下游规划性能随计算量可预测提升，且想象误差与其强相关，可作为真实机器人评估的可靠代理指标；模型能以单张目标图像零样本部署为机器人智能体，在真实硬件上完成长时程规划任务；8B 参数的 RoboJEPA 是迄今最大的 JEPA 预测器模型，并开源了检查点、训练和部署代码。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个在真实机器人数据上为多本体机器人世界模型建立缩放规律的工作，表明潜在世界模型的能力可随计算量预测扩展，并能零样本用于真实机器人规划。

title: Beyond Masks and Trajectories: Flow-Guided Latent Action Injection for Stable Surgical Video Generation
summary: Surgical video generation holds substantial potential for surgical education, simulation, and data augmentation, yet generating surgical videos with realistic and clinically plausible motion remains challenging. Most existing methods rely on auxiliary conditions, such as masks, trajectories, depth, or reference videos, to achieve visually plausible synthesis. Yet, these auxiliary conditions typically require additional manual annotation or specialized acquisition, making it difficult to scale such methods beyond small, curated datasets. This motivates the need for a reference-free architecture capable of generating high-quality surgical video without requiring auxiliary visual conditions at inference time. We propose FLAIR, a Flow-guided LatentAction Injection framework for Reference-free surgical video generation. FLAIR learns action priors from optical flow of real surgical videos, dynamically predicts corresponding latent action representation from an input prompt, and injects it into a frozen base model to generate surgical videos with improved action consistency. We further construct SurgActionClip-30K, the first large-scale surgical vision dataset comprising action-centric segmented clips and structured caption labels, addressing the persistent lack of fine-grained, action-centric surgical datasets. Lastly, we introduce SurgMetrics, the first surgical domain-specific evaluation metrics for quantifying the quality of generated surgical videos, addressing the persistent absence of clinically grounded evaluation standards in this domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLAIR enables generating high-quality surgical videos using text-only inference without auxiliary conditions, and validation in SurgMetrics demonstrates its strength in alignment with human perception compared to traditional metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FLAIR框架，一种基于流动引导的潜在动作注入方法，用于无参考的手术视频生成。同时构建了首个大规模手术视觉数据集SurgActionClip-30K，并提出了首个手术领域专用评估指标SurgMetrics。
AI.motivation: 手术视频生成对教育、模拟和数据增强有巨大潜力，但现有方法依赖辅助条件（如掩码、轨迹、深度或参考视频），这些条件需要额外人工标注或专业采集，难以扩展。因此需要一种无需辅助视觉条件的无参考架构，在推理时仅凭文本即可生成高质量手术视频。
AI.method: 提出FLAIR框架：从真实手术视频的光流中学习动作先验，根据输入提示动态预测相应的潜在动作表示，并将其注入冻结的基础模型中以生成动作一致性更好的手术视频。构建SurgActionClip-30K数据集，包含以动作为中心的分割片段和结构化字幕标签。引入SurgMetrics，首个手术领域专用评估指标，用于量化生成手术视频的质量。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FLAIR能够在仅使用文本推理、无需辅助条件的情况下生成高质量手术视频。在SurgMetrics上的验证显示，其与人类感知的一致性优于传统指标。
AI.conclusion: FLAIR实现了无参考、仅文本驱动的手术视频生成，并通过新数据集和评估指标推动了该领域的发展，解决了数据稀缺和评估标准缺失的问题。

title: Agentic AI-Assisted Modeling for Production Scheduling: Assessment in Constraint Programming
summary: Developing optimization models for production scheduling requires substantial expert effort.
