Research on large language models (LLMs) has followed two directions: specialized approaches for automated modeling, mostly for mixed-integer linear programming, which often rely on dedicated training or problem-specific architectures that limit industrial deployment; and agentic artificial intelligence for operational decision support, which generally assumes that the optimization model already exists. This study bridges both directions by assessing whether general-purpose LLMs, orchestrated as agents without task-specific training, can formulate and implement constraint programming models from natural-language problem descriptions. Singleagent and multi-agent architectures are integrated with a Model Context Protocol server that provides context-aware retrieval of solver documentation to mitigate hallucinations during implementation. Both are compared with a direct LLM baseline on six industry-oriented problems covering flow-shop, job-shop, flexible job-shop and resource-constrained warehouse scheduling, using three LLMs and assessing modeling accuracy, execution success, latency and token consumption. Formulation proves largely within reach of current LLMs, whereas implementation is the main barrier. The multi-agent workflow raises the share of scripts that run correctly as generated from 14.8% with a direct LLM call to 59.3%, reaching 80.6% on the four less complex problems, while tightly coupled intralogistics models remain an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估通用大语言模型作为智能体，在无任务特定训练下，能否从自然语言问题描述中构建并实现约束编程模型。通过单智能体和多智能体架构结合模型上下文协议服务器，并与直接LLM基线对比，发现建模基本可行，但实现是主要障碍，多智能体工作流显著提升了脚本正确运行率。
AI.motivation: 开发生产调度优化模型需要大量专家努力。现有LLM研究有两个方向：针对自动建模的专用方法（多用于混合整数线性规划），常依赖专用训练或问题特定架构，限制工业部署；以及面向运营决策支持的智能体AI，通常假设优化模型已存在。本研究旨在弥合这两个方向，评估通用LLM作为智能体能否从自然语言描述中构建并实现约束编程模型。
AI.method: 将单智能体和多智能体架构与模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器集成，提供上下文感知的求解器文档检索以减少实现中的幻觉。与直接LLM调用基线对比，在六个面向工业的问题（流水车间、作业车间、柔性作业车间、资源受限仓库调度）上，使用三种LLM，评估建模准确性、执行成功率、延迟和令牌消耗。
AI.result: 建模基本在当前LLM能力范围内，而实现是主要障碍。多智能体工作流将生成的脚本正确运行比例从直接LLM调用的14.8%提升至59.3%，在四个较简单问题上达到80.6%。紧密耦合的场内物流模型仍是开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 通用LLM作为智能体能够从自然语言描述中构建约束编程模型，但实现环节是主要瓶颈。结合MCP服务器的多智能体架构能显著提高实现成功率，而复杂耦合的物流调度问题仍有待进一步研究。

title: Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos
summary: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Ledger，一种从自我中心视频中构建的持久3D物体记忆系统，能关联物体位置、历史与上下文描述，并用于回答空间问题。
AI.motivation: 日常任务中，人们能记住之前遇到但当时不相关的物体位置和内容，而现有具身助手缺乏这种能力。研究旨在让助手通过观察日常活动视频，构建类似的人类式物体记忆。
AI.method: Ledger结合物体位置、历史记录和简短上下文描述；跨录制关联观察，保留离开视野的物体；按静止位置聚类观察，仅在重复证据后记录移动以减少定位噪声；保存记录后无需访问原始图像或视频即可回答空间问题。
AI.result: 在HD-EPIC上准确率从29.7%提升至42.6%，UCS-Bench从33.8%提升至38.5%，在Ego4D上物体定位中位误差为0.99米。分析表明时间持久性、上下文描述和检索各有互补作用。100个多场景拼接流实验暴露了检索和构建的失败，逐场景构建可部分恢复跨场景变化的性能损失。
AI.conclusion: Ledger能有效构建持久3D物体记忆，提升空间问答和定位性能；时间持久性、上下文描述与检索各自发挥互补作用，逐场景构建有助于缓解跨场景性能下降。

title: DisParQ: Self-Supervised Part Concepts for Interpretable Vision Foundation Models
summary: Concept-based vision models represent images through an intermediate layer of human-inspectable concepts, so what a model relies on can be traced to those concepts. However, those models are often limited to fixed categories or depend on language to define their concepts. We introduce DisParQ (Discrete Parts with Quantized attributes), a method that learns spatially grounded, discrete concept representations from a powerful frozen vision-only self-supervised backbone. It requires no class labels and no language supervision. Each image patch is assigned to exactly one concept from a learnable prototype dictionary, and only a sparse subset of concepts may activate per image. To capture how each concept varies across images (e.g., the type of a "wheel"), we learn continuous residuals alongside the concepts and then quantize them into discrete attributes. A spatial decoder reconstructs the backbone's representation from the concepts and attributes alone, so successful reconstruction means that the discrete representation preserves the backbone's information. We evaluate DisParQ across seven datasets, from general recognition (ImageNet, PartImageNet, Places) to fine-grained benchmarks (CUB, Cars, Dogs, Flowers). We show that DisParQ closely matches its frozen DINOv2 teacher on ImageNet linear probing (83.2% top-1), achieves higher concept consistency than language-aligned models, remains competitive on fine-grained recognition, and enables cross-category part-based retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出DisParQ方法，从冻结的纯视觉自监督骨干网络中学习空间定位的离散概念表示，无需类别标签或语言监督，并在多数据集上验证其概念一致性与识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概念的视觉模型虽可解释，但常受限于固定类别或依赖语言定义概念，缺乏从纯视觉自监督模型中无监督学习空间化离散概念的能力。
AI.method: DisParQ将每个图像块分配到一个可学习原型字典中的唯一概念，每张图像仅稀疏激活部分概念；同时学习连续残差并将其量化为离散属性以捕捉概念变化；通过空间解码器仅从概念和属性重建骨干网络表示，以验证离散表示的信息保留能力。
AI.result: 在七个数据集（ImageNet、PartImageNet、Places、CUB、Cars、Dogs、Flowers）上，DisParQ在ImageNet线性探测中达到83.2% top-1，接近冻结DINOv2教师；概念一致性高于语言对齐模型；在细粒度识别上保持竞争力，并支持跨类别基于部件的检索。
AI.conclusion: DisParQ表明无需标签和语言监督即可从纯视觉自监督骨干中学习空间定位的离散概念与属性，实现可解释且信息保留的表示，并在通用识别、细粒度识别和部件检索中有效。

title: AI Safety Considerations for Agents With Limited Time to Act
summary: In the wake of the increasingly public discussion about AI alignment, recent work has tried to propose specific AI architectures that behave safely. However, the proposed arguments that seemingly demonstrate proved alignment mostly neglect the environment the agent needs to act in. We discuss theoretical bounds for agent-agnostic safety guarantees in environments that can only be partially observed and within which an action is required within limited time. We introduce two realistic scenarios, one with an infinite state space and one with signal mixture. In these scenarios, we prove that even a perfect agent cannot guarantee safe behaviour. It will be argued that for any proof of AI safety or alignment, the environment and associated safe actions need to be specifically considered together with the agent.

AI.tldr: 论文讨论AI对齐与安全保证，指出不能脱离环境单独证明智能体安全；在部分可观测、限时行动的环境中，即使完美智能体也无法保证安全行为。
AI.motivation: 近期研究试图提出安全AI架构，但相关对齐证明大多忽略智能体所处的环境，因此需要重新审视仅基于智能体的安全保证。
AI.method: 从理论层面分析智能体无关的安全保证边界，并构造两个现实场景：无限状态空间与信号混合；在部分可观测且需限时行动的条件下进行证明。
AI.result: 在这两个场景中证明，即使存在完美智能体，也无法保证其行为安全。
AI.conclusion: 任何AI安全或对齐证明都必须将环境及相应安全行动与智能体一起具体考虑，而不能只关注智能体本身。

title: Concentration, Not Uncertainty: Why Targeted Synthetic Data Doesn't Help Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection requires pixel-accurate masks, but obtaining such annotations is slow and costly, making synthetic training images an attractive alternative. Under a fixed generation budget, however, it remains unclear which real-image regions to target for synthetic data generation. We study an uncertainty-guided generation strategy that clusters the unlabelled real images, identifies clusters on which the model is least certain, allocates synthetic generation toward those clusters, and iteratively retrains the model. Across 103 training runs, uncertainty-based targeting does not outperform random allocation. Five independent controls further show that this null result is not an artifact: targeted training sets are measurably different from random sets, but the difference is explained by concentrating the generation budget rather than by where uncertainty is concentrated, as every concentration rule we test reproduces the effect and, on boundary accuracy, so does aiming at the clusters the model was most certain about. Separately, we find substantial data contamination in CHAMELEON, with 50 of its 76 images duplicated from training data despite the standard overlap check reporting zero overlap. Together, these results show that, under a fixed synthetic-data budget, budget concentration, not uncertainty-based targeting, accounts for the observed training-set effects.

AI.tldr: 在固定合成数据生成预算下，研究不确定性引导的合成数据生成是否优于随机分配，发现并无优势；训练集效应实际源于预算集中而非不确定性定位，并发现CHAMELEON数据集存在严重数据污染。
AI.motivation: 伪装目标检测需要像素级精确掩码，但标注耗时昂贵，合成训练图像成为有吸引力的替代方案。然而在固定生成预算下，尚不清楚应将合成数据生成瞄准哪些真实图像区域。
AI.method: 提出不确定性引导的生成策略：对未标注真实图像聚类，识别模型最不确定的簇，将合成生成预算向这些簇倾斜，并迭代重训练模型。共进行103次训练运行，并设计五个独立对照实验验证。
AI.result: 不确定性定位未优于随机分配。对照实验表明该零结果并非假象：目标训练集与随机集可测量地不同，但差异可由生成预算的集中程度解释，而非不确定性集中之处——所有集中规则都能重现该效应，且在边界精度上，瞄准模型最确定的簇也能产生同样效果。此外，CHAMELEON数据集存在严重污染：76张图像中有50张与训练数据重复，而标准重叠检查却报告零重叠。
AI.conclusion: 在固定合成数据预算下，观测到的训练集效应来自预算集中，而非不确定性引导的定位；同时揭示了常用重叠检查无法发现的数据集污染问题。

title: Efficient 3D Gaussian Head Avatars for Edge Devices
summary: Generative 3D Gaussian head avatars provide high-quality, efficient rendering, but synthesising the Gaussian representation remains computationally expensive, limiting deployment on resource-constrained and edge devices. We introduce an efficient generator architecture for unconditional 3D Gaussian head synthesis, based on a parameter-efficient synthesis block and depth-wise separable convolutions while retaining style-based conditioning. Our architecture reduces generator complexity without requiring model compression or quantisation. Compared with the baseline model, our approach reduces FLOPs by 94%, parameter count by 70%, and model size by 81%, while maintaining competitive generation quality. We further demonstrate practical CPU inference and browser-based execution on mobile devices using ONNX Runtime, enabling 3D Gaussian avatar synthesis without dedicated GPU hardware or application-specific software. In addition to conventional image-quality metrics, we evaluate multi-view consistency, training cost, and deployment performance. Code, trained models, and evaluation tools will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种高效的无条件3D高斯头部合成生成器，在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低计算量和模型规模，并支持CPU与移动浏览器部署。
AI.motivation: 生成式3D高斯头部头像虽能实现高质量、高效渲染，但合成高斯表示的计算成本高，难以部署在资源受限设备和边缘设备上。
AI.method: 设计高效的生成器架构，采用参数高效的合成块和深度可分离卷积，同时保留基于风格的条件控制；不依赖模型压缩或量化来降低复杂度。
AI.result: 相比基线模型，FLOPs减少94%，参数量减少70%，模型大小减少81%，并保持有竞争力的生成质量；还实现了基于ONNX Runtime的CPU推理和移动端浏览器执行，并评估了多视角一致性、训练成本和部署性能。
AI.conclusion: 该架构可在无需专用GPU硬件或特定应用软件的情况下实现3D高斯头像合成，代码、训练模型和评估工具将公开。

title: OOM-RL II: Reality Is an Oracle, Not a Debugger Provenance-Constrained Diagnosis in Continually Evolving Agent-Engineered Systems
comment: 38 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Supplementary Dataset S1: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23215521. Follow-up to arXiv:2604.11477
summary: Reality may establish that an outcome occurred without identifying which evolving procedure produced it or why. This distinction matters in production ML systems whose code, configuration, and artifacts change while external feedback accumulates. We examine it in a human-directed, agent-engineered quantitative trading system, using oracle to mean an external source of realized outcomes rather than a complete correctness specification. Across one year, the account gained and outperformed a broad market index, while annual alpha was not statistically distinguishable from zero under the main retrospective specification. Retrospectively selected subperiods include adverse relative performance and conditional candidate-level weakness under declared approximate references. Engineering records document changes during the episode, and complete recommendation-to-runtime binding is unavailable. The archive does not establish a common frozen instance or a unique cause. The case motivates an outcome--diagnosis gap: outcome evidence, evaluated-object identity, and causal explanation support distinct claims. We distinguish frozen instances, pre-specified adaptive procedures, and ad-hoc development; organize archive-relative claim identifiability and an evidence hierarchy; and propose a prospective production-binding protocol. An illustrative compatible-history example shows how factual binding can resolve a recommendation's referent without supplying its counterfactual effect. The protocol is proposed rather than prospectively validated. External feedback constrains outcome claims, while provenance and additional identification structure determine the resolution of diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 论文通过一个人类指导、智能体工程的量化交易系统案例，指出“结果发生”与“原因/程序诊断”之间存在鸿沟：外部反馈可支持结果主张，但要确定评估对象和因果解释需额外溯源与识别结构，并提出未来生产绑定协议。
AI.motivation: 生产ML系统中代码、配置和制品不断变化且外部反馈累积，常难以判断结果由哪个演化流程产生、为何产生；需要区分结果证据、评估对象身份和因果解释。
AI.method: 研究一个运行一年的量化交易系统，以oracle指外部实现结果来源；结合工程记录、回顾性统计规范、子期分析、候选级弱点和推荐到运行时绑定检查，提出归档相对可识别性与证据层级，并设计前瞻性生产绑定协议。
AI.result: 账户一年内盈利并跑赢宽基指数，但主回顾规范下年化alpha与零无统计差异；回顾选择的子期出现不利相对表现和条件候选级弱点；完整推荐到运行时绑定不可得，归档无法确立共同冻结实例或唯一原因。
AI.conclusion: 外部反馈只能约束结果主张；诊断分辨率取决于溯源和额外识别结构。案例说明outcome-diagnosis gap，需区分冻结实例、预指定自适应程序和临时开发；所提协议尚待前瞻验证。

title: The Handover Problem: Governing Autonomy Transitions in Human-AI Collaboration
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Human-Machine Systems
summary:
Human-machine systems rarely operate at a fixed level of AI autonomy. As operators and AI systems collaborate over time, control must shift: the AI can take on more responsibility when collaboration is stable, maintain its current role when evidence is ambiguous, or return control to the human when conditions deteriorate. Existing work on adaptive automation, supervisory control, trust in automation, and deskilling explains parts of this problem, but provides no auditable, multi-signal criterion for governing when autonomy should change across multi-cycle workflows.
  We formalise this challenge as the Handover Problem: deciding, at each operational cycle, whether to escalate, maintain, or revert AI autonomy while keeping the process reversible, recoverable, and auditable. We introduce the Handover Readiness Score (HRS), a transparent composite measure that integrates four signal dimensions: operator readiness, human-AI trust, learning stability, and operational performance. It is combined with a hysteresis-based transition policy that requires sustained positive evidence before increasing autonomy but reverts promptly when conditions worsen.
  Across software engineering and manufacturing domains, the HRS and hard safety guards address complementary failure regimes: guards enforce immediate corrective action when a single indicator breaches a critical threshold, while the HRS detects the slow, multi-signal erosion of operator readiness that no individual guard can observe. The framework establishes autonomy handover as a governance problem requiring explicit, composite, and auditable criteria. This provides a conceptual and formal foundation that adaptive automation research has not previously provided.

AI.tldr: 论文将人机协作中AI自主权的动态切换形式化为“交接问题”，提出可审计的交接就绪分数（HRS）和基于滞后的切换策略，用于决定在每个操作周期中升级、维持或回退AI自主权。
AI.motivation: 现有人机系统很少在固定AI自主级别下运行，而自适应自动化、监督控制、自动化信任和技能退化等研究虽解释部分问题，却缺乏可审计、多信号的标准来治理多周期工作流中的自主权变更。
AI.method: 定义“交接问题”，要求过程可逆、可恢复、可审计；提出HRS，一个透明复合指标，整合操作员就绪度、人机信任、学习稳定性和操作绩效四个信号维度；结合基于滞后的过渡策略，在持续正向证据下才提升自主权，条件恶化时迅速回退。
AI.result: 在软件工程和制造领域，HRS与硬性安全防护针对互补的失败机制：安全防护在单一指标突破临界阈值时立即纠正，而HRS可检测单个防护无法观察到的操作员就绪度的缓慢、多信号侵蚀。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将自主权交接确立为需要显式、复合且可审计标准的治理问题，为自适应自动化研究提供了此前缺乏的概念和形式化基础。

title: UltraText Bench: A Comprehensive Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Image Generation
summary: Dense visual text requires image generators to reproduce long strings across multiple regions with correct placement and legibility. As short-string rendering improves, evaluation must test sustained performance across more demanding scenes. We introduce UltraText Bench, a bilingual benchmark for prompt-only generation of dense visual text. It contains 432 prompts spanning 24 real-world scene categories and three difficulty levels, split equally between English and Chinese. Each human-reviewed prompt supplies exact strings for four to twelve text regions, paired with structured references for their content, placement, and visual attributes. We use the Q-Judger vision-language model to assess each image against the complete reference, reporting text fidelity, text clarity, spatial quality, and scene quality. Across 24 model configurations, these dimensions reveal different strengths: Z-Image-Turbo gains 3.81 clarity points over Z-Image-Base while losing 14.76 fidelity points under the reported settings. Performance also varies with workload; Qwen-Image-2512's English composite falls from 86.50 at L1 to 42.86 at L3. Ten participants took part in human evaluation of the automatic scores. Repository: https://github.com/LINs-lab/UltraText_Bench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UltraText Bench，一个面向密集视觉文本生成的双语基准，包含 432 个提示，覆盖 24 类真实场景和 3 个难度级别，中英文各半。每个提示指定 4 到 12 个文本区域的精确字符串及结构化参考，并用 Q-Judger 从文本保真度、清晰度、空间质量和场景质量四个维度评估生成图像。
AI.motivation: 随着图像生成模型在短文本渲染上不断进步，现有评测不足以检验模型在更复杂场景中持续生成密集、多区域、长字符串文本的能力，因此需要一个更严格的双语基准。
AI.method: 构建 UltraText Bench：432 个经过人工审核的提示，覆盖 24 个真实场景类别和 3 个难度级别，中英文均分；每个提示提供 4 到 12 个文本区域的精确字符串，以及内容、位置和视觉属性的结构化参考。采用 Q-Judger 视觉语言模型对图像与完整参考进行自动评估，报告文本保真度、文本清晰度、空间质量和场景质量；另邀请 10 名参与者进行人工评价以验证自动分数。
AI.result: 在 24 个模型配置上，各评估维度揭示不同优势：例如在报告设置下，Z-Image-Turbo 相比 Z-Image-Base 清晰度提高 3.81 分，但保真度下降 14.76 分。性能也随工作负载变化，Qwen-Image-2512 的英文综合得分从 L1 的 86.50 降至 L3 的 42.86。10 名参与者参与了自动分数的人工评估。
AI.conclusion: UltraText Bench 能更全面地衡量密集视觉文本生成中的持续性能与多维度权衡，暴露当前模型在复杂多区域文本生成上的不足，并为后续评测提供双语、结构化、可复现的基准。代码与数据见 https://github.com/LINs-lab/UltraText_Bench。

title: Open-MMUnlearning: Unifying Methods and Evaluation for MLLM Unlearning
summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become more capable and widely deployed, concerns about privacy and safety have become increasingly pressing. Machine unlearning offers one approach to addressing these concerns by removing designated information from trained models while preserving unrelated capabilities. However, fragmented implementations and evaluation protocols, incomplete robustness testing, and limited understanding of metric reliability make progress in MLLM unlearning difficult to assess systematically. We introduce Open-MMUnlearning, an open-source, extensible framework that integrates target-model preparation, multimodal data processing, unlearning, and evaluation through shared interfaces and structured configurations. The framework supports five benchmarks spanning privacy, safety, and copyright, eight MLLMs from four model families, and twelve unlearning methods. Its evaluation suite jointly assesses forgetting effectiveness, retained utility, and robustness to model interventions, adversarial inputs, and membership inference attacks. Using a common evaluation protocol, we compare ten representative unlearning methods. In this comparison, GD and MIP-Editor tie for the highest overall score: GD achieves the highest Forget Quality, while MIP-Editor preserves more Model Utility. We further introduce a metric meta-evaluation protocol that tests faithfulness using models with controlled exposure to target knowledge and robustness under quantization and relearning. Among the thirteen evaluated metrics, BLEU achieves the highest aggregate reliability score. KS-Test attains the highest faithfulness AUC but performs less well on robustness. Together, the framework and these findings support reproducible comparison of MLLM unlearning methods and systematic assessment of evaluation reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出开源可扩展框架Open-MMUnlearning，统一多模态大模型遗忘的模型准备、数据处理、遗忘与评估流程，支持5个基准、8个MLLM、12种遗忘方法，并系统比较10种方法与13项评估指标。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态大模型能力增强和广泛部署，隐私与安全问题日益突出；机器遗忘可用于移除指定信息并保留其他能力，但现有实现和评估协议碎片化、鲁棒性测试不完整、指标可靠性理解不足，难以系统评估进展。
AI.method: 构建Open-MMUnlearning框架，通过共享接口和结构化配置集成目标模型准备、多模态数据处理、遗忘和评估；覆盖隐私、安全、版权5个基准、4个模型家族8个MLLM、12种遗忘方法；评估遗忘效果、保留效用，以及对模型干预、对抗输入和成员推理攻击的鲁棒性；使用统一协议比较10种代表性方法，并引入指标元评估协议，用受控知识暴露模型测试忠实性，在量化和再学习下测试鲁棒性，评估13项指标。
AI.result: 在统一评估中，GD与MIP-Editor总体得分并列最高：GD的遗忘质量最高，MIP-Editor的模型效用保留更好；13项指标中BLEU综合可靠性最高，KS-Test忠实性AUC最高但鲁棒性表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 该框架及相关发现支持多模态大模型遗忘方法的可复现比较，并有助于系统评估遗忘评估指标的可靠性。

title: Stale, Misattributed, or Late: Where Personal Memory Fails Before Generation
summary: Personal memory for language agents is usually judged by whether the final an- swer is correct. That score hides errors that arise before generation: the memory block may contain an obsolete value, a fact about the wrong person, or no use- ful fact before the serving deadline. We measure these failures directly. Using Personal Fact Memory (PFM) as a reference layer, we find that temporal validity is primarily a property of memory construction in our setting. On a controlled revision benchmark, serving only the active value of each correctly keyed slot eliminates observed stale exposure; without update resolution, 70.3% of prompts expose a superseded value. Once retrievers share the same active store and par- ticipant information, participant-aware BM25 is equivalent to the reference ranker within a prespecified 0.02 margin. The harder problem is assigning revisions to the right slot. Missed merges leave stale values active, whereas false merges silently remove current values; four LLM key assigners achieve higher key re- call than a rule extractor yet produce lower clean-retrieval rates, and open-domain merge recall on LongMemEval never exceeds 0.062. Misattribution survives va- lidity filtering: an entity posterior reduces same-name exposure on controlled data but cannot distinguish identically named speakers in LoCoMo. Two frozen lan- guage models reproduce prompt errors in generated text. Retrieval latency varies across rankers, but prompt prefill dominates turn-level latency on our hardware. These results argue for evaluating agent memory before generation, separating stored-state validity, identity resolution, abstention, and serving latency.

AI.tldr: 论文主张语言智能体的个人记忆评估不应只看最终答案正确性，而应直接测量生成前的记忆错误。以个人事实记忆（PFM）为参考层，发现时间有效性主要取决于记忆构建；无更新解析时70.3%提示暴露被取代值；参与者感知BM25与参考排序器等效；更难的是将修订分配到正确槽位，LLM键分配器键召回高但干净检索率低，LongMemEval开放域合并召回≤0.062；错误归因在有效性过滤后仍存在，LoCoMo中无法区分同名说话者；冻结语言模型会复现提示错误；提示预填充主导延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有评估以最终答案正确性为准，掩盖了生成前出现的记忆错误，如过期值、错误人物事实或缺少有用事实，因此需要直接测量这些失败。
AI.method: 以个人事实记忆（PFM）为参考层，在受控修订基准上测量记忆构建与serving；比较参与者感知BM25与参考排序器；用四个LLM键分配器对比规则提取器；在LongMemEval上测开放域合并召回；在LoCoMo上测同名说话者区分；用两个冻结语言模型检查生成文本中的提示错误；并测量检索与预填充延迟。
AI.result: 仅serving正确键槽的活跃值可消除过期暴露；无更新解析时70.3%提示暴露被取代值；参与者感知BM25与参考排序器在预设0.02边界内等效；LLM键分配器键召回高于规则提取器但干净检索率更低；LongMemEval开放域合并召回不超过0.062；实体后验减少受控数据同名暴露但在LoCoMo无法区分同名说话者；冻结语言模型复现提示错误；检索延迟因排序器而异，但提示预填充主导turn级延迟。
AI.conclusion: 应在生成前评估智能体记忆，并分离存储状态有效性、身份解析、弃权与serving延迟。

title: MOTIF: Person-of-Interest Deepfake Detection Beyond 3DMM Coefficients
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Information Forensics and Security (WIFS)
summary: Video deepfakes targeting a specific individual, the Person-of-Interest (POI), are the most harmful ones, and, since a public figure is abundantly recorded, a detector can be built from genuine footage of that individual. Such detectors commonly describe a subject through a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) and adopt its coefficients as a whole, so which part of that description carries the signal has never been measured. We dissect it, holding the encoder, the training corpus and the enrollment protocol fixed and varying only what the encoder observes. The groups of coefficients prove largely redundant, since the shape block alone recovers almost all the accuracy of the full vector, and their temporal evolution contributes a real but bounded amount. We further show that the dense surface the same fit returns, which these detectors discard, carries identity information that the coefficients do not, and that it helps precisely where they are weakest. We assemble the best configuration into MOTIF, a visual-only detector trained on real videos only, with no manipulated video and no POI-specific data. It improves on both state-of-the-art POI detectors in every dataset and manipulation of our benchmark and at two quality levels. Our experimental code will be released at https://github.com/polimi-ispl/MOTIF.

AI.tldr: 针对特定人物（POI）的视频深伪危害最大。本文剖析3DMM系数在POI检测中的作用，发现形状块几乎可恢复完整向量的精度，并利用被丢弃的密集表面身份信息，构建仅用真实视频训练的视觉检测器MOTIF。
AI.motivation: 现有POI检测器常用3DMM系数整体描述人物，但从未测量其中哪部分真正携带检测信号；同时，3DMM拟合返回的密集表面常被丢弃，其身份信息未被利用。
AI.method: 固定编码器、训练语料和注册协议，仅改变编码器观察内容，系统分解3DMM系数组及其时间演化；评估拟合得到的密集表面；将最佳配置组装为MOTIF，仅使用真实视频训练，无需操纵视频和POI特定数据。
AI.result: 3DMM系数组高度冗余，仅形状块就几乎达到完整向量的精度；时间演化有真实但有限的贡献；密集表面携带系数不具备的身份信息，并在系数最弱处提供帮助；MOTIF在基准中所有数据集和操纵类型、两个质量级别上均优于两个SOTA POI检测器。
AI.conclusion: POI深伪检测不必依赖完整3DMM系数，形状块与密集表面是有效信号；MOTIF作为仅视觉、仅真实视频训练的检测器取得了更优性能，实验代码将开源。

title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
summary: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 EmbodiedRSI，一种自进化智能体框架，通过快慢双系统架构、假设图、信息价值实验选择、代码技能协同进化和基于奖励的记忆学习，提升机器人基础模型在物体位置或指令变化下的适应能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型在视觉运动控制上表现强，但当物体位置或任务指令变化时性能会下降。传统后训练需要大量昂贵的机器人数据，而现有自进化框架在决定代码和技能变更时对机器人试验利用效率低。
AI.method: EmbodiedRSI 采用快慢双系统架构，在假设图中维护竞争的代码与技能假设；用信息价值实验选择能区分假设的物理实验；依据实验结果进行代码-技能协同进化；慢系统构建分层记忆，并通过奖励驱动的记忆学习选择对后续快系统改进有价值的记忆。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa365 上，EmbodiedRSI 达到 77.0% 总体成功率和 71.3% 的 Composite-Unseen 成功率，优于最佳基线的 40.1%；在 LIBERO-Pro 上达到 86.8% 总体成功率；还能零样本迁移到真实机器人，在多项挑战任务上达到 71.3% 总体成功率。
AI.conclusion: EmbodiedRSI 能自主决定探索方向，将物理交互转化为代码和技能改进，在仿真基准和真实机器人任务上均显著提升适应性与成功率。

title: Before They Can Solve: Predicting Post-Training Coding-Agent Performance from Base Models
summary: How can we predict which base checkpoint is worth an expensive round of agentic post-training? End-to-end pass@$K$ tests whether successful behavior already appears in a base model's distribution, but it is a poor fit for agentic coding: many base checkpoints cannot reliably produce the well-formed tool invocation required to complete a task end-to-end. Single-shot or short-horizon tasks avoid these tool-calling failures by collapsing a multi-step interaction into a fixed prompt and a single patch, but they sidestep the core capability we care about: maintaining coherent state over many tool-using steps as the repository evolves. To bridge this gap, we treat successful post-trained agent trajectories as a lookahead signal of base-model potential. Replaying each trajectory and rerunning tests after every code-changing step identifies the decisive step: the first step whose cumulative patch flips the repository from failing to passing, certifying that the recorded action solves the task given the prior context. Motivated by a coverage principle for agentic traces, we build three screens at this step that do not require a base checkpoint to drive the harness from a cold start: (i) Decisive-Action BPB (bits per byte) measures the probability mass on the certified action, (ii) Patch MCQ tests the checkpoint's choice between that action and alternatives rejected by the same verifier, and (iii) prefix-conditioned pass@$K$ evaluates support for functionally-correct generations and credits any continuation that the tests accept. Across ten pairs of public base and post-trained models, all three screens rank the cohort in close agreement with post-trained SWE-bench Verified pass@$1$. As our methods need only a benchmark's successful trajectories and its verifier, they can be applied to turn future agentic coding benchmarks into base-model evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需让基座模型从零开始运行智能体工具调用流程的方法，通过复用已成功训练后的智能体轨迹，预测哪个基座检查点值得进行昂贵的智能体后训练。
AI.motivation: 端到端 pass@K 不适合评估智能体编码能力，因为许多基座检查点无法可靠产生格式正确的工具调用；而单步或短视任务虽然规避了工具调用失败，却忽略了在多次工具使用步骤中维持仓库状态一致性的核心能力。
AI.method: 将成功的后训练智能体轨迹作为基座模型潜力的前瞻信号。回放每条轨迹，并在每次修改代码后重新运行测试，找到“决定性步骤”：其累积补丁首次使仓库从失败转为通过。基于智能体轨迹覆盖原则，在该步骤构建三种筛选指标：(i) Decisive-Action BPB，测量认证动作上的概率质量；(ii) Patch MCQ，测试模型在认证动作与被同一验证器拒绝的替代动作之间的选择；(iii) prefix-conditioned pass@K，评估对功能正确生成的支持，并认可任何通过测试的续写。
AI.result: 在十对公开基座模型与后训练模型上，三种筛选指标对模型队列的排序均与后训练后的 SWE-bench Verified pass@1 高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 由于这些方法只需要基准的成功轨迹和验证器，它们可以将未来的智能体编码基准转化为基座模型评估，从而预测基座检查点的后训练价值。

title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Agenthon Workshop
summary: As option markets grow and AI advances, agentic systems for option trading are gaining increasing attention. Language-model-based agents can reason over contextual information such as news, but option trading presents a particularly challenging decision problem: a single stock can have thousands of contracts, and the agent must decide both which contracts to trade and how to combine them. Existing approaches often sidestep this complexity by restricting the policy to a fixed strategy structure, such as a straddle, limiting their ability to switch strategies as market conditions change. We present SOTA (Stock Options Trading Agents), an agentic trading framework for structured option-strategy selection. SOTA abstracts the large option universe into strategy-level decisions while deterministic resolvers handle portfolio implementation. We develop SOTA by post-training Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. SOTA is evaluated on options on nine large-cap U.S. equities and SPY against rule-based and machine-learning strategy selectors in the same trading environment. Over a six-month out-of-sample period, SOTA earns an 18.3% total return with a Sharpe ratio of 1.60 and a maximum drawdown of 8.96%. We also document an asymmetric role of news: news improves frontier-teacher trajectories, but retaining news during reinforcement learning reduces out-of-sample return from 18.3% to -2.7%.

AI.tldr: 提出SOTA智能期权交易框架，将庞大期权组合选择抽象为策略级决策，再由确定性解析器实现组合；通过SFT+RL训练Qwen3.8-27B，在美股大盘股和SPY期权上取得六个月样本外18.3%收益、Sharpe 1.60、最大回撤8.96%，并发现新闻在训练中的非对称作用。
AI.motivation: 期权市场增长和AI代理发展，语言模型代理可推理新闻等上下文，但期权交易决策复杂：单只股票有数千合约，需同时决定交易哪些合约及如何组合。现有方法常限制为固定策略结构（如跨式），难以随市场变化切换策略。
AI.method: 提出SOTA，将大期权宇宙抽象为策略级决策，确定性解析器负责投资组合实现；通过监督微调后接强化学习对Qwen3.8-27B进行后训练；在九只美国大盘股和SPY期权上，与规则型和机器学习策略选择器在同一交易环境中评估。
AI.result: 六个月样本外期间，SOTA总收益18.3%，Sharpe比率1.60，最大回撤8.96%。新闻作用不对称：新闻能改善前沿教师轨迹，但强化学习阶段保留新闻会使样本外收益从18.3%降至-2.7%。
AI.conclusion: SOTA可有效进行结构化期权策略选择并优于基线；新闻在不同训练阶段作用不同，强化学习中直接保留新闻可能有害，需谨慎设计上下文使用。

title: ORCA: Hunting Compositional Failures in Text-to-Image Diffusion
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models fail predictably on compositional prompts: attributes bind to the wrong objects, spatial relations invert, and multi-object scenes lose count. Recent architectures already augment CLIP with a T5 encoder precisely because CLIP's contrastive embedding loses compositional structure, yet these failures persist. We argue the binding problem is therefore not one of missing information but of misaligned information: a text encoder preserves compositional structure, but in a representation space shaped by language modelling rather than vision, and the denoising objective does not directly reward aligning the two. We show this correspondence can be supplied as an explicit training signal, that the relevant cross-modal information is concentrated in a low-rank subspace of self-supervised visual features, and that supplying it can be folded into diffusion training as a single auxiliary loss. Our method, ORCA (Orthogonal Residual Compositional Alignment), aligns the latent of a diffusion transformer with a low-rank target derived from a frozen visual encoder, through a predictor whose orthogonal basis is parameterised by a learned residual between T5 and CLIP embeddings, which provides a prompt-dependent signal for selecting the visual readout subspace. We prove that the cross-modal information recoverable at a given rank is bounded by the spectral mass of the visual encoder's covariance in the top components. Across three diffusion-transformer backbones (DiT-B/2, DiT-L/2, U-ViT-L), ORCA improves FID and GenEval over both vanilla and REPA baselines at zero inference-time cost; on DiT-L/2 it reaches FID 16.65 and GenEval 0.291 at 200K steps, exceeding the strongest 400K baseline at half the training cost, with the largest gains concentrated on attribute binding, spatial relations, and multi-object prompts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ORCA，一种将显式跨模态对齐信号作为辅助损失融入扩散训练的文本到图像生成方法，通过低秩视觉特征子空间对齐，在零推理开销下提升组合式生成能力。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在组合式提示上失败（属性错绑、空间关系颠倒、多物体计数错误），即使加入T5编码器仍存在。作者认为问题不是信息缺失，而是信息错位：文本编码器保留了组合结构，但处于语言建模表示空间，去噪目标未直接奖励跨模态对齐。
AI.method: ORCA利用自监督视觉特征中跨模态信息集中于低秩子空间的特性，将冻结视觉编码器得到的低秩目标与扩散Transformer隐变量对齐；通过一个预测器实现，其正交基由T5与CLIP嵌入之间的学习残差参数化，形成提示相关的视觉读出子空间选择信号；并证明给定秩下可恢复的跨模态信息受视觉编码器协方差谱质量上界约束。
AI.result: 在DiT-B/2、DiT-L/2、U-ViT-L三种扩散Transformer骨架上，ORCA在零推理成本下较vanilla和REPA基线提升FID与GenEval；DiT-L/2在200K步达到FID 16.65、GenEval 0.291，以一半训练成本超过最强400K基线；增益主要集中于属性绑定、空间关系和多物体提示。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态组合对齐可作为单一辅助损失高效融入扩散训练，通过低秩子空间显式提供视觉-语言对应关系，在不增加推理开销的情况下显著改善组合式文本到图像生成。

title: RECAST: Learning to Compute the Right Context through Adaptive Evidence Routing
summary: Large language models are increasingly applied to tasks grounded in long, heterogeneous information sources. Conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) relies on fixed similarity-based retrieval, while agentic variants adapt queries and tool use but remain largely retrieval-centric. However, in many tasks, the evidence required for a solution is not explicitly present in any single source item. Instead, it must be derived through filtering, aggregation, or computation across multiple source items. In this work, we introduce RECAST (Routing Evidence through Computation, Access, and Synthesized Tools), a learned framework that formulates evidence construction as a sequential decision process over heterogeneous retrieval and computation operations, allowing evidence to be actively derived rather than merely retrieved. A lightweight RouterLM iteratively selects and formulates primitive operations or specifies customized operations for a frozen CompilerLM to translate into executable code. Once it judges the evidence sufficient, RouterLM passes the accepted evidence to a frozen AnswerLM to produce the final solution. We train RouterLM with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO). Across six heterogeneous benchmark families, RECAST achieves a mean success rate of 75.6%, outperforming the strongest large-model baseline by 15.9%. Moreover, training enables the Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM to outperform a training-free Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM by 5.0%. On three held-out benchmarks, RECAST improves over the strongest baseline by 15.0% on average, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization across tasks and heterogeneous source representations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RECAST，将证据构建从固定检索转为对异构检索与计算操作的序贯决策，通过轻量 RouterLM 调度冻结的 CompilerLM 和 AnswerLM，实现主动推导证据并回答。
AI.motivation: 传统 RAG 依赖固定相似度检索，智能体式 RAG 虽能调整查询和工具，但仍以检索为中心；许多任务所需证据不在单一来源中，而需跨多个来源进行过滤、聚合或计算才能得到。
AI.method: 将证据构建形式化为对异构检索与计算操作的序贯决策过程。RouterLM 迭代选择并构造基本操作，或为冻结的 CompilerLM 指定定制操作并编译为可执行代码；当判断证据充分后，将证据传给冻结的 AnswerLM 生成最终答案。RouterLM 采用监督微调 SFT 加组相对策略优化 GRPO 训练。
AI.result: 在六个异构基准系列上，RECAST 平均成功率为 75.6%，比最强的大模型基线高 15.9%。训练使 Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM 比免训练的 Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM 高 5.0%。在三个留出基准上，RECAST 平均比最强基线高 15.0%，展现出较强的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RECAST 表明，将证据构造作为检索与计算联合的序贯决策问题，可主动推导而非仅检索证据，从而在异构来源任务中取得更优性能与泛化能力。

title: DeltaSplat: Iterative Gaussian Refinement for Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene from sparse, unposed images in a single network pass, removing the need for camera calibration and per-scene optimization. However, camera estimation errors propagate into the predicted Gaussians and compound the geometric and photometric inaccuracies of single-pass prediction. To correct these errors, we introduce DeltaSplat, a lightweight Gaussian refinement module for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS. It iteratively renders the current Gaussians at the input context views and predicts per-Gaussian updates from the resulting residuals. A 2D residual alone, however, underdetermines the 3D correction. DeltaSplat therefore conditions each update on per-pixel Plücker rays and rendered depth as a soft geometric prior. A dual-branch convolutional mixer efficiently encodes these inputs, and per-attribute heads decode the fused features into position, opacity, and color updates. The module adds only ~2.2% parameters to the backbone and remains fully feed-forward at inference. On DL3DV, DeltaSplat reaches 26.64 dB PSNR in the pose-free setting, improving its state-of-the-art backbone by 1.75 dB and surpassing even baselines supplied with ground-truth cameras; consistent gains hold across 6-24 views and all camera regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeltaSplat，一种用于无位姿前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 的轻量级高斯精修模块，通过迭代渲染与残差更新来校正相机估计误差导致的高斯偏差。
AI.motivation: 无位姿前馈 3DGS 虽可从稀疏未标定图像单次重建，但相机估计误差会传播到预测高斯中，放大单次预测的几何与光度不准确性。
AI.method: DeltaSplat 在输入上下文视角渲染当前高斯，基于残差预测每个高斯的更新；针对 2D 残差对 3D 校正欠约束的问题，引入逐像素 Plücker 射线和渲染深度作为软几何先验，并用双分支卷积混合器编码，再由按属性划分的头解码头输出位置、不透明度和颜色更新。模块仅增加约 2.2% 参数，推理时保持完全前馈。
AI.result: 在 DL3DV 上，DeltaSplat 在无位姿设置下达到 26.64 dB PSNR，比其最先进骨干提升 1.75 dB，并超过使用真值相机的基线；在 6-24 个视角及所有相机条件下均取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: DeltaSplat 能有效校正无位姿前馈 3DGS 中的相机估计误差传播问题，以极低参数开销显著提升重建质量，并保持前馈推理优势。

title: DeepTopoClustering: Unsupervised Derivation of Surface Process Taxonomy from 4D Point Clouds for Topographic Monitoring
comment: Submitted to ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
summary: 4D point clouds acquired by permanent laser scanning (PLS) enable accurate high-frequency monitoring of surface change in dynamic topographic environments. However, existing methods remain limited in organizing detected surface activities into meaningful process types. We propose DeepTopoClustering (DTC), an unsupervised framework for deriving a hierarchical process taxonomy from object-based surface activities, so-called 4D objects-by-change (4D-OBCs). We transform each 4D-OBC into a GeoMorphogram, a distributional sequence representing the temporal evolution of topographic change within a spatially bounded surface activity. A convolutional autoencoder learns latent embeddings from GeoMorphograms, which are jointly optimized using a hierarchical deep clustering objective to organize surface activities into a hierarchy. We evaluate the learned hierarchy using expert annotations on two 4D datasets of sandy beach sites and their combination. DTC with GeoMorphograms achieves the highest agreement with expert judgment at the taxonomy level comprising eight major process types ($F_1=0.78$, match accuracy $=0.92$), outperforming dimensionality reduction and conventional flat clustering. The learned taxonomy separates major erosion- and deposition-dominated activities and distinguishes finer subtypes based on change magnitude, duration, compactness, and temporal evolution. DTC thus provides a scalable and interpretable route from 4D change detection to a data-driven, expert-supported surface process taxonomy, advancing automated knowledge derivation for understanding surface dynamics in topographic monitoring.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DeepTopoClustering（DTC）无监督框架，从永久激光扫描获得的 4D 点云中，将地表活动组织为具有层次结构的过程分类体系。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽能检测动态地形环境中的地表变化，但难以将检测到的地表活动组织为有意义的过程类型，因而限制了自动化知识提取。
AI.method: 将每个 4D 变化对象（4D-OBC）转换为 GeoMorphogram，即表示局部地形变化时间演化的分布序列；使用卷积自编码器学习潜在嵌入，并结合层次化深度聚类目标联合优化，从而构建地表活动层次分类；在两个沙质海滩 4D 数据集及其组合上，用专家标注进行评估。
AI.result: DTC 在包含 8 类主要过程类型的分类层次上与专家判断一致性最高，F1=0.78，匹配准确率=0.92，优于降维和常规平坦聚类；学习到的分类能区分侵蚀主导与沉积主导活动，并依据变化幅度、持续时间、紧凑性和时间演化区分更细子类型。
AI.conclusion: DTC 为从 4D 变化检测走向数据驱动、专家支持的地表过程分类提供了可扩展且可解释的路径，推动了地形监测中地表动态的自动化知识发现。

title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?
summary: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. The AI Science Exam for El Nino-Southern Oscillation (SciExam for ENSO) is a benchmark in which agents build low-order stochastic models of ENSO, the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, from real observations. Within a six-hour budget, agents process the observations, write their own diagnostics, which are then frozen, and develop a model using only these diagnostics as feedback. Hidden graders then test whether the model reproduces ENSO's statistics, recovers unobserved variables, and forecasts held-out years, and score a published model in the same way. Across twelve agent systems, six produce models that score higher than the published model, mainly through better reconstruction and forecasting. The simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two competing explanations of ENSO's warm-cold asymmetry, an open debate that the task never mentions. Controlled runs of the top system under varied information suggest that its scores do not come from recalling the dated observational record and that the information it receives shapes how it builds its model. SciExam for ENSO can thus evaluate agent research where no answer is known, and the results suggest that agents can already build competitive models whose structures bear on questions that scientists still debate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SciExam for ENSO 基准，用于评估语言模型智能体在真实科学研究任务中构建 ENSO 低阶随机模型的能力。智能体在六小时内基于真实观测开发模型，隐藏评分器检验其统计复现、未观测变量恢复和留出年份预测，并与已发表模型比较。十二个智能体系统中六个得分更高，说明智能体已能构建有竞争力的科学模型。
AI.motivation: 现有对语言模型智能体的科学能力评估通常依赖已知答案、评分标准或语言模型评审，无法判断一个新的科学模型是否有效。因此，需要一个在答案未知、开放研究情境下评估智能体科学建模能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建 SciExam for ENSO：智能体在六小时预算内处理 ENSO 真实观测，自行编写诊断程序，诊断随后被冻结；智能体只能基于这些诊断反馈开发低阶随机模型。隐藏评分器测试模型是否复现 ENSO 统计特征、恢复未观测变量、预测留出年份，并以同样方式评分一个已发表模型。
AI.result: 在十二个智能体系统中，六个生成的模型得分高于已发表模型，主要优势来自更好的重建和预测。较强模型的简化形式分别兼容关于 ENSO 冷暖不对称的两种竞争解释，而任务并未提及该争论。对最佳系统的控制实验表明，其得分并非来自回忆过时的观测记录，且接收的信息会影响其建模方式。
AI.conclusion: SciExam for ENSO 能在没有已知答案的情况下评估智能体的研究能力；结果表明，智能体已能构建有竞争力的模型，且这些模型结构可涉及科学家仍在争论的问题。

title: SANet: Selective Attention Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection aims to accurately identify and locate dim targets in complex backgrounds and supports applications such as maritime surveillance and military search and rescue. However, the small size and weak contrast of infrared targets make it difficult to balance detection accuracy and false alarms. This paper proposes a selective attention network (SANet) for infrared small target detection. A dual-path semantic-aware module combines standard and pinwheel-shaped convolutions to preserve local spatial consistency and capture broader contextual information. Spatial and channel attention further refine the features and improve target-background discrimination. To address the limitations of static skip connections in U-Net, a selective attention fusion module adaptively integrates features across scales using spatially varying weights. It selectively enhances salient regions and improves discrimination between true targets and false alarms. Experiments on three public benchmarks, NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1K, and NUDT-SIRST, show that SANet achieves competitive performance in intersection over union (IoU), normalized IoU, detection probability, and false alarm rate. Its IoU exceeds that of the second-best method by 1.93, 4.32, and 2.21 percentage points, respectively. These results support the effectiveness of SANet in dim-target perception, discriminative feature representation, and background suppression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用于红外小目标检测的选择性注意力网络SANet，通过双路径语义感知、空间与通道注意力以及选择性注意力融合模块，在复杂背景下提升弱小目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标尺寸小、对比度弱，在复杂背景中难以同时兼顾检测准确率与低虚警率，且U-Net中静态跳跃连接限制多尺度特征融合能力。
AI.method: 提出SANet：双路径语义感知模块结合标准卷积与风车形卷积，保留局部空间一致性并捕获更广上下文；引入空间和通道注意力细化特征；设计选择性注意力融合模块，以空间变化权重自适应融合跨尺度特征，增强显著区域并抑制虚警。
AI.result: 在NUAA-SIRST、IRSTD-1K和NUDT-SIRST三个公开基准上，SANet在IoU、归一化IoU、检测概率和虚警率上表现有竞争力；其IoU分别超过第二名方法1.93、4.32和2.21个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明SANet能有效提升暗弱目标感知、判别性特征表示和背景抑制能力，验证了其在红外小目标检测中的有效性。

title: Bringing BNNs to Fast Event Processing
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Accepted by NeVi Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) enable efficient deep learning deployment on resource constrained devices with weights and activations compressed to one bit, substantially reducing model size and inference cost. Event cameras offer complementary advantages, including low latency, high dynamic range, and low power consumption, by capturing asynchronous streams of events rather than dense image frames. Despite their shared emphasis on efficiency, the combination of these technologies remains largely unexplored. This work aims at adapting and evaluating modern deep BNN architectures on event data. We also show that cross-modal pretraining from RGB data can improve the classification accuracy of BNNs on neuromorphic datasets. We introduce the Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV), a binary representation that enables event-camera data to be processed directly by BNNs and represents a step toward fully binarized event-based vision systems. Best evaluated BNN on N-Caltech101 classification benchmarks shows 90.58% accuracy with 7.5x less operations than their full-precision counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将二值神经网络（BNN）与事件相机结合，提出二值事件表示PBEV，并利用RGB跨模态预训练提升事件数据分类性能。
AI.motivation: BNN和事件相机均以高效、低功耗为目标，但二者结合仍未被充分探索，旨在面向资源受限设备实现高效事件视觉部署。
AI.method: 适配并评估现代深度BNN架构于事件数据；利用RGB数据进行跨模态预训练；提出Polar-wise Binary Event Volume（PBEV）二值表示，使事件相机数据可直接输入BNN处理。
AI.result: 在N-Caltech101分类基准上，最佳BNN达到90.58%准确率，同时运算量比全精度对应模型少7.5倍。
AI.conclusion: BNN可有效处理事件数据，RGB跨模态预训练能提升神经形态数据集分类精度，PBEV是迈向全二值化事件视觉系统的一步。

title: Hard, Yet Reducible: Controlled Forward Transfer for Synthetic Degradation Curation
summary: Selecting synthetic degradations for dense prediction requires an estimate of their training utility, the generalization gain they bring under a finite training budget. Clean and degraded twins share content and labels, suggesting a score based on how much short training reduces the excess error caused by degradation. However, this gap can also shrink when clean performance deteriorates. Measuring the improvement on degraded images alone avoids that confound, but it still credits progress that the same amount of clean training would have produced. We propose the \textbf{controlled Reducible Degradation Gap} (cRDG) for regions defined by degradation type and severity. From a common checkpoint, cRDG runs two budget-matched probes that differ only in one augmentation slot, which holds either a synthetic degradation or a clean augmentation. The score is the gain on held-out degraded images relative to the clean-control probe. Clean harm is a separate feasibility constraint. cRDG reveals a correctable severity band in which training on the degradation yields high controlled gain under the available budget, and the band moves with the predictor, the starting checkpoint, and the training budget. \textbf{Curation of Reducible Bands} (\method) uses cRDG to select synthetic data without changing the predictor. On semantic segmentation and salient object detection, \method{} improves representative predictors under matched synthetic-data budgets and training schedules, extends to existing data-generation pipelines, and preserves clean performance. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出控制可减少退化差距（cRDG）来估计合成退化在有限训练预算下的训练效用，并基于此提出Curation of Reducible Bands选择合成数据。在语义分割和显著目标检测上，该方法在匹配预算与训练计划下提升代表性预测器，同时保持干净性能。
AI.motivation: 选择合成退化需要估计其训练效用。干净与退化图像共享内容和标签，可用短训练减少退化带来的超额误差来衡量；但该差距也可能因干净性能下降而缩小。仅看退化图像提升虽避开此混淆，却会把同等干净训练本可带来的进步也计入退化训练收益。
AI.method: 提出cRDG：从共同检查点出发，运行两个预算匹配的探针，仅一个增强槽不同，分别放入合成退化或干净增强。分数为在留出退化图像上相对干净控制探针的增益，干净损害作为单独可行性约束。基于cRDG提出Curation of Reducible Bands，在不改变预测器的前提下选择合成数据。
AI.result: cRDG揭示出可纠正的严重度带，在该带内训练退化可在现有预算下获得高控制增益，且该带随预测器、起始检查点和训练预算变化。在语义分割和显著目标检测上，方法在匹配合成数据预算和训练计划下提升代表性预测器，可扩展现有数据生成流程，并保持干净性能。
AI.conclusion: cRDG能控制混淆地评估合成退化的训练效用，据此筛选合成数据可有效提升密集预测性能，且不损害干净性能。代码与支持材料将公开。

title: Global Average Precision for Representation Learning
summary: Standard information retrieval metrics, such as mean Average Precision (mAP), assess performance one query at a time, based on how the similarities between a query and its positives compare against those with its negatives. The same holds for common representation learning losses, such as InfoNCE and per-query AP surrogates. None of them considers whether similarities are comparable across queries, which any system with a single decision threshold relies on. Global Average Precision (gAP) does, by ranking all query-candidate pairs in one list and computing a single AP. We introduce gSAP, a differentiable surrogate of gAP. It needs only a similarity matrix and a binary matrix marking the positive pairs, the same input as existing losses, so it is a drop-in replacement for them and agnostic to the encoder, the modality, and the source of supervision. Since it considers all possible pairwise comparisons in the batch jointly, it also remains trainable at low temperatures, a regime where per-query surrogates run out of gradient. Swapping it into established recipes improves supervised metric learning, cross-modal alignment, and self-supervised pretraining, where, to our knowledge, it is the first ranking loss to replace the community standard InfoNCE in the latter two. Its similarities are more consistent across queries, which drives the gains under a universal threshold. gSAP retrieves up to four times as many positive pairs as the strongest AP surrogate at the same precision, and it degrades the least when queries with no positives in the database are added. Beyond thresholding, models trained with gSAP also learn better representations, with higher transfer, $k$NN and zero-shot classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 gSAP，一个可微的全局 Average Precision（gAP）替代损失，仅需相似度矩阵和正样本二值矩阵，可作为现有损失的直接替换，并在监督度量学习、跨模态对齐和自监督预训练中提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 mAP、InfoNCE 和逐查询 AP 替代损失都逐查询评估，忽略不同查询间相似度是否可比；而依赖单一决策阈值的系统需要全局可比的相似度。gAP 虽能全局排序所有查询-候选对，但缺少可微替代。
AI.method: 提出 gSAP，作为 gAP 的可微代理损失。其输入与现有损失相同，即相似度矩阵和标记正样本对的二值矩阵，因此与编码器、模态和监督来源无关，可直接替换。它联合考虑批次内所有成对比较，故在低温度下仍可训练。
AI.result: 将 gSAP 替换进已有训练配方，可提升监督度量学习、跨模态对齐和自监督预训练，其中后两者据称首次用排序损失替代 InfoNCE。其相似度跨查询更一致，在通用阈值下带来增益；相同精度下检索正样本对数量可达最强 AP 代理的 4 倍，加入无正样本查询时性能退化最小。除阈值决策外，模型还学到更好表示，迁移、kNN 和零样本分类准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: gSAP 是一种有效的全局排序损失，能改善跨查询相似度一致性和单阈值检索性能，并提升表示质量，可广泛替代现有逐查询损失。

title: FedSSMCoOp: SSM Encoders for light-weight Federated Prompt Learning for Few-shot Classification
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance across a wide range of downstream vision tasks, thanks to the complementary information contained in the respective domains. Despite the performance gains, most of these approaches rely on aligning these domains using the cosine similarity metric, which fails to capture token-level structure and cross-modal interactions prior to the classification stage. This is especially critical in biomedical applications under federated constraints, where data sharing is restricted, labeled data is scarce at each site, and it differs widely across institutions, leading to substantial statistical heterogeneity. To overcome this issue, we propose FedSSMCoOp, a federated few-shot image classification framework that enables multimodal learning while preserving data privacy. With the help of the SSM-based Vision Mamba and Cross Mamba blocks, and by optimizing only the soft-prompt and communication-prompt updates in the federated setting, the framework prioritizes both computation and performance. Importantly, this eliminates the need to use an external Large Language Model (LLM) for feature alignment. The framework is further trained and evaluated on various biomedical image datasets, and its performance is assessed. The proposed framework delivers stable performance relative to the baselines and is, on average, 1.96 times lighter. The corresponding script will be made available soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FedSSMCoOp，一个面向联邦少样本图像分类的多模态学习框架，利用 SSM 视觉 Mamba 与 Cross Mamba 模块，仅优化软提示和通信提示，在保护隐私的同时提升生物医学图像分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型多依赖余弦相似度对齐跨模态特征，难以捕捉 token 级结构和分类前的跨模态交互；在联邦生物医学场景中，数据不能共享、标注稀缺且机构间分布差异大，统计异质性强，因此需要更高效且隐私保护的多模态联邦学习方法。
AI.method: 提出 FedSSMCoOp 联邦少样本图像分类框架，采用基于 SSM 的 Vision Mamba 和 Cross Mamba 模块进行多模态建模；在联邦设置下仅优化 soft-prompt 与 communication-prompt 更新，避免使用外部大语言模型进行特征对齐，从而兼顾计算效率与性能。
AI.result: 在多个生物医学图像数据集上训练和评估，所提框架相对基线表现稳定，并且平均轻量化约 1.96 倍。
AI.conclusion: FedSSMCoOp 能在联邦约束下有效进行多模态少样本生物医学图像分类，在保持隐私和降低计算开销的同时取得稳定性能，相关代码将公开。

title: VideoEvolve: Co-Evolving Memory and Retrieval for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding increasingly relies on external memory to organize massive visual streams into compact representations. However, most memory-based methods dynamically adapt how information is retrieved for different questions, while largely fixing what is remembered. This mismatch makes missing details costly to recover, whereas stored information is valuable only when it can be reliably retrieved. To address this issue, we propose VideoEvolve, a novel self-evolving framework that jointly evolves memory and retrieval for long video understanding. Specifically, starting from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, VideoEvolve couples a Memory Evolver for selective memory augmentation with a Retrieval Evolver for adaptive retrieval over the evolving memory. We then co-evolve the two Evolvers through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL), updating one while freezing the other. To steer this alternating evolution, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) identifies whether the current bottleneck lies in memory or retrieval and directs optimization toward the more limiting side. Furthermore, VideoEvolve introduces Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) to alleviate downstream feedback from over-specializing memory to a fixed set of training questions, shifting training toward underdeveloped yet learnable video capabilities. By integrating Agentic RL with BEF and CEF, VideoEvolve transforms downstream reasoning experience into transferable capability updates, providing a concrete path from static long-video systems toward experience-driven, self-improving multimodal intelligence. Extensive experiments on multiple long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoEvolve.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoEvolve，一种面向长视频理解的自我演化框架，通过联合演化记忆与检索模块，并利用智能体强化学习及两类反馈机制，将下游推理经验转化为可迁移能力，在多个长视频理解基准上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有基于外部记忆的长视频理解方法通常针对不同问题动态调整检索方式，但记忆内容基本固定，导致遗漏细节难以恢复，且存储信息只有在可可靠检索时才有价值。记忆与检索之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: VideoEvolve 从低帧率粗粒度概览出发，耦合记忆演化器（Memory Evolver）进行选择性记忆增强，以及检索演化器（Retrieval Evolver）在演化记忆上自适应检索。通过交替智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）共同演化二者，更新一个时冻结另一个。引入瓶颈感知演化反馈（BEF）判断当前瓶颈在记忆还是检索，并引导优化更受限的一侧；引入能力感知演化反馈（CEF）缓解下游反馈使记忆过度特化于固定训练问题，转向未充分发展但可学习的视频能力。
AI.result: 在多个长视频理解基准上的大量实验表明 VideoEvolve 有效。
AI.conclusion: VideoEvolve 将下游推理经验转化为可迁移的能力更新，为静态长视频系统迈向经验驱动、自我改进的多模态智能提供了具体路径。

title: From Pixel to Coding: Evaluating the Figure Reproduction Capabilities of MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in both visual understanding and code generation. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these two modalities in isolation, lacking a dedicated assessment of their unification, i.e., how a model can perceive complex visual structures and synthesize them into precise, executable code. Moreover, current visual code generation benchmarks often rely on simplified layouts within single programming environments, falling short of evaluating true unified multimodal reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose FigCodeBench, a comprehensive framework for rigorously evaluating MLLMs on figure reproduction, integrating multimodal comprehension and generation. We first design a systematic dataset construction pipeline, resulting in a total of 6,194 instances that cover 7 functional categories and 4 types of programming languages. We further categorize figure reproduction into three tiers with visual and code complexity modeling, specifically targeting complex structural reasoning, varying aspect ratios, and dense geometric constraints. We introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol, encompassing visual fidelity and syntactic isomorphism, that aligns highly with the Mean Machine Opinion Score (MMOS) and human preferences. Based on our framework, we conducted extensive experiments on 24 widely used proprietary and open-source MLLMs (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4, and Kimi-K2.5), where we observed a universal, non-linear performance cliff across different programming languages and difficulty scenarios for all models, and gained several insights, such as the significant metric decline in rigid declarative languages.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FigCodeBench，一个综合评估多模态大模型统一视觉理解与代码生成能力的基准框架，涵盖6194个实例、7类功能、4种编程语言，并在24个模型上实验揭示了跨语言和难度的非线性性能悬崖。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常孤立评估视觉理解或代码生成，缺乏对二者统一能力的专门评估；且当前视觉代码生成基准多依赖单一编程环境中的简化布局，无法评估真正的统一多模态推理。
AI.method: 设计系统化数据集构建流程，构建6194个实例，覆盖7个功能类别和4种编程语言；将图形复现按视觉与代码复杂度建模分为三层，针对复杂结构推理、不同纵横比和密集几何约束；提出多维评估协议（视觉保真度与句法同构性），与MMOS及人类偏好高度对齐；在24个主流专有与开源MLLM上开展实验。
AI.result: 所有模型在不同编程语言和难度场景下普遍出现非线性性能悬崖；获得若干洞见，例如在刚性声明式语言中指标显著下降。
AI.conclusion: FigCodeBench为严格评估MLLM的图形复现与统一多模态推理提供了全面框架，并揭示了当前模型在跨语言、跨难度场景下的共性局限。

title: Purifying Backdoored Large Vision-Language Models by Removing Hijacked Directions
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Defending against such attacks remains costly, as existing methods require either extensive retraining on clean data or per-query intervention at inference time. To address this limitation, we propose OrthoPurify, a more efficient method to purify backdoored model weights via one-step orthogonal projection. Specifically, through structural analysis of backdoor weight updates, we find that the backdoor is encoded by diverting a small number of weight update directions from task adaptation to backdoor shortcut encoding, a phenomenon we term direction hijacking. However, identifying these hijacked directions requires a benign reference model, which is typically inaccessible to the defender. We show that a pseudo-benign model, obtained by fine-tuning the pretrained weights on only a small set of clean samples, provides a sufficient approximation, as the dominant update directions stabilize within the first few gradient steps. OrthoPurify uses this pseudo-benign reference to isolate the hijacked directions and removes them through a single projection on the weight update. Extensive experiments show that OrthoPurify reduces the attack success rate to near zero while preserving the original performance across diverse benchmarks, without retraining the backdoored model or introducing inference-time overhead. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/womeimingzi/OrthoPurify.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OrthoPurify，一种通过一步正交投影高效净化后门 LVLM 权重的方法，无需重训练或推理时干预，可将攻击成功率降至接近零并保持原性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在安全关键场景中应用广泛，但仍易受后门攻击。现有防御方法成本高，要么需要大量干净数据重训练，要么需要在推理时逐查询干预。
AI.method: 作者从结构上分析后门权重更新，发现后门通过将少量权重更新方向从任务适配转向后门捷径编码，称为“方向劫持”。由于防御者通常无法获得良性参考模型，OrthoPurify 使用仅在小规模干净样本上微调预训练权重得到的伪良性模型作为近似参考，因为主要更新方向在前几步梯度中已稳定。随后利用该参考隔离被劫持方向，并通过一次正交投影从权重更新中移除后门。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，OrthoPurify 在多种基准上将攻击成功率降至接近零，同时保持原始性能，且无需重训练后门模型，也不引入推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: OrthoPurify 提供了一种高效、低成本的后门净化方案，证明通过伪良性参考和一步正交投影可有效消除 LVLM 中的后门，同时保持模型正常能力。

title: Perceptually Aligned Evaluation of Style Transfer
summary: Style transfer lacks a reliable evaluation standard: ground truth is inherently ill-defined, and existing automatic metrics often fail to reflect human preference. This paper introduces ASTRA (Assessment of Style TRansfer Algorithms), an approach for automatic evaluation of style transfer algorithms; it contains two components, ASTRA-Data and ASTRA-Score. ASTRA-Data consists of a benchmark image set of content and style references, a collection of style transfer results generated on the benchmark set, and user study data capturing human judgements through a two-stage pairwise comparison protocol. From these annotations, we derive ranking-based ground truth for content preservation, style fidelity, and overall preference. Based on ASTRA-Data, we construct ASTRA-Score, a learnt evaluator that predicts preference-aligned scores from content-style-stylization image triplets, enabling automatic and scalable evaluation of new models applied to the benchmark set. Experimental results demonstrate that ASTRA-Score achieves substantially higher correlation with human rankings compared to prior metrics. Overall, ASTRA establishes a robust mechanism for standardised evaluation of style transfer methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ASTRA，用于风格迁移算法的自动评估，包含基准数据集ASTRA-Data和可学习评分器ASTRA-Score，能更贴合人类偏好地评估风格迁移结果。
AI.motivation: 风格迁移缺乏可靠评价标准：真实参考结果本身难以定义，已有自动指标常无法反映人类偏好。
AI.method: 构建ASTRA-Data：包含内容与风格参考图、多种风格迁移结果，以及通过两阶段成对比较协议获得的人类判断数据，并据此生成内容保持、风格保真和整体偏好的排名式真值；再训练ASTRA-Score，从内容-风格-风格化图像三元组预测与偏好对齐的分数。
AI.result: 实验表明，ASTRA-Score与人类排名的相关性显著高于已有指标。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA为风格迁移方法提供了标准化、稳健的评估机制。

title: LoomSC: Scalable Deep Subspace Clustering with Projector Factorization and Exact Spectral Reduction
summary: Dense self-expression matrices and full-affinity spectral clustering limit the scalability of subspace clustering. We introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC), a framework that addresses both bottlenecks through projector factorization and exact spectral reduction. Motivated by the spectral structure of least-squares regression, LoomSC jointly learns latent features and a projector self-representation through two thin factors. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates preserve the sample factor's orthogonality while keeping the coefficient matrix implicit. We construct a nonnegative quadratic affinity that preserves the projector's support. An exact feature map then reduces its normalized spectral problem to an eigenproblem whose dimension depends only on the factor width. Neither the full affinity nor the sample Laplacian needs to be formed. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation and identifies conditions for subspace preservation and within-subspace connectivity. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 dataset-metric comparisons against 9 state-of-the-art baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 percentage points. Synthetic experiments scale to 500,000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8% accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LoomSC，一种用于子空间聚类的潜在正交优化模型，通过投影因子分解和精确谱降维，避免构造稠密自表达矩阵与全亲和矩阵，从而实现线性复杂度并可扩展到大样本。
AI.motivation: 稠密自表达矩阵和全亲和谱聚类限制了子空间聚类的可扩展性，因此需要同时解决计算与内存瓶颈。
AI.method: LoomSC 受最小二乘回归谱结构启发，联合学习潜在特征和投影自表示，使用两个薄因子；通过交替 Procrustes 与最小二乘更新保持样本因子正交并隐式表示系数矩阵；构造保持投影支撑的非负二次亲和，并用精确特征映射将归一化谱问题降为仅依赖因子宽度的特征问题；无需显式形成全亲和或样本拉普拉斯。
AI.result: 在五个图像聚类基准上，LoomSC 在 15 个数据集-指标比较中均排名第一或第二，平均准确率比最佳基线均值高 6.66 个百分点；合成实验扩展到 500,000 个样本，仍保持至少 99.8% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: 对于固定维度和迭代预算，LoomSC 完整流程在样本数量上具有线性时间和内存复杂度，并能在保持子空间结构与簇内连通性的条件下实现高效、可扩展的子空间聚类。

title: Do Generative Priors Align with Human Naturalness Perception?
summary: Visual generative models are trained to capture the probability distributions of natural images, yet whether their native priors reflect the regularities governing human perception of image naturalness remains an open question. Here, we probe these priors through native prediction errors across 25 open image and video generators. Because raw single-image losses are dominated by scene content and visual complexity, we evaluate directional loss differences using content-preserving, paired relational interventions that selectively disrupt facial configurations or physical illumination consistency while limiting changes in low-level image statistics. Across both domains, these loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances, capturing the classic Thatcher effect on faces and shape-dependent responses to illumination inconsistencies. Notably, these loss differences reliably track continuous gradations of human naturalness judgments across individual stimulus pairs (peaking at $r = .84$ on faces and $.64$ on physical scenes) and retain unique human-aligned signals even after controlling for feature distances from frozen vision encoders and standard image quality metrics. We also find that while overall sensitivity to these violations broadly covaries with human alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity, revealing that human-like naturalness judgments dissociate from generic violation detection. Together, these findings demonstrate that learning visual distributions yields generative loss landscapes that capture distinct aspects of human naturalness perception.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过25个开源图像和视频生成模型的原生预测误差，探究生成模型的先验是否反映人类对图像自然性的感知规律，发现成对关系干预下的损失差异能捕捉类似人类的选择性敏感度与容忍度。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成模型学习自然图像分布，但其原生先验是否反映支配人类自然性感知的规律尚不清楚；同时，原始单图损失常受场景内容和视觉复杂度主导，难以直接解读。
AI.method: 使用25个开源图像和视频生成器，采用内容保持的成对关系干预，分别破坏人脸构型或物理光照一致性，并控制低层图像统计变化；通过方向性损失差异评估模型先验，并与人类自然性判断、冻结视觉编码器特征距离和标准图像质量指标进行比较，还分析去噪调度中的表现。
AI.result: 损失差异再现了人类的选择性敏感度和容忍度，包括人脸撒切尔效应和光照不一致的形状依赖反应；其能追踪连续的人类自然性判断，人脸相关系数最高达r=.84，物理场景达.64，并在控制编码器特征和图像质量指标后仍保留独特的人类对齐信号。总体敏感度与人类对齐在模型间广泛协变，但在去噪调度中系统性解耦，对齐峰值早于敏感度。
AI.conclusion: 学习视觉分布会使生成损失景观捕捉人类自然性感知的不同方面；人类式的自然性判断与一般违规检测可分离，生成模型的原生先验部分反映了人类感知图像自然性的规律。

title: Performance at What Cost? A Sustainability-Aware Performance Index for Cell and Nucleus Instance Segmentation
summary: Pretrained models for cell and nuclear instance segmentation differ substantially in architecture, pretraining data and objectives, parameter count, inference strategy, adaptation requirements, postprocessing pipeline, and computational demand. Large pretrained and foundation models are increasingly adopted because of their strong zero-shot capabilities, but their use also imposes greater energy consumption, memory requirements, computational demands, adaptation costs, and operational carbon emissions. Whether these additional demands are justified by meaningful gains in segmentation performance remains unclear. We address this question by introducing the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI), a configurable metric that combines segmentation performance, energy consumption, and model size. We benchmark 19 pretrained and foundation models across six CellBinDB datasets under zero-shot inference and evaluate 16 fine-tunable models using few-shot adaptation with both frozen encoder and full-model fine-tuning. We estimate energy consumption for GPU, CPU, and RAM using software-based monitoring tools. Our results show that larger and more computationally demanding models do not consistently achieve proportionate improvements in segmentation quality. While few-shot adaptation benefits several models, the gains and resource costs vary considerably across architectures, datasets, and adaptation strategies, causing SAPI-based rankings to differ from rankings based on performance alone. This study provides a practical framework for comparing segmentation models more comprehensively and supports more computationally accessible and environmentally responsible model selection in biomedical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可持续性感知性能指数（SAPI），综合分割性能、能耗与模型规模，对多种细胞与细胞核实例分割预训练模型进行基准评测，发现更大、更耗算力的模型未必带来成比例的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练模型和基础模型虽具有强零样本能力，但会带来更高能耗、内存、计算需求、适配成本和碳排放，因此需要判断其额外代价是否能由分割性能提升所证明。
AI.method: 提出可配置的SAPI指标，融合分割性能、能耗和模型大小；在六个CellBinDB数据集上对19个预训练/基础模型进行零样本推理评测，并对16个可微调模型进行少样本适配，包括冻结编码器和全模型微调；使用软件监控工具估算GPU、CPU和RAM能耗。
AI.result: 更大、计算需求更高的模型并未持续获得成比例的分割质量提升；少样本适配对部分模型有益，但收益和资源成本因架构、数据集和适配策略而异，导致基于SAPI的排名与仅基于性能的排名不同。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了更全面比较分割模型的实用框架，有助于在生物医学图像分析中选择计算上更可及、环境上更负责任的模型。

title: MSU Team at the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026: Grounded Artifact Evidence for Deepfake Detection
summary: Recent advances in generative image models have made many manipulated images highly realistic, raising the need for detectors that are not only accurate but also able to provide visual evidence for their decisions. In this paper, we present our solution to the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge [2] on the XPlainVerse dataset [1], where systems are required to predict whether an image is real or fake and generate both complex and simple explanations grounded in visible forensic cues. Our method follows a modular detection-and-explanation design. For the real/fake decision, we build a multi-backbone detector that combines several DINOv3 models with Mesorch manipulation-localization features, bringing together pretrained visual representations, DCT-aware cues, and multi-scale forensic information. To inject explanation evidence into the detector, we use a Grounding-DINO-based pseudo-mask generation pipeline that converts local artifact descriptions from training explanations into weak patch- level supervision for an Artifact Evidence Map. We further introduce a local patch-level contrastive objective that separates artifact and authenticity evidence in the detector feature space without requiring paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks. For language output, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models to generate complex explanations for fake and real predictions, followed by a GRPO-optimized text simplification model. The proposed methods were trained and evaluated on the challenge subset of XPlainVerse. On the full test split, our submission achieves 0.9349 detection accuracy, 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模块化的可解释深度伪造检测方案，用于 XPlainVerse 挑战，同时完成真伪判断并生成复杂与简单解释，在测试集上取得 0.9349 检测准确率和 0.7456 最终挑战分数。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像模型使伪造图像高度逼真，检测器不仅需要准确，还需提供基于可见取证线索的视觉解释证据，以满足可解释深度伪造检测需求。
AI.method: 采用检测与解释分离的模块化设计。检测端使用多骨干检测器，结合多个 DINOv3 模型与 Mesorch 篡改定位特征，融合预训练视觉表示、DCT 线索和多尺度取证信息；通过基于 Grounding-DINO 的伪掩码生成流程，将训练解释中的局部伪影描述转为弱 patch 级监督，构建 Artifact Evidence Map；引入局部 patch 级对比目标，在特征空间分离伪影与真实性证据；语言端使用类条件 Qwen3-VL 生成真假预测的复杂解释，并用 GRPO 优化的文本简化模型生成简单解释。
AI.result: 在 XPlainVerse 挑战子集上训练和评估，完整测试集上达到 0.9349 检测准确率、0.5571 解释分数和 0.7456 最终挑战分数。
AI.conclusion: 所提模块化检测与解释方法能有效用于可解释深度伪造检测，在真伪判别和解释生成方面均取得较好表现。

title: AdSpark: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Product-Centric Advertisement Video Generation
summary: Product-centric advertisement video generation aims to create promotional videos that preserve fine-grained product identity while presenting selling points through coherent multi-shot narratives. However, this emerging task remains underexplored due to the lack of large-scale advertisement-specific datasets and comprehensive evaluation frameworks. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{AdSpark}, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for product-centric advertisement video generation, based on data from a major e-commerce platform. \textit{AdSpark-300K} contains approximately 300K reference image--prompt--video triplets, comprising a real-world subset and a synthetic subset. Each sample provides structured advertisement annotations, including product identity annotations, selling-point descriptions, creative plans, and aligned audio scripts, enabling models to learn product preservation and advertisement-oriented visual storytelling. We further propose \textit{AdSpark-Bench}, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates generated advertisements across six dimensions, including visual quality, product fidelity, instruction adherence, temporal coherence, audio alignment, and advertisement effectiveness. Based on AdSpark-Bench, we evaluate representative models, revealing key challenges in product preservation, multi-shot storytelling, and selling-point visualization. Experiments with AdSpark-300K-finetuned models further validate the effectiveness of our dataset. AdSpark provides a unified dataset and benchmark for future research, and we will release the dataset upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AdSpark，一个面向产品中心广告视频生成的大规模数据集和基准，包含约30万参考图像-提示-视频三元组，以及一个六维诊断评估基准AdSpark-Bench，旨在推动该领域研究。
AI.motivation: 产品中心广告视频生成任务尚未被充分探索，主要缺乏大规模广告专用数据集和全面的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建AdSpark-300K数据集，包含约30万参考图像-提示-视频三元组（真实和合成子集），并提供结构化广告标注（产品身份、卖点描述、创意计划、对齐音频脚本）。提出AdSpark-Bench基准，从视觉质量、产品保真度、指令遵循、时序连贯性、音频对齐和广告效果六个维度评估生成广告。基于该基准评估代表性模型，并微调模型验证数据集有效性。
AI.result: AdSpark-300K包含约30万三元组，评估揭示了产品保持、多镜头叙事和卖点可视化方面的关键挑战。使用AdSpark-300K微调的模型进一步验证了数据集的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AdSpark为未来研究提供了统一的数据集和基准，并将在论文接收后发布数据集。

title: Scalable Patch-Level Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) at scale produces powerful visual representations. However, most scalable SSL methods rely on ad hoc combinations of multiple objectives and stabilization mechanisms. Taking a step back, we ask if we can design a high-performing, yet principled SSL algorithm. Starting from the multi-view assumption, stipulating that task-relevant content is captured by the information common to different views, we construct an information-theoretic objective decomposing into interpretable terms. This derivation yields JEM, a student-teacher method that learns by aligning corresponding patch representations across views, explicitly regularized by information and structure preservation losses. JEM trains stably from 300M to 7B parameters, and, to our knowledge, is the first latent-space patch-level method demonstrated at 7B scale. Across all scales, JEM reaches strong performance on both global and dense probing tasks, on segmentation benchmarks consistently surpassing the DINOv2 algorithm, an influential foundation for today's strongest visual SSL methods. Notably, at 7B parameters, it exceeds the performance of DINOv3 on panoptic segmentation, despite being trained on $12\times$ less data without refinement stages. These results demonstrate that we can indeed design an SSL algorithm that learns strong representations, is principled and stable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出JEM，一种基于信息论原则的自监督学习算法。它从多视角假设出发，将目标分解为可解释项，通过学生-教师模型对齐不同视角的patch表示，并施加信息与结构保持正则。JEM可从300M稳定训练到7B参数，在全局和密集探测任务上表现强劲，分割任务持续超过DINOv2，7B模型在全景分割上超过DINOv3，且训练数据少12倍且无精调阶段。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模自监督学习方法多依赖多个目标的临时组合和稳定化机制，缺乏原则性。作者希望设计一个既有高性能又原理清晰、稳定可扩展的自监督学习算法。
AI.method: 从多视角假设出发，即任务相关信息存在于不同视角共有的信息中，构建一个可分解为可解释项的信息论目标。由此得到JEM：一种学生-教师方法，通过跨视角对齐对应patch表示来学习，并由信息保持和结构保持损失显式正则化。
AI.result: JEM可从300M稳定训练到7B参数，是首个在7B规模验证的潜在空间patch级方法。各规模下在全局和密集探测任务上均表现强劲；在分割基准上持续超过DINOv2。尤其在7B参数下，其全景分割性能超过DINOv3，尽管训练数据少12倍且没有精调阶段。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可以设计出一种既能学习强表示、又具有原则性和稳定性的自监督学习算法。

title: Temporal Residual Bottleneck for Robust Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception extends the sensing range of autonomous vehicles, but its performance degrades when shared features arrive stale or incomplete. Most latency-robust methods compensate delayed collaborator features through flow-guided alignment or direct feature transport. In this work, we formulate asynchronous collaborative perception as temporal residual prediction. Our Temporal Residual Bottleneck keeps a deterministic pose-warped collaborator feature as a conservative anchor and uses a $Δt$-conditioned xLSTM to extract residual temporal evidence from the available history. A detector-facing residual bottleneck then applies only gated, regularized corrections before ego-side fusion, reducing the risk of overwriting reliable static structure when temporal correspondence is uncertain. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and OPV2V show that our method is especially effective under severe fixed/irregular delays and packet drops. On DAIR-V2X, the reported checkpoint trades a small amount of synchronized peak accuracy for better robustness under stronger communication degradation. Controlled diagnostics further indicate that direct feature transport has oracle headroom but can become unreliable when deployed without accurate correspondence. These results support temporal residual fusion as a practical alternative for asynchronous and incomplete collaborative perception. Code will be publicly released at https://url.fzi.de/8dk38.

AI.tldr: 本文将异步协同感知建模为时序残差预测，提出时序残差瓶颈：以位姿变换后的协作者特征作为保守锚点，用 Δt 条件化的 xLSTM 从历史中提取残差时序证据，并在自车融合前仅施加门控、正则化的修正。在 DAIR-V2X 和 OPV2V 上，该方法在严重固定/不规则延迟与丢包下更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 协同感知可扩展自动驾驶感知范围，但共享特征延迟或不完整时性能下降。现有延迟鲁棒方法多通过光流引导对齐或直接特征传输来补偿延迟协作者特征，在通信退化严重且对应关系不准确时可能不可靠。
AI.method: 将异步协同感知公式化为时序残差预测。设计 Temporal Residual Bottleneck，保留确定性的位姿变换协作者特征作为保守锚点，并使用由 Δt 条件化的 xLSTM 从可用历史中提取残差时序证据。检测器侧的残差瓶颈在自车融合前仅应用门控、正则化的修正，以降低在时序对应不确定时覆盖可靠静态结构的风险。
AI.result: 在 DAIR-V2X 和 OPV2V 数据集上，方法在严重固定/不规则延迟和丢包场景下尤为有效。在 DAIR-V2X 上，所报告检查点以少量同步峰值精度换取更强通信退化下的鲁棒性。受控诊断表明，直接特征传输具有 oracle 上限空间，但若无准确对应关系，部署时可能不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将时序残差融合作为异步且不完整协同感知的一种实用替代方案。代码将公开于 https://url.fzi.de/8dk38。

title: Playing with Kruskal: algorithms for flat and hierarchical watershed cuts
summary: In the framework of edge-weighted graphs, watersheds have proven to be linked to well-known optimization problems, as Minimum Spanning Tree, which allowed the design of efficient algorithms for computing (hierarchical) watershed segmentations. In the present article, after reviewing the literature related to watershed segmentation, we present a detailed end-to-end pipeline of algorithms to compute (hierarchical) watershed segmentations, starting from the computation of graph-based image representations, up to the computation of connected components of the final (hierarchical) segmentation. We consider the several variations of watersheds, including their supervised and unsupervised versions, and the various ways of computing seeds, to name a few. For the first time, we bring together all these watershed notions and algorithms in a compact and understandable way. We aim at providing a reference for those interested in employing and reimplementing the watershed segmentation framework for their task at hand.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了分水岭分割，并提出了一个从基于图的图像表示到最终分割连通组件的端到端算法流程，涵盖了监督/无监督分水岭及种子计算等变体，旨在为相关任务提供参考。
AI.motivation: 为了将分水岭分割的各种概念和算法首次紧凑、易懂地汇集在一起，为有兴趣应用和重新实现该框架的研究者提供参考。
